k6w60k0.en: Game-development tools, built for the age of AI.
k6w60k0.zh: 为 AI 时代,做游戏开发的工具。

k1mt21yc.en: ForgeaX is an AI-native personal game studio. We believe the barrier to making games is being redefined by AI.
k1mt21yc.zh: ForgeaX 是一个 AI 原生的个人游戏工作室。我们相信:做游戏的门槛,正在被 AI 重新定义。

k157x7ue.en: Our vision is direct: let smaller teams, with AI, make games that used to require much larger ones. Not to replace creators, but to hand the heavy engineering and production between "idea" and "playable game" to AI.
k157x7ue.zh: 我们的愿景很直接 —— 让更小的团队,借助 AI,做出过去需要更大团队才能完成的游戏。不是取代创作者,而是把"把想法变成可玩游戏"中间那一大段繁重的工程与制作,交给 AI 去扛。

kuebe2a.en: In the studio you describe the game you want to an AI lead called Forge — through chat, by working directly in a visual editor, and (later) with inputs like images and video. It plans, brings in specialized sub-agents when needed (gameplay, design, art…), then writes the engine code itself, hot-reloading the result into a live browser preview.
kuebe2a.zh: 你在工作室里向一个叫 Forge 的 AI 主创描述你想要的游戏 —— 可以用对话,也可以在可视化编辑器里直接动手,未来还会支持图片、视频等更多输入。它会规划、必要时叫上各司其职的子 agent(玩法、设计、美术……),然后自己编写引擎代码,结果实时热重载到浏览器预览里。

k1teqe1x.en: Underneath are two in-house foundations: an engine redesigned for the AI's point of view (so AI can read it, write it, and understand its errors), and a development loop that holds AI to a correct, verifiable result (requirements in, playable output out, every step observable and traceable).
k1teqe1x.zh: 这背后有两块自研的底座:一个为 AI 视角重新设计的游戏引擎(让 AI 读得懂、写得动、错得明白),和一套引导 AI 持续收敛到正确结果的开发流程(需求进、可玩产物出,中间每一步可观测、可回溯)。

kicu10l.en: An AI-native engine — a TypeScript ECS engine with dual-RHI rendering (WebGPU + a wasm backend), PBR/IBL/SSAO, 2D/3D physics, glTF/FBX assets and skeletal animation. Its APIs, errors and state are shaped for AI to read and write.
kicu10l.zh: 一个 AI 原生引擎 —— TypeScript 写的 ECS 引擎,双 RHI 渲染(WebGPU + 一套 wasm 后端)、PBR/IBL/SSAO 渲染、2D/3D 物理、glTF/FBX 资产与骨骼动画。它的 API、错误与状态都为 AI 读写而设计。

k18vj1j4.en: A self-evolving dev loop (the ForgeaX closed loop) — a seven-step pipeline (requirements → research → plan → implement → verify → judgment → finalize) driven by an orchestrator and role-specialized sub-agents, with AI review and a sandbox that actually runs and screenshots each build; it learns from its own feedback and grows steadier over time.
k18vj1j4.zh: 自进化开发闭环(ForgeaX closed loop) —— 七步闭环(需求 → 研究 → 计划 → 实现 → 验证 → 验收 → 合入),由编排者驱动一组角色化子 agent,内置 AI 评审与"真跑 + 截图"的沙箱验证;它吃自己的反馈持续进化,越跑越稳。

k1kf5zj1.en: AI-native gameplay — not just making games with AI, but building AI into the play itself: intelligent NPCs, generative content, interactive AI experiences.
k1kf5zj1.zh: AI 原生玩法 —— 不止用 AI 做游戏,还支持把 AI 做进玩法本身:智能 NPC、生成式内容、可交互的 AI 体验。

k1yb9fj0.en: The studio & editor — a chat panel beside a live preview, and a visual scene editor whose edits flow straight back into the running game, on web or as a desktop app.
k1yb9fj0.zh: 工作室与编辑器 —— 对话区紧挨实时预览,可视化场景编辑器的改动直接回流到运行中的游戏;网页或桌面应用皆可。

kpab0dj.en: An agent team & creation tools — named agents for production, gameplay, design, narrative, art and coding, plus a marketplace of workbenches that generate characters, animation, 3D models, VFX, UI, music and more.
kpab0dj.zh: Agent 团队与创作工具 —— 制作、玩法、设计、叙事、美术、编码各有命名 agent;还有一整套工作台插件,生成角色、动画、3D 模型、特效、UI、音乐等。

kfmkc4a.en: The current stage is turning ideas into playable games with AI: we can already make playable FPS, ARPG, survival and shooter demos in the studio, with an engine covering PBR rendering, physics and skeletal animation. We'll keep polishing this stage toward shippable quality.
kfmkc4a.zh: 当前阶段是 用 AI 把想法做成可玩游戏:已经能在工作室里做出 FPS、ARPG、生存、射击等多款可玩 demo,引擎覆盖了 PBR 渲染、物理、骨骼动画等能力。这一阶段会持续打磨,把"AI 写出能出货的游戏"推进到更高的完成度。

k1ub9l19.en: The ForgeaX tool layer is licensed under Apache License 2.0 — anyone can freely fork, use, build commercially, and redistribute. We want it to be an open project the community can build together. See the license page.
k1ub9l19.zh: ForgeaX 的工具层采用 Apache License 2.0 —— 任何人都可以自由 fork、使用、商用与二次发布。我们希望它成为一个开放、可被社区共建的项目。详见 版权说明。

ksvmorx.en: Let smaller teams make bigger games.
ksvmorx.zh: 让更小的团队,做出更大的游戏。

k1ga91b2.en: ForgeaX keeps a multi-repo structure: each subsystem is its own repository under the GitHub org ForgeaX-Games. All repositories are open source (Apache-2.0) and ready to clone.
k1ga91b2.zh: ForgeaX 沿用多仓结构,每个子系统是一个独立仓库,集中在 GitHub 组织 ForgeaX-Games 下。所有仓库均已开源(Apache-2.0),可直接克隆。

kszuekl.en: The AI-native ECS engine (rendering / physics / assets / animation).
kszuekl.zh: AI 原生 ECS 游戏引擎(渲染 / 物理 / 资产 / 动画)。

k89xaa6.en: The agent kernel / CLI (orchestration, sessions, swappable backends).
k89xaa6.zh: 智能体内核 / 命令行(编排、会话、可换芯)。

kso0my0.en: The studio runtime (chat / fs / ws / HMR).
kso0my0.zh: 工作室运行时(chat / fs / ws / HMR)。

k1g384zu.en: Studio UI + scene editor + desktop shell.
k1g384zu.zh: Studio UI + 场景编辑器 + 桌面壳。

k1wvems7.en: The plugin marketplace; workbench repos are forgeax-wb-*.
k1wvems7.zh: 插件市场;工作台仓命名 forgeax-wb-*。

kmfmksl.en: Game demos and the shared library.
kmfmksl.zh: 游戏 demo 与共享游戏库。

k1f7y08z.en: The umbrella repo — a one-command studio.
k1f7y08z.zh: 总集成仓 —— 一键启动工作室。

kqm0uju.en: Questions, partnership ideas, or interested in joining the team? Write to us — we read every message.
kqm0uju.zh: 有疑问、想合作,或想加入团队?给我们写信 —— 每一封我们都会认真读。

k1k73c01.en: Usage, bugs, feature ideas — anything is welcome.
k1k73c01.zh: 用法、bug、功能建议 —— 任何想法都欢迎。

kofwuh4.en: Integrations, co-building, partnerships — lets explore it together.
kofwuh4.zh: 集成、共建、商务合作 —— 一起聊聊可能性。

k10824ke.en: Believe in AI-native game dev? Bring your work and reach out.
k10824ke.zh: 认同 AI 原生的游戏开发?带上你的作品来找我们。

km5njt.en: Or just email us directly: forgeax@outlook.com

k1qxv8c9.en: How AI gets a feature right
k1qxv8c9.zh: AI 是怎么把一个功能做对的

k1g8lpnn.en: AI doesn't get things right in one shot. ForgeaX uses an observable, traceable pipeline that guides each feature to a correct result, step by step.
k1g8lpnn.zh: AI 不是靠"一次写对"的。ForgeaX 用一条可观测、可回溯的流水线,让每个功能一步步收敛到正确。

k1n7hu49.en: Inside the engine, every feature goes through the same pipeline — requirements in, a working result out, with a readable record at each step:
k1n7hu49.zh: 在引擎内部,每个功能都经过同一条流水线 —— 需求进、可用产物出,中间每一步都留下可读的记录:

k10iqum6.en: Requirements — state what to build, with acceptance criteria.
k10iqum6.zh: 需求 —— 把要做什么写清楚,带验收标准。

k166yxcm.zh: 研究 —— 查历史、约束与可选方案。

k1bkirk6.en: Plan — set a strategy and break it into tasks.
k1bkirk6.zh: 计划 —— 定策略,拆成可执行任务。

ky7pqqp.en: Verify — independent checks; any red blocks the merge.
ky7pqqp.zh: 验证 —— 多方独立检查,任一不过就拦下。

kmh8bfi.en: Judgment — a human makes the final call.

k1jew2sc.en: An "orchestrator" drives the state machine, deciding which sub-agent to dispatch at each step and checking its output; sub-agents are role-specialized with their own context. Humans inject judgment at just two points: stating requirements and reviewing results.
k1jew2sc.zh: 一个"编排者"推进这条状态机,决定每一步派哪个子 agent、并检查它的产物;子 agent 各有角色、各自独立上下文。人类只在两个出入点注入判断:提需求和做验收。

kj5wazd.zh: 不让"看起来过了"溜过去

kjkxlw1.en: Verification has two AI gates: one statically scans docs and APIs from an AI user's perspective, catching "promised but not implemented"; the other actually runs the demo in an isolated sandbox, captures screenshots, and re-checks them — guarding against "tests green, screen black."
kjkxlw1.zh: 验证步里有两道 AI 关卡:一个以 AI 用户视角静态扫文档与 API,抓"承诺了却没实现";另一个在隔离沙箱里真跑 demo、截图,再回头核对画面对不对 —— 防止"测试假绿、画面却是黑的"。

k7yyefl.en: After each feature, the friction encountered along the way is captured as feedback that upgrades the pipeline itself. The next feature automatically uses the improved version — the pipeline feeds on its own output and gets smarter.
k7yyefl.zh: 每个功能跑完,过程里遇到的痛点会沉淀成反馈,反过来升级流水线本身。下一个功能自动用上更新后的版本 —— 流水线吃自己的产物,越跑越懂。

k1lszlsr.en: The result: AI produces not "demo-grade" code, but verified, replayable features a human can take over.
k1lszlsr.zh: 结果是:AI 写出来的不是"demo 级"代码,而是经过验证、可重放、能被人接手的功能。

k5la37v.zh: 延伸阅读:为什么做 AI 原生引擎 →

kb87x71.en: Thinking on how AI builds games, milestone retrospectives and deep-dives — the human perspective and judgment. For the AI's day-by-day record of building this engine itself, see the changelog (its long-term development memory).
kb87x71.zh: 关于"AI 怎么做游戏"的思考、里程碑回顾与深度文章 —— 偏人的视角与判断。想看 AI 逐日自建这套引擎的流水账,见更新日志(它的长期开发记忆)。

krtlgqg.zh: 为什么要做一个 AI 原生引擎

k1sa7yeo.en: When AI is the engine's first user, the API, error messages and state should be redesigned for its point of view. A few concrete choices we made.
k1sa7yeo.zh: 当 AI 成为引擎的第一用户,API、错误信息、状态形态都应该为 AI 的视角重新设计。这篇聊聊我们为此做的几个具体取舍。

k1pqr8a1.en: Not by getting it right first try, but with an observable, traceable pipeline: requirements → research → plan → implement → verify → judgment → finalize.
k1pqr8a1.zh: 不靠"一次写对",而是用一条可观测、可回溯的流水线,让它逐步收敛到正确:需求 → 研究 → 计划 → 实现 → 验证 → 验收 → 合入。

k1m0b4j1.en: Most game-engine APIs are written for humans. When AI becomes the one writing the code, the engine should look different.
k1m0b4j1.zh: 大多数游戏引擎的 API 是给人写的。当写代码的主力变成 AI,引擎就该换一种长法。

k1xwsgng.en: ForgeaX's core idea is simple: the user describes a game, and AI writes the engine code. That sounds like "just a different author," but in practice existing engines aren't friendly to AI — they assume a reader who reads docs, guesses, and fills in context like a human does.
k1xwsgng.zh: ForgeaX 的核心是:用户描述游戏,AI 来写引擎代码。这听起来只是"换个人写代码",但真正做下去会发现,现成引擎对 AI 并不友好 —— 它们假设的读者是一个能看文档、能猜、能脑补上下文的人类。

k9r2gyl.en: Our stance is blunt: AI is the engine's first user. When "friendly to AI" conflicts with "friendly to humans," AI wins. Here are a few concrete consequences.
k9r2gyl.zh: 我们的取舍很简单:AI 是引擎的第一用户。当"对 AI 友好"和"对人友好"冲突时,优先 AI。下面是几个具体的做法。

kuo0bs4.en: 1 · One source of truth, derive the rest
kuo0bs4.zh: 一、单一可信源,其余派生

kybu6l2.en: A fact is defined in exactly one place; everything else derives from it. Component fields, for instance, live inline in a schema — inspectors, debuggers and tooling read the schema instead of grepping source and guessing. AI doesn't need to "remember" conventions scattered everywhere, because there's only one place to look.
kybu6l2.zh: 同一个事实只有一处定义,其他地方都从它派生。比如组件的字段定义内联在 schema 里,inspector、调试器、工具链直接读 schema,而不是去 grep 源码瞎猜。AI 不需要"记住"散落各处的约定,因为约定只有一处。

k1ag3h38.en: 2 · Errors AI can understand and recover from
k1ag3h38.zh: 二、错误要让 AI 看得懂、能恢复

kgnh79n.en: An error isn't just a human sentence you throw. We use a closed set of error codes, each carrying structured "what / why / how to recover" info. When AI hits an error, it knows what to change next — instead of treating the exception text as mysticism.
kgnh79n.zh: 错误不是 throw 一句人话就完事。我们用闭包的错误码,每个错误自带"这是什么、为什么、怎么恢复"的结构化信息。AI 拿到错误,能直接知道下一步该改哪里,而不是把异常文本当成玄学。

k45f3uw.en: 3 · Structured data instead of "look at the screen"
k45f3uw.zh: 三、用结构化数据代替"看显示器"

k8qqdy2.en: The hardest part of a rendering bug is that "it looks wrong on screen." A human can stare at the monitor; AI can't. So the engine can capture a frame of render calls — draw calls, bindings, render targets, pipeline state — to read offline, replay, and inspect the full state at the Nth draw. A visual problem becomes data AI can Read.
k8qqdy2.zh: 渲染 bug 最难的地方在于"它在屏幕上看起来不对"。人可以盯着显示器调,AI 不行。所以引擎支持把一帧的渲染调用录下来 —— draw call、绑定、渲染目标、管线状态都能离线读取、重放、定位到第 N 次绘制时的完整状态。视觉问题被转成了 AI 能 Read 的数据。

kgkkq2b.en: 4 · Two implementations that check each other

kq32re8.en: The render layer has two backend implementations (WebGPU and a wasm one) behind a single interface. They render side by side: the moment AI misuses an engine API, the other backend immediately diverges, surfacing the problem — far faster than waiting for a human review.
kq32re8.zh: 渲染层有两套后端实现(WebGPU 与一套 wasm 实现),走同一套接口。它们同时出图:一旦 AI 把引擎 API 用错了,另一套后端会立刻表现出不一致,问题随即暴露。这比"等人来 review"快得多。

k3ngyh8.en: These designs share one yardstick: the fewer concepts a reader (human or AI) must hold in their head, the better. The more self-consistent and locally-indexable the API, the more often AI gets it right — and the easier it is for a human to take over.
k3ngyh8.zh: 这些设计有一个共同的衡量标准:读者(无论人还是 AI)要装进脑子里的概念越少越好。API 越自洽、越能就地索引,AI 写对的概率就越高,人来接手时也越省心。

k1jxh8ss.en: "AI-native" isn't a slogan — it's a long series of "redo it for the AI's point of view" decisions. We'll unpack more of them in the docs and future posts.
k1jxh8ss.zh: AI 原生不是一句口号,而是一连串"为 AI 视角重做一遍"的具体决定。我们会在文档和后续更新里,把这些逐步展开。

kkd7e86.en: Day one pours the hardest part of the foundation: a working WebGPU shader pipeline, the rendering device layer taken over end to end, a cross-environment GPU-memory lifecycle hotfix, and a chat agent that is concurrency-safe with sturdier input. Everything tall starts from lighting the first pixel correctly in a browser.
kkd7e86.zh: 第一天就把最硬的那块地基浇下去:一条能跑的 WebGPU 着色器管线、完整承接的渲染设备层、一个跨环境的显存生命周期热修,以及一个并发安全、输入更扛得住的聊天 agent。万丈高楼,从能在浏览器里正确点亮第一个像素开始。

k3b79w8.en: Why day one starts from the rendering foundation
k3b79w8.zh: 为什么第一天从渲染地基开始

k19uf6oc.en: This is day one of the platform's public record. For a platform where "you chat and a game appears," one thing must hold true at the very bottom: the browser has to render 3D — genuinely and stably. So day one wasn't about piling on a flashy interface; it put all the effort into the hardest part, the rendering foundation: building a rendering pipeline directly on the browser's next-generation graphics capability (WebGPU) in-house, rather than wrapping an off-the-shelf general library. That path is harder and slower at first — many details others have packaged away must be walked through ourselves, and the pitfalls filled one by one. But it decides whether image quality, performance and features stay in our own hands later, instead of being throttled by an upstream library's trade-offs. Today's deliverables are really different faces of one big thing — "lighting the first pixel correctly in a browser." Getting this most-underestimated, least-compromisable thing solid first is what gives every later dream of "generating games by conversation" a place to stand.
k19uf6oc.zh: 这是整个平台公开记录里的第一天。一个"聊着天就能做出游戏"的平台,最底下必须先有一件事能成立:浏览器里要能真正、稳定地把 3D 画面画出来。所以第一天没有去堆花哨的界面,而是把精力全压在最硬的渲染地基上——直接基于浏览器新一代图形能力(WebGPU)自研一套渲染管线,而不是借现成的通用库套个壳。这条路一开始更难、更慢:很多别人封装好的细节都得自己重走一遍,踩的坑也得自己一个个填。但它决定了之后画质、性能、特性是不是都掌握在自己手里,而不是被上游库的取舍卡住脖子。今天交付的几件事,合起来其实是同一件大事的不同侧面——"让第一个像素在浏览器里被正确点亮"。把这件最容易被低估、却最不能将就的事先做扎实,后面"对话生成游戏"的所有想象才有立足之地。

kik2lui.en: A working shader pipeline: WGSL + a shader-compile shim + simplified PBR
kik2lui.zh: 着色器管线跑通:WGSL + 着色器编译垫片 + 简化 PBR

k2bt8f6.en: The core of rendering is the shader — the little program that tells the GPU "what color each pixel should be." This day wired a whole shader pipeline together: written in the browser graphics standard's shader language (WGSL), paired with a compile shim that turns shader source into a GPU-executable format in place, plus a simplified physically-based shading (PBR) implementation. "Physically based" means materials react to light by real-world rules — metal looks like metal, plastic like plastic, not a colored paper cutout. This simplified PBR deliberately uses a lean resource-binding structure (just three bind groups) to stay light while keeping the image believable — easy to understand and easy to extend. The compile shim matters especially: WebGPU doesn't directly consume high-level shader source, so a translation step into a lower-level format is needed in between, and solving it in the browser is what makes "write a shader and immediately see the result" possible. From this day, the engine no longer merely tints triangles; it renders objects that are lit and have material — the key first step from "can draw" to "draws correctly," and the right starting point for all the richer materials and lighting to follow.
k2bt8f6.zh: 渲染的核心是着色器——告诉显卡"每个像素该是什么颜色"的小程序。这天把一整条着色器管线打通:用浏览器图形标准的着色器语言(WGSL)来写,配上一个能把着色器源码就地编译成显卡可执行格式的"编译垫片",再实现了一套简化版的基于物理的着色(PBR)。"基于物理"意味着材质对光的反应遵循真实世界的规律——金属看起来像金属、塑料看起来像塑料,而不是一块涂了颜色的纸片。这套简化 PBR 刻意用了精炼的资源绑定结构(只用三组绑定),在保证画面可信的前提下尽量轻,既好理解也好扩展。"编译垫片"这一步尤其关键:WebGPU 自身不直接吃高级着色器源码,中间需要一道把源码翻译成底层格式的工序,把它在浏览器里就地解决,才让"写一段着色器就能直接看到效果"成为可能。从这天起,引擎不再只是能给三角形涂个颜色,而是能把"被光照亮、带材质质感的物体"渲染出来——这是从"能画"迈向"画得对"的关键第一步,也为后面所有更复杂的材质、光照效果定下了正确的起点。

kk6fplx.en: The rendering device layer taken over end to end

k4o3ug5.en: For shaders to run, there must be a "rendering device layer" underneath handling everything: requesting GPU resources, managing the canvas surface, organizing each frame's draw commands and submitting them to the GPU. This day took that layer over completely from start to finish, verifying the whole chain stage by stage — from initial setup to stably producing frame after frame, a series of milestones all ticked off. Players never see this layer, but it's the steward of all rendering: when it's solid, the games above it are solid; when it has holes, even the prettiest effects randomly black out or crash. Many rendering issues look like a broken effect on the surface, but the root is really this layer not being sorted out. Making it staged and verifiable has a long-term payoff too: when a future frame goes wrong, you can trace back through these milestones to pin which link broke, rather than staring helplessly at a black screen. Making it sturdy first lays a reliable track for every rendering feature to come.
k4o3ug5.zh: 着色器要跑起来,底下还得有一层"渲染设备层"打理一切:申请显卡资源、管理画布表面、把每一帧的绘制指令组织好提交给显卡。这天把这一层从头到尾完整承接,并分阶段把整条链路逐一验证走通——从最初的初始化,到能稳定地一帧接一帧出画面,一系列里程碑全部打勾。这层东西平时玩家完全看不见,但它是所有画面的"总管":它稳,上面的游戏才稳;它有窟窿,再漂亮的特效也会随机黑屏或崩溃。很多渲染问题表面看是某个特效坏了,根子其实在这层没理顺。把它做成"分阶段、可验证"的形态,还有一个长远好处:以后任何一帧出问题,都能顺着这一层层的里程碑往回查,定位到底是哪一环断了,而不是面对一片黑屏束手无策。先把它做扎实,等于给后面每一个渲染特性都铺好了一条可靠的轨道。

k1kpdcf5.en: The first cross-environment hurdle: a GPU-memory lifecycle hotfix
k1kpdcf5.zh: 跨环境的第一道难关:显存生命周期热修

k1ysy9cf.en: Running WebGPU across different environments, GPU memory buffers follow strict lifecycle rules for "when usable, when to hand back"; once the timing is misaligned, you get half-read dirty data or an outright crash. This day hotfixed the buffer lifecycle during the "mapped read/write" stage, making it follow the rules under two quite different environments: one where, with no discrete GPU, rendering is simulated purely in software, and one where the browser calls the machine's native graphics directly. For the same code to be correct on both paths, every allocation and return of GPU memory has to get its timing exactly right. Such fixes ship no "visible new feature," yet they're exactly what decides whether the engine is "a toy that sometimes runs on my machine" or "a base that runs on another machine and another environment too." A large share of the cost of an in-house renderer goes into this grind of plugging cross-environment uncertainty one hole at a time; each one plugged widens the range of devices the platform can reliably cover.
k1ysy9cf.zh: 在不同环境里跑 WebGPU 时,显存缓冲区有一套严格的"什么时候能用、什么时候该交还"的生命周期规则;一旦时序没对齐,就会出现读到一半的脏数据、或者干脆崩掉。这天热修了缓冲区在"映射读写"阶段的生命周期问题,让它在两种差异很大的环境下都按规矩走:一种是没有独立显卡时用纯软件来模拟渲染,另一种是浏览器直接调用本机图形能力的原生路径。同一段代码要在这两条路上都不出错,意味着每一处对显存的申请与归还都得拿捏好时机。这类修复没有任何"看得见的新功能",却正是它们决定了引擎是"在我这台机器上偶尔能跑的玩具",还是"换一台机器、换一种环境也照样跑的底座"。自研渲染的代价,很大一部分就花在这种把跨环境不确定性一个一个堵掉的苦功上;每堵掉一个,平台能可靠覆盖的设备就多一片。

k1hbjmlp.en: Safe concurrency: a lifecycle lock per agent
k1hbjmlp.zh: 多 agent 并发的安全:给每个 agent 上生命周期锁

k1g4hj8p.en: The platform's other side is the agents that chat with you and do the work. From the start this platform envisions "a team of agents working at once" — a lead handing out tasks, sub-agents each taking a slice, rather than talking to one assistant at a time. But the moment several agents run concurrently, the classic "race condition" appears: two actions touch the same agent's state at almost the same instant with no guaranteed order, producing intermittent corruption or hangs. This day extracted each agent's lifecycle management into a dedicated "async lock" component: operations on the same agent — start, stop, switch — are serialized through that lock into a queue, guaranteeing only one action touches its state at any moment. With that, running many agents no longer means stepping on each other, and behavior becomes predictable. For a platform that treats "multi-agent collaboration" as a core promise, this lock is a key piece that lets the blueprint actually land instead of living only in a demo.
k1g4hj8p.zh: 平台的另一面,是那些跟你聊天、替你干活的 agent。这个平台从一开始就设想"一群 agent 同时干活"——主控派活、子 agent 各做一摊,而不是一次只跟一个助手对话。可一旦多个 agent 并发,就会冒出经典的"竞态"问题:两个动作几乎同时去改同一个 agent 的状态,谁先谁后没保证,结果就是偶发的错乱或卡死。这天把每个 agent 的生命周期管理抽成了一个独立的"异步锁"组件:对同一个 agent 的启动、停止、切换等操作会被这把锁串起来排队执行,保证任意时刻只有一个动作在动它的状态。这样一来,多开 agent 不再相互踩脚,行为变得可预期。对一个把"多 agent 协作"当作核心卖点的平台来说,这把锁是让那张蓝图能落地、而不是停留在演示里的关键一环。

kcocjoh.en: A sturdier terminal: paste won't crash + collaboration guidance
kcocjoh.zh: 终端体验更扛得住:粘贴不死机 + 协作沟通指引

k1449ega.en: Beyond concurrency safety, the chat agent gained two "everyday feel" fixes. First, terminal input: an old "the second paste freezes" bug was fixed, making pasting long requirement text on the command line more resilient — paste in a whole block of setup or a long spec and it won't seize up. Second, collaboration communication: the tool agents use to message one another got fleshed-out usage scenarios and reply guidance, so "who should message whom, when, and how" has structure, and communication during multi-agent collaboration stops being ad hoc. These are the key "doesn't feel awkward to use" details: an assistant that crashes when you paste your requirements, or that descends into a babble when collaborating, can't be trusted no matter how smart. Only by smoothing these rough edges one by one does it become something you'd hand real work to.
k1449ega.zh: 除了并发安全,聊天 agent 在"日常手感"上也补了两处。其一是终端输入:修了一个"粘贴时第二次就卡死"的老毛病,让在命令行里粘贴长段需求文本更有韧性——你把一整段设定、一份长长的需求贴进去,它不会再因此僵住。其二是协作沟通:给 agent 之间互相发消息的工具补全了使用场景与回复指引,让"谁该在什么时候、用什么方式给谁发消息"有章可循,多 agent 协作时的沟通不再各凭感觉。这些都是"用起来不别扭"的关键细节:一个会在你粘贴需求时崩掉、或者协作起来你一言我一语乱成一团的助手,再聪明也没法放心托付。把这些粗糙的边角一个个磨平,才谈得上让人愿意把真正的活交给它。

kc339js.en: No wasted cache: dynamic reminders append a new message
kc339js.zh: 对话不浪费缓存:动态提醒改为追加新消息

k18ftkvu.en: When talking to a large model, the stable context up front can be "cached" to save time and money; but rewriting the very front each time invalidates that cache and forces a full recompute. This day changed "dynamic reminders" (the temporary, conversation-shifting info handed to the model) from "rewrite the front" to "append a new message at the end," preserving the prefix cache. The direct feel for you: faster responses and lower cost on long conversations. Such an optimization looks small on its own, but on a platform built around long back-and-forth collaboration with AI it adds up to real differences in smoothness and spend — and the longer the conversation grows, the more this early right call pays off. It also reveals a stance running through the whole project: treating "how we talk to the model" as engineering worth real polish, not a prompt slapped together on a whim.
k18ftkvu.zh: 和大模型对话时,前面那段稳定的上下文可以被"缓存"下来,从而省时省钱;但如果每次都去改写最前面的内容,这份缓存就被作废,得重新算一整遍。这天把"动态提醒"(那些随对话变化、临时要塞给模型的信息)从"改写最前面"改成"在末尾追加一条新消息",从而保住前缀缓存不被打断。对你的直接体感就是:长对话的响应更快、花费更省。这类优化单看很小,但在一个会跟 AI 长时间来回协作的平台上,它累计起来就是实打实的流畅度差别和成本差别——而且越往后、对话越长,这一处当初做对的决定就越值钱。它也透露出一种贯穿整个项目的取向:把"和模型怎么对话"当成一门要认真打磨的工程,而不是随手拼个 prompt 了事。

k5v5o87.en: Looking at day one's pieces together, you notice none of them is deliberately a "feature to show off": no pretty home page, no flashy demo. They are the first cornerstone of each of four through-lines — rendering, engine, concurrency, conversation. Behind that is a clear-eyed judgment: whether "generate a game by chatting" ultimately works doesn't hinge on whether day one can demo a trick, but on whether the foundation is hard enough — drawable in the browser, stable across environments, agents that don't fight, long conversations that don't burn money. Pouring these four foundations at once is what lets every later day stack steadily on top of them. It's also the first model this changelog wants to leave for future development: get the hardest, least glamorous, least-compromisable things right first.
k5v5o87.zh: 把第一天的几件事连起来看,会发现它们刻意没有一件是"给人看的功能":没有漂亮的首页,没有可炫耀的 demo。它们是渲染、引擎、并发、对话这四条主线各自的第一块基石。这背后是一个清醒的判断——"对话生成游戏"这件事最终能不能成,不取决于第一天能不能演示出花活,而取决于地基够不够硬:浏览器里画得出、换环境跑得稳、多 agent 不打架、长对话不烧钱。今天把这四块地基同时浇下去,后面的每一天才能在它们之上稳稳地往上垒。这也是这份更新日志想为未来开发留下的第一个范本:先把最难、最不出彩、却最不能将就的东西做对。

k1pokze4.zh: 构建与运行时架构成型

kw75ruh.en: Day two formally connects the "game world" to the "screen": the ECS↔render bridge runs, a benchmark sets a yardstick for performance, the Studio front-end shell appears for the first time, and the chat agent grows a command system and smarter context compaction. The foundation moves from "can draw a frame" to "a runtime that actually turns."
kw75ruh.zh: 第二天,把"游戏世界"和"画面"正式接上:ECS↔渲染桥接跑通,给性能立了一把基准尺,Studio 前端外壳第一次出现,聊天 agent 也长出了命令系统与更聪明的上下文压缩。地基从"能画一帧"走向"一套能转起来的运行时"。

kmte3fb.en: From "can draw a frame" to "the architecture takes shape"
kmte3fb.zh: 承上启下:从"能画一帧"到"架构成型"

kkv1a0s.en: If day one answered "can a pixel be drawn correctly in the browser," this day answers the next question: where the picture comes from. What actually moves in a game is a world model called ECS (Entity–Component–System) — every character, prop and camera is an "entity," and their position, look and behavior are decided by "components" and "systems." With rendering but no world model, the engine is just a drawing tool; with a world model but no rendering, the world stays invisible. This day's through-line is connecting those two halves, and along with it standing up the overall build-and-runtime architecture, the front-end shell, and several foundational agent capabilities — so every link in the "generate a game by conversation" chain begins to take form.
kkv1a0s.zh: 如果说第一天解决的是"浏览器里能不能正确画出一个像素",那么这天要回答的是更进一步的问题:画面要从哪里来。游戏里真正在动的,是一套被称为 ECS(实体—组件—系统)的世界模型——所有角色、道具、相机都是其中的"实体",它们的位置、外观、行为由"组件"和"系统"决定。光有渲染、没有这套世界模型,引擎就只是个画图工具;光有世界模型、不接渲染,世界就看不见。这天的主线,就是把这两半接起来,并顺势把构建与运行时的整体架构、前端外壳、以及聊天 agent 的几项基础能力一起立起来——让"对话生成游戏"这条链路的每一环都开始有形。

k1ej99ul.en: The ECS↔render bridge: connecting the world to the screen
k1ej99ul.zh: ECS↔渲染桥接:让"游戏世界"和"画面"接上

k1m29u34.en: The most pivotal step this day was producing a first working version of the bridge between the ECS world and the renderer. What it solves sounds plain yet is utterly fundamental: there's an "entity" in the world carrying components like position, orientation, mesh and material — how does the renderer know where on screen and in what form to draw it? The bridge is that translation channel — each frame it converts the world model's state into draw commands the renderer understands. With it, placing a moving object in the world makes it genuinely appear and move on screen, without hand-writing any drawing code. This is the turning point where the engine goes from "two unrelated subsystems" to "one whole that turns"; every later experience of "place an object and it shows up on screen" traces back to the bridge connected this day.
k1m29u34.zh: 这天最关键的一步,是把 ECS 世界与渲染器之间的桥接做出了第一个可用版本。它要解决的事听起来朴素却极其根本:世界里有一个"实体",它带着位置、朝向、网格、材质这些组件,渲染器怎么知道该在屏幕的哪个位置、用什么样子把它画出来?桥接就是这条翻译通道——它把世界模型里的状态,每一帧转换成渲染器看得懂的绘制指令。有了它,你在世界里放一个会动的物体,屏幕上就真的会出现并跟着动,而不需要手写任何绘制代码。这是整个引擎从"两个互不相干的子系统"变成"一个能转起来的整体"的转折点;后面所有"摆个物体、它就出现在画面里"的体验,根子都在这一天接通的这座桥上。

k11aamxg.en: A dual-implementation benchmark: a yardstick for performance
k11aamxg.zh: 双实现基准:给性能立一把尺

k16775hb.en: On an engine's critical paths there's often more than one way to implement something, each with its own speed and trade-offs. This day built a "dual-implementation benchmark" probe: do the same thing two different ways and measure their real cost side by side. The value isn't which one won a single race, but that performance no longer rests on guesswork — any hunch that "writing it this way might be faster" can be measured on the spot with the same yardstick, avoiding a clever-looking decision that's actually slower. For an engine meant to evolve long-term and run on all kinds of devices, establishing "how to compare performance objectively" first is like assigning a referee to every future optimization, so fast and slow have evidence behind them.
k16775hb.zh: 在引擎的关键路径上,常常有不止一种实现方式,各有快慢与取舍。这天搭了一个"双实现基准"的探针:同一件事用两条不同的路子各做一遍,放在一起量它们的真实开销。这件事的价值不在于某一次比出了谁快,而在于从此性能不再靠拍脑袋——任何"这样写是不是更快"的猜想,都能用同一把尺当场量出来,避免凭直觉做了一个看着聪明、实则更慢的决定。对一个要长期演进、还要在各种设备上跑的引擎来说,先把"怎么客观地比较性能"这件事立起来,等于给后面每一次优化都配了一个裁判,让快与慢有据可依。

khcncxs.en: The Studio front-end shell is born

ksfrdn2.en: A landmark also happened this day: the Studio front-end shell got its first rough form. Until then all capability lived on the engine and command-line side; but what the end user actually faces is a web interface they can open, chat in, and watch the picture on the right. The initial shell stood up this day is the "skeletal starting point" for the chat panel, preview window and various workbenches to come. It's bare for now, but the significance is that the product begins converging from "a pile of capabilities" toward "a usable form." On one side an ever-harder engine foundation, on the other an interface starting to take shape — over the coming weeks the two dock into the Studio you see.
ksfrdn2.zh: 这天还有一件标志性的事:Studio 的前端外壳第一次有了自己的雏形。在此之前,所有能力都集中在引擎和命令行那一侧;而最终用户真正面对的,是一个能打开、能聊天、能看到右侧画面的网页界面。这天搭起的初始外壳,就是后面那个聊天面板、预览窗、各种工作台的"骨架起点"。它现在还很素,但意义在于:产品从"一堆能力"开始向"一个能用的形态"收拢。一边是越来越硬的引擎地基,一边是开始成形的界面,两者会在之后的几周里逐渐对接成你看到的那个 Studio。

k1k5fgm1.en: The agent grows a command system: a draft + /context
k1k5fgm1.zh: 聊天 agent 长出命令系统:草案 + /context

k157yg16.en: The chat agent took a step "from plain conversation to commands" this day: a design draft for a command system landed, and the spec for the /context command was pinned down first. A command system gives "collaborating with AI" a set of predictable, reusable shortcuts — instead of describing a frequent action in a roundabout sentence every time, one command triggers it precisely. /context, the first command to be specified, addresses exactly what matters most in long sessions: "which context is the model currently holding." Settling the command system's shape and its first command first means later commands can grow from the same standard, rather than each being written its own way and clashing.
k157yg16.zh: 聊天 agent 这天迈出了"从单纯对话到带命令"的一步:落了一份命令系统的设计草案,并先把 /context 命令的规格定下来。命令系统的意义,是给"和 AI 协作"补上一套可预期、可复用的快捷操作——不必每次都用自然语言绕一大圈去描述一个常做的动作,一条命令就能精确触发。/context 作为第一个被规格化的命令,关注的正是"模型现在记着哪些上下文"这件长会话里最要紧的事。先把命令系统的形态和第一条命令定清楚,后面的命令就能照着同一套规范长出来,而不是各写各的、互相打架。

k13fqs32.en: Smarter auto-compaction: by tool, by idle gap
k13fqs32.zh: 上下文自动压缩更聪明:按工具、按空闲间隙

k1lrbbqx.en: Over long back-and-forth with AI, accumulated context grows ever longer, slowing responses and raising cost; but crude compaction throws away useful information. This day added two bits of cleverness to context compaction: one, treat it "by tool" — different tools' results matter differently, so you can decide per-tool what to trim and what to keep instead of one-size-fits-all; two, trigger it "by idle gap" — do the compaction in the windows when you're not waiting on a result, hiding the cost at moments you won't notice rather than when you most want a fast reply. Together they let long sessions keep slimming down while disturbing you as little as possible. This careful accounting of "how to manage model context" is exactly where this platform treats things as real engineering from the start.
k1lrbbqx.zh: 长时间和 AI 来回,堆积的上下文会越来越长,既拖慢响应又增加成本;但简单粗暴地压缩又会丢掉有用信息。这天给上下文压缩加了两点巧思:一是"按工具"区别对待——不同工具的结果重要性不一样,可以分别决定哪些该精简、哪些该保留,而不是一刀切;二是"按空闲间隙"触发——挑你不在等结果的那些空档去做压缩,把开销藏在你感知不到的时刻,而不是在你最想要快速回应时去忙这件事。这两点合起来,让长会话既能持续瘦身、又尽量不打扰你。这类对"模型上下文怎么管"的精打细算,正是这个平台从一开始就当成正经工程来做的地方。

kn0xnow.en: Robustness in tooling and terminal: fetch, keys, the event bus
kn0xnow.zh: 工具与终端的韧性:抓取、按键、事件总线

k98hzqj.en: This day also tidied a batch of details that make daily use less prone to going sideways. Both modes of the web-fetch tool got steadier: the deep mode's error messages are more specific and easier to diagnose, while the direct mode is forbidden from installing extra components on its own, making its behavior more controllable. Cursor movement in the terminal (line start/end) was moved onto clearer key routing, so focus and keystrokes line up more accurately. The event bus fixed a self-amplifying loop where an observer's error triggered new errors that snowballed on themselves — once that happens logs explode instantly, so cutting it off at the source matters. None of these are flashy new features; they're the work of carving out "doesn't feel rough to use" bit by bit.
k98hzqj.zh: 这天还顺手补了一批让日常更不容易出岔子的细节。网页抓取工具的两种模式都更稳:深度模式的错误信息说得更具体、好排查,直连模式则禁止自作主张去装额外组件,行为更可控。终端里的光标移动(行首/行尾)改走了更清晰的按键路由,焦点和按键的对应更准。事件总线则修了一个"观察者报错又触发新错误、自己把自己越滚越大"的自激循环——这类问题一旦发生,日志会瞬间爆炸,把它从源头掐断很重要。这些都不是亮眼的新功能,而是把"用起来不硌手"一点点抠出来的功夫。

kt9s24p.en: Since the goal is "running locally in minutes," the install-and-startup path can't be bumpy. This day reorganized the startup flow into modules, made it compatible with a newer package-manager version, added "auto-install as a fallback when the runtime is missing," and aligned the cleanup script to the same conventions. For a platform that wants more people — including non-professional developers — to get started, the smoother the road "from clone to seeing the picture," the lower the bar. Paving that road early saves everyone who later wants to try a string of potentially off-putting hassles.
kt9s24p.zh: 既然目标是"几分钟就能在本地跑起来",安装与启动这条路就不能磕磕绊绊。这天把启动流程做了模块化整理,兼容了较新的包管理器版本,还加了"缺运行环境时自动兜底安装"的逻辑,并把清理脚本对齐到同一套约定。对一个想让更多人(包括非专业开发者)都能上手的平台来说,"从克隆到看见画面"这段路越平,门槛就越低。把这段路一开始就修平整,等于给后来每一个想试试的人省下一连串可能劝退的折腾。

kezjeae.en: From zero to a chat-made spinning cube
kezjeae.zh: 从零到「对话生成一个旋转立方体」

kwoxjxr.en: In 24 hours, four parallel tracks turned the product's core bet into something you can see: say a sentence, it writes code, and the browser hot-reloads the result. The day delivered a self-verifying "chat → spinning cube" end-to-end loop, plus the layered architecture, real agent runtime, three-column interface and hundreds of polish passes that hold it up.
kwoxjxr.zh: 24 小时,四条线并行,把整个产品最核心的假设变成了眼见为实:对它说一句话,它改代码,浏览器立刻热更出结果。这天交付的是一个能自我验证的"对话→旋转立方体"端到端闭环,以及托起这个闭环的分层架构、真正的 agent 运行时、三栏界面和上百次体验打磨。

kumzrv.en: The north star: why "a spinning cube"
kumzrv.zh: 北极星:为什么是"一个旋转立方体"

kzl8tlv.en: Everything this day aimed at one acceptance point: on a clean machine, clone, drop in a key, run one command, then tell the agent in the interface "make a spinning cube" — it edits code, the engine hot-reloads, and a turning cube appears in the browser at once. The cube itself is unremarkable, but it's the minimal proof of the product's core bet — "you can build something genuinely runnable just by talking" — and if any link in that chain breaks, the platform doesn't hold. Collapsing the goal into one unambiguous acceptance point a single screenshot can prove means the team isn't "feeling progress" but chasing a hard pass/fail target. This day, it passed.
kzl8tlv.zh: 这一天所有的工作都对着同一个验收点:在一台干净的机器上,克隆、填一个密钥、一条命令跑起来,然后在界面里对 agent 说"做一个旋转立方体",它去改代码、引擎热重载、浏览器里立刻出现一个转动的立方体。立方体本身毫不起眼,但它是整个产品最核心假设的最小证明——"用对话就能做出真正能跑的东西",这条链路上任何一环断了,这个平台就不成立。把目标收敛成这样一个能被一张截图证明的、不可含糊的验收点,意味着团队不是在"感觉有进展",而是在追一个要么通、要么不通的硬指标。这一天,它通了。

k1w498zu.en: The end-to-end loop runs: say a sentence, the picture changes
k1w498zu.zh: 端到端闭环跑通:说一句话,画面就变

kof8opc.en: This loop chains six links end to end: you state a requirement in the chat box → the agent writes the corresponding code into the game file → a file watcher notices the change → a real-time channel notifies the front end → the engine dynamically loads the new code → the picture updates instantly. This day connected those six links completely and stably for the first time, and an automated browser screenshot actually captured the cube mid-rotation at a tilt, with no errors the whole way except one harmless missing-icon notice. That means "what you see is what you get" is no longer a line in a vision deck but a real, repeatably-triggered pipeline. Every later experience of "build while chatting and see the result immediately" rests on this loop; with it working, the product truly came alive once.
kof8opc.zh: 这条闭环由六个环节首尾相接:你在对话框里说出需求 → agent 把对应的代码写进游戏文件 → 文件监听器察觉到改动 → 通过实时通道通知前端 → 引擎动态加载新代码 → 画面立刻更新。这天第一次把这六环完整、稳定地串通,并且用自动化浏览器截图实测到了那个正在旋转中、带着倾斜角度的立方体,全程除了一个无害的图标缺失提示,没有任何报错。这意味着"所见即所得"不再是愿景里的一句话,而是一条真实存在、可重复触发的流水线。后面所有"边聊边做、立刻看到效果"的体验,都建立在这条闭环之上;它通了,产品才算真正"活"了一次。

kdw8815.en: The three layers land: clear roles, replaceable
kdw8815.zh: 三层架构落地:各司其职、可替换

k5cmcla.en: To make this loop stand the long haul, the system was sliced into parts with clear, independently-replaceable responsibilities: a runtime kernel that actually drives the agent's thinking and acting (handling model calls, tools, sessions, memory); a pure orchestration-and-interface bridge (broadcasting file changes to the front end, never touching the large model itself); an engine (rendering game code into a picture); plus the three-column interface the user faces. This split was written into an internal interface contract and set as an iron rule not to be relitigated lightly — the kernel is the kernel, orchestration is orchestration, boundaries stay unambiguous. Its value: each layer can evolve and be swapped on its own, a problem in one layer doesn't drag down the whole, and "swap the engine, swap the interface" becomes possible later rather than a rewrite.
k5cmcla.zh: 为了让这条闭环长期站得住,这天把系统切成了几层职责清晰、可独立替换的部件:一层是真正驱动 agent 思考与行动的运行时内核(管模型调用、工具、会话、记忆);一层是纯粹的编排与界面桥接(负责把文件改动广播给前端,自己完全不碰大模型);一层是引擎(把游戏代码渲染成画面);再加上用户直接面对的三栏界面。这套划分写进了内部的接口约定,并被定为不可随意重议的铁律——内核就是内核、编排就是编排,边界不许含糊。它的价值在于:每一层都能独立演进、独立替换,某一层出问题不会牵连全局,也让"换一个引擎、换一种界面"在未来成为可能,而不是从头重写。

kfhbclm.en: Replacing the "placeholder shell" with a real agent runtime
kfhbclm.zh: 把"占位壳"换成真正的 agent 运行时内核

kv4ykj9.en: In the pre-dawn version of the loop, what drove the agent was still a temporary placeholder shell; this day, in some thirty-plus steps, it was replaced with a real "professional coding-assistant-class" agent runtime. This kernel has what a real agent needs: it can call the large model, use tools, maintain sessions and memory, and drive itself forward in a "think–act" loop. After the swap, the system received genuine model replies for the first time and ran a full "real model + real tools" loop. This step pushed the product from "looks like it can chat" to "can actually do the work" — earlier conversations were a performance; now behind them is an engine that can read, write and use tools to genuinely change your project.
kv4ykj9.zh: 凌晨那版闭环里,驱动 agent 的还只是个临时占位的空壳;这天分三十多个步骤,把它替换成了一套真正"类专业编码助手"的 agent 运行时内核。这套内核具备一个真实 agent 该有的东西:能调用大模型、能使用工具、能维护会话与记忆、能在一个"思考—行动"的循环里自主推进。替换之后,系统第一次拿到了真实的大模型回复,并跑通了"真模型 + 真工具"的完整闭环。这一步把产品从"看起来能聊"推进到"真的能干活"——之前的对话只是表演,现在背后是一个能读、能写、能调工具去真正改动你项目的引擎。

k1sz8ba9.en: Don't reinvent: reuse standards instead of copying thousands of lines
k1sz8ba9.zh: 不重复造轮子:复用标准而非抄千行代码

kpu73ds.en: While filling in agent capability, two pieces could have been done by "copying a thousand lines from elsewhere": the protocol layer that brings tool capability in, and a standard conversation-event protocol. This day's judgment was clear — wherever a mature open standard already exists and can be installed and used directly, don't re-copy it by hand. So both were replaced with official standard implementations of the earlier hand-written versions: the tool-protocol code shrank from a hundred-odd lines to eighty and got more complete transports and capability-change notifications for free; the conversation-event protocol pulled in a standard library and re-exported thirty-plus standard events with almost no new code. Together the two steps added under two hundred net lines yet delivered enterprise-grade capability. Behind it is a discipline that recurs: spend effort on the hard problems no one solved for you, not on reinventing wheels already sitting in public standards.
kpu73ds.zh: 在补全 agent 能力时,有两块本来可以"照着别处抄上千行"来做:一是把工具能力接进来的协议层,二是一套标准的对话事件协议。这天的判断很明确——凡是已经有成熟开放标准、且能直接装来用的,就不自己重抄一遍。于是这两块各自用官方提供的标准实现替换掉了早前的手写版本:工具协议那一处代码从一百多行缩到八十行,还顺带白拿到了更完整的传输方式和能力变更通知;对话事件协议那一处则直接引入标准库、转出三十多个标准事件,几乎没写新代码。两步加起来净增不到两百行,换来的却是企业级的能力。这背后是一条会反复出现的工程纪律:把力气花在别人没替你解决的难题上,而不是重造已经躺在公共标准里的轮子。

kd6eg59.en: Hundreds of chat-UI passes: from raw text to near desktop-grade
kd6eg59.zh: 聊天界面上百次打磨:从裸字符到接近桌面级

k11p3myo.en: Once the loop truly worked, the interface's experience gaps became the sorest spot. This day, in tiny steps over a hundred iterations, polished the chat panel from "raw text and placeholder boxes" to something near a mature desktop assistant. It includes a whole hand-written Markdown renderer (code blocks, lists, tables, task lists all supported), a character-by-character streaming animation whose speed adapts to content length, tool calls condensed into a high-density "pill" tag that expands to the full result, the agent's "self-correction/reflection" set off visually, contrast between bubbles and background tuned to meet accessibility standards, and looping animations turned off for users who prefer reduced motion. Each pass touched one thing, self-tested, and logged a note. The point is plain: however strong the capability, if it reads laboriously or looks cheap users won't trust it; polishing the surface you stare at most into something pleasant is itself part of the core feature.
k11p3myo.zh: 一旦闭环真通了,界面的体感缺陷就成了最痛的地方。这天用极小的步长、上百次迭代,把聊天面板从"裸字符 + 占位框"打磨到接近成熟桌面助手的质感。这里面有一整套手写的 Markdown 渲染(代码块、列表、表格、任务清单都支持),有逐字打字的流式动画且速率会随内容长短自适应,有把工具调用浓缩成一枚信息密度很高的"药丸"标签、点开还能看完整结果,有把 agent 的"自我纠正/反思"用视觉上分隔出来,还有按无障碍标准把气泡与背景的对比度调到达标、并为偏好减少动效的用户关掉循环动画。每一拍都只动一处、改完自测、再记一笔。这条线说明的事很朴素:能力再强,如果读起来费劲、看着廉价,用户也不会信任它;把日常最常盯着的那块界面抠到顺眼,本身就是核心功能的一部分。

kwtbix8.en: A flat restructure + zero-build, run-from-source dev
kwtbix8.zh: 扁平化重构 + 零构建直跑源码

k26owuc.en: In the afternoon came a structural flattening: the once deeply-nested directories were laid flat so the parts sit side by side in a more direct way. Alongside it, a "zero-build" dev mode was established: after cloning, one command runs the source directly, with no long compile-and-bundle step first. For developers, that means changing a line and seeing the result in the browser almost immediately, stepping iteration speed up a level; for newcomers, the road "from clone to seeing the picture" is squeezed to its shortest. The structural simplification is intangible, yet it decides whether the coming weeks can keep a "a big step a day" cadence — the simpler and clearer the foundation, the faster and steadier you build on top.
k26owuc.zh: 下午做了一次工程结构上的扁平化重构,把原本层层嵌套的目录拍平,让各个部件以更直接的方式并列。配套确立了"零构建"的开发方式:克隆下来之后,一条命令就能直接拉起源码运行,不必先经过一长串编译打包。对开发者来说,这意味着改一行代码、几乎立刻就能在浏览器里看到效果,迭代速度直接上一个台阶;对想上手的新人来说,"从克隆到看见画面"这段路被压到最短。结构上的简化看不见摸不着,却决定了后面几周能不能维持"每天一大步"的节奏——地基越简单清楚,在上面盖得就越快越稳。

kybb60c.en: The three-column Studio takes shape: files, preview, console, switchers
kybb60c.zh: Studio 三栏界面成形:文件、预览、控制台、各种切换器

k9lc6vt.en: In the evening the three-column Studio was laid out, with a batch of genuinely usable panels at once: the files tree on the left wired to real project files, click a product to preview it; a live preview window in the center connected straight to the engine, with a frame-rate readout, pause, reload, fullscreen and desktop/mobile device modes; plus a panel that pipes in the engine's console output, a switcher that lists and replays past sessions, and entries to switch projects and games with a "new" menu. Notably, this day also followed an instinct and merged the two concepts "project" and "game" into one — the user said they were the same thing, so the interface shouldn't force them apart. With that, the "manage-left / preview-center / chat-right" layout settled, and the Studio began converging from a pile of capabilities into a usable product form.
k9lc6vt.zh: 晚间集中把 Studio 的三栏界面铺了出来,一口气补上一批真正能用的面板:左侧的文件树接上了真实的项目文件、点一下产物就能预览;中间是直连引擎的实时预览窗,带帧率显示、暂停、重载、全屏,以及桌面/移动两种设备模式;还有把引擎控制台输出接进来的面板、能列出并回放历史会话的切换器、以及项目与游戏的切换入口和一个"新建"菜单。值得一提的是,这天还顺应一个直觉把"项目"和"游戏"两个概念合二为一——用户说它们本来就是一回事,界面就不该硬分。至此,"左侧管理、中间预览、右侧对话"的基本格局定了下来,Studio 从一堆能力开始收拢成一个能用的产品形态。

k1v04nyp.en: Seen together, the weight of this day is this: it wasn't a single feature shipping, but the product's core thesis being proven end to end for the first time. From a sentence to a moving cube, every link in between — rendering, runtime, orchestration, interface — genuinely ran, on a clean machine, evidenced by a screenshot. Everything complex after the cube — real games, complex scenes, a whole agent team — grows on this already-connected trunk. That's exactly why this day is worth recording as a model: connect the most critical, most falsifiable main chain first, then talk about the branches; running once is what gives you the confidence for the second time, and the hundredth.
k1v04nyp.zh: 把四条线连起来看,这一天的分量在于:它不是某个单点功能上线,而是整个产品的核心命题第一次被端到端地证明成立。从一句话到一个会动的立方体,中间的渲染、运行时、编排、界面每一环都真实跑通,并且是在一台干净机器上、被一张截图实证的。立方体之后的所有复杂——真实的游戏、复杂的场景、整支 agent 团队——都是在这条已经接通的主干上继续生长。也正因如此,这一天值得被当成范本记下来:先把那条最关键、最能证伪的主链路打通,再谈枝叶;能跑通一次,就有第二次、第一百次的底气。

kgd0yyd.en: Engine asset system v1 + deep chat polish
kgd0yyd.zh: 引擎资产系统 v1 + 聊天深度打磨

k12xjqao.en: A round-the-clock push across four parallel tracks: the engine got a proper asset system, rendering raised a "pixel-parity" quality yardstick gated in CI, the sandbox let the agent "see" whether the picture is right, the chat panel took a hundred polish passes, the backend laid heavy tests around safety and contracts, and a big refactor finally made the interface's hot-reload independent.
k12xjqao.zh: 一昼夜、四条线并行推进:引擎拿到正式的资产系统,渲染立起一把"逐像素对齐"的质量尺并接进持续集成守门,沙盒里让 agent 自己"看"画面对不对,聊天面板做了上百次稳态打磨,后端则在安全与契约上扎了大量测试,最后用一次大重构把界面的热更新独立了出来。

k108tjhf.en: Four tracks in a day: the day's panorama
k108tjhf.zh: 一昼夜四条线:这一天的全景

k1bw5a2k.en: This was the densest day so far, pushing from midnight into the next morning with four tracks running at once: the engine landing feature after feature and fix under a strict seven-step closed loop, the chat panel entering "never finished" steady-state polish, the backend nailing safety and interface contracts down with tests one by one, plus a closing refactor that pulled the interface's hot-reload out on its own. Packing so much into one day without chaos came down to two things: each track had clear boundaries and acceptance criteria, and the closer a change was to the foundation, the more it had to be verifiable. Below it's split by theme, but remember they rolled forward meshed together in a single day.
k1bw5a2k.zh: 这是迄今最密集的一天,从午夜一直推到次日清晨,四条线同时在跑:引擎在一套严格的七步闭环流程下连推多个特性与修复、聊天面板进入"永不收工"的稳态打磨、后端把安全与接口契约用测试一条条钉死、再加上收官时一场把界面热更新独立出来的大重构。把这么多动作压在一天里而不乱,靠的是两件事:一是每条线都有清晰的边界和验收标准,二是越靠近地基的改动越要可验证。下面按主题拆开讲,但要记住它们是同一天里咬合着往前滚的。

kj739eb.en: Engine asset system v1: referencing game content by handle
kj739eb.zh: 引擎资产系统 v1:用句柄引用游戏内容

k1p1gzd6.en: The engine's most important delivery this day was the first version of an asset system. Before it, "game content" like models, textures and scenes had no unified way to be managed; the asset system gave them a formal identity: every asset is a structured object referenced through a lightweight "handle" rather than passing huge raw data around. A handle is like a library call number — hold it and you can fetch the book, without carrying the whole book around. A sample room scene was built to validate the chain. The significance: game content can now be referenced, shared and reused in a structured way, with one entry point for loading models, textures and scenes. It's the true starting point for every later "import a model, place assets in a scene" feature.
k1p1gzd6.zh: 这天引擎最重要的交付,是第一版资产系统。在此之前,模型、纹理、场景这些"游戏内容"还没有一套统一的管理方式;资产系统给了它们一个正式的身份:每一份资产都是一个结构化的对象,通过一个轻量的"句柄"来引用,而不是到处传递庞大的原始数据。句柄就像图书馆的索书号——你拿着它就能取到那本书,却不必把整本书抱在手里到处走。配套还做了一个示例房间场景来验证整条链路。这套机制的意义在于:从此游戏内容可以被结构化地引用、共享和复用,加载模型、贴图、场景都有了统一的入口。它是后面所有"导入一个模型、把素材摆进场景"功能的真正起点。

k8oc33d.en: A pixel-parity benchmark: render quality can't quietly regress
k8oc33d.zh: 逐像素对齐基准:渲染质量不许偷偷退化

kk6or87.en: What an in-house renderer fears most isn't a single wrong frame but "quietly getting worse with no one noticing" — change one thing and some frames differ from the reference by a few pixels, invisible to the eye yet drifting off over time. This day raised a "pixel-parity" yardstick: compare the engine's rendered frames against a reference pixel by pixel, and the moment the difference exceeds a threshold, continuous integration goes red and blocks the change from merging into the trunk. It turns "is the rendering correct" from something watched by hand and by feel into an automatic, objective gate that runs on every commit. For an engine evolving its image quality long-term, this gate is the precondition for quality holding steady — with it, you can change rendering boldly without dread.
kk6or87.zh: 自研渲染最怕的不是某次画错,而是"悄悄变差却没人发现"——改了一处,某些画面比对照差了几个像素,肉眼一时看不出,日积月累就跑偏了。这天立了一把"逐像素对齐"的尺:用一个参照来逐像素比对引擎渲染出的画面,只要差异超出阈值,持续集成就直接亮红、当场拦下,不让有问题的改动合进主干。它把"渲染对不对"从一件靠人盯、靠感觉的事,变成了一道自动、客观、每次提交都跑的关卡。对一个要长期演进画质的引擎来说,这道守门是质量能稳住的前提——有了它,大胆改渲染才不至于提心吊胆。

k13db6ed.en: Sandbox visual verification: let the agent "see" whether the picture is right
k13db6ed.zh: 沙盒视觉验证:让 agent 自己"看"画面对不对

k1vp13fl.en: Having an AI edit games automatically runs into an unavoidable problem: after it changes things, how does it know the picture is actually right? Checking only whether the code errored easily leads to "the code didn't crash but the screen is black" while believing it succeeded. This day built a visual verification mechanism in the sandbox, deliberately separating two roles — "producing the picture" and "checking the picture": one side runs the game and captures frames, the other judges the captured frames. Separating the roles makes verification more trustworthy — no "I edit, I screenshot, I declare it fine" self-certification trap. This step is key to the agent moving from "can write code" to "is accountable for its output": it no longer just throws code over the wall but can close the loop and look at "what does the thing I made actually look like."
k1vp13fl.zh: 让 AI 自动改游戏,有个绕不开的难题:它改完之后,怎么知道画面真的对了?如果只看代码有没有报错,很容易"代码没崩、但画面是黑的"还自以为成功。这天在沙盒里搭起一套视觉验证机制,并刻意把"生产画面"和"检查画面"两个角色分开:一边负责把游戏跑起来、截出画面,另一边负责对截出的画面做判断。角色分离的好处是验证更可信——不会出现"自己改、自己拍、自己说没问题"的自证陷阱。这一步是让 agent 从"会写代码"走向"会对自己的产出负责"的关键:它不再只是把代码丢出去,而是能闭着环看一眼"我做出来的东西到底长什么样"。

k5vck39.en: Instanced rendering + many objects: a block game as the touchstone
k5vck39.zh: 实例化渲染 + 多物体:一个方块小游戏当试金石

k12nqkrk.en: This day also hammered the engine's many-object capability with a "falling-block clear" mini-game demo. Such games feature lots of identical blocks on screen at once, and issuing a separate draw command for each piles up cost fast. For this the engine added "instanced drawing": a single submission draws a large batch of the same object, amortizing the repeated cost. The many-object rendering path was tidied alongside, so "many entities appearing together" runs fast and stable. Validating with a genuinely playable mini-game rather than an abstract test is itself a discipline — making a real game run smoothly is far more convincing than passing an isolated snippet.
k12nqkrk.zh: 这天还用一个"方块下落消除"的小游戏 demo 来锤打引擎的多物体能力。这类游戏的特点是同屏会出现大量长得一样的方块,如果每一个都单独发一条绘制指令,开销会很快堆起来。引擎为此加上了"实例化绘制":一次提交就能画出大批同种物体,把重复开销摊薄。配套还梳理了多物体的渲染路径,让"很多个实体一起出现"这件事走得又快又稳。用一个真正能玩的小游戏来验证,而不是抽象的测试,这本身也是一种纪律——能让一个真实游戏跑顺,远比跑通一段孤立的示例代码更有说服力。

kp4vnj8.en: ~100 chat-polish passes: cost, duration, multiple providers
kp4vnj8.zh: 聊天面板上百拍稳态打磨:成本、时长、多供应商

kiuho9q.en: The chat panel entered "never finished" steady-state polish this day, a hundred-plus tiny iterations focused on a few practical things. One: surface each turn's real cost and duration, with an adaptive amount format — cents, dimes, dollars each at the right precision — so you see at a glance what it cost. Two: a switchable selector for "which coding backend to use": you can pin a conversation to one, the choice is remembered, syncs across tabs, supports up/down keyboard selection, and warns when the one you picked is unavailable. Three: thoughtful handling of the anxiety-inducing "the model is thinking silently for a long time" state — showing seconds elapsed, suggesting a switch past a threshold, and a placeholder note for "finished but no visible output." Each pass touched one thing, self-tested, and logged a note. This track earns a hundred passes because it's the surface the user stares at longest each day: however strong the capability, if it reads laboriously and feels uncertain, there's no trust.
kiuho9q.zh: 聊天面板这天进入"永不收工"的稳态打磨,上百次极小迭代集中在几件实用的事上。其一是把每一轮对话的真实成本和耗时显示出来,还做了自适应的金额格式——几分钱、几毛、几块各用合适的精度,让花了多少一目了然。其二是给"用哪个编码后端"做了一个可切换的选择器:可以为某次对话指定走哪一家,选择会被记住、能跨标签页同步、支持键盘上下选,还会在你选的那家不可用时给出提示。其三是把"模型在长时间静默思考"这种容易让人焦虑的状态做了体贴处理——显示已等待秒数、超过一定时间建议切换、对"跑完却没有可见输出"的情况给出占位说明。每一拍只动一处、改完自测、再记一笔。这条线之所以值得花上百拍,是因为它是用户每天盯得最久的界面:能力再强,读起来费劲、用起来心里没底,就谈不上信任。

kd2u2ee.en: Backend safety and contract hardening: whitelists, traversal defense, many tests
kd2u2ee.zh: 后端的安全与契约加固:白名单、防穿越、大量测试

k1oa5xab.en: Since the agent really reads and writes files on your machine, the backend must make "it can only touch what it should" airtight. This day laid a large batch of defenses and tests around file and path safety: constraining accessible paths with a whitelist, adding defense against "directory traversal" over-reach, refusing to overwrite an existing directory when writing a file, and redacting the user's home path in outward responses (so your machine's real paths don't leak). Meanwhile the backend's interface contracts were pinned down test by test — what input should return what, how edge cases are handled, all guarded by tests, and the unit-test count crossed a milestone that day. None of this is a "visible new feature," but it decides whether you dare let a file-editing AI into your own project: only with clear boundaries, predictable behavior and regressions caught by tests is there real peace of mind.
k1oa5xab.zh: 既然 agent 会真的读写你机器上的文件,后端这层就必须把"它只能碰该碰的东西"这件事做死。这天围绕文件与路径安全扎了一大批防线和测试:用白名单约束允许访问的路径、加上对"目录穿越"这类越权访问的防御、让写文件时拒绝覆盖一个已存在的目录、把对外返回里的用户主目录路径做脱敏(避免泄漏你机器上的真实路径)。与此同时,后端的各种接口契约也被一条条用测试钉住——什么样的输入该返回什么、边界情况怎么处理,都有测试守着,当天单元测试数量跨过了一个里程碑。这些工作没有一个是"看得见的新功能",但它们决定了你敢不敢把一个能动手改文件的 AI 放进自己的项目里:边界清楚、行为可预期、回归有测试兜着,才谈得上放心。

kwymvsv.en: A closing refactor: making the interface's hot-reload independent
kwymvsv.zh: 收官重构:界面热更新独立化

kyotu6k.en: Crossing into the early hours, the day closed with a structural refactor: making the interface's hot-reload mechanism independent, and putting each part in its place along the way — the user's game data moved to the instance's own directory, the engine source extracted to a unified build location, environment config lifted to the repo root, and the pitfall-prone nested-directory layout straightened out. Such a refactor shows almost no change on the user's side, but it makes the "edit code, the interface hot-reloads instantly" experience cleaner and less prone to cross-interference. The clearer the foundation, the faster you build later — doing this at the day's end is precisely because, after so many new things landed, the whole tree needed one consolidation to realign.
kyotu6k.zh: 跨到次日凌晨,这天用一场结构上的大重构收了官:把界面的热更新机制独立出来,并顺势把各部分各归其位——用户的游戏数据迁到实例自己的目录、引擎源码抽到统一的构建位置、环境配置上移到主仓根部、并理顺了嵌套目录里容易踩坑的布局。这类重构在用户那一侧几乎看不见任何变化,但它把"改一处代码、界面立刻热更"这条开发体验做得更干净、更不容易互相牵连。地基越清楚,后面盖得越快——把这件事放在一天的最后做,正是因为前面那么多新东西落下来之后,需要一次收拢让整棵树重新对齐。

k1adlsdl.en: If the previous days proved "conversation can build something runnable," this day laid the foundation for "can it be done reliably, long-term." The asset system lets content be managed structurally; the pixel-parity benchmark and sandbox visual verification give an objective judge of "is the picture right"; the backend's safety and tests make "letting the AI act" trustworthy; the chat polish makes people want to use it daily; and the closing refactor keeps it all clean in engineering terms. Together they reveal a stance: charge forward fast, yet leave at every step a solid trail that can be verified, regressed and retrospected. That's exactly the model this log wants to leave for future development — speed and rigor aren't an either/or, but two things attainable in the same day.
k1adlsdl.zh: 如果说前几天证明了"对话能做出能跑的东西",这一天是在为"能不能长期、可靠地做下去"打地基。资产系统让内容可被结构化管理,逐像素基准与沙盒视觉验证让"做出来的画面对不对"有了客观裁判,后端的安全与测试让"放手让 AI 动手"变得可信,聊天打磨让人愿意每天用,收官重构让这一切在工程上保持整洁。它们合起来透露出一种取向:既要往前冲得快,也要在每一步都留下能验证、能回归、能复盘的扎实痕迹。这正是这份日志想给未来开发留下的范本——速度与严谨不是二选一,而是同一天里可以兼得的两件事。

kjubew2.zh: 实时热重载预览 + 会话回放

ksquof3.en: This day truly closed the "say it, see it" feel: edit a game's files and the center preview refreshes itself; reopen a session and the prior back-and-forth replays in full. Alongside it, shaders can be composed across files and hot-reload, new games ship a runnable starter, and the agent always knows which game you're working on.
ksquof3.zh: 这天把"边说边看"的体感真正闭合:改动游戏文件,中间的预览自己刷新;重开一个会话,此前的来回完整回放。配套还让着色器能跨文件组合并热更新,新建游戏自带可运行的起点,agent 也总能知道你正在做哪个游戏。

k1oufv26.en: From bet to muscle memory: making "say it, see it" reflexive
k1oufv26.zh: 承上启下:把"边说边看"做成肌肉记忆

kostwaq.en: The previous days proved "conversation can build something runnable" and raised the foundations of rendering, assets and safety. This day's theme is polishing that loop from "runs once" into "comfortable to use" — changes visible instantly, history never lost, the agent never confused about which target it's acting on. These all sound like experiences that "should just work," but behind each is a real engineering gap being filled. Only once they're all filled does the platform go from "can demo" to "can sit down and use for hours."
kostwaq.zh: 前两天证明了"对话能做出能跑的东西",也立起了渲染、资产、安全这些地基。这天的主题,是把这条闭环从"能跑通一次"打磨成"用起来顺手"——让改动即时可见、让历史不会丢、让 agent 不会搞错对象。这些听起来都是"理所应当"的体验,但每一项背后都是一处真实的工程缺口被补上。当这些缺口都补齐,平台才从"能演示"变成"能长时间坐下来用"。

kotcn98.en: Live hot-reload preview: edit a file, the picture changes itself
kotcn98.zh: 实时热重载预览:改文件,画面自己变

kvbfffy.en: This day connected the center preview to a "hot-reload bridge": when a game's files change, the preview refreshes itself to show the latest, with no manual reload click. It works by the backend continuously watching for file changes in that game's directory and, the moment something changes, notifying the front end over a real-time channel, which reloads the preview. This may look like "saving a click," but it's a vital link in the "say it, see it" loop: the instant the agent finishes editing, you see the result on screen almost immediately, squeezing the latency between conversation and picture to a minimum. For someone sitting down to make a game for hours, this "what you change is what you see" instant feedback is what connects inspiration to implementation.
kvbfffy.zh: 这天给中间的预览接上了一座"热重载桥":当某个游戏的文件发生变化,预览会自动刷新,把最新的样子呈现出来,而不需要你手动点重载。它的工作方式是后端持续盯着该游戏目录里的文件改动,一有变化就通过实时通道通知前端,前端随即让预览重新加载。这一步看似只是"省了一次点击",实则是"边说边看"闭环里至关重要的一环:agent 一改完代码,你几乎立刻就能在画面上看到结果,对话与画面之间的延迟被压到最低。对长时间坐着做游戏的人来说,这种"所改即所见"的即时反馈,是把灵感和实现连起来的关键。

kr6t74v.en: Session replay: reopen a session and the back-and-forth comes back
kr6t74v.zh: 会话回放:重开一个会话,来回原样还原

kghv302.en: Collaborate with AI long enough and the session history becomes a precious asset — the requirements you raised, the decisions it made, the detours taken. This day persisted session history into a durable "ledger" and made reopening a session replay the prior back-and-forth from it. One technical subtlety was handled: the real-time event stream carries only lightweight records of "what happened," not the full text, so replay must reconstruct the real content from the ledger rather than naively replaying events. The significance: close it and come back, and context isn't lost; a stretch of history can be revisited anytime, just as it happened. This makes "working on a project long-term, over many rounds" possible, instead of starting from a blank page each time.
kghv302.zh: 和 AI 协作久了,会话历史就是你的宝贵资产——里面有你提过的需求、它做过的决定、走过的弯路。这天把会话历史落到一份持久的"账本"里,并让重新打开一个会话时能从账本完整回放此前的来回。技术上特别处理了一点:实时事件流里只带"发生了什么"的轻量记录、并不含完整文本,所以回放要从账本里把真正的内容重新组织出来,而不是简单重播事件。意义在于:你关掉再回来,上下文不会丢;一段历史可以随时翻回去看,就像它当时发生的样子。这让"长期、多轮地做一个项目"成为可能,而不是每次都从一张白纸开始。

kgu0zzn.zh: 着色器可组合 + 跨文件热更新

k1srk4fu.en: The engine gave shaders a "composable" capability this day: shaders can import one another, share fragments, and parameterize with macro definitions, instead of piling all code into one file. Better still, it supports cross-file hot-reload — edit a shared fragment that others reference and every shader using it refreshes instantly. For someone crafting visual effects, this means organizing shader code like building blocks: factor common lighting, noise and color processing into reusable modules referenced everywhere; change one and it takes effect everywhere, seen at once. It turns "writing effects" from "trial-and-error against one big blob" into "composing reusable modules and tuning live" — a real expansion of rendering expressiveness.
k1srk4fu.zh: 引擎这天给着色器加上了"可组合"的能力:着色器之间可以互相引入、共享片段、用宏定义参数化,而不必把所有代码都堆在一个文件里。更妙的是它支持跨文件的热更新——你改了被引用的那个公共片段,所有用到它的着色器都会跟着即时刷新。对做画面效果的人来说,这意味着可以像搭积木一样组织着色器代码:把通用的光照、噪声、色彩处理抽成可复用的模块,各处引用;改一处,处处生效,且立刻看到。它把"写特效"从"对着一大坨代码反复试"变成了"组合可复用的模块并实时调",是渲染表达力上的一次实打实的扩容。

k1dlfc5a.en: A unified engine console: one execution channel, consistent everywhere
k1dlfc5a.zh: 引擎统一控制台:一条执行通道,处处一致

kyb9lzo.en: The engine unified its "console" debug/inspect channel this day into a single abstraction: the backend converges to one execution channel, while the command-line side offers a lighter read-only inspect entry. The benefit of unifying is consistent behavior and a simpler mental model — wherever you initiate an inspect or execute, it travels the same orderly path, rather than each place having its own slightly-different version. Such convergence in abstraction is usually invisible on the user's side, but it decides whether a system grows messier as features pile up. Converging "how the console works" into one authoritative channel early sets the same rules for every capability that later plugs into the console.
kyb9lzo.zh: 引擎这天把"控制台"这条调试/检视通道做了统一抽象:后端收敛成单一的执行通道,命令行那侧则提供更轻量的只读检视入口。统一的好处是行为一致、心智简单——无论从哪里发起一次检视或执行,走的都是同一条规整的路径,而不是各处各写一套、行为还略有出入。这类抽象上的收敛在用户那一侧往往看不见,但它决定了系统会不会随着功能变多而越来越乱。把"控制台该怎么工作"在早期就收敛成一条权威通道,等于给后面所有要接进控制台的能力定了同一套规矩。

kkha2je.en: New games ship a runnable starter + the agent always knows which game
kkha2je.zh: 新建游戏自带可运行起点 + agent 总知道你在做哪个游戏

kpluwpx.en: This day filled in two details that make "creating a game" smoother. One: a new game ships with a directly-runnable starter (a spinning-cube opening), so the moment you create it you see a picture, instead of staring at a blank and writing from scratch. Two: the context of "which game you're currently working on" is fed explicitly into the agent's system prompt, so it clearly knows which game to write code into. The latter fixes a dangerous pitfall — with multiple games coexisting, an agent unsure of the current target easily edits the wrong place. Making the "active game" an explicit, reliably-passed context is like giving the agent a compass that won't point wrong.
kpluwpx.zh: 这天补上两处让"新建游戏"更顺的细节。其一:新建一个游戏时,系统会放进一个可直接运行的起点(一个转动的立方体起手式),于是你一建好就能看到画面,而不是面对空白发愣再从零写起。其二:把"当前正在做哪个游戏"这个上下文显式地喂进 agent 的系统提示里,让它清楚地知道现在该往哪个游戏里写代码。后者修的是一个很要命的隐患——多个游戏并存时,如果 agent 搞不清当前对象,很容易改错地方。把"活动游戏"做成一个明确、可靠传递的上下文,等于给 agent 装了一个不会指错的指南针。

k13ratiq.en: The backend keeps it solid: more tests, path redaction, name validation
k13ratiq.zh: 后端继续扎实:更多测试、路径脱敏、命名校验

kc8jjav.en: The backend kept up its rhythm of "pinning behavior down with tests," adding another large batch of end-to-end probes and unit tests. A few focuses: locking game and project naming rules with many cases (which names are valid, which should be rejected, every boundary guarded by tests), continuing to redact the user's home path in outward responses (no leaking your machine's real paths), and extracting key logic like building the system prompt into a pure, separately-testable function. None of these are flashy features; they're the daily work of "making a file-editing system worthy of trust." Notably, this day also adapted to another coding backend's event format, smoothing the integration of more model-driving options — one more choice, a consistent experience.
kc8jjav.zh: 后端这天延续了"用测试把行为钉死"的节奏,又补了一大批端到端探针和单元测试。重点有几处:把游戏与项目的命名规则用大量用例锁住(什么样的名字合法、什么样的该被拒,边界都有测试守着),把对外返回里的用户主目录路径继续做脱敏(不泄漏你机器上的真实路径),并把构造系统提示这类关键逻辑抽成纯函数、单独可测。这些都不是亮眼功能,而是"让一个能改你文件的系统值得信任"的日常功夫。值得一提的是,这天还顺手适配了另一种编码后端的事件格式,让接入更多模型驱动方式更顺——多一个选择,体验却保持一致。

k1btay4b.en: Seen together, the through-line is clear: make "build while talking" not just possible but frictionless. Changes visible instantly (hot-reload), history fully recoverable (session replay), effects organized like building blocks (composable shaders), the agent never editing the wrong target (active-game context), the backend worthy of trust (tests and redaction) — each removes a small friction that would break flow. Whether a tool is pleasant to use often hinges less on whether it can do one big thing than on how smoothly it does the hundred small everyday ones. What this day filled in were several of the most crucial among those hundred.
k1btay4b.zh: 把这天的几件事连起来看,主线非常清楚:让"边说边做"这件事不只是能成,而是用起来不硌手。改动即时可见(热重载)、历史完整可回(会话回放)、特效能像搭积木一样组织(可组合着色器)、agent 不会改错对象(活动游戏上下文)、后端值得托付(测试与脱敏)——每一项都在消除一个会打断心流的小摩擦。一个工具好不好用,往往不取决于它能不能做某件大事,而取决于做日常那一百件小事时顺不顺。这一天补的,正是这一百件小事里最关键的几件。

kijj96s.en: Close the browser — agents keep working
kijj96s.zh: 关掉浏览器,agent 照样在后台干活

kuo7jln.en: This day agents went from "a window you chat in" to "coworkers that run long in the background": closing the window or dropping the network doesn't stop them, and reopening picks up where you left off; multiple conversation tabs run concurrently without crosstalk; a local dashboard surveys every task; several coding backends share one protocol and can be swapped anytime; and the engine gained a unified handle-and-GUID asset vocabulary.
kuo7jln.zh: 这天 agent 从"陪你聊天的窗口"变成了"能在后台长跑的同事":关窗、断网都不影响它继续干,重开能接着看;多个对话标签页并发互不串台;新增本地监控面板纵览所有任务;几种编码后端共用一套协议、随时可切;引擎也补上了句柄与 GUID 资产的统一词汇。

k2d6id6.en: From "close the window and it stops" to "lives on in the background"
k2d6id6.zh: 从"关窗即停"到"后台不死"

kui6u17.en: Before this, an agent's life was tied to the browser: close the tab and the background process doing the work was terminated with it — a half-done long task gone in an instant. That's a fundamental obstacle to "having AI do things for you over time": who would hand it a task that runs for tens of minutes and then not dare close the laptop or drop the network for the whole duration? This day's through-line was "unbinding" the agent from the browser, making it an independent, persistent background coworker you can return to anytime. It's a mental shift: from "I keep a window open watching it chat" to "I hand off the work, go do other things, and come back to the result."
kui6u17.zh: 在此之前,agent 的命跟浏览器是绑在一起的:你一关标签页,后台那个正在干活的进程就被一并结束了——做一半的长任务说没就没。这对"让 AI 替你长时间做事"是个根本性的障碍:谁敢把一个要跑几十分钟的任务交给它,然后整个过程不敢关电脑、不敢断网?这天的主线,就是把 agent 从浏览器里"解绑",让它成为一个独立、持久、可随时回来查看的后台同事。这是一个心智上的转折:从"我开着窗口看它聊天",变成"我把活交给它,然后该干嘛干嘛,回头再来看结果"。

kq82g4a.en: Agents survive a closed window and resume
kq82g4a.zh: 关窗 / 断网后 agent 不死、可续看

k1fg7xzv.en: The core of making this work is persisting every task run to a record on disk, with an index. That way the agent's process no longer depends on the front-end connection to stay alive — the browser disconnecting only cuts the "watching" line; the "working" line keeps running in the background. When you reopen, the front end reconnects carrying a marker of "where I last saw," backfills the output you missed while away, then rejoins the still-flowing live stream. In testing that day, a reply of over ten thousand characters — which finished generating only after you reloaded the page — rendered in full across that refresh, not a word missing. Behind it is a "resumable" event-stream design: every event has a sequence number, and on reconnection it fetches from your last number onward, losing nothing and duplicating nothing.
k1fg7xzv.zh: 实现这件事的核心,是把每一次任务运行(Run)都持久化成磁盘上的记录,并配一份索引。这样一来,agent 的进程不再依赖前端的连接活着——浏览器断开,只是断了"看"的那条线,干活的那条线还在后台跑。当你重新打开,前端会带着"我上次看到哪了"的标记重新连上,把你离开期间错过的输出补齐、再接上仍在飞的实时流。当天实测中,一篇一万多字、在你重新加载页面之后才生成完的长回复,能跨着这次刷新被完整渲染出来,一个字都不少。这背后是一套"可断点续传"的事件流设计:每条事件都有序号,续连时从你上次的序号往后取,既不丢也不重。

kgasrt2.en: Concurrent conversation tabs, with no crosstalk
kgasrt2.zh: 多对话标签页并发,互不串台

k1f3elvp.en: Since agents can now run long in the background, naturally you should be able to open several at once. This day the interface supported multiple conversation tabs: a plus at the top opens a new session, so you can have one agent running a long task in this tab while chatting with another agent about something else in another, neither interrupting the other. Switching tabs interrupts no background run; each one's state and stream stay cleanly separated. For the vision of "one person leading a team of AIs," concurrent tabs are the most intuitive entry point — turning "advancing several things at once" from a concept into something you do casually, and paving the way for real multi-agent collaboration later.
k1f3elvp.zh: 既然 agent 能后台长跑,自然就该能同时开好几个。这天界面支持了多对话标签页:顶部一个加号就开一个新会话,你可以让一个 agent 在这个标签里跑长任务,同时在另一个标签里跟另一个 agent 聊别的,两边互不打断。切换标签不会中断任何一个后台运行,各自的状态、各自的流都稳稳隔开。对"一个人带一支 AI 团队"这个设想来说,多标签并发是最直观的入口——它让"同时推进好几件事"从概念变成了你随手就能做的操作,也为后面真正的多 agent 协作铺了路。

k1e6a7io.en: A local dashboard: overview, runs, sessions, usage
k1e6a7io.zh: 本地监控面板:总览、运行、会话、用量

k1udn5gw.en: With tasks running in the background and several open at once, you need somewhere to survey the whole. This day added a local dashboard in the top-right with four views: overview for the big picture, running tasks for who's still going, sessions for past conversations, and usage analysis for consumption. Here you can cancel or delete tasks and watch any task's output stream scroll out character by character live. Its value is a sense of control — when you've left several long tasks in the background, you need a dashboard to know at any moment where each stands, whether anything went wrong, and what it cost. Building this "operations view" into the product means the platform doesn't just want you to "do one thing with AI" but takes seriously the reality that "you'll be managing many things at once."
k1udn5gw.zh: 既然任务都在后台跑、还能多开,就需要一个地方纵览全局。这天在右上角加了一个本地监控面板,分四个视图:总览看全局态势、运行中的任务看谁还在跑、会话看历史对话、用量分析看消耗。你可以在这里取消或删除任务,也能实时盯着任意一个任务的输出流逐字滚出来。它的价值在于"掌控感"——当你把多个长任务丢在后台,你需要一个仪表盘随时知道它们各自到哪一步、有没有出问题、花了多少。把这种"运维视角"做进产品,意味着平台不只想让你"用 AI 做一件事",而是认真对待"你会同时管很多件事"这个现实。

k1ojvoec.en: Several coding backends, one protocol, swap anytime
k1ojvoec.zh: 几种编码后端,一套协议、随时可切

kc3mb2u.en: More than one "coding backend" can drive an agent, and each differs slightly in event format, capability and stability. This day integrated another new backend and unified them all under one event-stream protocol — whatever the underlying provider, the front end sees the same orderly events, so the interface and flow are identical. The most practical benefit: when one is temporarily unavailable or underperforming, you can switch to another in one click with no distortion to interface, operations or experience. Making "which model backend" a pluggable choice transparent to the layers above both protects users from being locked to a single provider and lets the platform calmly integrate more and more backends without rewriting the interface for each.
kc3mb2u.zh: 驱动 agent 的"编码后端"不止一家,各家的事件格式、能力、稳定性都略有差异。这天又接入了一种新的后端,并把所有后端都统一到同一套事件流协议之下——无论底层是哪一家,前端看到的都是同一种规整的事件,因此界面与流程完全一致。最实际的好处是:某一家临时不可用或者表现不佳时,你可以一键切到另一家,而界面、操作、体验都不变形。把"用哪个模型后端"做成一个可插拔、对上层透明的选择,既保护了用户不被单一供应商绑定,也让平台能从容地接入越来越多的后端,而不必每接一家就重写一遍界面。

k1oeslsj.en: Engine: a unified vocabulary of handles and GUID assets
k1oeslsj.zh: 引擎:句柄与 GUID 资产的统一词汇

kqhimqq.en: The engine made an important convergence in its low-level "conceptual vocabulary" this day. Assets were given globally unique identifiers (GUIDs) and a disk format addressed by them — meaning every asset has an identity that can't be confused, referenceable accurately across projects and scenes. The "handle" type design was clarified alongside, characterizing a reference along two dimensions so references are both type-safe and clearly expressed. The engine also changed "instancing" from implicit auto-batching to explicit declaration: you tell the engine plainly "this is a batch of the same object to draw together," making behavior more controllable and predictable. These are invisible low-level engineering, but they decide whether the engine stays clear and orderly as content grows and scenes get complex — giving assets a reliable identity system is the precondition for all later "import, reuse, compose."
kqhimqq.zh: 引擎这天在底层"概念词汇"上做了重要的收敛。资产被赋予了全局唯一标识(GUID),并定义了一套以此寻址的磁盘存放格式——意味着任何一份资产都有一个永不混淆的身份,跨项目、跨场景都能被准确地引用到。配套把"句柄"的类型设计也理清了,用两个维度去刻画一个引用的性质,让引用既类型安全又表达清晰。引擎还把"实例化"从隐式的自动合批改成了显式声明:你明确告诉引擎"这是一批要批量绘制的同种物体",行为更可控、更可预期。这些都是看不见的底层工程,但它们决定了引擎在内容越来越多、场景越来越复杂时,能不能保持清晰不乱——给资产一个可靠的身份系统,是后面一切"导入、复用、组合"的前提。

k1ygjp8i.en: Games stored per project + a hot-reload refresh fix
k1ygjp8i.zh: 游戏改为按项目本地存放 + 修好热更新刷新

k145ui8v.en: This day also adjusted how game content is stored: from "unified publishing" to "each project keeps its own copy," with game data living in that instance's own directory. This is more intuitive — your game belongs to your project, not published into some shared pool. A long-nagging hot-reload issue was fixed alongside: previously, under certain proxied setups, the preview wouldn't truly refresh after a browser reload because the hot-reload channel connected to the wrong port; this day fixed it so "edit and see it" holds steadily across deployment paths. Such adjustments look trivial but are the underlying guarantee of whether "build while talking" stays silky throughout.
k145ui8v.zh: 这天还调整了游戏内容的存放方式:从"统一发布"改成"每个项目自己存一份",游戏数据就放在该实例自己的目录里。这更符合直觉——你的游戏属于你的项目,而不是被发布到某个公共池里。配套修了一个困扰已久的热更新问题:此前在某些代理转发的情况下,浏览器重新加载后预览不会真正刷新,原因出在热更新通道连错了端口;这天把它修对,让"改完即见"在各种部署路径下都稳定成立。这类调整看着琐碎,却是"边说边做"能不能始终丝滑的底层保障。

k1baqcf5.en: The biggest shift this day was the agent's identity: it's no longer a chat partner that "exists only while you watch," but a background coworker that runs long independently, is surveyed and managed, and can be returned to anytime. Survives a closed window, runs concurrently, manageable via a panel, swappable backends — together these push "having AI do things for you" from a demo scenario toward a real way of working. You can hand several tasks to different agents at once, close the laptop and do something else, then come back and accept them one by one. This is exactly what the platform wants to be: not a toy you must watch constantly, but a team you can entrust and return to collect from. The real multi-agent collaboration to come is built on the "persistent + concurrent + observable" foundation laid this day.
k1baqcf5.zh: 这一天最大的转变,是 agent 的身份变了:它不再是一个"只在你看着时才存在"的聊天对象,而成了一个能独立长跑、被纵览管理、随时可回来查看的后台同事。关窗不死、多开并发、有面板可管、后端可换——这几件事合起来,把"让 AI 替你做事"从一个演示场景,推向了一个真实的工作方式。你可以同时把好几个任务丢给不同的 agent,关掉电脑去做别的,回来再逐一验收。这正是这个平台想成为的样子:不是一个你得一直盯着的玩具,而是一支你可以放心托付、然后回来收货的团队。后面真正的多 agent 协作,就建立在这天打下的"持久 + 并发 + 可观测"地基之上。

kobdhp0.en: Chat UI grows up: resizable layout, nested tool calls, sub-agent cards
kobdhp0.zh: 聊天界面进阶:可调布局、嵌套工具调用、子 agent 卡片

kr39rg2.en: Two through-lines this day: the interface grew up — resizable layout, tool calls nested under their to-do, sub-agents with their own cards, live and replay unified into one pipeline; and the backend quietly poured a big foundation — a plugin runtime (event bus, permission engine, sandboxed file API, plugin manifests) to pave the way for "any capability can plug in." The engine also extended its component vocabulary and introduced scene assets.
kr39rg2.zh: 这天有两条主线:界面长大了——可调布局、工具调用嵌套在待办下、子 agent 有了独立卡片、实时与回放统一成一条流水线;后端则在悄悄浇一块大地基——一套插件运行时(事件总线、权限引擎、沙盒文件接口、插件清单),为"任何能力都能作为插件接进来"铺路。引擎也扩展了组件词汇并引入了场景资产。

kjoh5su.en: One visible, one quiet: the UI grows up while the backend pours a foundation
kjoh5su.zh: 一明一暗:界面长大 + 后端浇地基

kico5gj.en: The day's work split into a visible half and an invisible one. The visible half: the chat interface matured a notch — this is what users face every day, where every bit of progress shows immediately. The invisible half: the backend quietly poured a far-reaching foundation, a runtime that lets "third-party capability be safely installed as a plugin." The latter shipped almost nothing a user could perceive that day, yet it decides whether the platform can grow from "an app with hardcoded features" into "a platform that can be extended endlessly, even built upon by users." Seen on the same day, the two embody a balance: keep polishing the experience at hand while betting on long-term extensibility.
kico5gj.zh: 这天的工作分成看得见和看不见的两半。看得见的一半,是聊天界面集中长大了一截——这是用户每天都要面对的地方,体验上的每一点进步都立竿见影。看不见的一半,是后端在默默浇一块影响深远的地基:一套让"第三方能力作为插件被安全地装进来"的运行时。后者当天几乎没有任何用户能直接感知的产出,却决定了这个平台未来能不能从"一个写死了功能的应用",长成"一个可以被不断扩展、甚至被用户二次开发的平台"。把这两件事放在同一天看,正好体现了一种平衡:既要持续打磨眼前的体验,也要为长远的可扩展性下注。

k1hx5dsp.en: Chat matures: resizable layout + tool calls nested under their to-do
k1hx5dsp.zh: 聊天界面进阶:可调布局 + 工具调用嵌套在待办下

k1eptrbb.en: The interface's progress this day centered on "organizing information more clearly." One: the sidebar, chat area and bottom panel are all resizable, so you can allocate screen space to whatever you're doing — narrow the chat when reading code, raise the bottom when watching output. Two, and more important: tool calls now nest under the to-do item they belong to, rather than spreading into one long flat list. When an agent executes a multi-step task, you can clearly see "which tools it called to complete this step," with the hierarchy obvious at a glance. What long conversations and multi-step tasks fear most is information blurring into a mass that hides progress; these two changes make "seeing clearly who's doing what, and how far along" real.
k1eptrbb.zh: 界面这天的进步集中在"信息怎么组织得更清楚"。其一,侧栏、聊天区、底部面板都能拖拽调整大小,你可以按当下在做的事自由分配屏幕——看代码时把聊天收窄,盯输出时把底部拉高。其二,也是更关键的一处:工具调用现在会嵌套显示在它所属的那个待办事项之下,而不是平铺成一长串。当 agent 在执行一个多步任务时,你能清楚看到"为了完成这一步,它调用了哪些工具",层级关系一目了然。长对话、多步骤任务最怕的就是信息糊成一团让人看不清进展;这两处改动,正是把"看得清谁在做什么、做到哪一步"这件事落到实处。

kusqv45.zh: 子 agent 有了独立卡片

kn2j8e8.en: As multi-agent collaboration grew common, "a lead agent delegating to several sub-agents" became an everyday scenario. This day gave sub-agent activity its own card presentation: sub-tasks no longer mix into the main conversation's text stream but each get a foldable card with their own context. This makes "who's working for whom, and how each is progressing" instantly distinguishable. For a platform that treats "one person directing a team of AIs" as a core scenario, this way of "giving each member's work its own place" is essential — otherwise, as the team grows, the screen becomes an unreadable stew. The sub-agent card is the first step in turning the abstract "multi-agent" into a picture your eyes can directly read.
kn2j8e8.zh: 随着多 agent 协作越来越常见,"一个主 agent 派活给多个子 agent"成了日常场景。这天给子 agent 的活动做了一个独立的卡片呈现:子任务不再混在主对话的字流里,而是各自有一张能折叠展开、带自己上下文的卡片。这让"谁在替谁干活、各自进展如何"在视觉上立刻分得清。对一个把"一个人指挥一支 AI 团队"当成核心场景的平台来说,这种"把每个成员的工作各自归位"的呈现方式至关重要——否则团队一大,屏幕就会变成一锅看不懂的乱炖。子 agent 卡片是把"多 agent"这件抽象的事,变成你眼睛能直接看懂的画面的第一步。

k1r6b1p7.en: Live and replay unified into one pipeline
k1r6b1p7.zh: 实时与回放统一到一条流水线

kef0zd7.en: Before this, "watching the agent live" and "replaying history afterward" were likely two separate rendering paths — so for the same content, what you saw live and what replayed often disagreed in detail. This day unified them onto one pipeline sharing the same processing callbacks: whether content is streaming in live or being replayed from the history ledger, it travels the exact same parse-and-present path. The significance is consistency: reopen a stretch of history and you see exactly what truly happened, with no detail distorted. This "single source-of-truth path" design both removes the burden of maintaining two logics and eliminates at the root the most confusing class of bug — "live and replay disagree."
kef0zd7.zh: 在此之前,"实时看着 agent 干活"和"事后回放一段历史"很可能是两套各自为政的渲染逻辑——结果就是同一段内容,实时看到的和回放出来的细节常常对不上。这天把它们统一到了同一条流水线上,共享同一套处理回调:无论内容是正在实时流进来,还是从历史账本里重放出来,都走完全相同的解析与呈现路径。意义在于一致性:你重新打开一段历史,看到的就是它当时真实发生的样子,一个细节都不会变形。这种"单一真相路径"的设计,既省去了维护两套逻辑的负担,也从根上杜绝了"实时和回放对不上"这类最让人困惑的 bug。

k1ra92xm.en: A backend plugin-runtime foundation: bus, permissions, sandbox
k1ra92xm.zh: 后端插件运行时地基:总线、权限、沙盒
