k8sxzsf.en: The collaboration roster filled out again this day: several new agents with distinct specialties arrived, so you can pick the right one to take a task rather than dumping everything on one generalist. The tool window's top bar gained an agent picker to assign which agent works inside a given workbench and open its details in one click to see what it's good at. The backend also added unified create/read/update/delete for agents with role support, making "managing your AI team" itself orderly. Getting the right agent on the right job is key to collaboration efficiency — handing an art need to an art-specialized agent is far more reliable than to a jack-of-all-trades. This day made "picking the person" both convenient and smooth.
k8sxzsf.zh: 协作阵容这天又充实了一批:新增了若干各有专长的 agent,你可以按任务挑合适的那个来接手,而不是所有事都丢给同一个通才。工具窗的顶栏还加了一个 agent 选择器,可以直接在某个工作台里指定由哪个 agent 来干,并一键打开它的详情看看它擅长什么。后端也补上了对 agent 的统一增删改查能力和角色配套,让"管理你这支 AI 团队"本身变得规整。让对的人做对的事,是协作效率的关键——一个画美术的需求交给擅长美术的 agent,远比交给一个什么都会一点的通才更靠谱。这天把"挑人"这件事做得既方便又顺手。

k5sqh13.en: Don't let docs lie: automatic doc-vs-code reconciliation
k5sqh13.zh: 让文档别骗人:文档与代码自动对账

kdygldy.en: This day also raised a special gate: automatically checking whether the "design docs" and the "actual code" still line up. Every long-evolving project has a common ailment — docs describe the original intent while code keeps changing, and over time the two quietly diverge until the docs start misleading. This reconciliation gate alarms when key code locations referenced by docs change, forcing you to update either the code or the doc, not letting them secretly part ways. It addresses "doc trustworthiness," the most easily overlooked yet long-term efficiency-eroding problem. For a platform that takes "AI also relies on docs to understand the system" seriously, keeping docs honest is itself core infrastructure — because lying docs mislead humans and AI alike.
kdygldy.zh: 这天还立了一道很特别的闸门:自动检查"设计文档"和"实际代码"是否还对得上。任何长期演进的项目都有一个通病——文档写的是当初的设想,代码却一直在变,时间一长两者就悄悄脱节,文档反而开始误导人。这道对账闸门会在代码里那些被文档引用的关键位置发生变化时报警,逼着你要么更新代码、要么更新文档,不许它们偷偷分家。它解决的是"文档可信度"这个最容易被忽视、却长期侵蚀团队效率的问题。对一个把"AI 也要靠文档来理解系统"当回事的平台来说,保证文档不骗人,本身就是一项核心基础设施——因为骗了人的文档,会同时把人类和 AI 一起带偏。

k1egpy25.en: The weight of this day rests almost entirely on that runtime switch: changing the engine that runs your game from "rented" to "our own." It's not a feature that instantly makes the image prettier, but a fundamental decision about "who holds the initiative for the future" — from now, image quality, performance and the direction of AI optimization are all in our own hands. Around this switch, materials became customizable, bad data can't get in, the team is easier to staff, and docs no longer lie — each making this "own engine" more controllable and trustworthy. A platform daring, after it already works, to replace its most core foundation with an in-house one isn't after momentary good looks but lasting autonomy — and that's the judgment this day most deserves to be remembered for.
k1egpy25.zh: 这一天的重量,几乎全压在那次运行时切换上:把跑你游戏的引擎,从"租来的"换成"自己的"。它不是一个能立刻让画面变漂亮的功能,而是一个关于"未来主动权在谁手里"的根本决定——从此画质、性能、为 AI 优化的方向,都掌握在自己手中。围绕这次切换,材质能自定义了、坏数据进不来了、团队更好挑人了、文档不再骗人了,每一件都在让这台"自己的引擎"更可控、更可信。一个平台敢在能用之后还把最核心的底层换成自研,图的不是一时的好看,而是长久的自主——这正是这一天最该被记住的判断。

kbry31i.zh: 骨骼动画 + 场景工作台与观测台

k65gv8v.en: This day characters genuinely "moved" for the first time: the engine added skinned skeletal animation. The tool family grew too — a scene workbench (with multi-game per project), an observatory, and narrative tools with real teeth; chat got cleaner, credentials safer, and the engine slimmed boilerplate and ran cleanly in the browser.
k65gv8v.zh: 这天角色第一次真正"动"了起来:引擎补上骨骼蒙皮动画。工具家族也扩到三件——场景工作台(还带一个工程多游戏)、观测台、叙事工具补上真本事;聊天界面更清爽、凭据更安全,引擎也瘦了样板代码、能在浏览器里干净运行。

k1pyrmy3.zh: 从"静态物体"到"活的角色"

k1ngh7h9.en: Before this day, the engine could render objects that were lit, textured and shadowed, but they were all "static" — however refined, just ornaments. The skeletal animation added this day is the key piece that brings these objects "to life"; and on the tool side, several capabilities — scene, observatory, narrative — arrived at once. Putting "make characters move" and "fill in the tools for making games" on the same day is this platform's consistent rhythm: the engine governs "is what you make vivid enough," the tools govern "is making it smooth," advancing both ends together. Below, each in turn.
k1ngh7h9.zh: 在这天之前,引擎能渲染被光照亮、贴着图、投着影的物体,但它们都是"静"的——再精致也只是摆件。这天补上的骨骼动画,是让这些物体"活过来"的关键一环;而工具侧又一口气添了场景、观测、叙事几件能力。把"让角色动起来"和"把做游戏要用的工具补齐"放在同一天,正是这个平台一贯的节奏:引擎管"做出来的东西够不够生动",工具管"做这件事顺不顺手",两头一起往前。下面分别看这几件事。

kgylsu8.zh: 引擎:角色骨骼蒙皮动画

ksiqn5g.en: The engine added one of the most essential pieces for games this day — skinned skeletal animation. How it works: build a "skeleton" for a character model, then "skin" the surface mesh onto it; when the skeleton poses according to animation data, the mesh stretches and bends along with it naturally, so the character walks, runs and waves rather than standing frozen. This is the watershed from "rendering a static object" to "rendering a living character" — a motionless character, however good-looking, is just a statue, while a moving character can carry real genres like role-playing, action and adventure. Getting this foundational capability right means the engine, from "can display scenes," becomes qualified to "carry a living protagonist" — the precondition for every later game with characters and combat.
ksiqn5g.zh: 引擎这天补上了游戏里最关键的一块——骨骼蒙皮动画。它的原理是:给角色模型搭一副"骨架",再把表面的网格"蒙"在骨架上;当骨架按动画数据摆出姿势时,网格会跟着自然地拉伸、弯折,于是角色就走、跑、挥手起来,而不是僵在原地。这是从"渲染一个静态物体"跨进"渲染一个活的角色"的分水岭——一个不会动的角色再好看也只是雕像,而能动的角色才撑得起角色扮演、动作、冒险这些真正的游戏类型。把这块基础能力做对,意味着引擎从"能展示场景"开始具备"能承载有生命的主角"的资格,这是后面所有有人物、有战斗的游戏的前提。

k1aqqhn5.en: A new scene workbench + multiple games in one project
k1aqqhn5.zh: 新增"场景"工作台 + 一个工程多个游戏

k60s1pu.en: The tool family gained a solid member: a scene workbench, landing as the first plugin of its kind that "actually does work," for building and organizing a game's scenes. The platform began supporting "managing multiple games in one project," with per-game isolated data storage — each game's content belongs to itself, with no cross-contamination. This means you can make a series in one project, branch out multiple levels, or try several different ideas in parallel without starting over each time. For a creator who wants to cultivate their own works long-term, "multiple games coexisting in one project without interference" is the basis for settling scattered attempts into a system — picking which game to run or edit is now a smooth step rather than a move.
k60s1pu.zh: 工具家族再添一位实打实的成员:场景工作台,作为第一个"真正能干活"的此类插件落地,用来搭建和组织一个游戏里的场景。配套平台开始支持"一个工程里管理多个游戏",并做了按游戏隔离的数据存放——每个游戏的内容各自归各自,互不污染。这意味着你可以在同一个工程里做一个系列、拆出多个关卡分支、或者并行试几个不同的想法,而不必每次都另起炉灶。对一个想长期经营自己作品的创作者来说,"多游戏共处一个工程、互不干扰"是把零散尝试沉淀成体系的基础——挑哪个游戏来跑、来改,从此是顺手的一步,而不是一次搬家。

kxt42tk.en: A new observatory: watch what agents are doing, live
kxt42tk.zh: 新增"观测台":实时看 agent 在做什么

kk6z8c.en: A new "observatory" workbench lays out agent activity in real time: who's running, which tool they're calling, what events they've produced — all at a glance. It's backed by a dedicated backend interface and an event bridge that streams what's happening in the background onto this panel. It addresses the most conflicting pair of needs when "letting a team of agents work on their own" — wanting to be hands-off yet fearing total loss of control. The observatory gives you a middle ground: let them run by themselves normally, and a glance at the panel tells you the overall state; the moment something's off, you can immediately see who and at which step the problem is and step in. For a platform leaning ever more on multi-agent collaboration, this "visible sense of control" is the psychological footing to dare hand more to the AI.
kk6z8c.zh: 新增了一个"观测台"工作台,把 agent 的活动实时摊开:谁在跑、在调用哪个工具、产出了什么事件,一目了然。它由专门的后端接口和一条事件桥支撑,把后台正在发生的事源源不断地送到这个面板上。它解决的是"放手让一群 agent 自己干活"时最矛盾的一对需求——既想撒手不管、又怕完全失控。观测台给了你一个折中:平时让它们自己跑,你扫一眼面板就知道全局态势;一旦哪里不对劲,你能立刻看清是谁、在哪一步出了问题,及时介入。对多 agent 协作越来越重的平台,这种"看得见的掌控感"是敢于把更多事交给 AI 的心理底气。

k1s727uj.en: Narrative tools get teeth + the narrative agent activates
k1s727uj.zh: 叙事工具补上真本事 + 叙事 agent 激活

k3o9rxu.en: The narrative line moved this day from "an empty shell" to "actually usable." The backend added a set of large-model-facing narrative tool definitions — equipping the agent with handy implements that genuinely arrange story and text, not just an interface that can't act; meanwhile, the dedicated agent responsible for narrative was formally activated from placeholder status and can take work. Together, "writing the story" has, for the first time, both a role and tools that can actually drive it in the platform. Making a game was never only piling up gameplay; plot, dialogue and pacing are equally a work's soul. Filling in the narrative tools and the narrative agent together is a concrete step toward "one person can make a complete, fully-fleshed game."
k3o9rxu.zh: 叙事这条线这天从"有个空壳"走到了"真能用"。后端补上了一组面向大模型的叙事工具定义——也就是给 agent 配上了几把能真正编排剧情与文本的"趁手家伙",而不只是一个没法动手的界面;与此同时,负责叙事的那个专门 agent 也从占位状态正式激活,可以接活了。两件事合起来,意味着"写故事"这件事在平台里第一次有了能实际驱动它的角色和工具。做游戏从来不只是堆玩法,剧情、对白、节奏同样是作品的灵魂;把叙事工具和叙事 agent 一起补齐,是平台朝"一个人就能做出一个有血有肉的完整游戏"这个目标迈出的实在一步。

k197kki6.zh: 聊天更清爽 + 凭据更安全

k1dwi6s.en: Interface and security each got a touch this day. The chat interface had a pass of simplification: redundant glow and blur removed, borders unified, the list paginates when many agents are installed, and hover heights are steadier — easier on the eyes over a long session and more focused on content itself. The preview window also opened the graphics and fullscreen permissions it needs, so games inside run more completely. On security, the backend began migrating model keys from a separate vault toward "environment-variable only" management, and added a file-activity ledger — both simplifying the credential path and making "when which file was touched" traceable. A cleaner interface is to disturb less, tidier credentials to be more trustworthy — both bringing the platform a step closer to "safe to use long-term."
k1dwi6s.zh: 这天界面与安全上也各收一笔。聊天界面做了一轮精简:去掉多余的发光与模糊效果、把边框统一,装了很多 agent 时列表会自动分页,悬停时高度也更稳,长时间盯着看更省眼、更专注于内容本身。预览窗也放开了所需的图形与全屏等权限,让里面的游戏跑得更完整。安全方面,后端开始把模型密钥从一个独立保险库迁向"只走环境变量"的方式管理,并加了一份文件活动账本——既简化了凭据的管理路径,也让"什么时候动了哪个文件"有迹可循。界面更清爽是为了少打扰,凭据更规整是为了更可信,两者都在让平台朝"能放心长期使用"再靠近一点。

k1arspnb.en: Engine: slimmer boilerplate + clean in-browser runs
k1arspnb.zh: 引擎:样板代码瘦身 + 浏览器里干净运行

k1di84rc.en: The engine did low-level work on both "easy to use" and "easy to run" this day. One is boilerplate slimming: giving common data structures sensible defaults and convenient factory functions, and unifying how some common utilities are exported — so writing game content takes less boilerplate and expresses intent more directly. The other is "browser-safe sub-exports": stripping dependencies usable only in the local environment (not the browser) out of the engine's main entry, ensuring the engine, when loaded in the browser, doesn't accidentally pull in things that can't run, and runs cleanly. The former lowers the burden of "writing," the latter safeguards the stability of "running"; neither is a flashy feature, but both genuinely make this in-house engine friendlier to the people using it (and the AI generating code).
k1di84rc.zh: 引擎这天在"好用、好跑"上各做了一处底层功夫。其一是样板代码瘦身:给常用的数据结构补上合理的默认值与便捷的创建函数,并统一了一些常用工具的引出方式——结果是写游戏内容时要敲的样板代码更少,意图更直接。其二是"浏览器安全子导出":把那些只能在本机环境(而非浏览器)里用的依赖,从引擎的主入口里剥离出去,确保引擎在浏览器里加载时不会误拉进跑不动的东西、干净利落地运行。前者降低了"写"的负担,后者保障了"跑"的稳定;它们都不是亮眼功能,却实实在在地让这台自研引擎对使用它的人(以及生成代码的 AI)更友好。

k3chbco.en: One-tap context compaction + a WebGPU software fallback
k3chbco.zh: 一键整理对话 + WebGPU 软件兜底

k1kh72bg.en: This day worked on "keeping long conversations and all kinds of machines from breaking down": one-tap conversation compaction, a visible context gauge, autocompleting slash commands; and a software fallback for 3D when hardware acceleration is missing. New games start from a clean ECS template, and the engine added 2D sprite-sheet animation and a batch of robustness fixes.
k1kh72bg.zh: 这天围绕"让长会话和各种机器都不掉链子"做功夫:一键压缩对话、上下文用量看得见、斜杠命令可补全;3D 在没有硬件加速时自动软件兜底。新游戏从干净的 ECS 模板起步,引擎还补上 2D 精灵图集动画与一批健壮性修复。

k1fj0a81.zh: 把"长期、广泛地用"这件事做扎实

k1198jdv.en: Once capability is in place, the next question is: can it be used long-term and broadly? Long-term means whether a single conversation can last without the context overflowing; broad means whether it runs on all sorts of machines, not just the developer's high-end one. The day's items answer these two respectively: one-tap conversation compaction addresses "chatting long enough hits the ceiling," and the WebGPU software fallback addresses "no good GPU means a black screen." Add the clean new-game starting point, 2D animation and a batch of robustness fixes, and the through-line is clear: not new gimmicks, but making "everyday long-running use on more machines" solid.
k1198jdv.zh: 能力齐了之后,下一个问题是:它能不能被长期、广泛地用?长期,指的是一次对话能不能撑很久而不被上下文塞爆;广泛,指的是它能不能在各种各样的机器上都跑得起来,而不只是开发者那台高配电脑。这天的几件事,正好分别回答这两个问题:一键整理对话解决"聊久了会卡上限",WebGPU 软件兜底解决"没有好显卡就黑屏"。再加上新游戏的干净起点、2D 动画和一批健壮性修复——主线很清楚:不是加新花活,而是把"日常长时间、在更多机器上用"这件事做扎实。

k5cn2ub.zh: 一键整理对话:/compact + 上下文用量环

k1uqfyg3.en: Over long back-and-forth with a large model, the "context" it can hold piles up; near the limit, responses slow, quality drops, and it even starts forgetting. This day added a /compact command: one tap compresses the prior exchanges into a concise summary, freeing room to keep going, and the compaction itself doesn't burn a whole conversation turn — it's done directly on the backend. The composer also gained a "context-usage ring" that, like a fuel gauge, shows at a glance how much budget remains, so when it's getting full you can see it and proactively decide whether to tidy up. With slash-command autocomplete, typing / surfaces all available commands for quick selection. This set of changes faces head-on the core constraint of "long-term collaboration with AI" — context is finite; putting its management in the user's hands, done lightly, is what makes long sessions truly sustainable.
k1uqfyg3.zh: 和大模型长时间来回,它能记住的"上下文"会越堆越满;一旦接近上限,响应会变慢、质量也会下滑,甚至开始忘事。这天加了一个 /compact 命令:一键把此前的来回压缩成一份精炼的摘要,腾出空间继续聊,而且这次压缩本身不占用一整轮对话——它是直接在后端完成的。输入框里还多了一个"上下文用量环",像油表一样直观显示当前还剩多少额度,快满了你一眼就能看见,从而主动决定该不该整理一下。配合斜杠命令的自动补全,打一个 / 就能看到所有可用命令并快速选用。这一组改动直面"和 AI 长期协作"绕不开的核心约束——上下文是有限的;把它的管理交到用户手里、而且做得轻巧,长会话才真正可持续。

k18g3kle.en: A WebGPU software fallback: 3D runs on more machines
k18g3kle.zh: WebGPU 软件兜底:更多机器能跑起 3D

k1n8b3q7.en: 3D rendering depends on a modern GPU's capabilities, but in reality some machines or environments can't get hardware acceleration — maybe the GPU is too old, maybe the runtime is constrained. Previously this meant a black screen, shutting those users out entirely. This day added a software fallback: when a hardware-accelerated rendering device can't be obtained, the system steps back and uses a software implementation to render the picture — slower, but at least it runs, shows and lets you keep working. Underneath, multi-level fallback was added (try the next path when one fails, error only as a last resort), with clearer diagnostics explaining why hardware acceleration wasn't taken (say, running under a non-secure origin). The significance is coverage: a platform for the mass market, wanting anyone to get started, can't assume everyone has a high-end machine; running on weaker machines too is what truly lowers the bar.
k1n8b3q7.zh: 3D 渲染依赖现代显卡的能力,但现实里总有一些机器或环境拿不到硬件加速——可能是显卡太旧、可能是运行环境受限。以前遇到这种情况就是一片黑屏,等于直接把这部分用户挡在门外。这天加了一层软件兜底:当拿不到硬件加速的渲染设备时,系统会自动退一步,改用软件实现把画面渲出来——虽然慢一些,但至少能跑、能看、能继续做。底层还做了多级回退(一条路不通就试下一条,实在不行才报错),并补上了更清楚的诊断提示,告诉你为什么没走上硬件加速(比如运行在非安全来源下)。这件事的意义在于覆盖面:一个面向大众、希望谁都能上手的平台,不能假设每个人都有一台高配电脑;能在更弱的机器上也跑起来,门槛才真正降了下来。

k1os2u3d.en: New games start from a clean ECS template
k1os2u3d.zh: 新游戏从干净的 ECS 模板起步

kpf3d2z.en: Creating a new game now generates from a clean, well-structured template organized along a proper architecture. This day rewrote that default template in a "proper ECS architecture" style, extracted it from an inline string into a version-controlled standalone file, and halved its line count — meaning the moment you create a game, you get a clean, compact base ready to build on, not a pile of boilerplate you must first understand before editing. The template and the system instructions fed to the AI were updated to the latest engine interfaces alongside. This matters especially for "AI writing games": the AI continues from the template's shape, so the cleaner and more standard the template, the more likely the AI's code is correct and the easier it is for you to read and reuse. A good starting point saves countless later corrections.
kpf3d2z.zh: 新建一个游戏时,现在会从一份结构清晰、按正规架构组织的精简模板生成。这天把这份默认模板重写成了"正规 ECS 架构"的写法,并把它从内嵌字符串提取成一个受版本控制的独立文件、行数还砍掉了一半——也就是说,你一建好游戏,拿到的就是一份干净、紧凑、能直接往上加东西的好底子,而不是一堆需要先读懂再删改的样板代码。配套也把模板和喂给 AI 的系统说明一起更新到了最新的引擎接口。这件事对"AI 来写游戏"尤其重要:AI 是照着模板的样子继续写的,模板越干净、越规范,AI 生成的代码就越大概率写对、越容易被你看懂和复用。一个好的起点,能省下后面无数纠偏的功夫。

kz3e73k.en: The engine added 2D sprite-sheet animation this day: playing multiple frames from a "sprite sheet" (a series of action frames laid out in one image) in sequence, giving 2D character and effect animation a ready-made, standard approach. This is the most common animation method in 2D games — a little figure walking, a flame flickering, is essentially a few frames cycling quickly. Before this, 2D content could only be static sprites; with sheet animation, the 2D line can truly move. Together with the earlier sprite layers, it fills in the engine's 2D fundamentals: correct layering and stacking, plus making each sprite move. For anyone wanting to make a 2D game, this is the key step from "can place images" to "can do animation."
kz3e73k.zh: 引擎这天补上了 2D 精灵图集动画:把一张"精灵图集"(把一连串动作帧排在同一张图里)里的多帧按顺序播放,角色和特效的 2D 动画就有了一套现成、规范的做法。这是 2D 游戏里最常用的动画方式——一个小人走路、一团火焰跳动,本质上就是几帧画面快速轮播。在此之前 2D 内容只能是静态精灵;有了图集动画,2D 这条线才算真正能动起来。它和此前的精灵图层一起,把引擎做 2D 的基本功补齐:既能正确分层叠放,又能让每个精灵动起来。对想做 2D 游戏的人来说,这是把"能摆图"升级成"能做动画"的关键一步。

k9xhc5v.en: Engine robustness: regression tests + a batch of rendering fixes
k9xhc5v.zh: 引擎健壮性:回归测试 + 一批渲染修复

k305fej.en: The engine also did a batch of unglamorous but important robustness work this day. Regression tests were added for several failure-prone situations — render queries, parent-child hierarchy, and the edge case of "not a single light in the scene" — pinning them down with tests so future changes elsewhere can't quietly break them. Some vaguely-named fields were renamed more accurately so the code is harder to misread; and a few compatibility issues that surfaced only after merging were fixed. These are the work of "welding down newly added capability": after intensely adding many things over the prior days, this day went back to add tests and clean edges, ensuring they don't just "run once" but "stay reliable going forward." Alternating fast iteration with steady consolidation is why this product line can keep running.
k305fej.zh: 这天引擎还做了一批不显眼但要紧的健壮性工作。补上了针对几类容易出问题的情形的回归测试——比如渲染查询、父子层级、以及"场景里一盏灯都没有"这种边界,把它们用测试钉死,防止以后改别的地方时把它们悄悄改坏。还把一些含义模糊的字段做了更准确的命名,让代码读起来更不容易误解;并修了几处合并后才暴露的兼容问题。这些都属于"把刚加进来的新能力焊牢"的工作:前面几天密集加了很多东西,这天回头给它们补测试、清边角,确保它们不只是"能跑一次",而是"以后也一直靠得住"。快速迭代和稳扎稳打交替进行,是这条产品线能一直跑下去的原因。

kuzwtee.en: The engine stands fully on its own + richer materials
kuzwtee.zh: 引擎完全自立 + 更真实的材质

k1f7ufcf.en: A milestone: the engine removed its last external rendering-library dependency, now running entirely on its own and self-verifying every frame's pixel accuracy. Materials rose to emissive + ambient occlusion + tone-mapping looks; more older devices can render; the preview got a native "player" where a game starts in fifty lines; plus HTTPS everywhere and preview auto-recovery.
k1f7ufcf.zh: 里程碑日:引擎拔掉最后一个外部渲染库依赖,从此完全靠自己跑、还能自检每帧的像素级精度。材质升到自发光 + 环境光遮蔽 + 多种色调映射;更多老设备也能画得出;预览有了原生"播放器",五十行就能写个游戏;再加上全程 HTTPS 与预览自动恢复。

k1tbvg6l.en: The watershed of standing alone: from "borrowed shell" to "standing on its own"
k1tbvg6l.zh: 自立的分水岭:从"借壳"到"自己站住"

kjwee04.en: This is a watershed day in the engine's history. All along, the engine had kept a low-level dependency on a mature external general-purpose rendering library — using it as the "reference answer" to check whether its own rendering was correct. This day removed that last dependency entirely, and the engine now runs solely on its own rendering pipeline. This isn't an ordinary dependency removal but a shift in posture: from "standing on others' shoulders, always referencing someone else" to "being the standard itself." The items below — a self-check benchmark, richer materials, device compatibility, a native preview — are all the accompaniment around this "standing alone," together declaring that this engine has grown into a mature renderer that stands on its own.
kjwee04.zh: 这是引擎发展史上的一个分水岭日。一直以来,引擎在底层还留着对一个成熟的外部通用渲染库的依赖——用它当"标准答案"来对照自己画得对不对。这天把这最后一个依赖整个拔掉,引擎从此完全靠自己的渲染管线运行。这不是一次普通的删依赖,而是一个姿态上的转变:从"站在别人肩膀上、随时要参照别人"的状态,变成"自己就是那个标准"。下面几件事——自检基准、材质升档、设备兼容、原生预览——都是围绕这次"自立"展开的配套,合起来宣告:这台引擎已经长成一个能独立站住的成熟渲染器。

kwdv3kh.en: A built-in pixel-parity benchmark: verifying itself
kwdv3kh.zh: 自带像素级对齐基准:自己给自己验真

k1kv7x51.en: After removing the external library, a practical problem followed: previously that library was the reference to confirm "is the rendering correct," and without it, what guarantees quality? The answer: the engine carries its own "pixel-parity" benchmark — it generates its own reference answer and checks each rendered frame pixel by pixel, alarming on any deviation. That turns the "quality judge" from externally borrowed into built into the engine itself. Its far-reaching significance: from now, the engine's image quality, performance and feature evolution are fully in its own hands, no longer led by an external library's capability boundaries and trade-offs — whatever you want to add or optimize, no working around someone else's limits. An engine that can verify itself is truly qualified to evolve independently long-term.
k1kv7x51.zh: 拔掉外部库之后,一个现实问题随之而来:以前靠那个库当对照来确认"画得对不对",现在没有它了,拿什么保证质量?答案是引擎自带了一套"像素级对齐"的基准——它能自己给自己出标准答案,逐像素核对每一帧渲染的结果,差一点就报警。这等于把"质量裁判"从外部请来的,变成了引擎自己内置的。它的深远意义在于:从此引擎的画质、性能、特性演进都完全掌握在自己手里,不再被外部库的能力边界和取舍牵着走——想加什么、想怎么优化,不必绕开别人的限制。一个能自我验真的引擎,才真正具备了长期独立演进的资格。

k1gu6zlc.en: Tier-1 PBR materials: emissive + ambient occlusion + tone-mapping looks
k1gu6zlc.zh: Tier-1 PBR 材质:自发光 + 环境光遮蔽 + 多种色调映射

kqvc089.en: The material system was unified and stepped up a level this day. The low level merged what had been several material variants into one unified "render-pass"-based material model, simplifying concepts and making room to add new capabilities. On this unified model, several realism-boosting abilities were added: emissive, letting objects glow on their own for neon signs, glowing runes and energy cores; ambient occlusion, naturally darkening crevices, corners and contact points to greatly strengthen depth; and several tone-mapping looks to choose the overall feel of the image (cool, warm, cinematic, etc.). To keep "more material variety" from "costing frame rate," these complex materials are threaded through a render-pipeline cache, reusing the same and keeping different ones separate. All told, things in a scene look more "right" and more tactile — the key upgrade from "can render" to "renders beautifully."
kqvc089.zh: 材质系统这天统一并升了一档。底层把原本分成几种变体的材质合并成一套统一的、基于"渲染通道"的材质模型,既简化了概念,也为加新能力腾出了空间。在这套统一模型上,加了几样让画面更真实的能力:自发光,让物体能自己"亮"起来,做霓虹灯、发光符文、能量核心这类效果;环境光遮蔽,让缝隙、转角、接触处自然变暗,大大增强立体感;还有多种色调映射风格,让你能挑画面的整体观感(冷峻、温暖、电影感等)。为了不让"材质花样一多就掉帧",这些复杂材质会被串进渲染管线的缓存里,相同的复用、不同的各管各的。综合起来,场景里的东西看上去更"对"、更有质感——这是从"画得出"迈向"画得好看"的关键升级。

k8ot564.en: Wider device support: the device layer completed + fallback without advanced features
k8ot564.zh: 更广的设备兼容:渲染设备层补齐 + 无高级特性也能兜底

kksknj7.en: This day also pushed "letting the engine run on more machines" forward. The low-level "rendering device layer" completed a key full set of capabilities, so the engine can fully request and use the device resources rendering needs in the browser, no longer missing pieces; on the fallback path without the latest GPU features, the remaining gaps to "renders properly" were wired up one by one. Even more thoughtfully, for devices missing certain modern GPU features, a material-compatibility route was built so they can draw objects correctly even on a simplified path. Net result: the range of machines that can run 3D properly widened another notch. For a mass-market platform, "runs on weaker machines" matters as much as "looks better" — the former decides how many can get in, the latter whether they stay.
kksknj7.zh: 这天把"让引擎在更多机器上跑得起来"也往前推了一截。底层的"渲染设备层"补齐了关键的一整组能力,让引擎在浏览器里能完整地申请并使用渲染所需的设备资源,不再缺胳膊少腿;在没有最新显卡能力的退路上,也把离"能正常出图"仅剩的几个缺口逐一接通。更贴心的是,对那些缺少某些现代显卡特性的设备,专门做了材质上的兼容方案,让它们即便走简化路径也能把物体正确画出来。综合下来,能正常跑起 3D 的机器范围又宽了一截。对一个面向大众的平台来说,"在更弱的机器上也能跑"和"画得更好看"同样重要——前者决定有多少人进得来,后者决定他们留不留得住。

keszgrr.en: A native preview player — a game in fifty lines
keszgrr.zh: 预览有了原生"播放器",五十行就能写个游戏

k1iefmo2.en: Preview games this day moved to the platform's own native runtime host: a clean game entry and loader responsible for loading and running a game correctly, with no detour through an external host. The game template was compressed to about fifty lines — meaning writing a runnable game starts from fifty lines. The value here is "a light enough starting point": a beginner or an AI faces not a big lump of framework code to understand first, but a minimal, clear skeleton ready to build on immediately. The lighter and more standard the start, the smoother the road of "chatting a game into being" — AI generating code from this clean start makes fewer errors, and a human taking over finds it easier to read and edit. A native host plus a minimal template is a step toward cutting the entry bar of "making a game" to the lowest.
k1iefmo2.zh: 预览游戏这天用上了平台自己的原生运行宿主:一套清爽的游戏入口与加载器,负责把一个游戏正确地装载、跑起来,不必再绕一个外部宿主。配套把游戏模板压缩到了约五十行——也就是说,写一个能跑的游戏,从五十行起步就够了。这件事的价值在于"起点足够轻":一个新手或一个 AI,面对的不是一大坨需要先读懂的框架代码,而是一份极简、清晰、能立刻往上加东西的骨架。起点越轻、越标准,"聊出一个游戏"这条路就越顺——AI 照着这个干净起点生成代码,出错更少;人接手时,也更容易看懂和修改。原生宿主 + 极简模板,是把"做游戏"的入门台阶削到最低的一步。

knn6h2f.zh: 稳定性:全程 HTTPS + 预览自动恢复

k13siqf4.en: This day also added two stability touches. One is support for a "HTTPS everywhere" dev mode — some modern browser capabilities (including certain graphics and device features) are only granted under a secure origin, and HTTPS makes them properly available while better matching a real deployment environment. The other is preview auto-recovery: when the preview errors due to a transient backend hiccup, it tries to reconnect and self-heal on its own, rather than sitting on an error page waiting for a manual refresh. Both are the work of "not interrupting you" — what most breaks flow during development is often not some big bug but these small recurring issues needing a manual rescue every so often. Automating them away is what makes sitting down to make a game for hours truly smooth.
k13siqf4.zh: 这天还在稳定性上补了两笔。其一是支持"全程 HTTPS"的开发模式——某些现代浏览器能力(包括部分图形与设备特性)只在安全来源下才放开,走 HTTPS 能让这些能力正常可用,也更贴近真实部署环境。其二是预览的自动恢复:当预览因为后端的临时抖动而出错时,它会自己尝试重连、自愈,而不是停在一个错误页面等你手动刷新。这两件事都属于"让你不被打断"的功夫——开发时最破坏心流的,往往不是某个大 bug,而是这种隔三差五要手动救一下的小毛病。把它们自动化掉,长时间坐着做游戏才真正顺畅。

k1yydrbi.en: The core of this day is the engine completing its "independence." Removing the last external rendering dependency and carrying its own pixel-parity benchmark means it grew from "running on a borrowed shell, referencing others" into a mature renderer that stands on its own and verifies itself. On that footing, materials rose to real tactile quality, device compatibility reached weaker machines, the preview got a minimal native starting point, and stability became more resilient — each an extension that means more after this independence. A platform daring to make its most core rendering foundation fully in-house, depending on no external library, is after holding its own fate: from now, how far image quality can go, how much performance can be optimized, and what new features to support are no longer at others' mercy. That's the weight this day most deserves to be remembered for.
k1yydrbi.zh: 这一天的核心,是引擎完成了"自立"。拔掉最后一个外部渲染依赖、自带像素级基准,意味着它从一个"借别人壳跑、要参照别人"的状态,长成了一个能独立站住、自己给自己验真的成熟渲染器。在这个底气之上,材质升到了能做真实质感、设备兼容覆盖到了更弱的机器、预览有了极简的原生起点、稳定性也更经得起折腾——每一项都是这次自立之后才更有意义的延伸。一个平台敢把最核心的渲染底座做成完全自研、不依赖任何外部库,图的是把命运攥在自己手里:从此画质能走多远、性能能优化到什么程度、要支持什么新特性,都不再受制于人。这正是这一天最该被记住的分量。

k1oe13mf.en: A dedicated animation workbench + live tool streaming
k1oe13mf.zh: 动画独立成工作台 + 工具执行实时流式显示

k6tsdoj.en: This day split the bloated character workbench into focused tools (character, animation, effects), and tool execution became live-streaming and auto-collapsing when done. The preview is steadier; the engine added an audio system, material inheritance, and a batch of advanced rendering demos.
k6tsdoj.zh: 这天把臃肿的角色工作台拆成几个各司其职的专门工具(角色、动画、特效),工具执行过程也变成实时流式、结束自动收起。预览更稳;引擎补上音频系统、材质继承,以及一批进阶渲染示例。

keogtod.en: Split and stream: make big tools focused, make waiting transparent
keogtod.zh: 拆分与流式:让大工具变专、让等待变透明

k10qdgra.en: The day's two through-lines are both about clarity. One is splitting an ever-bloating big workbench into focused tools — big-and-everything often means nothing is quite smooth, and after splitting each can be more focused and go deeper. The other is turning the agent's tool-calling from "a black box you wait on" into "watching it work live" — making waiting transparent so you can see which step it's on. One is structural clarity, the other process clarity; with preview stability polish and several new engine capabilities, the day's overall work is keeping this ever-larger system clear and controllable to people.
k10qdgra.zh: 这天的两条主线都关于"清晰"。一条是把一个越长越臃肿的大工作台,拆成几个各司其职的专门工具——大而全往往意味着哪样都不够顺手,拆开之后每个都能更聚焦、更深入。另一条是把 agent 调用工具的过程从"黑箱等结果"变成"实时看它干活"——让等待变得透明,你能看清它正在哪一步。一个是结构上的清晰,一个是过程上的清晰;再加上预览的稳定性打磨和引擎的几项新能力,这天整体在做的,是让这个越来越大的系统对人始终保持清楚、可控。

ketabu4.en: The character workbench splits: character, animation, effects each focused
ketabu4.zh: 角色工作台拆成专门工具:角色、动画、特效各司其职

k1fxu9e1.en: The original character workbench carried too many responsibilities — modeling, animation and effects all piled together, growing bloated with no room for any to stretch. This day split it by function: animation-related capabilities (skeletal animation, video generation and related pipelines) moved out wholesale into a dedicated animation workbench; effects-related capabilities (various visual-effect generation) moved into a separate effects/skill workbench; and the character workbench itself slimmed back to "focusing on the character." The split was careful — shared low-level code was carried over with clear annotations so that afterward the tools don't depend on each other and can each evolve independently. With clearer division of labor, each tool is more focused and usable, and each can go deeper in its own direction without one change rippling through everything.
k1fxu9e1.zh: 原先的角色工作台一个人扛了太多职责——又要造型、又要做动画、又要做特效,功能堆在一起越来越臃肿,哪一块都施展不开。这天把它按职能拆开:动画相关的能力(骨骼动画、视频生成等管线)整块迁出,独立成一个专门的动画工作台;特效相关的能力(各类视觉特效生成)迁进一个独立的特效/技能工作台;角色工作台本身则瘦身,回归"专心做角色本身"。拆分过程很讲究——把共享的底层代码以清晰标注的方式各自带走,确保拆完之后几个工具互不依赖、能各自独立演进。各司其职之后,每个工具都更聚焦、更好用,后面也能在自己的方向上深耕,而不必牵一发动全身。

krz5rh0.en: Tool execution streams live, then tidies itself away
krz5rh0.zh: 工具执行实时流式显示,完成自动收起

k1o3om58.en: When an agent calls a tool, the process now streams live — output rolls out line by line so you can watch it progress instead of waiting blankly for a final result. Behind this, the backend gained "incremental streaming output for tool calls": a tool pushes fragments to the interface in real time as it runs, rather than holding everything until it finishes. To avoid flooding the screen, the display keeps a "rolling tail" of just the latest lines; when the step finishes, its tool panel auto-collapses and the interface returns to clean at once. This improves the "waiting experience": while waiting on a tool that may run for tens of seconds, seeing it genuinely move and knowing which step it's at is far more reassuring than staring at a frozen spinner. Transparent while you watch, out of the way once you've seen it — exactly the discretion a good tool should have.
k1o3om58.zh: agent 调用工具时,过程现在是实时流式显示的——输出一行行滚出来,你能看着它一步步推进,而不是干等一个最终结果。这背后是后端支持了"工具调用的增量流式输出":工具一边跑,一边把片段实时推到界面上,而不是憋到结束才一次性返回。为了不刷屏,显示采用"只留最新几行"的滚动末尾方式;当这一步执行结束,对应的工具面板会自动收起,界面立刻回归清爽。这件事改善的是"等待体验":在等一个可能要跑几十秒的工具时,看着它确实在动、知道它到哪一步了,远比对着一个不动的转圈圈安心。看的时候透明,看完又不碍事——这正是一个好工具该有的分寸。

k5jhieo.en: A steadier preview: crash prevention + removing the redundant overlay
k5jhieo.zh: 预览更稳:崩溃防护 + 去掉多余的崩溃浮层

k9r93cu.en: Preview stability got another pass this day. The key piece: before reloading the preview, it now "gracefully" releases the graphics resources held earlier and then loads the new one — avoiding old and new rendering both grabbing resources and crashing the whole graphics environment. Crash detection got smarter too, changed to "start judging only after the first frame appears," dodging false alarms during the just-loaded, not-yet-rendered window. The somewhat redundant crash overlay was removed — if you really need to start over, the toolbar already has a reload button, which is enough. Streaming output also got throttling to avoid refreshing too fast and dragging down rendering. Individually fine-grained, these together decide one thing: whether, as you repeatedly try and edit in the preview, it keeps crashing on you. Eliminating these small crashes one by one is what keeps creation uninterrupted.
k9r93cu.zh: 预览的稳定性这天又收了一轮。最关键的一处是:在重新加载预览之前,会先"优雅地"释放掉之前占用的图形资源,再加载新的——避免新旧两套渲染同时抢占资源而把整个图形环境搞崩。崩溃检测也更聪明了,改成"出现第一帧画面之后才开始判断",从而避开了刚加载、还没出图那段时间的误报。原先那层略显多余的崩溃浮层也被去掉了——真要重来,工具条上本来就有重载按钮,够用了。流式输出还加了节流,避免刷得太快拖垮渲染。这些改动单看都很细碎,但它们共同决定了一件事:你在预览里反复试、反复改时,它会不会动不动就崩给你看。把这种小崩溃一个个消掉,创作时才不被打断。

k1w09f3y.en: Engine: an audio system + material inheritance + advanced rendering demos
k1w09f3y.zh: 引擎:音频系统 + 材质继承 + 进阶渲染示例

kk7uxzj.en: The engine filled in several pieces this day. Most notable is the audio system — the engine wired in a sound system based on the web's standard audio capability, so games can now make sound: background music, sound effects and scene-driven audio all have underlying support; a game with no sound always lacks half its soul, and this step adds the "hearing" dimension. On materials, inheritance from a "parent" material was supported: put shared settings on the parent, and a child overrides only what differs, making a batch of stylistically-unified-yet-slightly-varying materials both manageable and less error-prone; material registration was also unified. On rendering demos, a batch of advanced-technique demonstrations (depth, stencil, blending, culling, etc.) was completed — both living documentation of the engine's capabilities and a template for more complex visual effects later.
kk7uxzj.zh: 引擎这天补上了好几块。最值得说的是音频系统——引擎接入了基于网页标准音频能力的声音系统,游戏从此能出声:背景音乐、音效、随场景变化的声音都有了底层支撑;一个没有声音的游戏总是少了一半灵魂,这一步把"听觉"这条维度补了进来。材质上,支持了从"父材质"继承属性:把共用的设置放在父材质里,子材质只覆盖需要不同的部分,一批风格统一又各有小差异的材质从此既好管又不易出错;同时把材质的注册方式做了统一收敛。渲染示例上,补齐了一批进阶技法的演示(深度、模板、混合、剔除等),既是引擎能力的活文档,也为后面做更复杂的画面效果打了样。

k1p0esg6.en: This day worked on "staying clear after growing large." Splitting tools admits "one tool can't do everything," so let the specialized specialize; streaming execution admits "users have the right to see what the AI is doing," so make it transparent; preview crash-prevention and engine audio plus material inheritance smooth roughness and fill gaps in their own corners. What a system most easily loses while expanding fast is "clarity" — features pile up, tools get tangled, the process becomes a black box. This day went the other way: rather than keep stuffing one big tool, split it so each is clean; rather than let waiting be a black box, lay the process open for people. Staying clear is the precondition for a complex system to be trusted and steered long-term.
k1p0esg6.zh: 这一天在为"规模变大之后还能保持清楚"做功夫。工具拆分,是承认"一个工具不能什么都干",该专的就专;执行流式,是承认"用户有权看见 AI 在干什么",该透明的就透明;预览防崩、引擎补音频与材质继承,则是在各自的角落把粗糙磨平、把缺口补齐。一个系统在快速膨胀时最容易丢的就是"清楚"——功能越堆越多,工具越来越杂,过程越来越像黑箱。这天反其道而行:与其继续往一个大工具里塞东西,不如拆开让每样都清爽;与其让等待变成黑箱,不如把过程摊开给人看。保持清楚,是一个复杂系统能被长期信任和驾驭的前提。

k1wfpfno.en: The engine gains physics & picking + a rebuilt UI foundation
k1wfpfno.zh: 引擎加上物理与点选 + 界面底座换代

k1hanuez.en: This day the engine knocked out several hard parts of making a game at once: 2D/3D physics, screen picking, anti-aliasing, plus frustum culling for smoother large scenes. The interface moved onto a modern component foundation with a render-error safety net; materials gained inheritance read-through, picking a game activates it, and a reel workbench joined the tool family.
k1hanuez.zh: 这天引擎一口气补上做游戏的几块硬骨头:2D/3D 物理、屏幕点选拾取、抗锯齿,还加了视锥剔除让大场景更流畅。界面则迁到一套现代组件底座、配上渲染错误兜底;材质支持继承读穿,选哪个游戏就激活哪个,工具家族还添了影像工作台。

k1kwbas9.en: The engine's accumulated capabilities had mostly stayed on "rendering correctly and beautifully"; but a game needs more than looks — it has to be playable: objects must fall and collide, the player must be able to click and operate. The engine's through-line this day was knocking out at once the hard parts "playable" requires: physics, picking, anti-aliasing, performance culling. Meanwhile the interface side did a foundation upgrade, moving its whole interaction component set onto a more modern, stable implementation. Making "what you build playable" on one side and "the tool you build with steadier" on the other — this is a day the engine and interface crossed a quality threshold together.
k1kwbas9.zh: 引擎前面攒下的能力大多还停留在"把画面渲对、渲好看"上;但一个游戏光好看不够,得能玩——物体要会掉落、会碰撞,玩家要能点中、能操作。这天的引擎主线,正是把"能玩"所必需的几块硬骨头一次性补上:物理、点选、抗锯齿、性能剔除。与此同时,界面那一侧也做了一次底座换代,把整套交互组件迁到更现代、更稳的实现上。一边让"做出来的东西能玩",一边让"用来做的工具更稳",这天是引擎与界面同时迈过一道质量门槛的一天。

k6eumpp.en: A big engine boost: physics + click-to-pick + anti-aliasing
k6eumpp.zh: 引擎大补强:物理 + 点选拾取 + 抗锯齿

k1mutb4r.en: The engine knocked out three unavoidable parts of making a game at once this day. The headline is physics: a capability supporting both 2D and 3D was integrated, so objects now respond to gravity, collide and stack — platformers, brick-breakers, box-stacking and ball-rolling finally have real underlying support instead of hand-faked pretense. Next is screen picking: click an object on screen and select it precisely — the shared basis for "click to select an object" in the editor and "click-based gameplay" in the game. Third is anti-aliasing: object edges no longer show that staircase jaggedness, so the image looks clean and professional. Physics for "can move," picking for "can interact," anti-aliasing for "looks presentable" — with all three, the engine truly crosses from "can render" into "can make a playable game."
k1mutb4r.zh: 引擎这天一口气补上了做游戏绕不开的三块。最重磅的是物理:接入了一套同时支持 2D 和 3D 的物理能力,物体从此能受重力、会碰撞、能堆叠——平台跳跃、打砖块、堆箱子、滚小球这些玩法终于有了真正的底层支撑,而不是靠手写假装。其次是"屏幕点选拾取":鼠标点屏幕上哪个物体,就能精确地把它选中——这是编辑器里"点一下选中物体"和游戏里"点击玩法"共同的基础。第三是抗锯齿:物体边缘不再有那种台阶状的锯齿毛刺,画面看起来干净专业。物理负责"能动起来"、点选负责"能交互"、抗锯齿负责"看着像样",三者凑齐,引擎才真正从"能渲染"跨进了"能做一个能玩的游戏"。

kolwl27.en: Performance: frustum culling for smoother large scenes
kolwl27.zh: 性能:视锥剔除让大场景更流畅

k1uzry68.en: The engine also added a key performance optimization this day: frustum culling. The idea is plain — don't bother drawing objects the camera can't currently see (those outside the view). Before this, objects in a scene might all be processed whether or not they were on screen, wasting a lot of compute as scenes grew; now the engine first judges whether each object is within the camera's visible range and skips the invisible ones outright. The bigger the scene and the more objects, the more this saves, so frame rates hold up far better in complex scenes. It complements the earlier instanced drawing (draw a big batch of identical objects at once): one cuts "drawing duplicates," the other cuts "drawing the invisible." Together, the engine is clearly better equipped to carry large, dense scenes.
k1uzry68.zh: 引擎这天还加了一项关键的性能优化:视锥剔除。原理很直白——摄像机此刻看不到的物体(在视野之外的),就别费力气去画了。在此之前,场景里的物体不管在不在画面里都可能被一一处理,场景一大就白白浪费大量算力;现在引擎会先判断每个物体在不在摄像机的可见范围内,把看不见的直接跳过。场景越大、物体越多,这个优化省下来的就越多,复杂场景的帧率因此稳得多。它和此前的实例化绘制(一次画一大批相同物体)是互补的两招:一个减少"画重复的",一个减少"画看不见的"。两者合起来,引擎扛大型、密集场景的底气明显更足了。

k1axp4f1.en: A rebuilt UI foundation: a modern component library + render-error safety net
k1axp4f1.zh: 界面底座换代:现代组件库 + 渲染错误兜底

k1pffcv8.en: The interface did a "replace the foundation"-level upgrade this day: moving a whole set of interaction components — dialogs, dropdowns, menus, form controls — onto a modern, mature, reliable component base. The benefits are many — smoother interaction feel, more unified visuals, better accessibility; places that used to make do with the browser's native popups (those ugly, uncustomizable system prompt boxes) were upgraded to consistently-styled dialogs. More crucially, a "render-error safety net" was added underneath: if a UI component throws while rendering, the system isolates it rather than letting a local error freeze the whole startup screen into a blank. This looks like "just swapping a UI library," but it actually lifts the interface from "usable but fragile" to "robust and durable" — for a tool you stare at for hours every day, whether the interface is stable directly decides whether using it feels safe.
k1pffcv8.zh: 界面这天做了一次"换地基"级别的升级:把弹窗、下拉、菜单、表单控件等一整套交互组件,全部迁到一套现代、成熟、可靠的组件底座之上。好处是多方面的——交互手感更顺、视觉更统一、无障碍支持更好;原先一些用浏览器原生弹窗(那种很丑、没法定制的系统提示框)凑合的地方,也升级成了风格统一的对话框。更关键的是底层加了一道"渲染错误兜底":万一某个界面组件在渲染时抛了错,系统会把它隔离住,而不是让一个局部的错误把整个启动画面卡死、白屏。这件事看起来只是"换了套 UI 库",实则是把界面从"能用但脆"提升到"稳健耐用"——一个每天要长时间盯着用的工具,界面稳不稳,直接决定了用起来安不安心。

kam9tzc.en: Material inheritance read-through + picking a game activates it
kam9tzc.zh: 材质继承读穿 + 选哪个游戏就激活哪个

k1nztbxe.en: Two more everyday-smoothing improvements landed this day. One: material inheritance became "read-through" — a property a child material doesn't explicitly set automatically falls through to the parent's value — so putting shared settings on the parent and overriding only differences on children makes a batch of unified-yet-slightly-varying materials both manageable and less error-prone. Two, and a critical one: picking or creating a game now genuinely "activates" it as the current game, with the background agent's working directory switching to match. Before this, with multiple games coexisting it was easy to have "you're looking at this one while the agent edits that one" — once whatever you pick is what gets targeted, this mismatch is eliminated. One makes materials maintainable, the other keeps operations unconfused — both key details in straightening out the complex matter of "multiple contents coexisting."
k1nztbxe.zh: 这天还有两处让日常更顺的改进。其一,材质的继承做成了"读穿":子材质没有显式设置的属性,会自动透到父材质去取值——把共用设置放父材质里、子材质只覆盖差异,一批风格统一又各有小别的材质从此既好管又不易出错。其二,也是很要命的一处:挑选或新建一个游戏时,系统现在会真正把它"激活"成当前在做的游戏,后台 agent 干活的工作目录也跟着切过去。在此之前,多个游戏并存时很容易"你看着的是这个、agent 改的是那个"——选了哪个就对准哪个之后,这种错位被根除了。这两件事一个让材质好维护、一个让操作不犯迷糊,都是把"多内容并存"这件复杂事理顺的关键细节。

k4xsv2n.en: A new reel workbench + engine debugging and a default-model upgrade
k4xsv2n.zh: 新增影像工作台 + 引擎调试与默认模型升级

kv8zpb6.en: The tool family gained another member this day: a reel workbench for organizing cutscenes and cinematic content, one more handy tool for making games with narrative and staging. The engine side added a dedicated debugging-technique guide, distilling the routines for diagnosing rendering issues so people and AI can locate problems by following them. The backend upgraded the default model to a stronger tier, so the same conversation gets smarter responses. Individually small, these point one way: beyond the big "playable" and "steadier" blocks, nudging the tools' coverage, the engine's debuggability and the AI's underlying capability each forward a bit. A platform's maturity rests both on a few big strides and on this kind of continuous small reinforcement.
kv8zpb6.zh: 工具家族这天又添一位:影像工作台,用来组织过场动画与影像内容,为做有叙事、有演出的游戏多备一件趁手工具。引擎侧也加了一份专门的调试技法说明,把排查渲染问题的套路沉淀下来,方便人和 AI 照着定位问题。后端把默认使用的模型升级到了更强的一档,同样的对话能得到更聪明的回应。这些改动各自不大,但方向一致:在前面那些"能玩""更稳"的大块之外,把工具的覆盖面、引擎的可调试性、以及 AI 的底层能力都各自往前补了一点。一个平台的成熟,既靠几次大跨步,也靠这种持续的小补强。

k1fvmqgc.en: This is a day the engine and interface both "came of age." The engine adding physics, picking, anti-aliasing and culling — these aren't decorative effects but the passing line for "whether a thing can be called a game": it moves, it's interactive, it looks presentable, it runs a large scene. The interface moving onto a modern foundation with an error safety net lifts the shell you use for hours daily from "usable" to "rugged." Together, they mark the platform beginning to have the full footing to make "genuinely playable games" — both the engine muscle that makes a game hold and the interface stability that makes people want to use it daily. From this day, "make a playable game" is no longer a vision but a toolset actually in hand.
k1fvmqgc.zh: 这一天是引擎和界面同时"成人"的一天。引擎补上物理、点选、抗锯齿、剔除——这些不是锦上添花的特效,而是"一个东西能不能称之为游戏"的及格线:能动、能交互、看着像样、跑得动大场景。界面换上现代底座、加上错误兜底,则是把每天要长时间使用的那层壳从"能用"做到"扛造"。两件事合起来,标志着这个平台开始具备做"真正能玩的游戏"的完整底气——既有让游戏成立的引擎硬实力,又有让人愿意天天用的界面稳定性。从这天起,"做个能玩的游戏"不再是愿景,而是手里真有了那套工具。

k1tm0qzf.en: A desktop app arrives + a shared game library
k1tm0qzf.zh: 桌面 App 立起来 + 多游戏共用一个游戏库

k1ehrrji.en: This day Studio could open as a native desktop app for the first time — close the front window and agents keep working in the background. Multiple games can share one library; agents can call host tools by whitelist right in chat; the engine added a multi-pass pipeline, audio and toggleable anti-aliasing; and the repo was slimmed.
k1ehrrji.zh: 这天 Studio 第一次能作为原生桌面应用打开——关掉前台窗口、agent 也在后台照常干活。多个游戏可以共用一个游戏库;agent 能按白名单在对话里直接调宿主工具;引擎补上多通道渲染管线、音频与可切换抗锯齿;代码库也做了一次瘦身。

k1dc3nuv.en: From "a browser tab" to "a real application"
k1dc3nuv.zh: 从"浏览器里的标签页"到"一个真正的应用"

k9bkmgk.en: Before this, Studio lived in a browser tab — meaning its existence depended on that tab: close it, refresh, or have the browser crash, and everything in progress went with it. The day's headline was making it a standalone native desktop app, giving it "its own window, its own process" for the first time. Around this, the other lines made the platform more like a mature product: multiple games sharing content, agents calling capability more directly, the engine adding audio and multi-pass rendering, the repo slimming down. Upgrading "can run in a browser" to "can stay open as an application long-term" is the transformation this day most deserves to be remembered for.
k9bkmgk.zh: 在此之前,Studio 一直活在浏览器的一个标签页里——这意味着它的存在依附于那个标签:关掉、刷新、或者浏览器一崩,正在干活的一切就跟着没了。这天的头号大事,是把它做成一个能独立打开的原生桌面应用,让它第一次拥有"自己的窗口、自己的进程"。配合这件事,其余几条线也在让平台更像一个成熟产品:多个游戏能共享内容、agent 能更直接地调用能力、引擎补上音频与多通道渲染、代码库做减法。把"能在浏览器里跑"升级成"能作为一个应用长期开着",是这天最值得记住的转变。

k1bvw677.en: A desktop app: close the front window, agents don't die
k1bvw677.zh: 桌面 App 立起来:关掉前台窗口,agent 也不死

k1ln1yj8.en: This day stood up the full shell for a desktop app: Studio can open as a native desktop window for the first time, not just a browser tab. It came with process keep-alive (keeping background services alive beyond the window), window management, and correct asset-root resolution when packaging the desktop build. It finally gives the earlier "agents survive a closed browser" capability a real desktop entry — that keep-alive used to be inside the browser, and now, with a native window, you can keep it open as a real application long-term: hand work to agents, close the front interface, and they keep running in the background; open the window when you want to check progress. A form that can stand alone as an "application" is the key leap from "demo project" to "everyday tool."
k1ln1yj8.zh: 这天把桌面应用的整套外壳立了起来:Studio 第一次能作为一个原生桌面窗口打开,而不只是浏览器里的一个标签页。配套做了进程保活(让后台服务在窗口之外持续存活)、窗口管理,以及桌面打包时正确寻址资产根目录的能力。它和之前"关浏览器 agent 不死"的能力终于接上了一个真正的桌面入口——之前那套保活机制还是在浏览器里,如今有了原生窗口,你可以把它当一个真正的应用长期开着:把活交给 agent,关掉前台界面,它照常在后台跑;想看进度时再打开窗口。一个能独立成"应用"的形态,是从"演示项目"走向"日常工具"的关键一跃。

k13jp9a.zh: 多个游戏共用一个游戏库

k16f39q4.en: Multiple games can now share one game library: put common assets and components into a shared library, and each game carries its own "index" to reference them — no need to copy materials into every game. For a creator cultivating multiple works long-term, this means a series, or several prototypes, can cleanly reuse the same resources rather than scattering duplicate copies everywhere. A thoughtful optimization came with it: during development, an asset change in one game only rescans the resources of "the game you're currently working on," not the whole workspace from scratch — with many games, that's the difference between "takes effect instantly" and "wait a while every time." Sharing plus local rescan together make "one person managing many games" both space-efficient and snappy.
k16f39q4.zh: 多个游戏现在可以共用同一个游戏库:把公共的资产、组件放进一个共享库里,各个游戏再带一份自己的"索引"去引用它们——不必每个游戏都把素材复制一份。对一个想长期经营多个作品的创作者来说,这意味着系列作之间、或多个原型之间可以干净地复用同一批资源,而不是到处散落着重复拷贝。工程上还做了一处贴心优化:开发时,某个游戏的资产发生变动,只会重扫"当前正在做的那个游戏"的资源,而不是把整个工作区从头扫一遍——游戏一多,这个差别就是"改一下立刻生效"和"每次都要等半天"的区别。共享 + 局部重扫,合起来让"一个人管很多个游戏"既省空间又不卡顿。

kvc3sxf.en: Agents call host tools by whitelist, right in chat
kvc3sxf.zh: agent 能按白名单在对话里直接调宿主工具

kp26pdr.en: This day wired a "whitelist" channel through, from type definitions all the way to runtime. An agent can declare in its manifest "which host tools I'm allowed to call," and a "host-tool bridge" injects those declared tools into its conversation tool list; an old, hardcoded tool kit was retired along the way. Concretely: the agent responsible for story declared a set of narrative-related tools in its whitelist, so it can call a whole set of fine-grained narrative tools right in chat to arrange the plot, without routing through a separate kit. The value is "explicit authorization, direct invocation": what each agent can use is spelled out in its manifest — safe and controllable, and making "equip an agent with the capabilities it should have" a declarative, maintainable thing. This is the basis for an agent system trending toward "anyone can configure, each with its specialty."
kp26pdr.zh: 这天打通了一条"白名单"通道,从类型定义一直贯通到运行时。一个 agent 可以在自己的清单里声明"我被允许调用哪些宿主工具",系统的一座"宿主工具桥"就会把这些被声明的工具注入到它的对话工具列表里;借此还顺手退役了一套旧的、写死的工具包。落到实处:负责剧情的那个 agent 声明了一组叙事相关的工具白名单,于是它能直接在聊天里调用一整套细粒度的叙事工具来编排故事,而不必再绕一个专门的工具包。这套机制的价值在于"授权清楚、调用直接":每个 agent 能用什么由它的清单白纸黑字写明,既安全可控,又让"给某个 agent 配上它该有的能力"变成一件声明式的、好维护的事——这是 agent 体系走向"人人可配、各有所长"的基础。

k1nnacgf.en: Engine: a multi-pass render pipeline + audio + toggleable AA
k1nnacgf.zh: 引擎:多通道渲染管线 + 音频 + 可切换抗锯齿

k1yl3jkl.en: The engine filled in several pieces this day. The rendering abstraction grew into a "multi-pass" pipeline — many advanced visual effects (especially post-processing) are essentially computed "in several steps, layer over layer," and with a proper multi-pass structure such effects get a clean way to be built rather than crammed in. Anti-aliasing became runtime-toggleable, making it easy to compare on versus off and obvious while tuning. The engine also built an audio demo, validating "games can make sound" end to end (the sound system had been integrated earlier; this day got an audible sample). Physics fixed an "idle" bug — some objects used to be frozen in place under no forces, and now they fall, collide and move properly. Together, these firm up all three of the engine's experience lines — visuals, sound, physics — another notch toward "can genuinely make a complete game."
k1yl3jkl.zh: 引擎这天补上了几块。渲染抽象升级成"多通道"管线——很多高级画面效果(尤其是后期处理)本质上是"分好几步、一层叠一层"地算出来的,有了多通道的正规结构,这类效果就有了清爽的搭建方式,而不是硬塞。抗锯齿做成了可运行时开关,方便直接对比开与关的画面差别,调效果时一目了然。引擎还做了一个音频示例,把"游戏能出声"这件事跑通验证(声音系统此前已接入,这天有了能听的样例)。物理上修了一个"空转"的问题——之前某些物体会被冻在原地不受力,现在能正常地掉落、碰撞、运动了。这些合起来,是把引擎的"画面 + 声音 + 物理"三条体验线都往"真能做出一个完整游戏"的方向又夯实了一层。

k1mlzide.en: Repo slimming: getting binaries out of the codebase
k1mlzide.zh: 代码库瘦身:把二进制赶出代码库

kempynq.en: The engine also did a round of "repo slimming" this day: clearing bulky binary assets (sample materials, baseline images, build artifacts, etc.) out of the code repository, moving them to a dedicated resource repo or rebuilding them on demand, and establishing a continuous-integration check so no one accidentally stuffs binaries back into the codebase. Invisible to users, this genuinely improves the front-line dev experience: a smaller repo clones faster, has a cleaner history, and feels lighter day to day. For a project meant to evolve long-term, open-sourced, and cloned by more people to get started, "only code in the codebase" is a discipline worth keeping — it directly affects how long a newcomer (or a CI machine) waits and how much space it takes when first pulling the project down. Clearing this long-term burden early is a kindness to all future collaborators.
kempynq.zh: 这天引擎还做了一轮"代码库瘦身":把那些大体积的二进制资产(示例素材、基准图片、编译产物等)从代码仓库里清理出去,改为放到专门的资源仓或在需要时重建,并立了一道持续集成的检查,确保以后不会再有人不小心把二进制塞进代码库。这件事用户看不见,但它实实在在地改善了一线开发体验:代码库变小,克隆更快、历史更干净、日常操作更轻快。对一个要长期演进、还希望对外开源、让更多人能克隆下来上手的项目来说,"代码库里只放代码"是一条值得坚持的纪律——它直接关系到一个新来的人(或一台 CI 机器)第一次把项目拉下来时,要等多久、占多少空间。把这种长期负担提前清理掉,是对未来所有协作者的善意。

km662gk.en: The day's theme is growing the platform from "a thing running in a browser" into "an application you can own and use long-term." The desktop shell gave it its own window and process; the shared game library lets you cultivate more than one work inside it; the whitelist tool channel makes the agent system more configurable and controllable; the engine's audio plus multi-pass rendering and the repo slimming reinforce the "can build" and "runs for the long haul" ends respectively. These differently-aimed changes point at one mark of maturity: it's no longer just a project demonstrating that "conversation can make games," but a tool you'd install on your computer, open daily and entrust long-term. The moment it can stand alone as an "application," the product's identity changes.
km662gk.zh: 这一天的主旋律,是让平台从"一个跑在浏览器里的东西"长成"一个可以独立拥有、长期使用的应用"。桌面外壳给了它自己的窗口和进程;共享游戏库让你能在它里面经营不止一个作品;白名单工具通道让 agent 体系更可配、更可控;引擎补音频与多通道渲染、代码库瘦身,则分别在"做得出""跑得久"两头加固。这些方向各异的改动,共同指向同一个成熟标志:它不再只是一个用来演示"对话能做游戏"的项目,而是一个你愿意装到电脑上、天天打开、长期托付的工具。能独立成"应用"的那一刻,产品的身份就变了。

k1wgr12m.en: Export a game as a standalone site + skybox and bloom
k1wgr12m.zh: 一个游戏打包成网站带走 + 天空盒与辉光

kmmfl7b.en: This day took a big step "from built to shipped": a whole game can be exported as a self-contained static website, dropped onto any host and run. Scenes gained a real skybox and bloom and composite objects sit correctly; the preview loads correctly under prefixed URLs; and the interactive-narrative pipeline runs a full loop.
kmmfl7b.zh: 这天迈出"从做出来到发出去"的一大步:一个游戏能整体导出成自包含的静态网站,丢到任何托管就能跑。场景有了真天空盒与辉光、组合物体摆放也对了;预览在带前缀的地址下也能正确加载;互动叙事的整条管线跑通了闭环。

k14s52qd.en: For a game platform, being able to "build it" isn't enough — you must be able to "ship it," letting what you made leave the tool and be played by others. The weightiest thing this day was filling in the "export" step: packaging a whole game into a website anyone can host and anyone can open. Meanwhile the engine added skybox and bloom for atmosphere, fixed loading under prefixed URLs for deployment flexibility, and ran the narrative pipeline into a loop. On one side "make it look better," on the other "take it away when done" — the day pushed both ends of creation: making you enjoy building, and giving your results somewhere to go.
k14s52qd.zh: 一个游戏平台,光能"做出来"还不够,得能"发出去"——让做好的东西离开工具、被别人玩到。这天最有分量的一件事,就是补上了"导出"这关:把一个游戏整体打包成一个谁都能托管、谁都能打开的网站。与此同时,引擎在画面氛围上添了天空盒和辉光,在部署灵活性上修通了带前缀地址的加载,在内容创作上把叙事管线跑成了闭环。一边是"做得更好看",一边是"做完能带走",这天同时在为创作的两端使劲:既让你做得开心,也让你的成果有去处。

k1m8iw75.en: Package a game into a website you can take with you
k1m8iw75.zh: 一个游戏打包成网站带走

kjquv9g.en: A big step toward shipping: you can now export a whole game as a self-contained static website — no need to bring the full Studio along; drop the exported folder onto any static host and it runs on its own. In other words, the game you chat into being and build here can be packaged up, sent to friends to play, or put online for everyone, instead of being locked inside this tool. A first exported sample came with it — an FPS game called Sector Strike (with its own scene and readme) — to run and validate the whole export chain. A key bug was also fixed: the backend's route addresses used to be wrongly "captured" by the front-end's routing rules, keeping some embedded pages from opening; once fixed, the exported product reliably routes front-end and backend requests each to the right place. From "playable inside the tool" to "playable outside it," the road to shipping is genuinely open for the first time.
kjquv9g.zh: 这是面向"发布"的一大步:现在能把一个游戏整体导出成一个自包含的静态网站——不需要带上整套 Studio,把导出的那个文件夹丢到任意一个静态托管上,它就能独立跑起来。换句话说,你在这里聊出来、做出来的游戏,可以直接打包带走、发给朋友玩、或者放到网上让所有人玩,而不被锁在这个工具里。配套出了第一个被导出的样例——一个名为 Sector Strike 的 FPS 游戏(自带场景与说明文档),用来跑通并验证整条导出链路。同时还修掉了一个关键 bug:之前后端的接口地址会被前端的路由规则错误地"抢走",导致某些内嵌页面打不开;修对之后,导出的成品能稳定地把前后端的请求各自送对地方。从"在工具里能玩"到"脱离工具也能玩",这条发布之路第一次真正打通。

k18acnyy.zh: 天空盒 + Bloom 辉光,画面更有氛围

k1sw6w70.en: The engine shipped two immediately visible features this day. One is a visible skybox: a scene's background is no longer a flat solid color but a real sky environment wrapping the whole scene, with sky and atmosphere in the distance — the sense of space changes at once. The other is bloom: a soft glow spillover on bright areas — neon signs, strong light sources and glowing objects bleed a halo — the most common move for sci-fi, dreamy or night-scene atmosphere. Both are "atmosphere effects" acting directly on look and feel. Underneath, an important thing was wired through: hierarchical world transforms. A parent and child's position, rotation and scale now propagate correctly layer by layer to the renderer, meaning the parts of a composite object — a character holding a weapon, a vehicle with attached parts — finally place and move correctly with the whole instead of being misaligned. Atmosphere plus correct hierarchy together make a scene both good-looking and "correctly arranged."
k1sw6w70.zh: 引擎这天出了两个一眼就能看出来的画面特性。其一是可见天空盒:场景的背景不再是一块死板的纯色,而是真有一片天空环境包裹着整个场景,远处有天、有氛围,空间感立刻不一样了。其二是 Bloom 辉光:给画面里的亮部加上一层柔和的光晕溢出——霓虹灯、强光源、发光的物体周围会泛出光晕,这是营造科幻、梦幻、夜景氛围最常用的一招。这两样都是直接作用于观感的"氛围特效"。底层还修通了一件要紧事:层级世界变换。父子节点的位置、旋转、缩放现在能正确地一层层传到渲染端,意味着组合物体——比如握着武器的角色、装着零件的载具——的各个部分终于能正确地跟着主体一起摆放、移动,而不再各自错位。氛围 + 正确的层级,合起来让场景既好看又"摆得对"。

kxz76m9.en: Preview loads correctly under a URL prefix
kxz76m9.zh: 带前缀的预览也能正确加载资源

k1d7u9o.en: This day also grappled with an unglamorous but deployment-flexibility-critical path: making the preview load all resources correctly under a "URL path prefix." In many real deployments, an app isn't at the website root but under some sub-path (a subdirectory of some site) — and if resource addresses don't account for that prefix, loading fails to find files and errors. This day aligned the whole chain, from engine to packaging to the resource index, to "respect the path prefix," and locked a regression test to keep it from going wrong again; it also fixed the startup flow to ensure the full set of needed runtime pieces is correctly built before launch. It addresses the most headache-inducing class of environment issue — "deploy it somewhere else and loading breaks." Getting this path working means exported games and embedded previews reliably find their resources and run no matter what URL path they're placed under — exactly the underlying guarantee that makes "package it into a website and take it" genuinely usable.
k1d7u9o.zh: 这天还死磕了一条不显眼但很影响部署灵活性的链路:让预览在"带路径前缀"的地址下也能正确加载所有资源。很多真实的部署场景里,应用不是挂在网站根目录,而是挂在某个子路径下(比如某某网站下的一个子目录)——如果资源的地址没有把这个前缀算进去,加载就会找不到文件、报错。这天把从引擎到打包到资源索引的整条链路都对齐到"尊重路径前缀",并锁了回归测试防止它再次走歪;还顺手修了启动流程,确保所需的全套运行件都先正确构建好才启动。它解决的是"换个地方部署就加载失败"这类最让人头疼的环境问题。把这条链路打通,意味着导出的游戏、内嵌的预览,无论被放到什么样的网址路径下,都能稳定地把资源找对、跑起来——这正是上面"打包成网站带走"能真正可用的底层保障。

k1p2awzh.en: The interactive-narrative pipeline runs a full loop
k1p2awzh.zh: 互动叙事管线跑通完整闭环

k1b0y9et.en: The story pipeline for narrative-driven games was wired into an end-to-end loop this day. A plot is essentially a branching "story tree," and drawing and running that tree correctly means solving a string of thorny problems: disambiguating repeated numbering, repairing back edges, routing long-span connections around, and auto-mounting on start so it's visible from the beginning — all fixed this day, so the whole story structure presents correctly. The agent responsible for narrative connected to the full pipeline toolset and reports progress live as it runs. The key piece: when the whole pipeline finishes, the system automatically wakes that agent back to do a closing summary, rather than stopping halfway and leaving a dangling end. With that, building a branching, well-paced plot becomes a smooth, visible, self-closing flow from start to finish — the narrative line moves from "has tools" to genuinely "can run all the way through once."
k1b0y9et.zh: 面向影像叙事类游戏的剧情管线这天接成了端到端闭环。剧情本质上是一棵会分支的"故事树",而把这棵树正确地画出来、跑起来,要解决一串棘手问题:重复编号的消歧、回头边的修复、跨度很长的连线如何绕行布置、以及启动时就自动挂载好让它一开始就可见——这些这天都修通了,整棵故事结构能正确呈现。负责叙事的那个 agent 也接上了整套管线工具,并会在跑的过程中实时播报进度。最关键的一处:整条管线跑完之后,系统会自动把这个 agent 重新唤回来做一段收尾总结,而不是跑到一半就停下、留个烂尾。这样一来,做一段有分支、有节奏的剧情,从开头到收尾就成了一条顺畅、看得见、会自己收口的流水线——叙事这条线从"有工具"真正走到了"能完整跑完一遍"。

k1q4jpd1.en: The most important shift this day is the platform having a complete "exit" for the first time. Before, however well-made, a game was still trapped in the tool; and "export as a website" plus "loads correctly under any path" together let your work genuinely leave here and reach others for the first time. With skybox and bloom making it better-looking and the narrative loop making it more complete, this day filled in the last link of the "create — take shape — ship" chain. A creation tool's value is ultimately redeemed by whether "what you make can be seen by the world." From today, the game you make here is no longer just a local demo but a real work you can package, host and share for anyone to play.
k1q4jpd1.zh: 这一天最重要的转变,是平台第一次有了完整的"出口"。在此之前,无论做得多好,游戏都还困在工具里;而"导出成网站 + 在任意路径下都能正确加载"这两件事合起来,让你的作品第一次能真正离开这里、走到别人面前。配上天空盒与辉光让它更好看、叙事闭环让它更完整,这天等于把"创作—成型—发布"这条链路的最后一环补上了。一个创作工具的价值,最终要由"做出来的东西能不能被世界看到"来兑现。从今天起,你在这里做的游戏,不再只是一个本地的演示,而是一个可以打包、可以托管、可以分享给任何人玩的真正作品。

k1ynhkxh.en: The desktop app runs end to end + crisp in-world text
k1ynhkxh.zh: 桌面 App 端到端跑通 + 3D 世界里的清晰文字

k6ygjb8.en: June's first day: the desktop app ran end to end from install to play for the first time, with first-launch key onboarding. The engine landed a streak — crisp text in the 3D world, bidirectional object relations, a per-frame cache for performance, anti-aliasing and texture-orientation fixes; plus a new low-poly modeling assistant.
k6ygjb8.zh: 六月第一天:桌面应用第一次从安装到游玩全程跑通,首启就引导你填 key。引擎一天连击——3D 世界里能挂清晰文字、物体关系双向同步、加了每帧缓存提性能、修好抗锯齿与贴图朝向;还新增了一个低多边形建模助手。

kxw2nr0.en: From "a desktop shell stands up" to "usable end to end"
kxw2nr0.zh: 从"桌面壳立起来"到"端到端能用"

k1aqh76b.en: The desktop shell had just stood up the prior days, but between "stands up" and "usable" lies a whole chain: the backend must be bundled in, the preview embedded, sample games seeded, and the first launch must let users enter a key smoothly. This day connected that whole chain end to end, and the desktop app could go all the way from "install" to "play" for the first time. Meanwhile the engine advanced a long streak in a single day (text, relations, performance, image-quality fixes), and the collaboration side added a new assistant. Closing the loop on an "installable and runnable" desktop experience while continuing to feed the engine and tools, this day laid June's opening firmly on the dual track of "usable and still growing."
k1aqh76b.zh: 前几天桌面应用的外壳刚立起来,但"立起来"和"能用"之间还隔着一整条链路:后端要打进包、预览要内嵌、示例游戏要自动放好、第一次启动还得让用户顺利填上 key。这天把这整条链路从头到尾打通,桌面应用第一次能从"安装"一路走到"游玩"。与此同时,引擎单日推进了一长串(文字、关系、性能、画质修复),协作侧还添了一个新助手。一边把"能装能跑"的桌面体验做闭环,一边持续给引擎和工具加料,这天是把六月开局稳稳铺在"既能用、又在长"的双轨上。

k1wl3ru5.en: The desktop app runs end to end + first-launch key onboarding
k1wl3ru5.zh: 桌面 App 端到端跑通 + 首启引导填 key

k2rx30a.en: The desktop app ran from start to finish for the first time this day. It bundles the backend service directly into the installer, embeds the engine preview into the window, seeds sample games automatically on first launch, and even wires up the mouse pointer capture (locking the cursor into the window to turn the view) that first-person games need. Most thoughtful is the first-launch experience: an onboarding overlay prompts you to enter your API key, which takes effect immediately with no app restart — the backend applies the newly entered key to the running environment live. Ports can be overridden via environment variables to fit different machines, and a common dependency-placement issue self-heals before assembly to avoid build failures. From this day, using it as a desktop application you can install, open and play directly genuinely works end to end — the key step from "developers running in source" to "ordinary people installing an app and using it."
k2rx30a.zh: 桌面应用这天第一次从头跑到尾。它把后端服务直接打进安装包、把引擎预览内嵌进窗口、把示例游戏在首次启动时自动放好,连第一人称游戏需要的鼠标指针捕获(把光标锁进窗口里转视角)也接上了。最贴心的是首次启动体验:会弹出一个引导层让你填入 API key,填完立即生效、不用重启应用——后端会把新填的 key 实时应用到运行环境里。端口也能用环境变量覆盖以适配不同机器,装配前还会自愈一类常见的依赖摆放问题,避免打包失败。从这天起,把它当一个能安装、能打开、能直接玩的桌面软件来用,整条路真正通了——这是从"开发者在源码里跑"到"普通人装个 app 就能用"的关键一步。

k1cetbcs.en: Engine: crisp text in the 3D world
k1cetbcs.zh: 引擎:3D 世界里能挂清晰文字

k1bi20fx.en: The engine landed "world-space text rendering" this day: you can now place crisp text, sharp even when enlarged, directly anywhere in a 3D scene. This matters more than it sounds — games need text standing in the world everywhere: signs, road markers, names above characters, health-bar numbers, floating damage popups, interaction prompts. It uses a special glyph representation that keeps edges sharp whether the text is moved near or far, scaled up or down, instead of turning into a blurry pixel mush. Before this, the engine could only draw geometry and textures, and text was a glaring gap; filling it means making games with UI, prompts and numeric feedback has proper text capability for the first time. For almost any genre, this is an essential step from "can render a world" to "can convey information in the world."
k1bi20fx.zh: 引擎这天落地了"世界空间文字渲染":现在能把清晰、放大也不糊的文字直接挂在 3D 场景里的任意位置。这件事比听起来重要——游戏里到处都需要立在世界里的文字:招牌、路牌、角色头顶的名字、血条数字、漂浮的伤害跳字、互动提示。它用的是一种特殊的字形表达方式,让文字无论被拉近拉远、放大缩小,边缘都保持锐利,而不是变成一团模糊的像素糊。在此之前,引擎只能画几何与贴图,文字是个明显的空缺;补上这一块,意味着做带 UI、带提示、带数值反馈的游戏第一次有了正经的文字能力。对几乎任何类型的游戏来说,这都是从"能渲染世界"到"能在世界里传达信息"的必备一步。

kj75rsf.en: Engine: bidirectional relations + unified entity lifecycle + a performance cache
kj75rsf.zh: 引擎:物体关系双向同步 + 实体生命周期统一 + 性能缓存

k18yojkc.en: The engine reinforced several things in low-level "object organization" this day. One: relationships between objects became bidirectionally auto-synced — when you create or break a parent-child or ownership link, both ends stay consistent automatically, with no dirty state where "the parent claims this child but the child doesn't recognize the parent," making composition and teardown easier. Two: scene-instance lifecycle was unified — detach, destroy and full clear follow one orderly semantics, avoiding missed deletions and leftovers in edge cases. Three, performance: a per-frame render-state cache was added, caching and reusing what would otherwise be recomputed every frame, cutting needless overhead. These are invisible inner work, but they decide whether a complex scene grows messier and slower as objects are frequently added, removed and combined. Establishing the rules for "how objects connect, are born and die" is the foundation for the engine to withstand real game complexity.
k18yojkc.zh: 引擎这天在底层的"对象组织"上做了几处加固。其一是物体之间的"关系"做成了双向自动同步:当你建立或解除一对父子、归属之类的关联时,关系的两端会自动保持一致——不会出现"父亲说有这个孩子、孩子却不认这个父亲"的脏状态,组合与拆解都更省心。其二是把场景实例的生命周期统一了:分离、销毁、整体清除走同一套规整的语义,避免边角情况下漏删、残留。其三是性能:加了一层每帧的渲染状态缓存,把每帧都要重算的东西缓存起来复用,减少无谓开销。这些都是看不见的内功,但它们决定了一个复杂场景在频繁增删、组合对象时会不会越来越乱、越来越慢。把"对象之间怎么连、怎么生、怎么灭"这套规矩立稳,是引擎能扛住真实游戏复杂度的根基。

kdxz8sm.en: Engine image-quality fixes: anti-aliasing + texture orientation
kdxz8sm.zh: 引擎画质修复:抗锯齿 + 贴图朝向

k1036xiy.en: This day also fixed several image-quality issues that directly affect look and feel. Anti-aliasing got two fixes: one was wrong math in the sampling offset, making edge smoothing inaccurate; the other more subtle — colors were wrongly converted through a space twice, making flat areas of the image overall brighter and washed out. With both fixed, edges are cleaner and colors more accurate. A texture upside-down issue on procedurally-generated geometry was also fixed: the root cause was that the texture coordinate's direction and the graphics sampler's origin convention didn't align (one counts from the top, the other from the bottom), the classic "off by one flip" pitfall — textures like grass were applied upside down and are now right-side up. None of these are new features but carving the details of existing capability to "it just looks right." Image quality often wins exactly on these glance-obvious-yet-easily-overlooked details.
k1036xiy.zh: 这天还修了几处直接影响观感的画质问题。抗锯齿修了两处:一处是采样偏移的数学算错,导致边缘平滑得不准;另一处更隐蔽——颜色被错误地做了两次空间转换,使得画面平坦区域整体偏亮、发灰。两处修对之后,边缘更干净、色彩更准。还修了一个程序化生成几何体的贴图上下颠倒问题:根因是贴图坐标的方向和图形采样器的原点约定没对齐(一个从上数、一个从下数),典型的"差一个翻转"的坑——草地之类的贴图原本是倒着贴的,现在正过来了。这些都不是新功能,而是把已有能力的细节抠到"看着就是对的"。画质这种东西,往往就赢在这些一眼能看出对错、却很容易被忽略的细节上。

k1w755z6.en: A new low-poly modeling assistant + auto-starting external plugins
k1w755z6.zh: 新增低多边形建模助手 + 外部插件自动启动

kemcim9.en: The collaboration roster gained another member this day: an assistant specialized in low-poly 3D modeling, with headless rendering, to help you generate those low-face-count, sharp-edged, clean-styled 3D models — an art style many indie games favor, fast to make and distinctive. The platform also lets external workbench plugins auto-start with the system: installed third-party tools work from boot without manual launching each time, smoothing the integration experience. A sync issue that made some tools wrongly report "unknown tool" was also fixed — the root cause was tool-registration sync not being timely or idempotent enough, and once fixed, tool calls are steadier. A new modeling assistant, an integration improvement that makes plugins lower-maintenance, and a fix making tool calls more reliable — together they keep polishing "collaborating with a team of specialized AIs to make games" into something smoother.
kemcim9.zh: 协作阵容这天再添一员:一个专做低多边形(low-poly)3D 建模的助手,带无头渲染能力,可以帮你生成那种面数少、棱角分明、清爽风格的 3D 模型——这是很多独立游戏偏爱的美术风格,做起来又快又有辨识度。平台这边还让外部工作台插件能随系统自动启动:装好的第三方工具开机即用,不必每次手动去拉起,接入体验更顺。同时修好了一个会让某些工具被误报"未知工具"的同步问题——根因是工具注册的同步不够及时、不够幂等,修对之后工具调用更稳。一个负责造型的新助手、一个让插件更省心的接入改进、一个让工具调用更可靠的修复,合起来继续把"用一群各有专长的 AI 协作做游戏"这件事打磨得更顺手。

k1tqfkb5.en: June opening with a day like this sends a clear signal: making "ordinary people install an app and use it" genuinely end to end, while pushing the engine forward at once on visual expressiveness (text), low-level order (object relations and lifecycle), and performance and image-quality detail. The desktop side moving from "can open" to "usable" means the tool begins to have the form to reach real users; the engine adding world text and straightening out object relations means the games it can carry get closer to "complete works." A mass-market creation platform must both let people in easily (a desktop app plus first-launch onboarding) and let them make presentable things (continual engine reinforcement) — and this day took a solid step on each of these two most fundamental lines.
k1tqfkb5.zh: 六月以这样一天开局,信号很明确:一边把"普通人装个 app 就能用"这件事做到真正端到端,一边让引擎在画面表达力(文字)、底层秩序(对象关系与生命周期)、性能与画质细节上同时往前推。桌面端从"能开"走到"能用",意味着这个工具开始具备走向真实用户的形态;引擎补上世界文字、把对象关系理顺,意味着它能承载的游戏越来越接近"完整作品"。一个面向大众的创作平台,既要让人轻松进得来(桌面 app + 首启引导),又要让人做得出像样东西(引擎能力持续补强)——这一天在这两条最根本的线上,都各自扎实地走了一步。

k9rmvhk.en: One command to launch the desktop app + a node editor joins
k9rmvhk.zh: 一条命令开桌面应用 + 节点编辑器进商店

k2erp1l.en: This day one command launches the whole desktop Studio; plugin startup moved from hardcoded to manifest-driven discovery, a whole visual node editor joins as a plugin with plugins isolated from each other; chat gained handy interactions and the preview a load watchdog; and the engine did a round of ECS slimming.
k2erp1l.zh: 这天一条命令就能拉起整个桌面 Studio;插件启动从写死改成按清单自动发现,一个可视化节点编辑器整体作为插件接进来、插件之间互不串台;聊天加了一组顺手交互、预览加了加载看门狗;引擎还做了一轮 ECS 大瘦身。

kmicuqw.en: Making both "launch it" and "plug it in" simple
kmicuqw.zh: 把"开起来"和"接进来"都做简单

k176l2sw.en: The day's through-line is two "made simpler"s. One is making "launching" simple: running the whole Studio on the desktop used to mean memorizing a string of commands to start each service; now one command does it. The other is making "plugging in" simple: adding a new tool to the platform used to require hardcoding startup logic; now it's "auto-discovery by manifest" — drop in any plugin that follows the convention and it's recognized and launched. With a round of chat-experience polish and an internal engine slim-down, the day's overall work is paving both the "use it" and "extend it" roads flatter — easier for ordinary people to launch, easier for developers to integrate.
k176l2sw.zh: 这天的主线是两个"变简单"。一个是把"开起来"变简单:以前要在桌面端跑起整套 Studio,得记一串命令分别拉各个服务;现在一条命令搞定。另一个是把"接进来"变简单:以前给平台加一个新工具,启动逻辑得在代码里写死;现在改成"按清单自动发现",任何符合约定的插件丢进来就能被识别、拉起。再加上聊天体验的一组打磨和引擎内部的一轮大瘦身,这天整体在做的,是把"用起来"和"扩展起来"两条路都铺得更平——让普通人更容易开,让开发者更容易接。

khaucch.en: One command to open the desktop app
khaucch.zh: 一条命令就能开桌面应用

kf0xy89.en: The desktop side gained a one-command launcher this day: a single command starts dev mode, builds a package, opens the app directly, or shuts everything down, with docs explaining the three ways to run — browser dev, desktop dev, and the packaged desktop app, and what each suits. Running the whole Studio on the desktop used to mean memorizing and typing a string of commands in order to start each service, hard to recover from when something went wrong; now one line brings up the whole desktop side. Underneath, start/stop moved to "process groups": a group of services starts together and is cleanly cleaned up together on exit — directly solving a long-standing annoyance where closing the window left a pile of "zombie processes" in the background, quietly holding ports and memory and bogging down the machine. Flattening the launch bar is a precondition for more people to install it on their own computers and use it daily.
kf0xy89.zh: 桌面端这天有了一个一键启动器:一条命令就能起开发态、打包、直接打开应用、或一键收摊关停,配套文档把三种运行方式讲清楚——浏览器开发态、桌面开发态、以及打包后的桌面应用各适合什么场景。以前要在桌面端把整套 Studio 跑起来,得记住并按顺序敲一串命令分别拉起各个服务,出错了还不好收拾;现在普通人一句话就能把整个桌面端跑起来。底层还把服务的启停改成"进程组"方式:同一组服务一起拉起、退出时整组一起干净清理——这直接解决了一个长期的烦恼:关掉窗口后总有一堆"僵尸进程"残留在后台,悄悄占着端口和内存拖慢机器。把启动这道门槛削平,是让更多人愿意把它装到自己电脑上日常用的前提。

kx4rbj5.en: A node editor joins the store, with plugins isolated
kx4rbj5.zh: 节点编辑器接进商店,插件互不串台

k1xn7lot.en: This day changed plugin startup from "a pile of hardcoded logic" to "auto-discovery by manifest": any standalone plugin with a manifest declaration, dropped in, is automatically recognized and launched by the system, with no need to edit the main program's startup code for each plugin. Using this generic mechanism, a complete visual node editor (bringing a "3D low-poly" and a "scene-generator" workbench) joined as a whole plugin. An isolation issue was solved alongside: each plugin now has its own isolated project root, so several workbenches no longer share one project and edit the wrong place by crosstalk; in development, plugins default to hot reload, so a one-line change takes effect at once. The significance: it turns "how third-party tools integrate" from one-off hardcoding into a reusable, auto-discoverable, mutually-isolated standard — a key step toward a "plugin ecosystem," making any future tool both clean and plug-and-play.
k1xn7lot.zh: 这天把插件的启动方式从"一堆写死的逻辑"改成了"按清单自动发现":任何带有清单声明的独立插件,被丢进来就能被系统自动识别并拉起,不必再为每个插件改一遍主程序的启动代码。借着这套通用机制,一个完整的可视化节点编辑器(自带"3D 低多边形"和"场景生成"两个工作台)整体作为插件接了进来。配套还解决了一个隔离问题:每个插件现在拥有自己独立的工程根目录,几个工作台之间不再共享同一个工程、互相串台改错地方;开发时插件默认开启热更新,改一行代码立刻生效。这件事的意义在于:它把"第三方工具如何接入"从一次性的硬编码,变成了一套可复用、可自动发现、互相隔离的标准——这是平台朝"插件生态"演进的关键一步,让以后接入任何新工具都既干净又即插即用。

k1kf7czw.en: A smoother chat + a preview load watchdog
k1kf7czw.zh: 聊天更顺手 + 预览加载看门狗

k1y2lf8h.en: The conversation panel gained a set of everyday-smoothing interactions this day: switch the current model on the fly, replay history in segments (instead of laboriously scrolling one long strip), new entries for common actions in the top bar, and a context-usage ring showing at a glance how much budget remains. The preview gained an "initial-load watchdog": if the first frame is slow to appear after loading, it auto-reloads and retries until the picture actually renders, rather than leaving you waiting at a white screen — this kind of "occasionally won't load, need a manual refresh" issue most wears your patience, and automating it away makes the experience much smoother. The backend also fixed a few chat hangs and ensured conversations genuinely run on the model you pick. Individually small, together these polish the highest-frequency surface of the day from "usable" to "responsive."
k1y2lf8h.zh: 对话面板这天加了一组让日常更顺手的交互:可以随手切换当前用的模型、按段回看历史对话(而不是在一长条里费劲翻)、顶栏新增了一些常用动作的入口,还有一个上下文用量环直观显示当前还剩多少额度。预览这边加了一个"初次加载看门狗":如果加载后迟迟没出第一帧画面,它会自动重载、再试,直到画面真正渲染出来,而不是把你晾在一片白屏前干等——这类"偶尔加载不出来需要手动刷一下"的小毛病,最磨耐心,自动化掉之后体验顺很多。后端也顺手修了几处聊天会卡住的情况,并确保对话真正按你选的模型来跑。这些改动单个都不大,但合起来就是把每天最高频的那块界面,从"能用"打磨到"跟手"。

k1g7q473.en: A big ECS slim-down: fewer concepts, faster, easier to grasp
k1g7q473.zh: 引擎 ECS 大瘦身:更少概念、更快、更好懂

k18088j3.en: The engine did a heavy round of "slimming" this day on its core — the "entity-component-system" (ECS) that describes a game world. It removed or merged several cumbersome concepts: no longer needing a separate "register component" step, unifying "local transform" and "world transform" into one no-longer-split set, folding each world's own component numbering into one globally-unified identifier, dropping some redundant local caches, and peeling out a responsibility that shouldn't have been mixed with asset registration to be managed separately. Behind this is a design axiom running through the whole project: the measure of code quality isn't line count but "how many concepts you must hold to understand any single spot" — fewer concepts, fewer errors for both humans and AI reading it. This slimming is entirely invisible on the user's side, yet directly decides whether the engine, as it grows ever larger, can stay "decomposable, fast, changeable." Continuously cutting the core's conceptual noise is the inner work that lets this engine evolve healthily long-term.
k18088j3.zh: 引擎这天对它的核心——那套描述游戏世界的"实体-组件-系统"(ECS)体系——做了一轮力度很大的"瘦身"。它删掉或合并了好几个累赘的概念:不再需要单独"注册组件"这道手续、把"本地变换"和"世界变换"统一成一套不再分裂、把每个世界各自一份的组件编号折叠成一个全局统一的标识、去掉一些冗余的本地缓存、并把一块本不该和资产注册混在一起的职责剥离出去单独管理。这背后是一条贯穿整个项目的设计公理:衡量代码好坏的不是行数,而是"读懂任意一处需要同时记住多少个概念"——概念越少,人和 AI 读起来就越不容易出错。这类瘦身在用户那侧完全看不见,却直接决定了引擎在变得越来越大的同时,能不能始终保持"拆得开、跑得快、改得动"。把核心的概念噪音持续砍掉,是这台引擎能长期健康演进的内功。

k1iy1ydi.en: The day's items seem to each mind their own corner, but inside share one pursuit: cutting friction. The one-command launcher cut the friction of "launching," manifest auto-discovery cut the friction of "plugging in," the chat polish and preview watchdog cut the friction of "daily use," and the ECS slim-down cut the friction of "reading and changing code." For a platform to be used by more people, extended by more tools, and maintained long-term, what usually matters isn't some dazzling big feature but smoothing these unremarkable frictions one by one. The less friction, the lower the bar, and the more people willing to come in, stay, and contribute. This day pushed forward several steps at once on the plain but fundamental matter of "making everything a bit smoother."
k1iy1ydi.zh: 这一天的几件事看似各管一摊,内里却是同一种追求:把摩擦削掉。一键启动器削掉了"开起来"的摩擦,清单自动发现削掉了"接进来"的摩擦,聊天打磨和预览看门狗削掉了"日常用"的摩擦,ECS 瘦身则削掉了"读代码、改代码"的摩擦。一个平台要想被更多人用、被更多工具扩展、被长期维护,靠的往往不是某个炫目的大功能,而是把这一处处不起眼的摩擦一个个磨平。摩擦越少,门槛越低,愿意进来、愿意留下、愿意贡献的人就越多。这一天,正是在"让一切都更顺一点"这件朴素却根本的事上,同时往前推了好几步。

koqdkxs.en: An editor mode gets its roadmap + the engine preps for visual editing
koqdkxs.zh: 编辑器模式定下路线 + 引擎为可视化编辑铺路

kyv5fe1.en: This day locked Studio's path from "play-only" to "edit-and-play" into a design blueprint; the engine pushed a stack of underlying capabilities in a single day — field reflection, a swappable render pipeline, an AI-facing engine manual — specifically to lay the groundwork for a visual editor; meanwhile two parallel runtime kernels converged into one, and game content kept moving toward structured assets.
kyv5fe1.zh: 这天把 Studio 从"只能玩"扩成"边编边玩"的路线正式敲定成一份设计蓝图;引擎一天连推多项底层能力——字段反射、可替换渲染管线、给 AI 看的引擎使用手册——专门为可视化编辑器打底;同时把两套并行的运行内核收敛成一套,游戏内容继续往结构化资产上靠。
