k18uor7l.en: Setting direction, laying foundations, and subtracting — all in one day
k18uor7l.zh: 一天里同时定方向、打地基、做减法

kaxpoue.en: The day's items look scattered but orbit one goal: growing a new "editor" leg for Studio. Growing it takes three things at once. First, "set direction" — turning "add an editing mode" from spoken discussion into a formal design blueprint so the coming work has something to follow. Second, "lay foundations" — the engine filling in, at the bottom layer, the capabilities an editor genuinely needs; without them the upper interface is a castle in the air. Third, "subtract" — converging two historically-parallel runtime kernels into one, so the maintenance burden doesn't crush you before the new feature even appears. When a project reaches the threshold of adding a major capability, what's most tested isn't the speed of writing new code but whether you can simultaneously think the direction through, firm up the foundation, and shed the baggage — this day did all three.
kaxpoue.zh: 这一天的几件事看似分散,其实围着同一个目标转:让 Studio 长出"编辑器"这条新腿。要长出它,得三件事同时做。一是"定方向"——把"再加一个编辑模式"从口头讨论变成一份正式的设计蓝图,让接下来的落地有谱可依。二是"打地基"——引擎在底层补上编辑器真正需要的几样能力,没有它们,上层界面就是空中楼阁。三是"做减法"——把历史上遗留的两套并行运行内核收敛成一套,免得新功能还没长出来,维护负担先把人拖垮。一个项目走到要加重大新能力的关口,最考验的不是写新代码的速度,而是能不能同时把方向想清楚、把地基夯实、把包袱卸掉——这天三件事一起做了。

k3wghpl.en: An editor mode roadmap: from play-only to edit-and-play
k3wghpl.zh: 编辑器模式定下路线:从"只能玩"走向"边编边玩"

k14fv053.en: Until now, Studio has mostly been the place to run and play-test a game: you chat with the AI, it writes code, and the right side runs the game for you. This day formally kicked off "add an editing mode," captured as a full set of design and status documents — comparing the engine's existing capabilities, writing down the editing mode's feature spec, taking stock of how far the implementation has come, and offering a concrete design proposal. The goal is clear: you don't just watch a game run but can directly place objects, tweak properties and build scenes in a visual interface — true edit-and-play, where a change shows its effect right beside you at once. Writing it up as a document first, rather than diving straight into code, is because it touches the engine, the front end and the runtime in several places and deserves a clear blueprint before action; all the editor work over the coming days follows this blueprint. It's a signpost for Studio's move from a player's view toward a creator's view — from "the AI builds it for you and you play," toward "the AI and you edit together and you can step in anytime."
k14fv053.zh: 一直以来,Studio 主要是"运行 / 试玩"游戏的地方:你跟 AI 聊,它写代码,右侧把游戏跑给你看。这天把"再加一个编辑模式"这件事正式立项,落成一整套设计与现状文档——它对引擎现有能力做了对照分析、写下了编辑模式的功能规格、盘点了当前实现到哪一步、并给出了具体的设计提案。目标很明确:让你不只是看游戏跑,还能直接在可视化界面里摆放物体、调属性、搭场景,做到"边编边玩"——改一下立刻在旁边看到效果。把这件事先写成文档而不是直接闷头写代码,是因为它牵动引擎、前端、运行时好几处,值得先把蓝图画清楚再动手;接下来几天的所有编辑器落地动作,都以这份蓝图为准。这是 Studio 从"玩家视角"迈向"创作者视角"的方向标——从"AI 替你做、你来玩",走向"AI 和你一起编、你随时插手"。

k5fiif.en: Field reflection lands: the property panel can build itself
k5fiif.zh: 引擎补上字段反射:属性面板能自己长出来

k1d4rzf1.en: The engine's key step this day was adding "reflection metadata" to component fields. Reflection, put plainly, lets a program "describe itself": the system no longer needs to be told — it can read, for each property in each component, the name and type — this one's a number, that one's a color, another's a toggle. Why does this matter? Because the heaviest work in a visual editor is drawing an input control for each of hundreds of property kinds: a slider for numbers, a picker for colors, a checkbox for toggles. Hand-writing each one neither finishes nor keeps up with the engine's changes. With field reflection, the editor's property panel can "build itself from the metadata" — add a new property in the engine and the matching control appears in the panel automatically, with no extra handwork. This is exactly the underlying precondition that lets that editor blueprint genuinely land: first make the data self-describing, and only then can the interface be automated.
k1d4rzf1.zh: 引擎这天最关键的一步,是给组件的字段加上了"反射元数据"。所谓反射,通俗说就是让程序能"自我描述":系统不再需要别人告诉它,自己就能读出每个组件里每个属性的名字和类型——这是个数字、那是个颜色、还有一个是开关。这件事为什么重要?因为一个可视化编辑器最繁重的活,就是为成百上千种属性各画一个输入框:数字配滑块、颜色配取色器、开关配勾选框。如果靠人手一个个写界面,既写不完也跟不上引擎的变化。有了字段反射,编辑器的属性面板就能"照着元数据自动长出来"——引擎里加了个新属性,面板里自动多出对应的控件,无需任何额外手工。这正是上面那份编辑器蓝图能真正落地的底层前提:先让数据能自我描述,界面才谈得上自动化。

kbm8nc5.en: The render pipeline becomes swappable, so visual style isn't locked
kbm8nc5.zh: 渲染管线变成可替换的,画面玩法不再被锁死

kqf9fj7.en: The engine also made the "render pipeline" swappable this day. The render pipeline is the whole assembly line by which the engine turns a 3D scene into each frame on screen — deciding how light falls, how shadows are computed, how post effects stack. This pipeline used to be hardcoded into the engine: you could only use the one visual style it gave. This day exposed the pipeline's "seam," so a project with special visual needs can drop in its own rendering flow and achieve a distinctive look beyond the engine's default. More importantly, the capability was validated by "using it ourselves first" — the engine's own rendering began running through this swappable pipeline, ensuring it's not decorative but genuinely usable. Proactively opening the seam of a core capability means the engine shifts from a "take-it-as-given" black box toward a platform where "advanced users can deeply customize" — especially crucial for creators chasing a distinctive visual identity.
kqf9fj7.zh: 引擎这天还把"渲染管线"做成了可替换的。渲染管线是引擎把一个三维场景变成屏幕上每一帧画面的那整条流水线——决定光怎么打、阴影怎么算、后期特效怎么叠。以前这条流水线是写死在引擎里的:你只能用它给定的那一套画面风格。这天把这条流水线的"接缝"暴露了出来,有特殊画面需求的项目可以换上自己的一套渲染流程,做出引擎默认之外的独特观感。更重要的是,这个能力是用"自己先用起来"的方式验证的——引擎自己的画面也开始走这条可替换的管线,确保它不是个摆设而是真能用。把核心能力的接缝主动开放出来,意味着引擎从一个"只能照单全收"的黑盒,开始变成一个"高级用户能深度定制"的平台,这对追求独特视觉的创作者尤其关键。

k11nsi4s.en: An engine usage manual, written for the AI
k11nsi4s.zh: 给 AI 写一份引擎使用手册

k19x3pkh.en: The day also did something distinctive: writing an engine usage manual specifically for the AI. On this platform the main force actually writing game code is the AI agent, not a person — so "make the engine usable" must first mean "make it legible and correctly usable to the AI." This manual isn't prose for humans but a structured usage spec for agents plus a set of directly-followable operational skills: how to create entities, attach components, use the asset system, and the correct posture for common tasks, all written in a form an agent can reliably follow. Its significance: a tool's "documentation" is no longer a side note for humans but a means of production that directly determines AI output quality — the better the AI understands the engine, the more correct and less rework-prone the games it writes for you. Treating "the manual for the AI" as a first-class citizen, written in earnest, is a fundamental difference in mindset between this AI-native platform and a traditional engine.
k19x3pkh.zh: 这天还做了一件很特别的事:专门为 AI 写了一份引擎使用手册。在这个平台上,真正动手写游戏代码的主力是 AI agent,而不是人——所以"让引擎好用"这件事,首先得"让 AI 看得懂、用得对"。这份手册不是给人读的散文,而是为 agent 准备的结构化使用规范和一组可直接照做的操作技能:怎么创建实体、怎么挂组件、怎么用资产系统、各种常见任务的正确姿势,都写成 agent 能稳定遵循的形式。它的意义在于:一个工具的"文档"不再只是写给人的旁注,而成了直接决定 AI 产出质量的生产资料——AI 越懂引擎,它替你写出来的游戏就越正确、越少返工。把"给 AI 的说明书"当成一等公民来认真写,是这个 AI 原生平台和传统引擎在思路上的根本不同。

kbs601m.en: Two runtime kernels converge into one
kbs601m.zh: 两套运行内核收敛成一套

k1rr1f1r.en: The day also performed a heavy "subtraction": formally retiring and archiving a historically-leftover standalone runtime kernel, with all the runtime duties it once carried already moved into the unified backend process. This single cut deleted nearly a hundred and fifty thousand lines of code, leaving only an empty shell as a historical marker. Why is this good? Because for a long time the system had two kernels capable of running agents at once, so any change had to be synced on both sides, and a moment's inattention left their behavior inconsistent — an invisible, ongoing maintenance tax. Once converged into a single kernel, all agent flows, capabilities and tools register and run in just one place, with no more "two sides to keep aligned." Deleting a hundred and fifty thousand lines yet making the system more robust confirms a creed running through the whole project: progress isn't measured by lines written but by how many things you must hold in mind to understand and maintain the system — the complexity you can cut is itself the most valuable output.
k1rr1f1r.zh: 这天还做了一次力度极大的"减法":把历史上遗留的一套独立运行内核正式退役归档,它原先承担的全部运行职责,都已经搬进了统一的后端进程里继续跑。这一刀切下去,删掉了将近十五万行代码,只留一个空壳作为历史标记。为什么这是好事?因为长期以来系统里同时存在两套能跑 agent 的内核,任何一处改动都得在两边同步,稍不留神就两边行为不一致——这是隐形的、持续的维护税。把它收敛成唯一一套之后,以后所有的 agent 流程、能力、工具都只在一个地方注册和运行,不再有"两套要对齐"的负担。删掉十五万行代码、系统反而更健壮,这正印证了贯穿整个项目的一条信条:衡量进步的不是写了多少行,而是读懂和维护这套系统需要同时记住多少东西——能砍掉的复杂度,本身就是最值钱的产出。

k109sur5.en: Game content moves to assets + a replay-order fix
k109sur5.zh: 游戏内容走向资产化 + 回放顺序修复

k52pzmd.en: The content side also moved a step with the main line this day: enemies in the sample shooter changed from "spawned one by one in code" to "scene asset instances." The difference between these approaches: enemies hardcoded in code can only be changed by a programmer, while enemies made into structured assets are easier to reuse and configure, and easier for the coming editor to recognize and place — so this too is groundwork for visual editing, letting "things that will be edited" exist in asset form ahead of time. Beyond that, the content-creation tools (node-style editing, scene-building and the like) got a batch of everyday polish: brush tools, a canvas fit-to-view, a scene toolbar, import round-trip fixes and more, making those workbenches smoother to use. A chat replay-ordering issue was also fixed: inter-agent and system messages now append correctly at the tail, so replaying a stretch of history matches exactly the order you saw live — for replay to be trustworthy, the order must be precise to the letter.
k52pzmd.zh: 内容侧这天也跟着主线往前挪了一步:示例射击游戏里的敌人,从"用代码一个个生成"改成了"场景资产实例"。这两种做法的区别在于:写死在代码里的敌人只有程序员能改,而做成结构化资产的敌人则更容易复用、配置,也更容易被即将到来的编辑器识别和摆放——所以这也是在为可视化编辑做准备,让"会被编辑的东西"提前以资产的形态存在。除此之外,内容创作类的工具(节点式编辑、场景搭建那一类)也收了一批日常打磨:笔刷工具、画布自适应视图、场景工具栏、导入往返的修复等等,让这些工作台用起来更顺。配套还修了一处聊天回放的顺序问题:agent 之间的消息和系统消息现在会正确地追加在末尾,回看一段历史时的顺序,和你当时实时看到的完全一致——回放要可信,顺序就必须分毫不差。

k7ewkvh.en: This day is the textbook look of a project "preparing to pivot": before tackling a big thing, first settling direction, foundation and baggage all at once. The editor blueprint gives "where to go," the engine's field reflection, swappable pipeline and AI manual pave "a road you can actually walk," while kernel convergence and assetization shed "the old baggage that trips you up." Worth remembering: this day had not a single dazzling new button a user could click and play with that very day — its value is all underneath, the kind of "if you don't lay the foundation today, tomorrow's tower can't be built" work. A platform that evolves over the long run depends precisely on being willing to do this groundwork in earnest when there's no instant applause. From this day, the new "editor" leg has its drawings and its foundation; what follows is building it up, layer by layer.
k7ewkvh.zh: 这一天是一个项目"准备转向"的典型样子:在动手做一件大事之前,先把方向、地基和包袱三件事一次性料理干净。编辑器蓝图给出了"往哪走",引擎的字段反射、可替换管线、AI 使用手册铺好了"走得动的路面",而内核收敛和资产化则卸下了"会绊脚的旧包袱"。值得记住的是,这天没有一个用户当天就能点开把玩的炫目新按钮——它的价值全在底下:是那种"今天不打地基,明天的高楼就盖不起来"的工作。一个能长期演进的平台,靠的正是愿意在没有即时掌声的时候,认真做这些铺垫。从这天起,"编辑器"这条新腿有了图纸、有了地基,接下来就是把它一层层盖起来。

ket8tor.en: The editor mode is actually usable

k8vjkbr.en: The editor mode that was just a blueprint the day before became working features this day: select objects in the viewport, drag gizmos, auto-save — "edit-and-play" runs for the first time. Scenes became a document-driven single source of truth, one per game and following whichever game is open; characters and vehicles drag straight in and plugins navigate to one another carrying context; and in a single day the engine added anti-aliasing, 9-slice UI art, extensible asset formats and clearer load errors.
k8vjkbr.zh: 前一天还只是蓝图的编辑模式,这天直接变成能用的功能:在视口里选对象、拖动 gizmo、自动存盘,"边编边玩"第一次真正跑起来。场景变成了以文档为准的单一权威、每个游戏一份并跟随当前打开的游戏;角色和载具能直接拖进来、插件之间能带着上下文互相跳转;引擎一天还补上抗锯齿、9-slice UI 素材、可扩展的资产格式与更清楚的加载报错。

k5zolj9.en: The blueprint lands: from "watching it run" to "reaching in to change it"
k5zolj9.zh: 蓝图落地:从"看它跑"到"动手改"

kii5k83.en: The editor blueprint set the day before entered implementation and ran through with no dawdling — a beautiful instance, across the whole project, of "think it through, then build it at once." Before this, Studio was always a place of "you speak, the AI builds, you watch": you describe what you want, the AI writes code, and the right side runs the game; but if any one thing wasn't to your liking, you could only keep describing it in words, unable to nudge it by hand. What this day added is exactly the "by hand" road: select, drag, save — these plainest of actions hold true in Studio for the first time. Meanwhile the engine filled in four or five capabilities underneath to back this road, and the content toolchain let assets flow more smoothly into the editor. In one line: for the first time, creative agency shifted from "all handed to the AI" to "both human and AI can reach in."
kii5k83.zh: 前一天定下的编辑器蓝图,这天没有拖泥带水,直接进入实施并跑通——这是整个项目里一次很漂亮的"想清楚就立刻做出来"。在此之前,Studio 始终是一个"你说、AI 做、你看"的地方:你描述想要什么,AI 写代码,右侧把游戏跑给你看;但只要有一处不合你意,你也只能继续用嘴描述,没法亲手挪一下。这天补上的,正是"亲手"这条路:选中、拖动、存盘,这些最朴素的动作第一次在 Studio 里成立。与此同时,引擎也在底层一口气补了四五项能力为这条路兜底,内容工具链则让素材能更顺地流进编辑器。一句话概括这一天:创作的主动权,第一次从"全交给 AI"变成了"人和 AI 都能动手"。

ku9nzc3.en: Editor mode lands: select, drag gizmos, auto-save
ku9nzc3.zh: 编辑模式落地:选对象、拖 gizmo、自动存盘

kk4593f.en: This day Studio gained a real "editor mode" for the first time, built up steadily in two layers. First the "editing surface" was stood up — the editing interface is rendered live by the engine, so what you see is the game's true appearance rather than a separately-drawn approximation; then the "editing brain" was wired in — a command bus threads each of your actions into controllable instructions, paired with a scene tree on the left (listing what objects exist and who is whose child) and a property inspector on the right (select an object to see and edit its properties), plus live sync between editor and engine. In feel: you can click to select objects in the viewport, use a gizmo (that handle wrapped around an object that lets you drag, rotate and scale directly) to adjust position and pose, and drag assets from the asset panel into the scene. This "surface + brain + sync" structure is key — it means the editor isn't a hardcoded panel but a framework that grows alongside the engine's capabilities, and every later editing feature grows on top of it.
kk4593f.zh: 这天 Studio 第一次有了真正的"编辑模式",而且是分两层稳稳搭起来的:先把"编辑表面"立起来——编辑界面由引擎实时渲染,你看到的就是游戏真实的样子,而不是另画一套近似图;再把"编辑大脑"接通——一条命令总线把你的每一步操作串成可控的指令,配上左侧的场景树(列出场景里有哪些物体、谁是谁的子节点)、右侧的属性检视面板(选中一个物体就能看到并修改它的各项属性),以及编辑器与引擎之间的实时同步。具体到手感:你能在视口里点选物体,用 gizmo(那个套在物体上、能直接拖动 / 旋转 / 缩放的控制柄)直接调整位置姿态,还能从资产面板把素材拖进场景。这套"表面 + 大脑 + 同步"的结构很关键——它意味着编辑器不是一个写死的面板,而是一个能随引擎能力一起生长的框架,后面所有编辑功能都长在它上面。

k1345a07.en: Scenes become "document-driven": one per game, auto-following
k1345a07.zh: 场景变成"以文档为准":每个游戏一份、自动跟随

k1ki7m3i.en: This day also established something far-reaching: scenes are now "document-driven" — a game's scene is expressed as a structured document, and that document is the scene's sole authority; the editor reads it, the engine runs by it, and saving saves it. Behind this, a dedicated scene core landed as the single source of truth for these documented scenes. Persistence came with it — "one scene per game, auto-saved, following whichever game is open": whichever game you open is the scene file you edit, and data no longer bleeds between games. Why does "document-driven" matter so much? Because it points "human editing" and "AI editing" at the same thing — drag an object and you change this document; the AI writes code and changes this same document; the two are naturally consistent rather than each editing their own copy. This day even the sample shooter template was changed to describe its static arena via this document, validating for the first time, with a real game, that the mechanism works.
k1ki7m3i.zh: 这天还确立了一件影响深远的事:场景从此"以文档为准"——一个游戏的场景被表达成一份结构化的文档,这份文档就是这个场景的唯一权威,编辑器读它、引擎按它来跑、存盘存的也是它。这背后落地了一个专门的场景核心,作为这套文档化场景的单一真相源。配套做了"每个游戏一份场景、自动存盘、且跟随当前打开的游戏"的持久化:你打开哪个游戏,编辑的就是哪个游戏的那份场景文件,几个游戏之间的数据再不会串到一起。为什么"以文档为准"这么重要?因为它让"人手编辑"和"AI 编辑"指向同一份东西——你拖动一个物体改的是这份文档,AI 写代码改的也是这份文档,两边天然一致,不会各改各的。这天连示例的射击游戏模板都改成了用这份文档来描述它的静态场地,等于第一次用真实游戏验证了这套机制可用。

k1tc73sb.en: Drag in characters and vehicles + jump between plugins
k1tc73sb.zh: 角色 / 载具直接拖进来 + 插件之间能互相跳转

kzcq4rz.en: On the content-creation side, this day wired up the "direct upload" path: characters, NPCs and vehicles finished in the character workbench can be dragged straight in for use, and finishing an NPC auto-advances to the next step; several old bugs — not displaying across surfaces, vehicles landing in the wrong spot — were fixed along with it. Further, plugins can now navigate to one another: a click in the character tool, say, can carry the current context straight into the animation tool to keep going, with no hunting for windows or re-confirming which character it was. The animation workbench's four modules were also unified at once into a single design language, with tidy color and spacing, looking like one product rather than four parts bolted together. Together these thread the "make a character → animate it → place it in the scene" flow — which used to mean bouncing back and forth across several tools — into a smooth assembly line, whose endpoint is exactly that just-now-usable editor.
kzcq4rz.zh: 内容创作这一侧这天打通了"直接上传"链路:在角色工作台里做好的角色、NPC、载具,可以直接拖进来用,做好 NPC 还会自动跳到下一步;之前几个老毛病——跨界面显示不出来、载具放不对位置——也一并修掉了。更进一步,插件之间现在能互相导航:比如在角色工具里点一下,就能带着当前的上下文直接跳进动画工具继续做,不用自己来回找窗口、重新对一遍是哪个角色。动画工作台的四个模块界面也一次性统一到了同一套设计语言,配色和间距都整齐了,看起来像一个产品而不是四个拼起来的零件。这些改动合起来,把"造角色 → 做动画 → 放进场景"这条原本要在好几个工具间反复横跳的流程,串成了一条顺手的流水线——而它的终点,正是上面那个刚刚能用的编辑器。

k1luudzm.en: Engine: anti-aliasing + 9-slice UI art, a more refined look
k1luudzm.zh: 引擎:抗锯齿 + 9-slice UI 素材,画面更精致

kic0iii.en: The two engine pieces this day are both visible refinements. One is multi-sample anti-aliasing: without it, an object's slanted edges and outlines carry a fringe of fine "jagged" steps, especially obvious on diagonals and in the distance; with it, edges are softly smoothed and the whole image is instantly a notch cleaner. The other is 9-slice support: a fundamental of UI work — a button or panel's background image, if stretched whole, distorts its rounded corners; the 9-slice approach cuts the image into nine pieces so the "four corners" stay as-is while only the "edges and middle" stretch as needed, letting one image fit buttons and panels of any size without warping. Neither changes gameplay, but they directly decide whether a game "looks refined." Making these basic look-and-feel capabilities solid is the precondition for users' creations to be "presentable" — however good the gameplay, a fringe of jaggies and a distorted button cheapens it at first glance.
kic0iii.zh: 引擎这天补的两块,都是肉眼能看出来的精致度。一是多重采样抗锯齿:没有它时,物体的斜边和轮廓会有一圈细碎的"锯齿"台阶,尤其在斜线和远处特别明显;接上之后,边缘被柔和地平滑掉,整个画面立刻干净一档。二是 9-slice 素材支持:这是做 UI 的一项基本功——一张按钮或面板的背景图,如果整张直接拉伸,四个圆角就会被拉变形;9-slice 的做法是把图切成九块,让"四个角"保持原样、只让"边和中间"按需拉伸,于是同一张素材能适配任意大小的按钮和面板而不走样。这两样都不改变玩法,但直接决定了一个游戏"看起来精不精致"。把这种基础观感能力做扎实,是让用户做出来的东西"拿得出手"的前提——再好的玩法,配上一圈锯齿和拉花的按钮,第一眼就掉价。

k6vplih.en: Engine: extensible asset formats + no more silent load failures
k6vplih.zh: 引擎:资产格式可扩展 + 加载不再沉默失败

kx1d9iu.en: The engine also made two more "skeletal" changes this day. One: asset importing became extensible. The knowledge of "which format, read how" used to be hardcoded in the engine core, so the engine could only use the few formats it knew; this day that knowledge was inverted out of the core into something injectable from outside — meaning third parties can later teach the engine its own asset formats without touching the engine itself. This turns the engine from a closed "eats only the prescribed ration" system into an open, extensible platform. Two: a built-in mapping from resource ids to internal handles was added, with clearer errors. Before, if a component wasn't correctly defined or a referenced resource couldn't be found, the system often failed silently — the scene looked loaded, yet some object was inexplicably missing and you had no idea where it went wrong; now such cases are reported explicitly. Extensibility lets the engine "grow open," and clear errors let it "be debugged" — both backstops for ever more complex content.
kx1d9iu.zh: 引擎这天还做了两件更偏"骨架"的改动。一是把资产导入做成可扩展的:以前"什么格式、怎么读"的知识是写死在引擎内核里的,引擎认得几种就只能用几种;这天把这块知识从内核里倒置出去,变成可以由外部注入的——意味着以后第三方可以教引擎认识它自己的资产格式,而不必改动引擎本身。这是把引擎从一个封闭的"只吃指定口粮"的系统,改造成一个开放的、能被扩展的平台。二是给资源标识到内部句柄加了一套内建映射,并补上了更清楚的报错:以前如果一个组件没被正确定义、或者引用的资源找不到,系统往往是沉默地失败——场景看着加载完了,某个对象却莫名不在,你完全不知道哪里出了错;现在这类情况会明确报出来。可扩展让引擎"长得开",清晰报错让引擎"调得动",两者都是为日益复杂的内容兜底。

kays763.en: Behind the scenes: preferences follow you + no stale dev cache
kays763.zh: 幕后:偏好跟人走 + 开发期不再吃旧缓存

k1swi1qo.en: The backend also tidied two unglamorous but experience-shaping things this day. One: browser preferences were persisted to the server, so the personal settings you tweak in the interface no longer live only in one browser but follow you, still there when you open up elsewhere. Two: an annoying dev-time phenomenon was fixed — a plugin's entry page used to be cached by the browser, so after changing code and refreshing you'd still see the old version and doubt whether it took effect; this day that entry page was set to not cache, guaranteeing a refresh shows the latest. Individually trivial, such changes decide "how comfortable it is to use": preferences not lost, refresh-is-fresh — seemingly obvious, yet genuinely achieving them takes picking at one spot after another. Smoothing these burrs is the daily homework of a tool moving from "usable" to "pleasant."
k1swi1qo.zh: 这天后端也收了两处不起眼但很影响体验的小事。一是把浏览器里的偏好设置持久化到了服务端:你在界面上调过的那些个人偏好不再只存在某一个浏览器里,而是跟着你走,换个地方打开也还在。二是修了一个开发期的烦人现象——插件界面的入口页面以前会被浏览器缓存,导致改了代码刷新后看到的还是旧版本,让人怀疑是不是没生效;这天把这个入口页面改成不缓存,保证刷新就是最新。这类改动单看微不足道,但它们决定的是"用着顺不顺心":偏好不丢、刷新即新,看似理所应当,真正做到却要一处处去抠。把这些毛刺磨平,正是一个工具从"能用"走向"好用"的日常功课。

knv8mtb.en: This day is a watershed: Studio began growing from a "conversational game generator" into a "creation platform with both conversation and editing." What's most worth remembering isn't just the result "the editor works," but how it landed — blueprint one day, running the next, and not an isolated panel piled on but the "document-driven scene" foundation, several engine underlying capabilities, and the content tools' inflow path all aligned at once, so the editor was born standing on a structure that can keep growing. For users, from this day you can have the AI generate while you hand-tune yourself, both pointing at the same scene without fighting. For the platform, this step formally reconnected "human creativity" into the creative loop — the AI takes you from zero to eight-tenths, and you hand-add the remaining, most personal-taste two-tenths yourself.
knv8mtb.zh: 这一天是一个分水岭:Studio 从一个"对话式游戏生成器"开始长成一个"对话 + 编辑双修的创作平台"。最值得记住的,不只是"编辑器能用了"这个结果,更是它落地的方式——前一天画蓝图,后一天就跑通,而且不是孤立地堆一个面板,而是同时把"以文档为准的场景"这个地基、引擎的若干底层能力、内容工具的流入链路一起对齐,让编辑器一出生就站在一个能继续生长的结构上。对用户来说,从这天起你可以一边让 AI 帮你生成,一边自己上手微调,两种方式指向同一份场景、彼此不打架。对平台来说,这一步把"人的创造力"正式接回了创作回路——AI 负责把你从零带到八分,你负责把那剩下的、最讲个人趣味的两分亲手补上。

k5dwluf.en: The editor that had just run the day before reached completion this day, with every implementable feature filled in: panels drag, group, pop out into separate windows and reset with one click; the move/rotate/scale gizmos are all in place with shortcuts; the property inspector refreshes live as you drag; one-key fly-to-selection plus history and capabilities panels are ready. The engine also made a mesh's topology type directly visible in the viewport, and the content tools got a batch of interface unification.
k5dwluf.zh: 前一天刚跑通的编辑器,这天一口气把所有可实施的功能补齐收官:面板能拖、能分组、能弹成独立窗口、能一键重置;移动 / 旋转 / 缩放三种 gizmo 全到位并配上快捷键;属性面板跟着你拖动实时刷新;一键飞到选中对象、历史与能力面板齐备。引擎这边还让网格的拓扑类型能直接在视口里看出来,内容工具也收了一批界面统一。

k1c5zshi.en: From "usable" to "feels like a real editor"
k1c5zshi.zh: 从"能用"到"像个真编辑器"

k1evxn1j.en: The day before, the editor could select objects, drag gizmos and save for the first time, taking the first "hands-on" step; but at that point it was more a usable prototype than a mature tool you'd happily spend all day working in. This day's work fills "usable" out into "pleasant": what makes a professional editor feel natural is countless seemingly-trivial yet indispensable things — whether panels arrange to your habits, whether the transform tools are complete, whether a value change shows feedback at once, how fast you can find an object, whether a mistake can be undone. Filling all of these in at once equips the editor with "the full basics a professional tool should have." This isn't piling on features but polishing a tool to the point of "no awkwardness on first use" — and it's exactly that lack of awkwardness that decides whether a creator will use it for the long haul.
k1evxn1j.zh: 前一天,编辑器第一次能选对象、拖 gizmo、存盘,迈出了"动手"的第一步;但那时它还更像一个能用的雏形,而不是一个让人愿意整天待在里面干活的成熟工具。这天做的,就是把"能用"补成"好用":一个专业编辑器之所以让人顺手,靠的是无数件看似细碎、实则缺一不可的事——面板能不能按你的习惯摆、变换工具全不全、改一下数值能不能立刻看到反馈、找一个物体快不快、做错了能不能回退。这天把这些事一次性补齐,等于给编辑器装上了"专业工具该有的全部基本功"。这不是堆功能,而是把一个工具打磨到"上手没有别扭感"的程度——而正是这种没有别扭感,决定了一个创作者愿不愿意长期用它。

k11qsil.en: Dockable panels: arrange the interface your way, reset in one click
k11qsil.zh: 可停靠面板:界面随你摆,乱了一键复位

k7gcxk4.en: This day wired a dockable panel system into the editor, with a unified panel manager to govern it. What it can do: every panel — scene tree, property inspector, material, timeline, material graph and so on — can be dragged with the mouse to any region to rearrange, can stack several panels into one tab group (drag together to group, click a tab to switch), can pop a panel out into its own floating window to view alone, and if you mess the layout up you can reset to default in one click. Why does this matter? Because different people and different tasks need entirely different layouts: tuning materials you want the material panel enlarged, animating you want the timeline filling the bottom. One hardcoded fixed layout can only ever serve one kind of person; dockable panels hand the decision of "what the interface looks like" back to the user. The same day debuted three new panels — material, timeline and material graph — joined with the existing inspector and scene tree into this system, and the editor's "skeleton" took shape from here.
k7gcxk4.zh: 这天给编辑器接入了一套可停靠的面板系统,并配了一个统一的面板管理器来掌管它。具体能做什么:每一块面板——场景树、属性检视、材质、时间轴、材质图等等——都可以用鼠标拖到界面的任意区域重新摆放,可以把几个面板叠成一组标签页(拖到一起就成组、点标签就切换),可以把某个面板弹成一个独立的浮动窗口单独看,布局被你折腾乱了还能一键重置回默认。为什么这件事重要?因为不同的人、不同的活,需要的界面布局完全不同:调材质时想把材质面板放大,做动画时想让时间轴占满底部。一套写死的固定布局永远只能照顾一种人;而可停靠面板把"界面长什么样"的决定权交还给了用户。同一天还首发了材质、时间轴、材质图三个新面板,加上已有的检视器和场景树一起接进这套系统——编辑器的"骨架"自此成型。

kk9u3tn.en: The full transform toolset: move, rotate, scale
kk9u3tn.zh: 三种变换工具全到位:移动、旋转、缩放

k19d458b.en: The day before, the only gizmo you could drag was "move"; this day "rotate" and "scale" were filled in, with a set of shortcuts matching industry-standard convention to switch quickly between the three modes — so anyone who has used any professional 3D tool knows how to use it almost without learning. The three transforms are the most basic actions for placing anything: move a crate to the wall (move), set it at an angle (rotate), double its size as an obstacle (scale) — none dispensable. The engine was also made to render an object's rotation correctly, ensuring the pose you see in the viewport exactly matches the data. On top of that, "one-key fly-to-selection" was added — press a key or double-click and the camera smoothly flies over to frame the selected thing in the center, so in a big scene you no longer struggle to find the viewpoint by hand. Completing this most basic toolset and making it intuitive is the dividing line where an editor turns from a "demo" into a "production tool."
k19d458b.zh: 前一天能拖的只有"移动"一种 gizmo,这天把"旋转"和"缩放"也补齐了,并配上了一组与业界通行约定一致的快捷键来快速切换这三种模式——这样上手过任何专业三维工具的人,几乎不用学就知道怎么用。三种变换是摆放任何东西的最基本动作:把一个箱子挪到墙边(移动)、让它斜着放(旋转)、把它放大一倍当作障碍(缩放),缺一不可。配套还让引擎正确渲染出物体的旋转,保证你在视口里看到的姿态和数据完全一致。此外还加了"一键飞到选中对象"——按一个键或双击,相机立刻平滑地飞过去把选中的东西框在画面中央,在一个大场景里再不用费劲手动找视角。把这套最基础的操作做齐、做到符合直觉,是编辑器从"演示品"变成"生产工具"的分界线。

k5nz9ev.en: See it at once: the inspector refreshes live as you drag
k5nz9ev.zh: 改一下立刻看到:检视器跟着拖动实时刷新

km19xtm.en: This day also wired up the most crucial feedback loop in editing: the property inspector refreshes live with your dragging in the viewport. That is, as you drag an object with a gizmo, the numbers for position, rotation and scale in the right-hand inspector jump in sync, so you can drag while seeing the exact current values; conversely, this loop also guarantees that when you type a precise value in the panel, the viewport object changes with it at once. This "bidirectional, instant" consistency is the soul of every professional editor — it eliminates the uncertainty of "just how much did that drag change," letting coarse adjustment (dragging gizmos) and fine adjustment (typing values) seamlessly connect. The same day brought a history panel and a capabilities panel: the history panel lets you see and undo each operation you performed, and the capabilities panel surfaces the currently available operations in one place. With live feedback and an undoable history, editing finally becomes "confident and bold" — mistakes can be undone, changes can be seen.
km19xtm.zh: 这天还接通了编辑里最关键的一条反馈回路:属性检视面板会跟着你在视口里的拖动实时更新。也就是说,当你用 gizmo 拖动一个物体时,右侧检视面板里那些表示位置、旋转、缩放的数字会同步跳动,你能一边拖、一边精确地看到当前数值;反过来,这条回路也保证了你在面板里输入一个精确数值时,视口里的物体立刻随之改变。这种"双向、即时"的一致性,是所有专业编辑器的灵魂——它消除了"我刚才那一拖到底改成了多少"这种不确定感,让粗调(拖 gizmo)和精调(填数值)能无缝衔接。同一天还上线了历史面板和能力面板:历史面板让你能看清并回退做过的每一步操作,能力面板则把当前可用的操作集中呈现。有了实时反馈和可回退的历史,编辑这件事才真正变得"放心大胆"——错了能撤,改了能看见。

k1m8t4rj.en: Engine: see a mesh's topology type at a glance
k1m8t4rj.zh: 引擎:一眼看出网格的拓扑类型

k1ngkvt5.en: A very practical engine addition this day: a mesh's "topology type" was made into a debug view that can be drawn directly in the viewport, with all five basic geometry topologies (points, line segments, continuous polylines, triangle faces, continuous triangle strips) visibly annotated. What does this mean? A 3D model is, at bottom, a pile of points and the connections between them, and "topology" describes "how those points are connected" — isolated points, individual line segments, or assembled triangle faces. When a model displays wrong, the problem is often a wrong topology type, but you used to only guess at the code or data. Now you can draw it directly in the viewport and look, making it far more intuitive to locate broken geometry. This capability mainly serves debugging and asset inspection, and it's on the same line as the editor — the editor lets you place and adjust, while this debug view lets you see what's really happening underneath when something goes wrong. Making "invisible internal state" visible is a hallmark of a tool maturing.
k1ngkvt5.zh: 引擎这天补的一项很实用:把网格的"拓扑类型"做成了能直接在视口里画出来的调试视图,五种基本的几何拓扑(点、线段、连续折线、三角面、连续三角带)都能被可视地标注出来。这是什么意思?一个三维模型说到底是由一堆点和它们之间的连接关系拼成的,而"拓扑"就是描述"这些点是怎么连起来的"——是孤立的点、是一根根线段、还是拼成的三角面。当一个模型显示不正常时,问题常常就出在拓扑类型不对,但以前你只能对着代码或数据瞎猜。现在能在视口里直接把它画出来看,定位坏掉的几何就直观多了。这项能力主要服务于调试和资产排查,它和编辑器是一条线上的——编辑器让你能摆放和调整,而这种调试视图让你在出问题时能看清底层到底怎么了。把"看不见的内部状态"变得可见,是工具走向成熟的一个标志。

kt4556d.en: Games and content tools: aligning to the editor line
kt4556d.zh: 游戏与内容工具:对齐编辑器这条线

k1f2vcdi.en: As the editor reached completion, its surroundings converged in the same direction. On the games side, the sample shooter's "playable experience" was written into a proper document, and another shooter sample got "scene-file seeding" — pre-saving its scene as that document-driven scene file so it runs the same disk-scene mechanism as the editor; the artifacts left from earlier editor-testing were also cleaned up to keep the seed scene clean. On the content-tools side, the skill workbench's sidebar workflow was streamlined, and the sidebar header styles across plugins were unified at once so they look like different modules of one product; the narrative tool also kept advancing, adding validation of key nodes and a character timeline. Individually small, these together ensure one thing: when the editor's main line reached completion, the game samples and creation tools around it weren't each going their own way but were pulled together onto the same mechanism and the same visual language.
k1f2vcdi.zh: 编辑器收官的同时,周边也在往同一个方向靠拢。游戏这边,把示例射击游戏的"可玩体验"写成了正经文档,并给另一个射击示例做了"场景文件种子化"——也就是把它的场景预先存成那份以文档为准的场景文件,让它和编辑器走的是同一套磁盘场景机制;还顺手清理掉了之前用编辑器做测试时留下的痕迹,保证种子场景是干净的。内容创作工具这边,梳理了技能工作台的侧边栏工作流,并把各个插件的侧边栏标题样式一次性对齐统一,让它们看起来是同一个产品的不同模块;叙事工具也继续推进,加上了关键节点的校验和角色时间线。这些改动单看都不大,但它们共同确保了一件事:当编辑器这条主线收官时,它周围的游戏示例和创作工具不是各走各的,而是被一起拉到了同一套机制、同一套视觉语言上。

k1c3zv0a.en: From blueprint to completion, the editor took just three days: set direction, run it through, fill it in. The period drawn this day means Studio formally has a feature-complete, awkwardness-free visual editor — no longer an auxiliary demo beside the AI but a second creative main line on equal footing with conversation. What's worth savoring is the rhythm of these three days: not leaving a pile of half-finished pieces to rush a schedule, but honestly filling in a professional tool's basics one by one until "every implementable feature landed." Whether a tool is ultimately pleasant to use is never decided by how many dazzling big features it has, but by whether these unglamorous basics were earnestly completed. With the editor line wrapped, human and AI finally stand before the same canvas: the AI paints with code and conversation, you revise with mouse and gizmo, two brushes on one image.
k1c3zv0a.zh: 从蓝图到收官,编辑器只用了三天:定方向、跑通、补齐。这天画下的句号,意味着 Studio 正式拥有了一个功能完整、上手不别扭的可视化编辑器——它不再是 AI 之外的一个附属演示,而是和对话生成平起平坐的第二条创作主线。值得回味的是这三天的节奏:没有为了赶进度而留下一堆半成品,而是一项项把专业工具的基本功老老实实补齐,直到"所有可实施的功能都落地"。一个工具最终好不好用,从来不是由它有多少炫目的大功能决定的,而是由这些不起眼的基本功有没有被认真做齐决定的。编辑器这条线收官之后,人和 AI 终于站在了同一块画布前:AI 用代码和对话作画,你用鼠标和 gizmo 修改,两支笔画在同一张图上。

k1fizrlf.en: Drag a model in and it becomes a scene
k1fizrlf.zh: 拖一个模型进来就变成场景

kop6vkl.en: This day the editor learned something very practical: drag a 3D model into the asset panel and it automatically expands into an editable scene — the model's node hierarchy, lights and cameras restored intact. Alongside it, the editor's multi-window docking system got a thorough overhaul so detaching panels no longer misbehaves, the once-black HDR sky was fixed, and groundwork was laid for placing many copies of the same model efficiently.
kop6vkl.zh: 这天编辑器学会了一件很实用的事:把一个 3D 模型拖进资产面板,它会自动展开成一个可编辑的场景——模型里的节点层级、灯光、相机都被原样还原。配套还把编辑器的多窗口停靠系统彻底整修了一轮、让拆窗口不再乱跳,把一度变黑的 HDR 天空修了回来,并为"同一模型大量重复摆放"打好了底层基础。

kslnwsg.zh: 把"外面的资产"接进"里面的编辑"

k17pamqk.en: After the editor wrapped up over the preceding days, what this day added was the intake it most deserved yet had been missing: bringing in assets made outside. However powerful a creation tool, if it can only use what it generates itself, the creator's asset library is locked into a small circle; true openness is being able to pull in models and textures made anywhere and keep using them. The day had just this one main line, but a weighty one — letting the editor "ingest" a standard 3D model file and turn it into a scene you can keep arranging. Around it, the backend opened a few new entry points and the front end added an import menu, while the same day also swept away a long-accumulated pile of instability in the editor's multi-window operations at once and fixed a once-broken sky display. In a word: this day both opened "assets can come in" and made the editor itself "stable to use."
k17pamqk.zh: 编辑器在前几天收官之后,这天补上的是它最该有、却一直缺的一条进料口:把外部做好的资产搬进来。一个创作工具再强,如果只能用它自己生成的东西,创作者的素材库就被锁死在一个小圈子里;真正的开放,是能把任何地方做好的模型、纹理拿进来继续用。这天的主线就只有这一条但分量很重——让编辑器能"吃下"一个标准 3D 模型文件,并把它变成可以继续编排的场景。围绕这条主线,后端开了几个新入口、前端加了导入菜单,而同一天还顺手把编辑器多窗口操作里积压已久的一堆不稳定问题一次扫清、把一度损坏的天空显示修复。一句话:这天既打通了"资产进得来",也让编辑器本身"用得稳"。

k4h09j3.en: Drag a model in, and it becomes a scene
k4h09j3.zh: 拖一个模型进来,自动变成场景

kiz0rt8.en: The day's core capability: drag a 3D model file into the asset panel and it's automatically broken down into an editable scene. The prior pain was concrete — a standard model file isn't an isolated blob of geometry; inside it usually carries full structure: a node parent-child hierarchy, individual sub-meshes, attached lights, even preset cameras; but on import those structures were often all lost, leaving you a single opaque, immovable lump. The approach now: the backend runs model parsing on demand and translates the model's internal node tree faithfully into that "document-driven" scene — whatever hierarchy, lights and cameras the model holds, the scene restores the corresponding objects, one-to-one, individually selectable and editable. An import dropdown was added to the editing surface for common model, texture and scene-pack formats; the backend opened three steps — uploading binary assets, parsing the model on demand, and breaking the node tree into a scene document — to wire the path through, and the asset panel auto-refreshes after import with no manual reload. For creators this means a whole scene or a rigged character you sculpted externally can be dragged in and arranged and tuned right away, rather than rebuilt from scratch.
kiz0rt8.zh: 这天的核心能力是:把一个 3D 模型文件拖进资产面板,它会被自动拆解成一个可编辑的场景。此前的痛点很具体——一个标准模型文件其实不是一坨孤立的几何,它内部往往带着完整的结构:节点的父子层级、一个个子网格、附带的灯光、甚至预设好的相机;但导进来后这些结构常常全丢了,你只剩一坨打不开、动不了的整体。现在的做法是:后端按需跑模型解析,把模型内部的节点树原样翻译成那份"以文档为准"的场景——模型里有什么层级、什么灯光、什么相机,场景里就还原出对应的对象,一一对应、可独立选中和编辑。配套在编辑界面加了导入下拉菜单,支持常见的模型、纹理与场景包格式;后端还新开了"上传二进制资源、按需解析模型、把节点树拆成场景文档"三个环节把这条链路接通,导入完成后资产面板自动刷新,不用手动重载。对创作者来说,这意味着你在外部捏好的一整个场景或一个带骨架的角色,拖进来就能直接接着摆、接着调,而不是从零重搭。

kauh3eu.en: Detaching panels no longer misbehaves: a docking overhaul
kauh3eu.zh: 编辑器拆窗口不再乱跳:停靠系统大修

kbajxk7.en: This day gave the editor's panel docking a thorough overhaul, clearing in one go a long-accumulated pile of "glitchy" behavior. The prior pain: multi-window operations were full of traps — dragging a panel like the inspector out into its own OS window, then closing that window, or undoing/redoing in a detached panel, could all glitch, misalign or even freeze. The root cause was the docking's deeply-nested internal structure with hard-to-track state. This day changed it to a "flat structure": preview and edit were promoted to top-level independent panels, and flattening the hierarchy made behavior predictable. On this new structure, a string of specific bugs were fixed one by one: dragging a panel to empty space cleanly pops it into its own window instead of vaguely floating within the app; when an independent window is closed, the panel inside dutifully returns to the main interface; and undo/redo finally works in detached panels. Visually, the somewhat harsh blue tab highlight was swapped for a neutral dark tone, and panel names were tidied and unified. The multi-window workflow went from "usable but nerve-wracking" to "genuinely stable."
kbajxk7.zh: 这天对编辑器的面板停靠做了一次彻底整修,一口气清掉了一堆积压已久的"抽风"行为。此前的痛点是:多窗口操作处处是坑——把检视器之类的面板拖出成一个独立的操作系统窗口、再把那个窗口关掉、或者在分离出去的面板里按撤销/重做,都可能各种乱跳、错位甚至卡死。根因在于停靠的内部结构层层嵌套、状态难以追踪。这天把它改成了"扁平结构":预览和编辑都被提成顶层的独立面板,层级一拉平,行为就好预测了。在这套新结构上,一连串具体毛病被逐个修好:把面板拖到空白处会干脆利落地弹成独立窗口,而不是含糊地浮在应用内;独立窗口被关掉时,里面的面板会自己乖乖回到主界面;撤销/重做在分离的面板里也终于正常工作。视觉上还把那个有点刺眼的蓝色标签高亮换成了中性的深色,面板名称也统一规整。多窗口工作流从"能用但提心吊胆"变成了"真的稳"。

k19fh7bo.en: The skybox returns: HDR environment-map import fixed
k19fh7bo.zh: 天空盒回归:HDR 环境贴图导入修好

kbfzcmn.en: A while back, the chain responsible for loading HDR environment maps had broken for a stretch, with the direct consequence that the sky in scenes went black for a time — sky light and ambient atmosphere all gone. This day restored the whole environment-map import and loading path, so the HDR sky renders correctly again in both edit and play. It's worth explaining why this matters: an HDR environment map isn't just "drawing a pretty sky backdrop"; it's simultaneously the lighting source for the entire scene — what color the sky is, where it's bright and where dim, naturally falls on every object in the scene and decides the whole image's light and shade, warm and cool. So when the sky goes black, what's lost isn't just the backdrop but the scene's "atmosphere of light." Restoring this chain relights the scene's "soul lighting." It's also a reminder: the more a foundational chain affects everything downstream, the more it needs regression protection, lest it quietly break again with no one noticing right away.
kbfzcmn.zh: 前一阵子,负责加载 HDR 环境贴图的那条链路断过一段时间,直接后果是场景里的天空一度变成了黑的——天光、环境氛围全没了。这天把整套环境贴图的导入与加载补了回来,HDR 天空在编辑和试玩里都能重新正常出图。这里值得解释一下它为什么重要:一张 HDR 环境贴图不只是"画一张好看的天空背景"那么简单,它同时是整个场景的光照来源——天空什么颜色、哪里亮哪里暗,会自然地照在场景里所有物体上,决定整个画面的明暗冷暖。所以天空一黑,丢的不只是背景,而是整个场景的"光的氛围"。把这条链路修回来,等于把场景的"灵魂照明"重新点亮。这也提醒了一件事:越是这种牵一发动全身的基础链路,越要有回归防护,免得它再次悄悄断掉而没人立刻发现。

k1q591y0.en: Laying groundwork for "placing many copies of one model"
k1q591y0.zh: 为"同一模型摆很多个"打底

kkhsiuy.en: The engine also did a performance-paving thing underneath this day: wiring several shaders to a dedicated "per-instance transform" channel. What does this mean? Many game scenes feature heavy repetition of the same model — hundreds of trees in a forest, rows of bricks on a wall, a crowd of identically-shaped enemies. The naivest approach redraws the model one by one, but that cost balloons linearly with count and a large scene stutters. The more efficient approach is "instancing": the same model is handed to the GPU just once, attached with a list of "each copy's own position, orientation and scale," letting the GPU draw hundreds or thousands of copies into their places in one pass. This day wired several shaders in the scene to this per-instance data channel, aligned shadow drawing with it, and added regression protection. This is the kind of under-the-hood work users don't see but that directly decides "how big a scene can be stacked and how smoothly it runs" — not a feature in itself but the precondition that makes many later "large-scene" features possible.
kkhsiuy.zh: 引擎这天还在底层做了一件为性能铺路的事:让多个着色器接上专门的"逐实例变换"通道。这是什么意思?很多游戏场景里会出现大量同一个模型的重复——一片树林里的几百棵树、一面墙上的成排砖块、一群外形相同的敌人。最朴素的做法是把这个模型逐个重新画一遍,但那样开销会随数量线性暴涨,场景一大就卡。更高效的做法叫"实例化":同一个模型只交给显卡一次,再附上一张"每个副本各自的位置、朝向、缩放"的清单,让显卡一次性把成百上千个副本各就各位地画出来。这天把场景中多个着色器接上了这条逐实例的数据通道,并让阴影绘制也与之对齐、加上了回归防护。这属于用户看不见、但直接决定"场景能堆多大、跑多流畅"的底层功夫——它本身不是一个功能,而是让后面很多"大场景"功能成为可能的前提。

k13esj9g.en: If the preceding days were about "building the editor up," this day was about "running its water and power and firming its foundation." The import capability makes the editor no longer an island that can only use its own materials but an open workbench that can take in external assets and keep creating on top of them — a step that vastly broadens the range of materials creators can use. The docking overhaul is value of another kind: it added no new feature, purely polishing what existed from "usable but often glitchy" to "solid in use," and that solidity is exactly the foundation on which a professional tool earns long-term trust. With the return of sky lighting and the groundwork for instanced rendering, this day pushed the editor's "intake, stability, visuals, performance" four facets forward a notch at once. It reminds us: a tool matures by both continually growing new capabilities and continually going back to firm old ones into true reliability — neither dispensable.
k13esj9g.zh: 如果说前几天是把编辑器"盖起来",这一天就是给它"通水电、修地基"。导入能力让编辑器不再是一座只能用自家材料的孤岛,而是一个能接纳外部资产、继续在其上创作的开放工作台——这一步极大地拓宽了创作者能用的素材范围。停靠系统大修则是另一种价值:它没有增加任何新功能,纯粹是把已有的东西从"能用但常出岔子"打磨到"用着踏实",而这种踏实恰恰是专业工具能被长期信赖的根本。再加上天空照明的回归和实例化渲染的铺垫,这一天把编辑器的"进料、稳定、视觉、性能"四个侧面同时往前推了一格。它提醒我们:一个工具走向成熟,既要不断长出新能力,也要不断回头把旧能力夯到真正可靠——两者缺一不可。

kgqkuvx.en: The core editor panels arrive + Windows support
kgqkuvx.zh: 编辑器三件套到齐 + Windows 兼容

keb06w9.en: This day filled the editor with the three most essential, most everyday panels of game editing — Hierarchy, Inspector and Assets — forming a complete editing flow for the first time; meanwhile the engine added 2D tile-map rendering, fixed a batch of Windows compatibility issues, wired a full imported-model scene into a sample game, and made the backend degrade gracefully when a sub-service is down rather than erroring outright.
keb06w9.zh: 这天把游戏编辑里最核心、最日常的三个面板——层级、检视器、资产——一次性补进了编辑器,编辑动线第一次完整成形;引擎同时新增了 2D 瓦片地图渲染、修好了 Windows 上的一批兼容问题,还把一个完整的导入模型场景接进了示例游戏,并让后端在子服务未启动时优雅降级而不是直接报错。

kyo0et6.en: From "skeleton" to "flesh": the editor starts filling in
kyo0et6.zh: 从"骨架"到"血肉":编辑器开始填实

k15jmm91.en: The previous two days stood up the editor's "skeleton" — the dockable panel system, transform tools, undo/redo. But a skeleton alone can't do work; what actually lets someone sit down and build a game are the feature panels hung on that skeleton. This day's work is exactly putting flesh on that skeleton: filling in, all at once, the three core panels indispensable to any game editor, so the most basic editing flow — "see objects, select, change properties, pull in assets" — runs end-to-end for the first time. Meanwhile the engine broadened itself in two directions — adding the rendering foundation for the whole tile-map category of 2D gameplay, and fixing a batch of Windows compatibility issues so more people can run it. With an imported model actually wired into a sample game and the backend degrading gracefully on failure, the day's theme is clear: filling the framework built over the preceding days, spot by spot, into something genuinely usable.
k15jmm91.zh: 前两天把编辑器的"骨架"立了起来——可停靠的面板系统、变换工具、撤销重做。但骨架本身不能干活,真正让人能坐下来编游戏的,是挂在骨架上的那些功能面板。这天做的,正是往这副骨架上填血肉:把任何游戏编辑器都不可或缺的三个核心面板一次性补齐,让"看见对象、选中、改属性、取素材"这条最基本的编辑动线第一次完整跑通。与此同时,引擎也在两个方向上拓宽自己——一是补上了 2D 瓦片地图这一整类玩法的渲染基础,二是修好了在 Windows 上的一批兼容问题让更多人能跑起来。再加上把导入的模型真正接进一个示例游戏、让后端在异常时优雅降级,这一天的主题很清晰:把前几天搭好的框架,一处处填成真正能用的东西。

ks60drv.en: The core editor trio: Hierarchy / Inspector / Assets
ks60drv.zh: 编辑器三件套到齐:层级 / 检视器 / 资产

ki7v6ec.en: This day the editor filled in the three most essential panels of game editing, each minding its own domain and none dispensable. The Hierarchy panel: arranging every object in the scene into a tree by parent-child relationship, making clear at a glance who is whose child, click to select — this is where you "find things and grasp structure" in a scene. The Inspector panel: select an object and its every property spreads out on the right — position, rotation, material, all kinds of parameters editable directly — this is where you "tune one thing." The Assets panel: browse and pull in all the project's materials — models, textures, scene packs and so on, dragging in whatever you need — this is where you "fetch materials." Together, the three form the core flow every game developer repeats hundreds or thousands of times a day — "see all objects → select one → change its parameters → drag something in from assets" — finally complete in Studio. They're a "trio" precisely because the essence of editing is shuttling endlessly between "the global view, the single-object detail, and the source of materials" — only with all three present does the editor truly become capable of work.
ki7v6ec.zh: 这天编辑器补上了游戏编辑里最核心的三个面板,它们各管一摊、缺一不可。层级面板:把场景里所有对象按父子关系排成一棵树,谁是谁的子节点一目了然,点一下就能选中——这是你在场景里"找东西、理结构"的地方。检视器面板:选中一个对象后,在右侧把它的所有属性摊开,位置、旋转、材质、各种参数都能直接改——这是你"调一个东西"的地方。资产面板:浏览和取用项目里的全部素材——模型、纹理、场景包等等,需要什么从这里拖进来——这是你"取材料"的地方。这三个面板配合在一起,"看见全部对象 → 选中一个 → 改它的参数 → 从资产里拖东西进来"这套每个游戏开发者每天要重复成百上千次的核心动线,终于在 Studio 里完整成形。它们之所以是"三件套",正因为编辑的本质就是在"全局视图、单体细节、素材来源"这三者之间不停穿梭——三个都到齐,编辑器才算真正能干活。

kjqmrnb.zh: 引擎新增 2D 瓦片地图渲染

kidqjbz.en: The engine laid the foundation for a whole category of gameplay this day: 2D tile-map rendering. Tile maps are the classic 2D-game approach — cut the world into a grid of square cells, put a small picture ("a tile") in each cell, and assembled they make a whole map: grass, walls, rivers and roads are all paved from these little squares; classic side-scrolling, top-down and pixel-art games are nearly all built on it. This day the engine landed the base components for tile maps and tile layers, and can read a common tile-map file format — meaning a level you draw in a dedicated map tool can be read straight into the engine and rendered, without re-placing every cell by hand. The significance: it formally extends the platform's reach from the previously 3D-leaning scenes into the vast territory of 2D — the first game many creators want to make is precisely a 2D one, and opening this road throws the door open to a large body of 2D creators.
kidqjbz.zh: 引擎这天补上了一整类玩法的地基:2D 瓦片地图渲染。瓦片地图是 2D 游戏里最经典的做法——把世界切成一格一格的方块网格,每一格放一张小图("瓦片"),拼起来就是一整张地图:草地、墙壁、河流、道路都是用这些小方块铺出来的;经典的横版、俯视角、像素风游戏几乎都建立在它之上。这天引擎落下了瓦片地图和瓦片图层的基础组件,并且能读取通用的瓦片地图文件格式——也就是说,你用专门的地图工具画好的关卡,可以直接被引擎读进来渲染出来,而不必手工重摆每一格。这件事的意义在于,它让平台的能力从此前偏重的 3D 场景,正式扩展到了 2D 这一大片天地——很多创作者想做的第一个游戏恰恰是 2D 的,把这条路打通,等于向一大批 2D 创作者敞开了门。

khpqb7i.en: Windows compatibility: it runs properly on more machines
khpqb7i.zh: Windows 兼容修复:更多电脑能正常跑

k1mbwi91.en: This day focused on a batch of Windows compatibility issues. The most common and most insidious pitfall of cross-platform software often lies not in the features themselves but in the subtle convention differences between systems: different operating systems use different text line-endings, different file-path separators, different behavior for wildcard file matching — and if any one isn't aligned, code that ran fine on one system fails inexplicably on another. This day fixed, one by one, a set of failures caused by these differences, and unified the text line-ending convention so all files behave consistently across platforms. For Windows users, this means the development environment and tests run properly on their own machines instead of snagging everywhere on OS differences. For a tool to be used by as many people as possible, cross-platform support is unavoidable groundwork — it adds no new feature, yet directly decides how many people "can't even get in the door." Firming up this compatibility clears the very first obstacle for a broader user base.
k1mbwi91.zh: 这天集中修了一批 Windows 上的兼容问题。跨平台软件最常见、也最隐蔽的坑,往往不在功能本身,而在系统之间那些细微的约定差异:不同操作系统的文本换行符不一样、文件路径的分隔方式不一样、按通配符匹配文件的行为不一样——任何一处没对齐,在一个系统上跑得好好的代码,换到另一个系统就会莫名其妙地失败。这天把因这些差异导致的一组失败逐个修掉,并统一了文本换行的规范,确保所有文件在各平台上表现一致。对 Windows 用户来说,这意味着开发环境和测试能在自己的机器上正常跑起来,不再因为系统差异处处卡壳。一个工具想要被尽可能多的人用上,跨平台就是绕不开的基本功——它不增加任何新功能,却直接决定了有多少人"连门都进不来"。把这块兼容性补扎实,是在为更广的用户群体扫清最前面的障碍。

kwcqjrw.en: Wiring "an imported model" into a real game + a sturdier backend
kwcqjrw.zh: 把"导入的模型"接进一个真游戏 + 后端更稳健

kf5t45.en: The previous day opened the "drag a model in and it becomes a scene" capability; this day ran it through with a real example: a full scene model was wired into the shooter sample as a real-world example of the "import a model → assemble a playable scene" path. A new capability merely running isn't enough — it needs a real use case to verify it holds up in an actual end-to-end flow, and this sample does exactly that. The backend also holds up better against surprises: when a depended-on sub-service isn't up yet, related requests now degrade gracefully to a clear "temporarily unavailable" status instead of throwing a pile of generic server errors that drag the whole interface down. This "graceful degradation" is a hallmark of a robust system — one component being down shouldn't paralyze the whole system; it should clearly say "this part isn't available right now" and let the rest run on. Combined with the earlier binary-asset upload channel, the full chain of bringing external materials in and using them in a real game grew more complete this day.
kf5t45.zh: 前一天打通了"拖一个模型进来就变成场景"的能力,这天就用一个真实示例把它跑了一遍:一个完整的场景模型被接进了射击示例游戏,作为"导入模型 → 拼成可玩场景"这条路的实战样例。一项新能力光能跑通还不够,得有真实的用例去验证它在端到端的真实流程里确实站得住——这个示例做的就是这件事。后端这边也更经得起意外了:当某个依赖的子服务还没启动时,相关请求现在会优雅地返回一个"暂不可用"的明确状态,而不是抛出一堆笼统的服务器错误把整个界面拖垮。这种"优雅降级"是健壮系统的标志——一个部件没起来,不该让整个系统跟着瘫;它应该清楚地说"我这块暂时不行",让其余部分照常运转。配合此前的二进制资源上传通道,把外部素材搬进来、再用进真实游戏的整条链路,这天又完整了一截。

k1fnqd7n.en: This day had no earth-shattering single breakthrough, but it nicely illustrates a product's process of "moving from framework to practicality." The arrival of the editor trio means Studio's visual editing crossed, for the first time, from "demonstrable" into "you can actually sit down and work"; the addition of 2D tile maps extended the platform's territory from 3D to 2D, catching a large body of creators who want to make classic 2D games; and the Windows compatibility fix clears the entry barrier ahead of time for more potential users. Seen together, these three point in the same direction: letting more people, in more ways, on more devices, genuinely put this platform to use. A tool's maturity is never the birth of some dazzling feature, but this kind of "coverage" and "usability" being solidly broadened day after day.
k1fnqd7n.zh: 这一天没有一个石破天惊的单点突破,但它很好地诠释了一个产品"由框架走向实用"的过程。编辑器三件套的到齐,意味着 Studio 的可视化编辑第一次从"能演示"跨进了"能真正坐下来干活";2D 瓦片地图的加入,把平台的疆域从 3D 扩展到了 2D,接住了一大批想做经典 2D 游戏的创作者;Windows 兼容的修复,则是在替更多潜在用户提前扫清进门的门槛。把这三件事放在一起看,会发现它们指向同一个方向:让更多的人、用更多的方式、在更多的设备上,都能真正用起这个平台。一个工具的成熟,从来不是某个炫目功能的诞生,而是这种"覆盖面"和"可用度"在一天天里被踏踏实实地拓宽。

k1axrl2n.en: A big editor integration + textured models render live
k1axrl2n.zh: 编辑器大整合 + 模型带材质实时渲染

k31l8oz.en: This day the editor integrated a whole batch of interactions at once — a context menu, referencing a selected object into chat, workspace tabs, professional-grade viewport controls; imported models render live with materials, textures and sky light in both edit and play for the first time, so what-you-see-is-what-you-get no longer comes with a discount; the console for watching the AI work live had its rough edges smoothed one by one, and the animation tools were unified into one interface.
k31l8oz.zh: 这天编辑器一次性整合了右键菜单、把选中对象引用进对话、工作区标签页、专业级视口操作等一大批交互;导入的模型第一次能在编辑和试玩里都带着材质、纹理、天光实时渲染,所见即所得不再打折;实时盯着 AI 干活的控制台被逐个磨平毛刺,动画工具也统一成了同一套界面。

k707ga2.en: Two lines both "converging" in one day
k707ga2.zh: 一天里两条线都在"收口"

kukzmho.en: This day can be summed up in one word: "converging" — gathering the parts scattered about over the preceding days, each individually usable, into a coherent, unified, tactile whole. On the editor side, a batch of scattered interactions were integrated at once, turning it from "the features are assembled" into "it works as one piece"; on the rendering side, imported models can finally appear in a scene in real time with their own true materials and textures, closing the last visual gap of "what-you-see-is-what-you-get"; on the tools side, several animation workbenches were unified into one design language so the whole product looks like one product; and even the back-office console for watching the AI work live had each grating little flaw smoothed away this day. What separates a product's "the parts work" from "the whole is pleasant" is often exactly this kind of day-by-day converging work — it doesn't add to what you can do, but vastly changes how it feels to do it.
kukzmho.zh: 这一天可以用"收口"两个字概括:把前些天散落各处、各自能用的零件,收拢成一个连贯、统一、有质感的整体。编辑器侧,把一批零散的交互一次性整合进来,让它从"功能凑齐了"变成"用起来是一套";渲染侧,让导入的模型终于能带着自己的真实材质和纹理在场景里实时呈现,补上了"所见即所得"最后的视觉差距;工具侧,把几个动画工坊的界面统一成同一套语言,让整个产品看起来像一个产品;就连后台那个实时盯着 AI 干活的控制台,也在这天被逐个磨掉了每一处硌手的小毛病。一个产品从"各部分能用"到"整体好用"之间,往往隔着的就是这样一天天的收口工作——它不增加你能做的事,但极大地改变你做这些事时的感受。

k11pabkb.en: A big editor integration: context menu, reference-to-chat, a pro viewport
k11pabkb.zh: 编辑器一波大整合:右键菜单、引用进对话、专业视口

k1998b25.en: The editor filled in a large batch of natural-feeling interactions at once this day. A unified right-click menu puts common actions within reach anywhere — right-click nearby instead of hunting the interface for a button. "Reference a selected object into chat": select something in the scene and, in one click, carry it as a reference into the conversation with the AI, so when you say "scale this up a bit," the AI knows exactly which "this" you mean without your laboring to describe it. Multiple workspaces switch via tabs, with different layouts for different work that don't disturb each other. The viewport's move/rotate/scale handles and the camera's pan/zoom/orbit adopt the common operating conventions of mainstream professional 3D software — anyone who has used a pro 3D tool picks it up at almost zero cost. An error overlay was added on the canvas: the moment something goes wrong, a prompt pops up right in the view, instead of burying the error in an unseen console and leaving you mystified. This whole wave of integration clearly pushed the editor from "the features work" toward "natural to use and professional to look at."
k1998b25.zh: 编辑器这天一次性补齐了一大批让它"顺手"的交互。统一的右键菜单,让常用操作在任何地方右键就能就近取用,不必满界面找按钮。"把选中对象引用进对话":在场景里选中某个东西,一键就能把它作为引用带进与 AI 的对话里,这样你说"把这个放大一点"时,AI 精确知道"这个"指的是哪一个,而不用你费力描述。多个工作区用标签页切换,做不同的活有不同的布局,互不打扰。视口里移动 / 旋转 / 缩放的操作手柄和相机的推拉旋转,采用了业界主流三维软件那一套通行的操作习惯——任何用过专业三维工具的人几乎零成本就能上手。画布上还加了错误浮层:一旦出问题,直接在画面里弹出提示,而不是把错误闷在看不见的控制台里让你一头雾水。这一整波整合,把编辑器从"功能能用"明确推向了"用着顺手、看着专业"。

k1awieej.en: Models render live with materials, in edit and play alike
k1awieej.zh: 模型在编辑和试玩里都能带材质实时渲染

kbf7r5.en: This day filled in the last visual piece long missing from "what-you-see-is-what-you-get": imported 3D models now render correctly with full materials at runtime. Specifically: textures (the pattern and color laid on the model's surface), mipmaps (so objects no longer show fine shimmering noise in the distance), and double-sided materials (so thin, sheet-like objects display correctly on both faces without breaking). Combined with image-based environment-map sky lighting, models look real and tactile in a scene rather than a lump of gray model with no surface detail. More crucial than any single capability is consistency: this runtime rendering makes edit and play look exactly the same — what you arranged and saw in the editor is what it is when actually played, with no more "looks one way editing, another way running" gap. The sample shooter has moved wholesale onto this runtime rendering path, with its edit and play views matching seamlessly. For creators this means you can finally "polish confidently against what the editor shows," because that is what the final product looks like.
kbf7r5.zh: 这天补上了"所见即所得"长期缺的最后一块视觉拼图:导入的 3D 模型现在能在运行时带着完整材质正确渲染。具体包含几样:纹理(贴在模型表面的那层图案与色彩)、多级纹理细节(让物体在远处不再出现细碎的闪烁噪点)、双面材质(薄片状的物体两面都能正确显示而不穿帮);再配上基于环境贴图的天光照明,模型在场景里看起来真实、有质感,而不再是一团没有表面细节的灰模型。比单点能力更关键的是一致性:这套运行时渲染让编辑态和试玩态看到的完全是同一个样子——你在编辑器里摆好、看到的效果,就是真正玩起来时的效果,中间不再有"编辑时一个样、跑起来另一个样"的落差。示例射击游戏已经整体切到这条运行时渲染链路上,编辑与试玩两边的画面严丝合缝。对创作者而言,这意味着你终于可以"放心地照着编辑器里的样子去打磨",因为它就是最终成品的样子。

kq3lctk.en: Live console polish: watching the AI work, more reassuring
kq3lctk.zh: 实时控制台抛光:盯着 AI 干活更踏实

k1va6kiw.en: This day had a dense burst of polish concentrated on the console for "watching the AI agents work live" — your window into the progress of multiple background AI tasks and stepping in at any time. Previously it was a bit grating in every corner; this day those were smoothed one by one. Close the browser and come back, and the background agents are still alive with state intact; when running a full-screen terminal program inside it, the mouse wheel can finally scroll directly; as multiple task cards switch focus, their brightening and dimming became a smooth transition instead of a jarring jump; the currently-focused card gained a clear highlight border instead of the browser's default ugly white edge; a full-screen card correctly covers above the top bar instead of being blocked; and an annoying loop that kept falsely reporting "history lost" was eliminated. None of these is a "new feature," but together the console went from "barely usable" to "you can watch it all day without irritation." For a platform centered on AI agents, "comfortably observing what the AI is doing" is itself a key capability — only when you can see clearly and watch steadily will you confidently hand the work to it.
k1va6kiw.zh: 这天有一阵密集的抛光集中在那个"实时盯着 AI agent 干活"的控制台界面上——它是你观察后台多个 AI 任务进展、随时介入的窗口。此前它每一处都还有点硌手,这天被一项项磨平。关掉浏览器再回来,后台的 agent 还活着、状态不丢;在里面跑那种占满整屏的终端程序时,鼠标滚轮终于能直接滚动了;多个任务卡片在切换焦点时,变亮变暗改成了平滑过渡而不是生硬地"啪"地一跳;当前聚焦的那张卡片有了清晰的高亮边框,不再是浏览器默认的难看白边;全屏的卡片会正确地盖在顶栏之上而不被挡住;还消除了一个会反复误报"历史记录丢失"的烦人循环。这些改动没有一个是"新功能",但合起来,这个控制台从"勉强能用"变成了"可以盯着看一整天而不心烦"。对一个以 AI agent 为核心的平台来说,"能舒服地观察 AI 在干什么"本身就是一项关键能力——看得清、盯得住,人才放心把活交给它。

k9di2l.en: A unified animation workbench + cutout and annotation tools
k9di2l.zh: 动画工坊统一界面 + 抠图与标注新工具

k1mrm5p0.en: Several animation-related tools each had their own interface before — icons, button priority, sidebar layout and toast styles all inconsistent, so the workbenches together looked like things stitched from different teams. This day standardized them onto one design language in a single pass: a unified icon set, clear button hierarchy (primary and secondary actions distinguishable at a glance), consistent sidebar layout, unified toast style, and unified "complete"-state colors. Beyond visual unity, the 2D skeletal-animation pipeline gained several practical abilities: choosing among multiple candidate results, automatic background removal, and an annotation mode; another workbench for building 2D scenes was also formally opened up. Visual consistency seems like just "looking nice," but it's really about trust — when every corner of a product looks like the same thing, users instinctively believe the same reliable logic sits behind them. For creators who don't write code and only use the interface, this day was the first time Studio "looked like a complete product" rather than a platter of assorted tools.
k1mrm5p0.zh: 动画相关的几个工具此前各自一套界面,图标、按钮主次、侧栏布局、提示风格都不一致,几个工坊放在一起像是几个不同团队拼出来的东西。这天把它们一口气标准化到同一套设计语言上:统一的图标库、清晰的按钮层级(主操作和次操作一眼分得清)、一致的侧栏布局、统一的提示样式、统一的"完成"状态配色。除了视觉统一,2D 骨骼动画的处理管线还新增了几样实用能力:从多个候选结果里挑选、自动抠掉背景、以及一个用来标注的模式;另一个用来搭 2D 场景的工作台也被正式开放出来。视觉一致看似只是"好看",实则关乎信任——当一个产品的各个角落长得像同一个东西时,用户才会本能地相信它们背后是同一套靠谱的逻辑。对不写代码、只用界面的创作者来说,这天是 Studio 第一次"看起来像一个完整的产品",而不是一堆工具的拼盘。

k3bpf6q.en: Engine: the sky no longer renders upside-down + advanced rendering demos
k3bpf6q.zh: 引擎:天空不再倒着画 + 进阶渲染教学示例

kdtci41.en: The engine fixed a textbook small-but-irritating bug this day: the skybox's cube map was previously drawn flipped vertically, leaving the sky upside-down. This day removed that flip, and the cube map finally renders right-side-up — the sky is back to normal. The same wave produced a batch of advanced rendering-technique demos running directly in the engine: cube environment maps, efficient ways to share data in shaders, and the instanced rendering mentioned earlier (using a planet-ring scene to validate efficient drawing of many repeated objects). These demos serve a dual purpose: on one hand they are "living documentation" of the engine's capabilities — anyone wanting to know how a technique is used finds a runnable demo most intuitive; on the other, the very act of building demos continually exposes residual little pitfalls in the rendering pipeline and patches them on the spot — the upside-down-sky bug was found and fixed exactly this way. Teaching yourself while cleaning up is a good habit for keeping an engine continuously healthy.
kdtci41.zh: 引擎这天修了一个很典型的小而扰人的 bug:天空盒的立方体贴图之前在竖直方向上被画反了,导致天空是上下颠倒的。这天把这个翻转去掉,立方体贴图终于正着画了——天空回归正常。同一波还做了一批进阶渲染技法的教学示例并直接跑在引擎里:立方体环境贴图、着色器里高效共享数据的方式、以及前面提到的实例化渲染(用一个行星环的场景来验证大量重复物体的高效绘制)。这些示例有双重作用:一方面它们是引擎能力的"活文档",任何人想知道某项技法怎么用,看这个能跑的示例最直观;另一方面,做示例的过程本身就在不断地把渲染管线里残留的小坑暴露出来、就地补掉——天空倒置这个 bug 正是这样被顺手发现并修掉的。一边教自己、一边修脏,是让一台引擎持续保持健康的好习惯。

klwgsrq.en: This day discovered no new continent out of nowhere, but it brought the promise running through the whole platform — "what-you-see-is-what-you-get" — nearly to completion. The editor's interaction integration makes the creative process natural; textured runtime rendering makes what you see in editing what it is when played; the animation tools' unified interface makes the whole product feel like an organic whole; the console's polish lets you observe the AI work with confidence; and even the engine's teaching demos clean up the foundation while fixing as they go. Strung together, all of the day's effort points at one goal: eliminating "awkwardness in the process." The mark of a tool's true maturity is often not what astonishing new thing it can do, but that doing each old thing no longer makes you furrow your brow. This day, smoothing one tiny furrow after another, took a solid step forward.
klwgsrq.zh: 这一天没有横空出世的新大陆,但它把"所见即所得"这个贯穿整个平台的承诺,几乎补到了完整。编辑器的交互整合,让创作的过程顺手;模型带材质的实时渲染,让编辑里看到的就是玩起来的样子;动画工具的界面统一,让整个产品像一个有机的整体;控制台的抛光,让你能踏实地观察 AI 干活;就连引擎的教学示例,也在顺手修脏中让底层更干净。把它们串起来看,会发现这一天的所有努力都指向同一个目标:消除"过程中的别扭感"。一个工具真正成熟的标志,往往不是它又能做什么惊人的新事,而是它做每一件旧事时,都不再让你皱一下眉。这一天,正是在抹平那一道道细小皱眉上,踏踏实实地往前走了一大步。

kes0wt3.en: A build-gate so the AI can't fake "done"

krld4j1.en: This day installed a build-gate on the AI's game-making: if the build doesn't pass, the AI isn't allowed to declare "done," and the specific errors are fed back for it to fix against. The same day the engine strode forward — multi-material models, clustered many-light rendering, an unlocked object cap, a more intuitive game-entry API; the editor began showing real geometry; and team progress gained visualization charts.
krld4j1.zh: 这天给 AI 造游戏装上了一道"验车线":构建跑不过,AI 就不许宣布"做完了",而且具体的报错会被喂回去让它照着改。同一天引擎大踏步推进——多材质模型、集群多光源、解除对象数量上限、更直觉的游戏入口写法;编辑器开始显示真实几何;团队进度也有了可视化图表。

kyz7c7c.zh: 让"做完"变成一件可验证的事

kkq2bp4.en: Handing game development to an AI raises an unavoidable, fundamental question: how do you know its "done" is really done? People instinctively trust "if it says complete, it's complete," but an AI isn't always reliable — it might declare success right after editing code, only for you to open a black screen. The day's main line solves this trust problem mechanically: no longer letting the AI "be the judge of itself," but gatekeeping with an objective, machine-executed check. Seen alongside the same day's batch of engine enhancements, the two are complementary — the build-gate guarantees "what it delivers actually runs," while the engine enhancements guarantee "what it can deliver is richer, bigger and better-looking." One is the floor of quality, the other the ceiling of capability; pushing both forward is what makes the platform both "dependable" and "capable."
kkq2bp4.zh: 把游戏开发交给 AI,有一个绕不开的根本问题:你怎么知道它说的"做完了"是真的做完了?人会下意识地相信"它说完成了就是完成了",但 AI 并不总是可靠——它可能改完代码就宣布大功告成,而你一打开却是黑屏。这天的主线,就是从机制上解决这个信任问题:不再让 AI"自己说了算",而是用一道客观的、机器执行的检验把关。这与同一天引擎那一大批底层增强放在一起看,恰好构成一组互补——验车线保证"它交付的东西真的能跑",引擎增强则保证"它能交付的东西更丰富、更大、更好看"。一边是质量的底线,一边是能力的上限,两头一起往前推,平台才既"靠得住"又"做得了"。

k16sqlon.en: A game build-gate: no "done" until it actually compiles
k16sqlon.zh: 游戏"验车线":构建跑不过,AI 不许说做完

k1i8qrir.en: The AI building games here used to have a headache-inducing flaw: it would declare "complete" after editing code, only for the browser to open a black screen, or for the code to not compile at all — you thought you got a playable game but actually got a pile of code that won't run. This day installed a build-gate across the whole flow: the backend added a build-preflight step that genuinely compiles the game before the AI declares completion; and a hard rule was baked into the AI's charter — it may only declare done once the build passes. Blocking alone isn't enough; the key is letting the AI fix it itself: the specific build errors are forwarded in real time to where the AI can see them, feeding back the detailed cause instead of a cold "it failed." So a complete self-correcting loop took shape: create game → AI writes code → backend runs build → failure yields specific errors → AI fixes against them → until it truly passes. The far-reaching significance: it turns "done" from an AI's subjective claim into an objectively verifiable fact — when it says "it's ready," you can trust that far more confidently.
k1i8qrir.zh: 此前 AI 在这里"造游戏"常有个让人头疼的毛病:改完代码就宣布"完成",结果浏览器一打开是黑屏,甚至代码根本编译不过——你以为拿到了一个能玩的游戏,实际拿到的是一堆跑不起来的代码。这天给整个流程装上了一条"验车线":后端新增了一个构建预检环节,在 AI 宣布完成之前,先实打实地把游戏编译一遍;同时在 AI 的行为准则里写死了一条铁律——必须构建通过,才被允许宣布做完。光拦住还不够,关键是要让 AI 能自己修好:构建报错的具体内容会被实时转发到 AI 能看到的地方,把详细的错误原因喂回给它,而不是丢一句冷冰冰的"失败了"。于是一个完整的自我纠错闭环成形了:创建游戏 → AI 写代码 → 后端跑构建 → 失败就给出具体错误 → AI 看着错误再改 → 直到真的通过。这件事的深远意义在于:它把"做完"从一句 AI 的主观声明,变成了一个可被客观验证的事实——当它说"做好了",你能更放心地相信那是真的。

kc6oi4l.en: Multi-material models: each part finally gets its own material
kc6oi4l.zh: 多材质模型:复杂模型终于"各部位各材质"

k5426rn.en: The engine added a key capability for handling complex models this day: a model can contain multiple "sub-meshes," each with its own material slot. It sounds abstract but the use case is very concrete — on a character, armor is metal, clothing is cloth, the face is skin, their texture, reflectivity and color entirely different; on a car, the body is painted, the windows glass, the tires rubber. Previously a model could often only wear one material as a whole, flattening these per-part differences so it looked either all-plastic or all-metal, badly distorted. Now the engine can split a model into multiple sub-meshes by part and assign each its own material, so complex models finally render correctly with "each part its own material." Several model-import bridging bugs were fixed alongside, and all the real sample games completed the data-format migration to match. For creators this means the detailed models imported from outside can be presented correctly as they were meant to look, rather than forced into one uniform material.
k5426rn.zh: 引擎这天补上了一项处理复杂模型的关键能力:一个模型可以包含多个"子网格",每个子网格挂自己独立的材质槽。这听起来抽象,但用例非常具体——一个角色身上,盔甲是金属、衣服是布料、脸是皮肤,它们的质感、反光、颜色完全不同;一辆车,车身是喷漆、车窗是玻璃、轮胎是橡胶。此前模型往往只能整体套一种材质,这些不同部位的差异就被抹平,看起来要么全是塑料感、要么全是金属感,失真严重。现在引擎能把一个模型按部位拆成多个子网格,给每个部位分配各自的材质,复杂模型终于能正确地"各部位各材质"地渲染出来。配套还修了模型导入桥接的若干 bug,并让所有真实示例游戏跟着完成了数据格式的迁移。对创作者来说,这意味着从外部导入的那些精细模型,能以它们本来该有的样子被正确呈现,而不是被强行统一成一种材质。

k1jggko6.en: More lights, bigger scenes: raising the ceiling on scale
k1jggko6.zh: 更多灯光、更大场景:把规模的天花板抬高

kuxvp1v.en: The engine also raised the ceiling on "how big a scene can be" from two directions this day. One is lighting: rendering moved to a "clustered lighting" approach — its core idea is to slice screen space into many small cells and, for each cell, compute only the few lights that actually affect it, so one scene can hold far more light sources than before without crushing performance. A nighttime city, a block full of neon and street lamps, needs exactly the simultaneous presence of many lights, and this pipeline opens room for such scenes. The other is capacity: the render buffers holding object data were changed to "grow on demand by doubling" — previously a scene's object count had a hard cap of roughly a thousand, beyond which it broke; now the buffer automatically expands by multiples as objects grow, the cap is lifted, and large scenes can hold much more. Both are under-the-hood work users don't see yet that directly decides "how big your ambition can go" — not a specific gameplay feature, but the precondition that turns "a grander scene" from impossible into possible.
kuxvp1v.zh: 引擎这天还从两个方向抬高了"场景能做多大"的天花板。一是光照:渲染走向了"集群光照"的路线——它的核心思路是把屏幕空间切分成许多小块,每块只计算真正影响到它的那几盏灯,从而让同一个场景里能容纳远比以前更多的光源而不至于拖垮性能。一个夜晚的城市、一个布满霓虹和路灯的街区,需要的正是大量灯光的同时存在,这条管线为这类场景打开了空间。二是容量:底层把存放对象数据的渲染缓冲改成了"按需翻倍扩容"——以前场景里的对象数量有一个大约一千的硬上限,超过就出问题;现在缓冲会随对象增多自动成倍扩张,这个上限被解除,大场景能塞下多得多的东西。这两项都是用户看不见、却直接决定"你的野心能做到多大"的底层功夫——它们本身不是某个具体玩法,而是让"更宏大的场景"这件事从不可能变为可能的前提。

klkv4me.en: A more intuitive way to write a game's entry point
klkv4me.zh: 更直觉的游戏入口写法

k183dcb2.en: The engine also reorganized this day how "creating a game application" is written, splitting it into a more intuitive three layers: one for the camera and basic display settings, one for build/packaging options, one for how resources are wired in. Previously these differently-natured parameters were mixed together and easy to confuse — especially for the AI that relies on it to write code, the messier and less clearly-categorized the parameters, the higher the chance of error. Split by responsibility into three clear layers, what each layer does is obvious at a glance, so the AI writes games more smoothly and less error-prone. This and the day's "build-gate" are really two sides of one coin: the gate guards the exit, blocking faulty output; making the API more intuitive lowers the chance of error at the entrance. A platform that has the AI write code needs both to verify after the fact and to make it harder to err beforehand — together they steadily raise output quality. The default new-game template was upgraded too, shipping out of the box with an HDR sky and a controllable character, so every new game starts from a more presentable baseline.
k183dcb2.zh: 引擎这天还把"创建一个游戏应用"的入口写法重新做了梳理,分成更直觉的三层:一层管摄像机与画面基本设置,一层管打包构建的选项,一层管资源的接入方式。此前这些不同性质的参数是混在一起的,写起来容易混淆——尤其对要靠它来写代码的 AI 而言,参数越杂、越没有清晰的归类,写错的概率就越高。把它按职责分成清楚的三层之后,每一层是干什么的一目了然,AI 写起游戏来更顺手、更不容易出错。这件事和当天的"验车线"其实是一体两面:验车线在出口处把关,堵住错误的产物;而把 API 设计得更直觉,则是在入口处降低出错的概率。一个让 AI 来写代码的平台,既要在事后能检验,也要在事前让它更难写错——两者配合,产出的质量才能稳步提升。新建游戏的默认模板也一并升级,开箱就自带 HDR 天空和一个能操控的角色,让每个新游戏都从一个更体面的起点开始。

ko7877a.en: The editor shows real geometry + steadier replay
ko7877a.zh: 编辑器显示真实几何 + 更稳的回放

k1rmsb67.en: The editor moved a step closer to what-you-see-is-what-you-get this day: it now preloads model files, so the edit view directly shows a model's real geometry rather than a temporary placeholder box. It seems like a detail but the impact is real — when you place, align and adjust an object in the editor, you see what it actually looks like, instead of imagining what a box standing in for it will eventually become. The underlying asset pipeline also moved to the engine's native scene-pack format, and the edit view likewise carries an HDR sky, aligning the editing environment further with the final runtime. On error, the on-canvas overlay expands the more detailed underlying cause rather than a generic message, for quick diagnosis. Chat replay also fixed the interleaving order of cross-agent cards — when you review a stretch of history, the back-and-forth between multiple AIs is woven back together correctly, exactly matching the order you saw live. Together these serve one thing: making what you see in the editor, and in replay, as close to real as possible.
k1rmsb67.zh: 编辑器这天朝"所见即所得"又靠近了一步:现在它会预先加载模型文件,所以编辑视图里直接显示的是模型真实的几何形状,而不再是一个临时的占位方块。这看似细节,但影响很实在——你在编辑器里摆放、对齐、调整一个物体时,看到的就是它真正的样子,而不是凭空想象一个方块代表的东西最终会长成什么。底层资产管线也切到了引擎原生的场景包格式,编辑态同样带上了 HDR 天空,让编辑环境和最终运行环境进一步对齐。出错时,画面上的错误浮层会展开更详细的内层原因,而不只是一句笼统的报错,方便快速定位问题。此外还修了聊天回放里跨 agent 卡片的交错顺序——当你回看一段历史时,多个 AI 之间你来我往的发言能正确地穿插还原,和当时实时看到的顺序完全一致。这些改动共同服务于一件事:让你在编辑器里看到的、回放里看到的,都尽可能地接近真实。

kimuds7.en: This day also added visualization charts for the team's work progress. As more and more work is pushed forward in parallel by AI agents, "where exactly are we now, and how much is left" becomes a question that needs to be seen. The added throughput and burn-down curves chart this information as dual lines accumulating over time, paired with a project-metrics panel, so the team sees the overall pace at a glance: how much was completed in this stretch, how much is still in flight, whether the speed is accelerating or slowing. For a development flow heavily reliant on automation, this "global visibility" matters greatly — though people hand much concrete execution to the AI, they must keep a grip on the overall situation, knowing in what direction and at what speed things are moving. Charting progress is precisely a means to step back from the tangle of execution details while still holding the big picture steady.
kimuds7.zh: 这天还给团队的工作进度加上了可视化图表。当越来越多的工作由 AI agent 并行推进时,"现在到底进行到哪了、还剩多少没做完"就成了一个需要被看见的问题。新增的吞吐量与燃尽曲线把这些信息画成了随时间累积的双线图,再配上一个项目指标面板,团队一眼就能看到整体的推进节奏:这段时间完成了多少、还有多少在路上、速度是在加快还是放缓。对一个高度依赖自动化的开发流程来说,这种"全局可见性"非常重要——人虽然把大量具体执行交给了 AI,但必须始终对整体态势保持掌控,知道事情正朝什么方向、以什么速度推进。把进度画成图,正是让人从繁杂的执行细节里抽身出来、仍能稳稳把握全局的一种手段。

k69vv6o.en: The day's two main lines together answer two facets of the core proposition "how to make an AI reliably build good games." The build-gate answers "reliable": through objective build verification and specific error feedback, it turns "done" from empty words into a fact that can be verified and self-corrected — the cornerstone of trust. The engine's series of enhancements answer "good": multi-material makes models more real, clustered lighting and expanded capacity make scenes grander, a more intuitive entry makes the AI err less — the expansion of capability. What an AI-driven creation platform most fears is "looks impressive but delivers unreliably"; and this day firmed up exactly the two most fundamental things at once — "dependable" and "well-made." When the machine is both more capable and more strictly verified, people can truly, confidently entrust "building a game" to it.
k69vv6o.zh: 这一天的两条主线,合起来回答了"如何让 AI 可靠地造出好游戏"这个核心命题的两个侧面。验车线回答的是"可靠":通过客观的构建检验和具体的错误反馈,把"做完"从一句空话变成一个能被验证、能被自我纠正的事实——这是信任的基石。引擎的一系列增强回答的是"好":多材质让模型更真实、集群光照与扩容让场景更宏大、更直觉的入口让 AI 更少出错——这是能力的拓展。一个由 AI 驱动的创作平台,最怕的就是"看起来很厉害,实际交付靠不住";而这一天恰恰是在同时夯实"靠得住"和"做得好"这两件最根本的事。当机器既能力更强、又被更严格地检验时,人才能真正放心地把"造一个游戏"这件事托付出去。

kkh3007.en: Real sky out of the box + text-to-3D models
kkh3007.zh: 新建游戏即有真天光 + 文字生成 3D 模型

k1ehovqg.en: This day every new game ships with a real sky out of the box — one shared high-dynamic-range sky, baked once at build and shared by all games; the store gained a workbench that turns "a sentence" into a 3D model; the definition of a scene converged to a single source, so edit and play no longer disagree; and the engine added offscreen rendering and nested scenes.
k1ehovqg.zh: 这天每个新建游戏开箱就有真实天光——一张共享的高动态范围天空,打包时一次烤好、所有游戏共用;商店里新增了一款"用一句话生成 3D 模型"的工作台;场景的定义被收敛到唯一一处,编辑与试玩从此不再各说各话;引擎还补上了离屏渲染与场景嵌套。

kw6oypu.en: Pushing both "good-looking" and "usable" forward in one day
kw6oypu.zh: 同一天,把"好看"和"好用"一起往前推

kf6194e.en: The day's several main lines land on different stages of creation, but all point at "making it easier for ordinary people to build a presentable game." The real sky out of the box addresses "is the first impression good" — a new game shouldn't start out drab; text-to-3D model generation addresses "where do assets come from" — people who can't model can get a usable model from a sentence; converging scene definitions to one place addresses the old, confusing problem of "why do edit and play differ"; and the engine's offscreen rendering and nested scenes lay foundations for more advanced visual effects and more complex level composition later. Together they reveal a clear product philosophy: continually lower the bar to "start" while continually raising the ceiling of "what's achievable" — letting beginners get going easily, and giving serious creators enough depth.
kf6194e.zh: 这一天的几条主线,分别落在创作的不同环节上,但都指向"让普通人更容易做出像样的游戏"。开箱即有的真天光,解决的是"第一眼好不好看"——一个新建游戏不该一开始就是灰扑扑的;文字生成 3D 模型,解决的是"素材从哪来"——不会建模的人也能凭一句话拿到能用的模型;场景定义收敛到一处,解决的是"编辑和试玩为什么不一样"这个让人困惑的老问题;引擎的离屏渲染和场景嵌套,则是在为后面更高级的画面效果和更复杂的关卡组合打地基。把这几件事放在一起,会看到一条清晰的产品哲学:既要不断降低"开始"的门槛,也要不断抬高"能做到"的上限——让零基础的人能轻松上手,也让认真创作的人有足够的纵深。

kj4l4to.en: All games share one sky — new ones look right out of the box
kj4l4to.zh: 所有游戏共用一张天空盒,新建即有真天光

k181su0e.en: This day pulled the environment sky into one shared resource, so all games share the same high-quality sky. The prior pain was concrete: a newly created empty game often had only a synthetic gray gradient for sky, sometimes with a missing-asset error — crude and unreal at first glance. The new approach: place this high-dynamic-range (HDR) environment map in one shared spot, have each game merely "fold in a reference" to it, and bake it once at build time into a compact format the runtime can read directly, with no expensive conversion at runtime. The result is twofold: on one hand, any new game ships with real sky atmosphere out of the box — the sky is a real sky, and the ambient light it casts naturally falls on every object in the scene; on the other, the edit view uses the same sky, so the ambient light you see in the editor exactly matches play. Why "share one" rather than each game storing its own copy? Because one resource is maintained in one place, saving duplicate storage and guaranteeing a unified baseline look across all games. It seems like just "a new default background," but it actually lifts every new game's starting point straight from "ugly" to "presentable."
