The most fundamental sense of security for a creator is "what I change is saved and recoverable" — and this day made that security real.
k1x15o5h.zh: 编辑器这天补上了一个让它从"能看能调"真正变成"能用来创作"的关键闭环:打开工程、修改、再把改动可靠地存回磁盘。具体落地了几件事:支持"打开一个工程"的创作流程,把游戏的入口和场景资产正确地装载进来;改成了"手动保存"——去掉了之前那种自动定时保存,改用一个清晰的"未保存"标记,让你明确知道当前改动存没存、由你决定什么时候落盘;打通了从编辑器内的改动到磁盘文件的回写链路,并配了热重载,改完能即时看到效果又能稳妥保存。此外还给编辑器加了"系统面板"(可以开关游戏里各个逻辑系统)和检视器里的"添加组件"菜单。这些拼在一起,意味着编辑器不再只是一个用来微调的辅助视图,而是一个能独立承载"打开 → 编辑 → 保存"完整创作循环的真正工具。对创作者来说,最根本的安全感就是"我改的东西存得住、找得回"——这天把这份安全感坐实了。

k1wkpzpd.en: Observability: a telemetry/log panel + a chat anti-freeze
k1wkpzpd.zh: 可观测性:遥测与日志面板 + 聊天防卡死

kah2upg.en: This day added "observability" to the whole system — letting you see what's actually happening inside it. A telemetry panel was added, gathering "traces + logs" into one observable feed: what an agent is doing at the moment, how long each step took, and what went wrong are all visible in it. The backend got a matching telemetry sink and reporting route, and the front end gained a monitoring scaffold. Why build this deliberately? Because as more work is pushed autonomously by AI, "what is it actually doing, where is it slow, where did it err" becomes a question that must be visible — invisible, it can be neither trusted nor optimized. Meanwhile, the chat fixed a real freeze risk: when the AI outputs very long, formatted Markdown, the front end keeps re-parsing and rendering, frequently enough to blow up memory and freeze the whole interface; this day throttled it so long answers stay stable as they stream. A transparent system that withstands long, intense use is what lets people confidently hand it big tasks to run.
kah2upg.zh: 这天给整个系统增添了"可观测性"——让你能看清它内部到底在发生什么。新增了一个遥测面板,把"追踪 + 日志"两类信息汇成一条可观测的信息流:某个 agent 此刻在干什么、每一步花了多长时间、中间出了什么状况,都能在这个面板里看到。后端配了对应的遥测汇集与上报通路,前端也加了一层监控脚手架。为什么要专门做这个?因为当越来越多的工作由 AI 自主推进时,"它到底在干什么、慢在哪、错在哪"就成了一个必须能被看见的问题——看不见,就既无法信任,也无法优化。与此同时,聊天这边修了一个真实的卡死风险:当 AI 输出超长的、带格式的 Markdown 内容时,前端会不停地重新解析渲染,频繁到一定程度就会把内存吃爆、整个界面卡死;这天给它加了节流,让长回答能边输出边稳定显示。一个透明、且扛得住长时间高强度使用的系统,才能让人放心地把大任务交给它跑。

k1bitegp.en: Engine: unified handles + instanced drawing + a unified plugin protocol
k1bitegp.zh: 引擎:统一句柄 + 实例化绘制 + 插件协议归一

ke2la6m.en: The engine did several far-reaching low-level things this day. One: unifying "handles." A handle is a program's reference to an entity or asset (a grip pointing at something), and this day unified entity and asset handles into one encoding carrying "generational" info — a generation being a version stamp on each handle, so when the thing it points to has been destroyed and its slot reused by something new, the system immediately recognizes "this is a stale old reference" rather than mistaking it as valid. This eliminates at the source the extremely subtle, hard-to-diagnose class of bugs where you "reference something that's already gone." Two: instanced-drawing optimization — when a scene has many identical objects (a forest, a crowd of soldiers), drawing commands used to be issued one by one, and this day merged the identical ones into a bucket drawn in one call, sharply cutting draw calls — a qualitative change for large-scene performance, verified with a stress test of tens of thousands of independent objects. Three: unifying the plugin protocol into one form for more consistent extension, plus a headless clean backend for testing. These are under-the-hood work users don't see yet that decides how big the platform can run, how far it extends, and how few errors it makes.
ke2la6m.zh: 引擎这天在底层做了几件影响深远的事。其一是把"句柄"统一:句柄是程序里对实体和资产的引用(相当于一个指向某个东西的把手),这天把实体和资产的句柄统一成同一套带"代际"信息的编码——所谓代际,就是给每个句柄盖一个版本戳,这样当它指向的东西已经被销毁、那个位置又被新东西占用时,系统能立刻识别出"这是个过期的旧引用",而不是误以为还有效。这从源头上消除了"引用到一个已经没了的东西"这类极其隐蔽、极难排查的 bug。其二是实例化绘制优化:当场景里有大量长得一模一样的物体(一片树、一群兵)时,以前是逐个发出绘制指令,这天改成把同类的合并成一桶、一次画出来,绘制调用大幅减少——这对大规模场景的性能是质变,并用上万个独立物体的压力测试验证了效果。其三是把插件协议统一成一种写法,让扩展更一致;还提供了一个无界面的纯净后端用于测试。这些都是用户看不见、却决定平台"能跑多大、扩多远、错多少"的底层功夫。

kerzhya.en: What's most memorable about this day is that it attended to both ends of a user journey at once. For the newcomer clicking in for the first time because of the open-sourcing, it shaved the "entry" threshold to the lowest — a two-step guide, skippable, with a default recommendation, doing its best to let everyone willing to try start smoothly. For creators already seriously working on projects, it equipped the "work" tools more fully — a professional asset browser, an editing loop that reliably saves, a telemetry panel that sees inside. And the engine-level handle unification, instanced drawing and unified plugin protocol provide, deeper down, the support for all of this to be "large-scale, extensible, reliable." For a product to truly hold, catching newcomers isn't enough — those who stay must find it smoother the more they use it; satisfying veterans isn't enough — newcomers must be able to get in. This day rarely did both together — opening the door and equipping the house alike.
kerzhya.zh: 这一天最值得记住的,是它同时照顾到了一个用户旅程的两端。对刚刚因为开源而第一次点进来的新人,它把"进门"的门槛削到了最低——两步引导、可跳过、有默认推荐,尽量让每个愿意尝试的人都能顺利开始。对那些已经在认真做项目的创作者,它把"干活"的工具备得更齐——专业的资产浏览器、能可靠存盘的编辑闭环、看得清内部的遥测面板。而引擎层面的句柄统一、实例化绘制、插件协议归一,则在更深处为这一切的"大规模、可扩展、可靠"提供着支撑。一个产品要想真正立住,光接住新人不够,还得让留下来的人越用越顺;光让老手满意也不够,还得让新人进得来。这一天,正是难得地把这两件事放在一起做——既敞开了门,也备好了屋。

kpjb9af.en: Open a project and it just renders + agents get long-term memory
kpjb9af.zh: 打开一个工程就渲染它 + agent 长期记忆

k1yxtke5.en: This day shipped v0.2.0 and firmed up several trust-shaping things: whatever project you open is rendered faithfully, with no hidden "preferred mode"; each agent got a consistent identity and long-term memory that remembers you across sessions; dragging materials into chat from anywhere is supported; desktop development extended to Windows; and the engine added 2D GPU instancing and spot-light shadows while repairing a once-fully-dead bloom.
k1yxtke5.zh: 这天发布了 v0.2.0,并把几处影响"信任感"的事一并做实:打开哪个工程就老老实实渲染哪个、不再有隐藏的"优先模式";每个 agent 有了统一的身份和能跨会话记住你的长期记忆;支持从任意位置把素材拖进对话;桌面开发支持到了 Windows;引擎还补上 2D 的 GPU 实例化与聚光灯阴影,并修好了一度全失效的辉光。

k11vi1hj.en: The second public release, polished around "trust"
k11vi1hj.zh: 第二个公开版本,围着"可信"打磨

kc0elln.en: This day shipped v0.2.0 — the second public release after open-sourcing, with the homepage's "what's new" highlights updated. A version number means more than incrementing a digit; it packages the improvements accumulated over a stretch into a node that can be referenced, downloaded and trusted. And nearly everything done around this release this day points at one keyword: trust. Opening a project and rendering it faithfully makes results trustworthy; agents having stable identities and remembering you makes collaborators trustworthy; materials draggable straight to the AI without repeated description makes interaction trustworthy; Windows development working and bloom no longer dead makes the platform trustworthy in more environments. What a product just stepping into public view and being seriously tried by more and more people most needs to build is exactly this trust — "it does what it says, it remembers, it's dependable everywhere." This day firmed up that trust spot by spot.
kc0elln.zh: 这天发布了 v0.2.0——开源之后的第二个公开版本,首页也更新了"新功能"亮点。一个版本号的意义,不只是数字加一,而是把一段时间里攒下的改进打包成一个可以被引用、被下载、被信任的节点。而这天围绕这个版本所做的事,几乎都指向同一个关键词:可信。打开一个工程就如实渲染它,是让结果可信;agent 有稳定的身份、能记住你,是让协作者可信;素材能直接拖给 AI、不必反复描述,是让交互可信;Windows 也能开发、辉光不再失效,是让平台在更多环境下都可信。一个刚走向公众、正被越来越多人认真试用的产品,最该建立的就是这种"它说到做到、它记得住、它在哪都靠谱"的信任。这一天,正是把信任一处处坐实。

k6755kc.en: Open a project, and it just renders that project
k6755kc.zh: 打开一个工程,就渲染那个工程

kx6nefb.en: This day fixed a conceptual awkwardness, and what it really fixed was a kind of "unpredictability." Play used to first decide how to render by a guess that "prefer treating it as a certain special form" — a heuristic that, in some cases, made opening the same project give you not itself but something it "guessed" it into. The problem wasn't whether the guess was right but that it made results unpredictable: clicking something, you couldn't be fully sure what you'd see. This day changed it to the most direct, plainest behavior — whatever project you open is rendered faithfully as that project, with no hidden "preferred mode" interposed. Correspondingly, the editor can open a specific on-disk game to run with a single command, with that game's path supplied by the outer host instead of hardcoded into the editor's libraries (making the editor cleaner and more reusable as a pure tool). "What you open is what you get" sounds obvious, but a tool genuinely achieving "you open something and you definitely get it, no surprises" is exactly the cornerstone of predictability — and predictability is the precondition of trust.
kx6nefb.zh: 这天修正了一处概念上的别扭,而它修的其实是一种"不可预测"。此前在试玩时,系统会先按一套"优先把它当成某种特殊形态"的猜测去决定怎么渲染——这套启发式在某些情况下会让你打开同一个工程,得到的却不是它本身,而是被它"猜"成了别的样子。问题不在于这套猜测对不对,而在于它让结果变得不可预测:你点开一个东西,不能百分百确定会看到什么。这天把它改成了最直接、最朴素的行为——打开哪个工程,就老老实实渲染哪个工程,不再有任何隐藏的"优先模式"插在中间。配套地,编辑器还能用一条命令直接打开磁盘上的某个具体游戏来跑,而且这个游戏的路径由外层的宿主统一提供,不再被硬编码烤死在编辑器的库里(这让编辑器作为一个纯粹的工具更干净、更可复用)。"所见即所选"听起来理所当然,但一个工具真正做到"你打开什么就一定得到什么、毫无意外",恰恰是可预测性的基石——而可预测,正是信任的前提。

kw5z18n.en: Consistent agent identities + long-term memory that remembers you
kw5z18n.zh: agent 统一身份 + 能记住你的长期记忆

k1gd9ma3.en: The collaboration team became more "human" and more "lasting" this day. On one hand, all agents adopted a consistent identity presentation — named as "a Chinese role plus an English name," with their personas filled in, so what you face is no longer a string of function modules but a team of companions each with a name, a personality and a role. On the other, and more crucially: they gained long-term memory. Each agent in the workbench got a structured "long-term memory" tab and a browsable diary; the system automatically distills what's worth remembering at the end of each turn; and it maintains a "global user profile" that gradually learns your preferences, habits and what you're working on as you spend time together. Why does memory matter so much? Because an assistant without memory starts from a blank page each time — you must repeatedly explain the same background and preferences, and collaboration forever stays at "first meeting." With long-term memory, these agents remember you and past decisions and lessons, so collaboration grows more effortless and more attuned the longer it lasts. For a platform centered on "long-term collaboration with a team of AIs to make games," letting the AI "remember" is the key leap from "tool" toward "companion."
k1gd9ma3.zh: 协作团队这天变得更"像人"、也更"长情"了。一方面,所有 agent 统一了身份呈现——用"中文职能 + 英文名"的方式命名,并把各自的人设补全,于是你面对的不再是一串功能模块,而是一群各有名字、各有性格、各司其职的伙伴。另一方面,也是更关键的一步:它们有了长期记忆。工作台里每个 agent 都有了一个结构化的"长期记忆"标签页和一本可翻阅的日记;系统会在每一轮对话结束时,自动把其中值得长期记住的内容沉淀下来;还会维护一份"全局用户档案",随着你和它的相处而逐渐了解你的偏好、习惯、在做什么。为什么记忆这么重要?因为没有记忆的助手,每次都从一张白纸开始——你得反复交代同样的背景、同样的偏好,合作永远停留在"初次见面"。有了长期记忆,这些 agent 会记得你、记得过往的决定和教训,于是合作越久越省心、越懂你。对一个主打"和一群 AI 长期协作做游戏"的平台来说,让 AI"记得住",是从"工具"走向"伙伴"的关键一跃。

k1fodq15.en: Drag into chat from anywhere + asset-pipeline improvements
k1fodq15.zh: 从任意位置拖进对话 + 资产管线改进

k1bvvi32.en: Interaction got smoother again this day: you can now drag things straight into chat across surfaces. You can pull a batch of items from the asset browser or various panels into the chat box, where they line up as a queue of "reference pills" handed to the AI together. This removes a very common clumsiness — previously, to have the AI "use these models, this texture, that object in the scene," you had to describe each in words, laborious and error-prone; now you select and drag, and the AI knows exactly which you mean. The asset pipeline kept improving alongside: delete support, drag-to-chat, and regenerated internal identifiers for a batch of assets to resolve collisions when importing materials — collisions that had previously kept some resources from loading inexplicably. Upgrading "showing the AI" from "describing in words" to "dragging by hand" seems a small interaction but greatly lowers the friction of passing concrete materials between human and AI. Less friction, smoother collaboration.
k1bvvi32.zh: 交互这天又顺手了一截:现在可以跨界面把东西直接拖进对话。你能从资产浏览器、从各个面板里,把一批内容拖进聊天框,它们会排成一队"引用胶囊"一起递给 AI。这件事消除的是一种很常见的笨拙——以前想让 AI"用这几个模型、这张贴图、这个场景里的那个对象",你得用语言一个个把它们描述清楚,既费劲又容易说不准;现在直接选好、拖过去,AI 立刻精确知道你指的是哪些。配套资产管线也继续打磨:支持删除、支持拖到对话,并重新生成了一批资产的内部标识,以解决导入素材时标识相互撞车的问题——这种撞车此前会导致某些资源莫名加载不出来。把"指给 AI 看"从"用嘴描述"升级成"用手拖过去",看似只是一个小交互,实则大幅降低了人和 AI 之间传递具体素材时的摩擦。摩擦越小,协作越流畅。

k1e2yl5h.zh: Windows 桌面开发支持 + 引擎修复

khl07mk.en: Desktop development extended to Windows this day: you can do desktop development on Windows (via Git Bash), with a Windows-specific linking issue fixed, so Windows users can develop and debug the desktop app locally, not just the web version. This continues the recent sustained investment in Windows compatibility — carrying the Windows users who hold most of the desktop market from "web version only" further to "desktop development too." The engine fixed two real problems: bloom (the effect that bleeds a soft glow from bright areas) had been fully dead due to three stacked bugs and is now properly repaired, bringing back the atmosphere; and the large vertex indices common in big models (a format that can address more vertices), previously rejected outright at parse, are now preserved correctly, so complex large meshes import without erroring. The startup path also gained an opt-in: when stale engine build output is detected, you can have it auto-rebuild (the default is still to prompt you to handle it, to avoid triggering a rebuild unexpectedly). These all help the platform run steadily across more environments, more materials and more complex scenes.
khl07mk.zh: 桌面端的开发这天支持到了 Windows:可以在 Windows 下(通过 Git Bash)进行桌面开发,并修了 Windows 平台特有的链接问题,于是 Windows 用户也能在本地开发、调试桌面应用,而不只是网页端。这延续了近来持续往 Windows 兼容上投入的方向——把占据大半桌面市场的 Windows 用户,从"只能用网页版"进一步带到"也能做桌面开发"。引擎侧修了两处实打实的问题:其一,辉光(让画面亮部泛出柔和光晕的效果)此前因为三个叠加的 bug 已经完全失效,这次被彻底修复,画面的氛围感回来了;其二,很多大型模型常用的大顶点索引(一种能寻址更多顶点的格式)以前会在解析时被直接拒掉,导致复杂大网格导不进来,现在能正确保留,大模型导入不再报错。启动链路还加了一个可选项:当检测到引擎的构建产物已经过期时,可以选择让它自动重建(默认仍是提示你手动处理,以免意外触发重建)。这些都是在让平台在更多环境、更多素材、更复杂场景下都能稳稳跑起来。

k1sf5ozu.zh: 引擎:2D 的 GPU 实例化 + 聚光灯阴影

k1oaq7l8.en: The engine advanced a step each on 2D performance and lighting this day. On performance, "chunk-level GPU instancing" landed for sprites and tilemaps: 2D games often have massive repeated elements — screens of tiles, sheets of bullets, many identical small tiles — drawn one by one before, slowing down as the count grows; now identical elements in the same chunk can be merged into a bucket and drawn by the GPU in one pass, sharply cutting draw calls and qualitatively changing large-scale 2D performance. On lighting, spot-light shadows were added: a spot light is a directional, cone-shaped source like a flashlight or a stage spotlight, and it can now cast shadows correctly, giving underlying support for effects like "a beam sweeping through the dark with shadows dragging along." The sprite rendering pipeline was also unified — folding a special path previously written just for sprites into the generic rendering path, one fewer fork to maintain separately. Some of these make 2D run faster, some make light and shadow richer, some make the engine simpler, together tamping the 2D line another layer firmer.
k1oaq7l8.zh: 引擎这天在 2D 性能和光照上各推进了一步。性能上,落地了针对精灵和瓦片地图的"区块级 GPU 实例化":2D 游戏里常常有海量重复元素——满屏的瓦片、成片的弹幕、大量同样的小图块,以前是逐个发出绘制指令,数量一大就拖慢;现在能把同一区块里的同类元素合并成一桶、交给显卡一次性画出来,绘制调用大幅减少,大规模 2D 场景的性能因此质变。光照上,新增了聚光灯阴影:聚光灯是那种像手电筒、舞台追光一样有方向、有锥形照射范围的光源,现在它也能正确地投出阴影,做"黑暗中一束光扫过、影子随之拉动"这类效果有了底层支持。此外还把精灵的渲染管线做了归一——把原本为精灵单独写的一套特殊路径,合并进通用的渲染路径里,少了一套需要单独维护的分叉。这些改动有的让 2D 跑得更快、有的让光影更丰富、有的让引擎更简洁,共同把 2D 这条线又夯实了一层。

k5088no.en: The version number v0.2.0 marks the fruit of the first stretch of consolidation after open-sourcing. And the day's most moving line is really the agents' long-term memory — it gives "collaborating with AI" a dimension of time for the first time. A companion who remembers you and a tool that treats you as a stranger each time are two entirely different relationships; the former understands you more the more you use it, the latter stays in place forever. Paired with the predictability of "open something and it renders," the low friction of "just drag it over," the broad coverage of "Windows can develop too," and the engine's spot-by-spot fixes and speedups, this day pushed the whole platform another big step toward "worth trusting and living with long-term." A tool that genuinely wants to accompany users for a long time must both do what it says and be dependable everywhere, and also remember and understand you — and this day pushed on both at once.
k5088no.zh: v0.2.0 这个版本号,标记的是开源之后第一段沉淀的成果。而这一天最动人的一条线,其实是 agent 的长期记忆——它让"和 AI 协作"这件事第一次有了时间的维度。一个会记得你的伙伴,和一个每次都把你当陌生人的工具,是两种完全不同的关系;前者会越用越懂你,后者永远停在原地。配上"打开什么就渲染什么"的可预测、"拖过去就行"的低摩擦、"Windows 也能开发"的广覆盖、以及引擎一处处的修复与提速,这一天把整个平台往"值得长期信赖、值得长期相处"的方向又推了一大步。一个真正想陪用户走很久的工具,既要做到说到做到、处处可靠,也要做到记得住、懂你心——这一天,正是在这两件事上同时用力。

kz35103.en: Full-chain observability: see where it's slow at a glance
kz35103.zh: 全链路可观测:慢在哪一眼看见

ko0xnqq.en: This day connected "traces + logs" into one complete chain spanning the front end, backend and agents: an action sent from the UI, through the backend, into an agent's execution and back to the picture is traceable end to end, with a stall watchdog, so where it's slow or stuck is visible at a glance. The render-debugging tooling also learned to record initial state, letting the nastiest problems like "black screen" reproduce stably on replay.
ko0xnqq.zh: 这天把"追踪 + 日志"打通成一条贯穿前端、后端、agent 的完整链路:一次操作从界面发出、经后端、到 agent 执行、再回到画面,全程可追,配卡顿看门狗,慢在哪、卡在哪一眼可见。渲染调试工具也学会了录下初始状态,让"黑屏"这类最难缠的问题能在回放里稳定重现。

k18txqaz.en: A system you can't see, you can't control

kmidehc.en: As a system grows more complex and hands more and more steps to AI to run autonomously, a fundamental question surfaces: what's actually happening inside it? An action was sent, nothing responds for a while — is it stuck on the front end, the backend, or is some agent heads-down at work? From surface symptoms alone, you can only guess. What this day did is turn the whole system from a "black box" into a "transparent box": making an action's full journey — from your click in the UI, through backend processing, through an agent executing turn by turn, back to the result on screen — traceable and visible all the way. It adds no new gameplay, yet is the precondition for steering a complex system long-term: only what you can see can you control, and only what you can control can you confidently hand more to. Observability is the starting point of all optimization and debugging — you cannot improve what you cannot clearly see.
kmidehc.zh: 当一个系统越来越复杂、越来越多的环节交给 AI 自主推进,一个根本问题就浮上来了:它内部到底在发生什么?一次操作明明发出去了,半天没反应,到底卡在前端、卡在后端、还是某个 agent 正在埋头干活?光凭表面现象,你只能猜。这一天做的,就是把整个系统从"黑箱"变成"透明箱":让一次操作的完整旅程——从你在界面上点下去、到后端处理、到 agent 一回合一回合地执行、再到结果回到画面——全程都能被追踪、被看见。这看似不增加任何新玩法,却是一个复杂系统能被长期驾驭的前提:看得见,才管得住;管得住,才敢继续放手交给它更多。可观测性是所有优化与排错的起点——你无法改善一个你看不清的东西。

kt9xlfp.en: One trace threading front end, backend and agents
kt9xlfp.zh: 一条贯穿前后端与 agent 的追踪

kmqpg8t.en: The day's core work was connecting "tracing" into a chain that truly threads the full stack. Tracing means stamping an action with a single identifier so that, whatever layer of the system it flows through, it carries that identifier and leaves timestamps, so the fragments scattered everywhere can afterward be strung into one complete timeline by that identifier. What was achieved this day is passing that identifier from the front end all the way to the backend and into an agent's execution — any action can be reconstructed into the full trajectory of "how long it spent on the front end first, then the backend, then which agent took over and how long that took." The technical key is correctly propagating this trace context down across every layer boundary instead of dropping it at the boundary (which would leave only isolated fragments that can't be assembled into a whole). Once this full-chain trace exists, the vaguest, hardest-to-investigate complaints — "the system is slow" or "the system is stuck" — gain a ruler that pinpoints precisely.
kmqpg8t.zh: 这天最核心的工作,是把"追踪"打通成一条真正贯穿全栈的链路。所谓追踪,就是给一次操作打上一个统一的标识,让它无论流经系统的哪一层,都带着这个标识、留下时间戳,于是事后可以把散落在各处的片段,按这个标识串成一条完整的时间线。这天做到的,是让这条标识从前端一路传递到后端、再传递到 agent 的执行里——任意一次操作,都能被还原成"它先在前端花了多久、再在后端花了多久、然后哪个 agent 接手、又花了多久"的完整轨迹。技术上的关键,是让这个追踪上下文在跨越每一层边界时都被正确地往下传,而不是在边界处断掉(那样就只能看到孤立的片段、拼不成全局)。这条贯穿全链的追踪一旦建立,"系统慢"或"系统卡"这类最含糊、最难查的抱怨,就有了一把能精确定位的尺子。

k8k7fcg.en: A browser tracer + a stall watchdog
k8k7fcg.zh: 前端追踪器 + 卡顿看门狗

kdwlgri.en: Within this full-chain trace, the front-end segment got a dedicated browser-side tracer following the leg "from your action in the UI to its final render." It addresses a very concrete confusion: sometimes you click or type and the interface is slow to respond — is the request not sent yet, is it waiting on the backend, or is the front end itself stuck rendering somewhere? The browser tracer breaks this leg into visible steps so you can see exactly which step it's stuck on. A "stall watchdog" came with it: it watches the rhythm of key flows and, the moment a step stalls beyond its expected time, flags the stall immediately, instead of leaving you staring at a frozen interface unsure whether it's dead or busy. For a tool centered on interface interaction, "what is the front end busy with, is it stuck" is users' most direct and frequent question; bringing this leg into observability extends tracing's reach to the spot closest to the user.
kdwlgri.zh: 在这条全链追踪里,前端这一段单独加了一个浏览器侧的追踪器,专门跟住"从你在界面上发出一个动作,到它最终渲染出来"这一程。它解决的是一类很具体的困惑:有时你点了一下、敲了一段,界面却迟迟没反应——到底是请求还没发出去、是在等后端、还是前端自己在某处卡住了渲染?前端追踪器把这一程拆成可见的步骤,让你能看清究竟卡在哪一步。配套还加了一个"卡顿看门狗":它会盯着关键流程的节奏,一旦某一步迟迟不动、超出了预期时间,就立刻把这个卡顿标记出来,而不是让你对着一个一动不动的界面干等、不知道它是死了还是在忙。对一个以界面交互为核心的工具来说,"前端到底在忙什么、有没有卡住"是用户最直接、最高频的疑问;把这一程也纳入可观测,等于把追踪的触角伸到了离用户最近的地方。

keyyxgl.en: Backend collection and reporting + each agent turn in the trace
keyyxgl.zh: 后端汇集与上报 + agent 每回合纳入追踪

k11x0pz9.en: The chain's other two segments were filled in alongside. The backend stood up a telemetry sink: traces and logs produced everywhere are collected here and reported out, and the trace context brought down from the front end is passed further on, ensuring an action's backend portion still hangs on the same trace line without a gap. The agent segment wove each turn of execution into the same trace — when an agent takes a task and runs a turn, how long that turn took and what it did is recorded as one node on this trace. Together these make "full-chain" live up to its name: from a front-end click, through backend processing, to an agent's turn-by-turn work, all strung on one line. For a platform whose core experience is "directing a team of AI agents to work," "what is each agent busy with this turn, where is it slow" is exactly what should be visible; bringing agent execution into the trace means the AI's work process is no longer an un-peerable black box.
k11x0pz9.zh: 链路的另外两段也同步补齐。后端这边立起了一个遥测汇集入口:各处产生的追踪与日志被统一收到这里、再上报出去,并且会把前端带下来的追踪上下文继续往后传递,确保同一次操作在后端的部分,仍然挂在同一条追踪线上、不会断档。agent 这一段,则把每一回合的执行也纳入了同一条追踪——一个 agent 接手一个任务、跑了一回合,这一回合花了多久、做了什么,都会作为这条追踪上的一节被记录下来。这两段合起来,才让"全链路"名副其实:从前端的一次点击,到后端的处理,再到 agent 一回合一回合的工作,全部串在同一条线上。对一个核心体验就是"指挥一群 AI agent 干活"的平台来说,"每个 agent 这一回合到底在忙什么、慢在哪"是最该被看见的;把 agent 的执行也接进追踪,等于让 AI 的工作过程不再是一个不可窥视的黑箱。

k1f0wp5n.en: Graphics debugging: recording initial state to reproduce black-screen bugs
k1f0wp5n.zh: 渲染调试:录下初始状态,重现"黑屏"类问题

kx05qd1.en: In the same spirit as observability, the render-debugging tooling got stronger this day. It could already "capture a frame and replay it for comparison," but a key piece was missing: initial state. A picture is drawn step by step from some starting point, and if capture only recorded the drawing actions but not the initial contents of resources at the start, replay amounts to "replaying from a wrong starting point," and some problems simply won't reproduce. This day filled that in: frame capture now also records the initial state of relevant resources, seeded into the replay to precisely rebuild the whole frame from an identical start. It's especially useful for the nastiest problems like "the screen is black, objects vanished" — often caused by some initial state being set wrong, previously very hard to locate because the replay couldn't reproduce it; now the black screen reproduces faithfully on replay, turning an "occasional, uncatchable" ghost bug into a concrete object that "reproduces stably and can be studied and fixed repeatedly." It's two sides of the same coin as the day's full-chain tracing: one lets you see "where the system is slow," the other "where the picture is wrong."
kx05qd1.zh: 和"可观测"同一种精神,渲染调试工具这天也更强了一档。此前它已经能"录制一帧画面、再回放对比",但缺了一块关键拼图:初始状态。画面是从某个起点一步步画出来的,如果录制时只录了那些绘制动作、却没录下起点时各项资源的初始内容,回放就等于"从一个错误的起点重演",有些问题根本复现不出来。这天补上了这块:录帧时会把相关资源的初始状态也一并记下来,回放时把它作为"种子"注入,从完全一致的起点精确重建整帧。它对排查"画面一片黑、物体凭空消失"这类最难缠的问题尤其管用——这类问题往往就出在某个初始状态没设对,过去因为回放复现不出来而极难定位;现在黑屏能在回放里如实重现,等于把一个"偶发、抓不住"的幽灵 bug,变成了一个"稳定重现、可以反复研究并修复"的具体对象。它和当天的全链路追踪是同一回事的两面:一个让你看清"系统慢在哪",一个让你看清"画面错在哪"。

kdustfx.en: What this day added is a sense organ indispensable to a maturing system. Over many preceding days the platform kept growing new capabilities — moving characters, editable scenes, generatable assets, open-sourced to all; but the more capable and autonomous it gets, the more important it is to "see clearly what's happening inside." A system that can't see its own interior can only guess when something goes wrong, doesn't know where slowness comes from, and eventually loses control for being undiagnosable. This day connected tracing into one line spanning front end, backend and agents, and let render debugging record initial state to reproduce picture problems stably — effectively giving the platform two pairs of eyes at once: one for performance and flow, one for picture and rendering. Making both "what the system is doing" and "why the picture looks like this" visible means that whatever comes next — optimizing speed, diagnosing faults, or confidently handing more autonomy to the AI — rests on reliable evidence. Capability decides "what a platform can do," and observability decides "how far it can be trusted" — and this day filled in the latter.
kdustfx.zh: 这一天补上的,是一个走向成熟的系统必不可少的"感官"。前面的许多天,平台一直在长出新的能力——会动的角色、能编辑的场景、能生成的资产、能开源给所有人;但能力越多、越自动,"看清它内部在干什么"就越重要。一个看不见自己内部的系统,出了问题只能靠猜,慢了也不知道慢在哪,最终会因为无法诊断而失控。这天把追踪打通成贯穿前端、后端、agent 的一条线,又让渲染调试能录下初始状态、稳定重现画面问题——等于一次性给了平台两双眼睛:一双看性能与流程,一双看画面与渲染。把"系统在干什么"和"画面为什么是这样"都变得可见,意味着接下来无论是优化速度、排查故障,还是放心地把更多自主权交给 AI,都有了可靠的依据。能力让一个平台"能做什么",而可观测性决定它"能被信赖到什么程度"——这一天,补的正是后者。

k1pit7qp.en: A UE5-grade plan for the content browser & drag-to-scene, plus an editor QA gate
k1pit7qp.zh: 把内容浏览器和拖拽到场景对标 UE5 + 编辑器自带质检门

k1m1qwij.en: A foundations day — no flashy new gameplay, but two things that make everything after it steadier: first, writing down a UE5-grade design for how assets get browsed and dragged into a scene; second, putting the standalone editor under its own automated quality gate, so it can grow new features without quietly breaking the old ones.
k1m1qwij.zh: 这是一个"打地基"的日子,没有炫目的新玩法,做的是两件让后面走得更稳的事:一是把"资产怎么浏览、怎么拖进场景"按成熟引擎(UE5)的标准写成白纸黑字的设计,二是给独立编辑器装上一道属于它自己的自动质检门,让它往后长新功能时不会悄悄把旧的弄坏。

k1u3ipl2.zh: 为什么"先写设计、再动手"

k98n4g2.en: The more polished something needs to be — and the more it aims to match a mature tool's feature — the more it's worth thinking through and writing down before building. A content browser and "drag a model into the scene" sound simple, but what really decides whether they feel good is a thousand details: how assets are categorized, how thumbnails are generated, where a dropped item lands, how its orientation and scale are decided, how it snaps to existing objects. Improvised on the fly, these tend to end up inconsistent and entangled to change. This day first organized the interaction into a design doc benchmarked against UE5: using the industry's proven, comfortable patterns as the reference, pinning down "what it should be" before letting the AI implement it. For a project driven largely by AI, a clear design doc matters all the more — it is both the construction drawing for the AI and the yardstick for judging afterward whether it was done right.
k98n4g2.zh: 越是要做得像样、越是要对标成熟工具的功能,越值得先把它想清楚、写下来,再开工。内容浏览器和"把模型拖进场景"听起来简单,但真正决定好不好用的,是无数细节:资产怎么分类、缩略图怎么生成、拖进去的瞬间放在哪、朝向和缩放怎么定、和已有物体怎么对齐。这些如果边做边拍脑袋,最后往往各处不一致、改起来牵一发动全身。这一天先把这套交互按"对标 UE5"的标准整理成设计文档:以业界公认顺手的范式为参照,先定清楚"它应该是什么样",再让 AI 照着实现。对一个主要由 AI 自主推进的项目来说,一份清晰的设计文档尤其关键——它既是给 AI 的施工图,也是事后判断"做对没做对"的标尺。

k1171ynm.en: A content browser & drag-to-scene, benchmarked against UE5
k1171ynm.zh: 对标 UE5 的内容浏览器与"拖进场景"

keb6nrz.en: The design targets the two most frequent acts in creation: finding an asset and placing it into the world. The "content browser" is benchmarked against the categorized, thumbnailed, searchable asset library of a mature engine — you should be able to browse every model, texture, scene and character in your project like flipping through a material cabinet, instead of hunting blindly in folders. "Drag-to-scene" then demands that path feel smooth and natural: grab a model from the browser, drop it into the 3D view, and it lands in the scene at a sensible position, orientation and size with its materials and references correctly wired — not a misplaced or untextured blob. Benchmarking both against a paradigm proven by millions of developers, like UE5's, means the goal isn't "good enough to work" but "as comfortable as a professional engine." What this day delivered is the full design and parity checklist for that path, laying the blueprint for the real implementation that follows.
keb6nrz.zh: 这份设计瞄准的是创作里最高频的两个动作:找到一个资产、把它放进世界里。"内容浏览器"对标的是成熟引擎里那个分门别类、带缩略图、能搜索筛选的资产库——你应该能像翻素材柜一样浏览自己工程里所有的模型、贴图、场景、角色,而不是在文件夹里盲找。"拖拽到场景"则要求把这条路径做到顺滑自然:从浏览器里抓起一个模型,拖到 3D 视图里松手,它就以合理的位置、朝向、尺寸落进场景,并正确接好材质与引用——而不是丢进去一团错位或没贴图的东西。把这两件事按 UE5 这种被千万开发者验证过的范式来对标,意味着目标不是"能用就行",而是"用起来和专业引擎一样顺手"。这一天交付的是这条路的完整设计与对标清单,为随后的真正落地铺好了图纸。

k1ekgf69.en: The editor gets its own QA gate
k1ekgf69.zh: 编辑器有了自己的质检门

k11idysg.en: The other thing is about reliability. The visual editor has already become a part that builds and runs on its own; this day went further and gave it its own automated quality gate: every change must first pass a suite of automated build-and-check steps before it counts. It sounds unremarkable, yet it's the key to keeping any continuously growing component healthy. The editor will keep gaining panels, interactions and capabilities; without this gate, some change could quietly break another corner unnoticed until a user hits it. With it, problems are caught at the earliest and cheapest stage — the moment the change is made — instead of flowing to you. In other words, what this day added to the editor isn't a new feature but a guarantee of "not regressing as it grows."
k11idysg.zh: 另一件事关乎可靠性。可视化编辑器这块,已经独立成一个能单独构建、单独运行的部分;这一天进一步给它装上了一道属于它自己的自动质检门:每次改动都要先经过一套自动化的构建与检查,通过了才算数。这听起来不起眼,却是任何一个会持续长大的部件能保持健康的关键。编辑器以后会不断加面板、加交互、加能力;没有这道门,某个改动可能在不被注意的角落悄悄弄坏了另一处,直到用户撞上才发现。有了这道门,问题会在最早、最便宜的阶段——也就是改动刚发生时——就被拦下,而不是流到你手里。换句话说,这一天给编辑器装的不是新功能,而是"长大的过程中不退步"的保障。

k1rf7wpx.en: Not every day should be a fireworks of new features. A tool that means to last and to be professional needs "foundation days" interleaved between the sprints: getting the direction clear, setting the standard, building the quality guardrails. The two things this day did are exactly that — a UE5-grade design setting a professional target for the most frequent path of "how assets get used," and an automated QA gate insuring the fast-growing editor. Neither conjures anything on screen immediately, but together they decide whether the real building that follows can be fast, steady and pitfall-free. Aim high, rail it tight, and every later step lands on solid ground.
k1rf7wpx.zh: 不是每一天都该是新功能的烟花。一个想做得长久、做得专业的工具,需要在冲刺之间穿插这样的"地基日":把方向想清楚、把标准定下来、把质量护栏架好。这一天做的两件事正是如此——用一份对标 UE5 的设计,给"资产怎么用"这条最高频的路径定了专业级的目标;用一道自动质检门,给正在快速长大的编辑器上了保险。它们都不会立刻在画面上变出什么,但它们决定了接下来真正动手时,能不能做得又快又稳、又不踩坑。把目标定高、把护栏架牢,后面的每一步才走得踏实。

k1pxsuc4.en: One command — now on Windows too
k1pxsuc4.zh: 一条命令,从此 Windows 也能跑

k1vwxq8c.en: This day moved the install and launch scripts wholesale from bash to cross-platform Bun TypeScript: the same commands run identically on macOS, Linux and Windows, and Windows no longer needs Git-Bash. Alongside it fixed a string of Windows-specific blockers, changed "sessions" from globally bound to scoped per game, made asset import steadier, and made the underlying CLI faster, more controllable and more auditable.
k1vwxq8c.zh: 这天把安装和启动脚本从 bash 整体搬到了跨平台的 Bun TypeScript:同一套命令在 macOS、Linux、Windows 上一致运行,Windows 上不再需要 Git-Bash。配套修掉了一串 Windows 专属的拦路问题,把"会话"从绑死全局改成跟着每个游戏走,资产导入更稳,底层 CLI 也更快、更可控、更可审计。

k5me3ob.en: The biggest barrier: it wouldn't install if you switched platforms
k5me3ob.zh: 最大的一道门槛:换平台就装不起来

k16t80cs.en: For a long time, getting it installed and running relied on a pile of bash scripts. Fine for macOS and Linux, but a hard wall for Windows users — bash isn't native to Windows, so you either had to install a compatibility layer like Git-Bash or hit assorted cryptic errors. For a tool that wants "anyone to turn ideas into games," "it won't install" is the most fatal first turn-off. This day fixed exactly that: rewriting all install and launch scripts wholesale, from bash into cross-platform TypeScript run by Bun. Bun behaves identically across the three major systems, so the same commands and the same logic run on Windows exactly as on Mac, with no compatibility layer needed.
k16t80cs.zh: 长期以来,装好、跑起来这一步是靠一堆 bash 脚本完成的。这对 macOS 和 Linux 用户没问题,但对 Windows 用户就是一道硬门槛——bash 不是 Windows 的原生环境,要么得先装 Git-Bash 这类兼容层,要么各种诡异报错。对一个想让"任何人都能把想法变成游戏"的工具来说,"装不起来"是最致命的第一道劝退。这一天解决的就是这件事:把所有安装与启动脚本,从 bash 整体重写成用 Bun 跑的跨平台 TypeScript。Bun 在三大系统上行为一致,于是同一套命令、同一套逻辑,在 Windows 上和在 Mac 上跑得一模一样,不再需要任何兼容层。

k1n8c2qt.en: The commands collapse into one memorable set
k1n8c2qt.zh: 命令收敛成一组好记的

k4pmwxl.en: Along with the move, the entry points got cleaned up. The scattered, per-platform scripts of the past (`.sh`, `.bat`, `.ps1`, and so on) were deleted together and unified into one plain, memorable set: `bun run setup` to install the environment once, `bun run start` to boot the whole stack, `bun run stop` to stop it, `bun run app` for the desktop app. Whatever system you're on, these few are all you need to remember. For new users it means "copy four lines from the README and it runs," with no more "I'm on Windows, which one do I swap this for"; for existing users it means no more maintenance burden of "two copies of each script (one sh, one ps1) to edit in lockstep and easy to miss." Collapsing several equivalent scripts into one cross-platform source of truth is the heart of the day's work — one fewer thing to keep in sync is one fewer place to go wrong.
k4pmwxl.zh: 搬迁的同时,入口也清理干净了。过去散落的、平台各异的脚本(`.sh`、`.bat`、`.ps1` 等)被一并删掉,统一成一组直白好记的命令:`bun run setup` 一次性装好环境、`bun run start` 起整套服务、`bun run stop` 停掉、`bun run app` 开桌面应用。不管你在哪个系统上,记住这几条就够了。对新用户,这意味着"照着 README 抄四行就能跑起来",不用再分辨"我是 Windows,这条该换成哪个";对老用户,这意味着不再有"两份脚本(一份 sh、一份 ps1)各改一遍、还容易改漏"的维护负担。把多份等价脚本收敛成一份跨平台的真源,正是这天工作的核心——少一份要同步的东西,就少一处会出错的地方。

k1tcmqn8.en: Clearing a string of Windows-specific blockers
k1tcmqn8.zh: 顺手修掉一串 Windows 专属拦路虎

k1umipsl.en: To truly make Windows smooth, cross-platform scripts alone aren't enough — you also have to fix, one by one, the oddities that only surface on Windows. A typical case handled this day: the system's "fake" Python — Windows ships a python3 placeholder that isn't actually installed and only pops the app store when invoked, and a script that naively assumes it works will mysteriously stall during setup. This day taught the install flow to recognize and skip that placeholder and find a Python that actually works. Details like this — nonexistent on other systems, tripping you only on Windows — are the most grinding yet most necessary part of cross-platform support: they add no features, but each one fixed means a batch of Windows users stalls one less time and gets to keep going.
k1umipsl.zh: 真正让 Windows 顺起来,光有跨平台脚本还不够,还得逐个修掉那些只在 Windows 上冒头的怪问题。这天处理的一类典型是:系统里那个"假"的 Python——Windows 自带一个其实没装、点了只会弹应用商店的 python3 占位程序,脚本如果天真地以为它能用,就会在装环境时莫名其妙地卡住。这天让安装流程学会识别并跳过这个占位、去找一个真正能用的 Python。类似这种"在别的系统上根本不存在、只在 Windows 上才会绊一跤"的细节,是跨平台支持里最磨人也最必要的一环——它们不增加任何功能,但每修掉一个,就有一批 Windows 用户能少卡一次、顺利往下走。

k1b0tsrm.en: Sessions change from globally bound to scoped per game
k1b0tsrm.zh: 会话从"绑死全局"变成"跟着游戏走"

kebb9r.en: This day also touched a more internal structure: who a session belongs to (a session being one stretch of your conversation with Forge). Sessions used to be global and separate from any specific game; this day nested them under each game, scoped per game. Meaning: your conversation with Forge for the "space shooter" project and the one for the "farm sim" project are now each their own, never bleeding into each other. It's more intuitive — a conversation belongs to a specific game in the first place — and it lays groundwork for cleaner project management later: switch games and its chat history and context come along, instead of facing one global pot of mixed sessions. This kind of "filing data where it truly belongs" tidy-up is unglamorous day to day, yet it keeps the whole system's mental model clean.
kebb9r.zh: 这天还动了一处更内在的结构:会话(也就是你和 Forge 的一段对话过程)的归属。此前会话是全局的、和具体游戏分离的;这天把它改成嵌套进每个游戏之下、按游戏来划分。意思是:你为"太空射击"这个项目和 Forge 的对话,和你为"农场模拟"那个项目的对话,从此各归各的、互不串味。这更符合直觉——一段对话本就属于某一个具体的游戏;也为后面更清晰的项目管理打底:切换游戏时,连同它的对话历史、上下文一起切过去,而不是面对一锅混在一起的全局会话。这类"把数据归到它真正所属的地方"的整理,平时不显眼,却让整个系统的心智模型更干净。

kecufoa.en: Steadier asset import + a faster, more controllable CLI
kecufoa.zh: 资产导入更稳 + 底层 CLI 更快更可控

k905oqq.en: The day also landed several fixes that make daily use steadier. On assets, it fixed an indexing problem when importing larger models (big meshes need wider integers to index their vertices, which used to fail here) and made the metadata written on model import follow one canonical format — so importing a bigger, more complex model no longer falls over easily. The CLI core that drives the AI got several refinements too: trimming redundancy so the first turn starts working faster in some cases; fixing an issue in injecting an agent's "code of conduct"; and adding optional masking of a user's own external tools plus an audit trail of an agent's calls to host tools — the latter meaning "which tools did the AI actually use this time" becomes traceable on record. Together, this tamps the foundation another layer toward "faster, more controllable, more trustworthy."
k905oqq.zh: 这天还落了几项让日常更稳的修复。资产这边,修好了较大模型导入时的一个索引问题(大网格需要用更宽的整数来索引顶点,过去会在这里出错),并让模型导入时写出的元数据走统一的规范格式——导入一个大一点、复杂一点的模型不再容易"翻车"。底层驱动 AI 的 CLI 内核也做了多项打磨:让某些场景下的首轮响应去掉冗余、更快开始干活;修正了一处给 agent 注入"行为准则"的问题;并新增了可选地屏蔽用户自带外部工具、以及对 agent 调用宿主工具的审计记录——后者意味着"这次 AI 到底动用了哪些工具"变得有据可查。这些合起来,是把地基往"更快、更可控、更可信"的方向又夯实了一层。

k1k7qeff.en: The protagonist of this day is "the barrier." However powerful a tool is, if a large group is shut out because their system is wrong and it won't install, half its value is gone before anyone uses it. Making install and launch fully cross-platform, so Windows users too can run it with one command, throws that door open to everyone — one of the preconditions for "anyone can make games" to hold true. And on the same day, filing sessions under their game, fixing asset import to be steady, and polishing the CLI core to be faster and more auditable tidied the room while the door was opened. Lower the barrier to entry, then raise the quality inside — this day did both.
k1k7qeff.zh: 这一天的主角,是"门槛"。一个再强大的工具,如果一大批人因为系统不对、装不起来就被挡在门外,它的价值就先打了对折。把安装与启动彻底跨平台、让 Windows 用户也能一条命令跑起来,等于把这扇门向所有人敞开——这是"任何人都能做游戏"这句话能成立的前提之一。而同一天里,把会话归到游戏名下、把资产导入修稳、把 CLI 内核打磨得更快更可审计,则是在敞开门的同时,把屋里也收拾得更整洁。降低进入的门槛,再提高里面的质量——这一天两件事都做了。

k1cdxxbs.en: Forge learns teamwork: many agents at once
k1cdxxbs.zh: Forge 学会组队:多个 agent 一起干活

kaidi6m.en: The day's biggest change: Forge is no longer a lone worker plodding through tasks one after another, but can raise a team — multiple agents sharing one task board and progressing in parallel. Also, single-mesh scene assets in the editor now persist to disk and survive reopen and playtest; a first packaging UI appears; you can scan a QR to take over a working agent from your phone; and chat no longer freezes on certain tricky formatting. On top of that, the project's everyday commands consolidated under one entry, bun fx.
kaidi6m.zh: 这天最大的变化,是 Forge 不再只能一个人埋头串着做,而是能拉起一支队伍:多个 agent 共享同一张任务看板、并行推进。同时,编辑器里单个 mesh 的场景资产能稳定落盘、重开和试玩都还在;出现了一键打包的界面雏形;你还能扫码用手机接管正在干活的 agent;聊天也不再因为某些复杂排版而卡死。此外,项目的日常命令也收敛到了一个统一入口 bun fx。

km0xhu7.zh: 从"一个 Forge"到"一支队伍"

k1cvru43.en: Until now, when Forge took a request it basically did it step by step on its own: plan, write code, verify, one after another. Fine for small tasks, but when a request is large and splits into several independent chunks, serial becomes the bottleneck — things that could run at once are stuck queuing. This day introduced a multi-agent Team mode: Forge can raise a number of "teammate" agents who share one task board, each claiming and progressing in parallel, then folding results back together. Technically this is several things working in concert: an executor that can truly run teammates concurrently, an in-process "mailbox" letting teammates message one another, and a shared task table everyone can see, claim from and keep consistent. It upgrades "directing one AI" into "directing a team of AI."
k1cvru43.zh: 到目前为止,Forge 接到一个需求,基本是自己一步步串着做:规划、写代码、验证,一件接一件。这对小任务够用,但当需求一大、可以拆成好几块互不依赖的活时,串行就成了瓶颈——明明能同时进行的事,却只能排着队等。这一天引入了多 agent 的 Team 模式:Forge 可以拉起若干"队友"agent,大家共享同一张任务看板,各自认领、并行推进,再把结果汇总回来。技术上,这背后是几件事的合力:一个能真正并发执行队友的执行器、一套让队友之间互通消息的进程内"信箱"、以及一张所有人都能看、能认领、状态一致的共享任务表。它把"指挥一个 AI"升级成了"指挥一个 AI 团队"。

k1cbbd64.en: On by default, with a "coordinator view"
k1cbbd64.zh: 默认就开,带一个"队长视角"

k16l1kj6.en: Team mode is on by default as of this day (with a switch kept, so you can drop back to a single agent anytime). To keep "a crowd of agents at work" from becoming an unreadable tangle, it comes with a "coordinator view": a coordinator breaks work into tasks, assigns them and watches progress, and from this view you can see clearly "who's doing what right now, and how far along." At the same time, the system hints to participating agents, when appropriate, that "you're in team mode," so their behavior differs from working solo — knowing to claim tasks off the board and collaborate, rather than each going their own way and duplicating effort. On by default means this isn't an experiment tucked in a corner, but one of Forge's default ways of working from this day on.
k16l1kj6.zh: Team 模式这一天就默认开启了(也保留了一个开关,想关随时能关回单 agent)。为了让"一群 agent 在干活"不至于变成一团看不懂的乱麻,它配了一个"队长视角":由一个协调者把活拆成任务、分派下去、盯着进度,你从这个视角能看清"现在有谁在做什么、做到哪了"。同时,系统会在合适的时候给参与的 agent 提示"你现在处于团队协作模式",让它们的行为与单打独斗时有所区别——知道要认领看板上的任务、要和队友协作,而不是各干各的、重复劳动。默认开启,意味着这不是一个藏在角落的实验功能,而是 Forge 从这天起的默认工作方式之一。

kzel48o.en: The editor: a single mesh now stays put in the scene
kzel48o.zh: 编辑器:单个 mesh 也能稳稳留在场景里

kbtvri.en: The editor filled in a key piece of reliability. Previously, after placing a standalone mesh into the scene, its "scene asset" wasn't saved to disk reliably, so on reopening the project or hitting ▶ to playtest, the thing might vanish or fail to render. This day made single-mesh scene assets write back to disk and persist correctly: what you placed is still there after closing and reopening, and renders as usual when you switch to playtest. It also restores a mesh's original glTF materials when you drag it in, instead of turning into an untextured gray blob. For a what-you-see-is-what-you-get editing experience, "what I placed stays there" is the most basic trust — and this day completed it.
kbtvri.zh: 编辑器这边补上了一块关键的可靠性。此前把一个单独的 mesh(模型网格)放进场景后,它的"场景资产"没能稳定地落盘保存,结果重开工程、或点▶试玩时,这块东西可能就不见了或渲染不出来。这一天让单 mesh 的场景资产能正确写回磁盘并持久化:你摆好的东西,关掉再打开还在,切到试玩模式也照常渲染。配套还做到了:把一个 mesh 拖进来时,能恢复它原本在 glTF 模型里带的材质,而不是变成一块没贴图的灰白。对"所见即所得"的编辑体验来说,"我摆的东西会一直在"是最基本的信任——这一天把这份信任补齐了。

k1w8gxhp.en: A first packaging UI + taking over from your phone
k1w8gxhp.zh: 一键打包的界面雏形 + 用手机接管

k1po335c.en: Two more things make "taking your work with you, watching it anytime" smoother. First, a first packaging UI appears in the editor's top bar: the target platform for packaging, the engine-root selection, history and other options moved onto a visible UI (bilingual, too), bringing "export the game into a distributable build" a step closer from the command line toward a graphical interface. Second, a "scan a QR to take over from your phone" capability arrived: scan a code and you can send and receive messages with a working agent on your phone — step away from the desk and still glance at progress or add an instruction. Both point the same way: don't pin creation to one fixed place — easily carry the build out, and hold control of it in your hand.
k1po335c.zh: 还有两件让"把作品带走、随时盯着"更顺的事。其一,编辑器顶栏出现了打包界面的雏形:打包的目标平台、引擎根目录的选择、历史记录等选项被搬到了可见的 UI 上(且支持中英文),让"把游戏导出成可分发的成品"这件事从命令行往图形界面靠拢了一步。其二,新增了"扫码用手机接管"的能力:扫一下二维码,就能在手机上和正在干活的 agent 双向收发消息——人离开电脑,也能随时看一眼进度、追加一句指令。这两件事方向一致:让创作不被钉死在一个固定的地方——既能把成品轻松带出去,也能把对它的掌控握在手机上。

k1vkmugy.en: Steadier: chat no longer freezes + real-process tests
k1vkmugy.zh: 更稳:聊天不再卡死 + 真实进程级测试

k9m5dy5.en: Reliability wasn't left behind either. The chat interface fixed a problem where parsing certain complex Markdown formatting could fall into an infinite loop and eventually eat all memory and freeze — so pasting in oddly formatted content won't drag the conversation window down anymore. Underneath, a batch of "real-process" end-to-end tests was added: no longer just running in an ideal setting, but actually launching the program as a full process, covering key paths like crash recovery, context compaction, background residency and the command-line interface. Tests are invisible day to day, but they're where the confidence to "dare to change things, knowing a change won't quietly break" comes from — one more layer of real testing is one more safety cushion for moving forward.
k9m5dy5.zh: 可靠性也没落下。聊天界面修掉了一个会让它在解析某些复杂 Markdown 排版时陷入死循环、最终吃光内存卡死的问题——往后再贴进奇怪格式的内容,也不会把对话窗口拖垮。底层还补上了一批"真实进程级"的端到端测试:不再只是在理想环境里跑跑,而是真的把程序当成完整进程拉起来,覆盖断点恢复、上下文整理、后台常驻、命令行界面等关键路径。测试这东西平时看不见,但它是"敢不敢放心改、改了会不会悄悄坏掉"的底气来源——多一层真实测试,就多一分往前走的安全垫。

kb31y3h.en: Everyday commands consolidate to one entry: bun fx
kb31y3h.zh: 日常命令统一到一个入口:bun fx

ka4xa9n.en: This day also consolidated the project's everyday operational commands: the previously scattered setup / start / stop scripts now live under a single entry, bun fx <command>, and running bun fx on its own prints help for every available command. The common ones: bun fx setup (prepare the environment the first time), bun fx update (only pull the latest root code and sync submodules — no longer also reinstalling deps or rebuilding plugins, so it's narrower and faster), bun fx start (web mode by default), bun fx start app (desktop mode), plus bun fx stop / bun fx restart. Collapsing to one entry means that on macOS, Linux or Windows you only need to remember bun fx; it also untangles "update the code" from "set up the environment" — so pulling daily updates is lighter and less likely to trigger a full reinstall by accident. The README, dev docs and public-site instructions are all synced to this new entry.
ka4xa9n.zh: 这天还把项目的日常操作命令做了一次收敛:过去散落的 setup / start / stop 等脚本,如今统一到一个入口 bun fx <命令> 之下,直接运行 bun fx 就会打印出所有可用命令的帮助。常用的有:bun fx setup(首次装好环境)、bun fx update(只拉取主仓最新代码并同步子模块——不再顺手重装依赖或重新构建插件,职责更单一、也更快)、bun fx start(默认起网页模式)、bun fx start app(起桌面模式),以及 bun fx stop / bun fx restart。把入口收敛成一个,意味着无论在 macOS、Linux 还是 Windows,记住一个 bun fx 就够了;同时也把"更新代码"和"装环境"这两件以前容易混在一起的事各归其位——日常拉更新更轻,也更不容易误触发一次完整重装。README、开发文档与公开站的说明都已同步到这个新入口。

k1glp0xa.en: The keyword of this day is "scale up." Before it, Forge's throughput ceiling was "how fast one agent can work"; with Team mode, that ceiling rises to "how much a team can do in parallel" — a qualitative leap from solo to team, meaning the larger and more splittable a request is, the more it can be pushed at once and finished faster. Around that core, the day steadied several experiences: what you place in the editor stays, the build can be packaged out from the UI, you can keep directing from your phone away from the desk, and chat no longer freezes on odd formatting. Scaling the AI's throughput from "one" to "a team" on one side, and tightening every corner of the daily experience on the other — the ceiling of capability and the floor of experience both rose a notch this day.
k1glp0xa.zh: 这一天的关键词是"放大"。在此之前,Forge 的产能上限是"一个 agent 能干多快";有了 Team 模式,这个上限被抬到了"一支队伍能并行干多少"——这是从单兵到团队的质变,意味着越大、越能拆分的需求,越能被同时推进、更快完成。围绕这个核心,这天又把几处体验补稳:编辑器里摆的东西会一直在、成品能从界面打包带走、人离开电脑也能用手机接着指挥、聊天不再被怪格式卡死。一边把 AI 的产能从"一个"放大到"一群",一边把日常体验的每个角落收得更牢——能力的天花板和体验的地板,这一天一起往上抬了一截。

k1g1hxju.en: This is the day-by-day record of ForgeaX building itself. The engine and platform are written almost entirely by AI in a self-running development loop — and this is its long-term development memory: one page per day of the features it shipped for itself and how it built them.
k1g1hxju.zh: 这是 ForgeaX「自己造自己」的逐日记录。这套引擎与平台,几乎完全由 AI 在一个自主开发循环里写成;而这里,就是它的长期开发记忆 —— 每天一页,记录当天它为自己交付了哪些特性、又是怎么实现的。

k65x0wy.en: A user's-eye guide to building a game with ForgeaX. Click any item to expand the details.
k65x0wy.zh: 从用户角度,带你一步步用 ForgeaX 做出一款游戏。点开每一条查看细节。

k13vk5qf.en: What ForgeaX is and what games it makes
k13vk5qf.zh: ForgeaX 是什么、能做什么样的游戏

k1q8lq0s.en: ForgeaX is an AI-native game development studio. You describe the game in plain language; an AI lead called Forge plans it, designs it, and writes it into running game code itself, hot-reloading the result into your browser — what you say is what you play.
k1q8lq0s.zh: ForgeaX 是一个 AI 原生的游戏开发工作室。你用自然语言描述想要的游戏,一个叫 Forge 的 AI 主创把它规划、设计,并亲手写成可运行的游戏代码,结果实时热重载进浏览器 —— 所见即所玩。

kv7r2q5.en: Two in-house foundations sit underneath: an engine redesigned for the AI's point of view (see Why an AI-native engine) and a development loop that converges features on a correct result (see How AI gets a feature right).
kv7r2q5.zh: 它背后有两块自研底座:一个为 AI 视角重新设计的引擎(读 为什么做 AI 原生引擎),和一条引导功能持续收敛到正确的开发流水线(读 AI 是怎么把功能做对的)。

k1hl3dpm.en: It suits 2D / 2.5D / 3D web games. Playable FPS, Diablo-style ARPG, two-level survival and shooter demos already exist (see the showcase); the engine covers PBR / IBL / SSAO rendering, 2D/3D physics, skeletal animation and dual RHI (see "Engine capabilities" at the bottom of the showcase).
k1hl3dpm.zh: 适合做网页端的 2D / 2.5D / 3D 游戏。已经用它做出 FPS、暗黑风 ARPG、双关生存、射击压测等可玩 demo(见 案例);引擎已覆盖 PBR / IBL / SSAO 渲染、2D/3D 物理、骨骼动画、双 RHI 等(见案例页底部「引擎能力一览」)。

kjfqhiy.en: Everything runs in the browser (WebGPU), web and desktop on one stack; open source under Apache License 2.0 (see the license).
kjfqhiy.zh: 全部跑在浏览器(WebGPU),网页与桌面同一套栈;开源,采用 Apache License 2.0(见 版权说明)。

kkajkzc.zh: 安装与启动(一条命令起工作室)

knhq32v.en: Prerequisites: git, bun ≥ 1.3, node ≥ 22, curl. (On a clean host, bun fx setup can also bootstrap bun / node 22+ / pnpm / the Rust+wasm toolchain — zero-prompt by default; --interactive asks per tool, --skip-bootstrap skips it.)
knhq32v.zh: 前置: git、bun ≥ 1.3、node ≥ 22、curl。(在干净机器上,bun fx setup 还能自动装齐 bun / node 22+ / pnpm / Rust+wasm 工具链 —— 默认零提示全自动,加 --interactive 逐项确认,加 --skip-bootstrap 跳过装环境。)

kruv87t.en: What bun fx setup does: verifies prereqs → inits submodules → builds the engine packages → runs bun install in each sub-repo → builds the marketplace plugins → scaffolds $ROOT/.env from .env.example. With --interactive it also prompts for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; otherwise it warns and you edit .env later.
kruv87t.zh: bun fx setup 做了什么:校验前置 → 初始化子模块 → 构建引擎包 → 在每个子仓 bun install → 构建 marketplace 插件 → 从 .env.example 生成 $ROOT/.env。加 --interactive 时会顺带提示你填 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;否则先给个提醒,稍后自己编辑 .env 即可。

kgsabrt.en: bun fx start boots three services: server (:18900, the runtime core — chat / backends / sessions), interface (:18920, the Studio UI with vite HMR), and engine (:15173, the renderer). Override ports in .env via FORGEAX_{SERVER,INTERFACE,ENGINE}_PORT. Then open http://localhost:18920.
kgsabrt.zh: bun fx start 启动 3 个服务:server(:18900,运行时核心 —— chat / 后端 / 会话)、interface(:18920,Studio UI,vite HMR)、engine(:15173,渲染器)。端口可在 .env 用 FORGEAX_{SERVER,INTERFACE,ENGINE}_PORT 覆盖。启动后浏览器打开 http://localhost:18920。

k3e759y.en: Everyday commands (one entry, bun fx): run bun fx setup once to prepare the environment; later pull updates with bun fx update (updates the root repo + syncs submodules, no reinstall / rebuild); bun fx start / bun fx start app launch web / desktop; bun fx stop and bun fx restart stop / restart; bun fx status and bun fx doctor diagnose your setup; bun fx build app packages the desktop app. Run bun fx with no arguments to list every command.
k3e759y.zh: 日常命令(统一入口 bun fx):首次用 bun fx setup 装好环境;之后拉取更新用 bun fx update(只更新主仓 + 同步子模块,不重装 / 不重新构建);bun fx start / bun fx start app 起网页 / 桌面;bun fx stop 与 bun fx restart 停 / 重启;bun fx status、bun fx doctor 排查环境;bun fx build app 打包桌面应用。直接运行 bun fx(不带参数)会列出全部命令。

k5v5meq.en: Desktop app: bun fx start app opens a native window on the live source (first run auto-installs and starts the stack; closing it stops the stack); bun fx build app packages a self-contained .app / .dmg. See Run & preview for all modes.
k5v5meq.zh: 桌面应用:bun fx start app 开一个原生窗口跑实时源码(首次自动装依赖 + 自动起栈,关窗口自动收栈);bun fx build app 打包自包含 .app / .dmg。完整运行形态见 运行与预览。

k81nzwf.en: Platform support (macOS / Linux / Windows, first-class): install and launch are one set of cross-platform Bun scripts, so all three systems run the same bun fx commands with identical behavior — and Windows no longer needs Git-Bash (the old dual .sh / .bat / .ps1 scripts were deleted). Specifically: web dev (bun fx start) and desktop dev (bun fx start app, a native Tauri window on live source) work on macOS / Linux / Windows; packaging a game into a double-clickable .app / .dmg (bun fx build app) is currently done on macOS. Common Windows-specific issues (black preview, a console window per turn, processes not closing cleanly, the system's stub Python) are all fixed — see Changelog · 2026-06-28.
k81nzwf.zh: 平台支持(macOS / Linux / Windows 一视同仁):安装与启动是一套跨平台的 Bun 脚本,三个系统跑的是同一组 bun fx 命令,行为一致——Windows 上不再需要 Git-Bash(早期那套 .sh / .bat / .ps1 双份脚本已删除)。其中:网页开发(bun fx start)与桌面开发(bun fx start app,Tauri 原生窗口跑实时源码)在 macOS / Linux / Windows 上都可用;把游戏打包成可双击的 .app / .dmg(bun fx build app)目前需在 macOS 上进行。常见 Windows 专属问题(预览黑屏、每轮弹控制台、进程关不净、系统自带的"假" Python)都已修复,详见 更新日志 · 2026-06-28。

ke62y7a.en: Prefer not to do it by hand? Let your AI coding CLI clone & launch it — see Have your AI CLI clone & launch it; then build your first game with Quick start. For API keys, see Advanced · Switch / configure the AI backend.
ke62y7a.zh: 不想手动?让你的 AI 编程 CLI 替你 clone + 启动,见 让 AI CLI 克隆并启动;装好后照 快速开始 做第一个游戏。API key 的配置见 进阶 · 切换 / 配置 AI 后端。

ktof0gp.en: 🚧 The source is being prepared for public release; the repo URL above works once it's public.
ktof0gp.zh: 🚧 源码正在为公开发布做准备,上面的仓库地址公开后即可用。

k1gh6t7y.en: Open the studio, learn the interface

k19fulvc.en: The interface is three parts: a top bar, the chat on the left, and the preview/workbench on the right.
k19fulvc.zh: 界面就三块:顶栏 + 左侧对话 + 右侧预览/工作台。

k1qa6isn.en: Top bar — the ⊕ new menu, a project switcher (move between games — what a "project" is is covered in Core concepts), and a session switcher (review / switch past conversations).
k1qa6isn.zh: 顶栏(TopBar) —— ⊕ 新建菜单、项目切换器(在不同游戏间切换,什么是"项目"见 核心概念)、会话切换器(回看 / 切换历史对话)。

k1emhf30.en: Left · chat (ChatPanel) — a team rail (Forge and the sub-agents), a message stream (sub-agent cards, Forge's thinking and tool calls), and a composer at the bottom with a backend switch at its bottom-right (see Advanced).
k1emhf30.zh: 左侧 · 对话区(ChatPanel) —— 团队栏(Forge 与各子 agent)、消息流(含子 agent 卡片、Forge 的思考与工具调用),底部是输入框(Composer),右下角有后端切换(见 进阶)。

khrokju.en: Right · main area (MainArea) — toggles between the preview (your game live in an iframe) and the workbench (file editing / design docs); see Scenes & editor.
khrokju.zh: 右侧 · 主区(MainArea) —— 在预览(游戏实时 iframe)与工作台(文件编辑 / 设计文档)之间切换,详见 场景与编辑器。

k1u52xng.en: The top-right cog opens Settings: API keys, model choice, CLI backend, and plugin management. The desktop app also shows a first-run overlay that prompts for the key the first time you open it.
k1u52xng.zh: 右上角齿轮是设置(SettingsPanel):填 API key、选模型、切 CLI 后端、管理插件。桌面应用首次启动时还有一个引导浮层(FirstRun)直接让你填 key。

k1qjbx3g.en: In ForgeaX, "project" and "game" are the same thing — a game is one games/<slug>/ folder. A real game folder usually looks like this:
k1qjbx3g.zh: 在 ForgeaX 里,"项目"和"游戏"是同一回事 —— 一款游戏就是一个 games/<slug>/ 目录。一个真实游戏目录通常长这样:

kfd7ga6.en: the game manifest. Minimally three fields: id, name, and entry (pointing at the entry code, e.g. src/main.ts).
kfd7ga6.zh: 游戏清单。最小就三个字段:id、name、entry(指向入口代码,如 src/main.ts)。

k2p2tuk.en: the game's own readme / gameplay overview (controls, mechanics, story beats).
k2p2tuk.zh: 这款游戏自己的说明 / 玩法概览(键位、机制、剧情节奏)。

k1yq9ath.en: the game code. Besides the main.ts entry, it's usually split into modules by concern (e.g. player.ts, enemies/, effects.ts, setup.ts).
k1yq9ath.zh: 游戏代码。入口 main.ts 之外通常按职责拆成多个模块(如 player.ts、enemies/、effects.ts、setup.ts)。

k1qf5srz.en: design documents and art / audio assets.
k1qf5srz.zh: 设计文档与美术 / 音频资产。

k117fbfr.zh: 标准 TS 工程文件。

k1pdlt9f.en: The main.ts entry imports engine capabilities from @forgeax/engine-runtime / engine-ecs / engine-app and exports a GameEntry — the contract by which the engine loads a game. For the full capability set, see "Engine capabilities" on the showcase.
k1pdlt9f.zh: 入口 main.ts 从 @forgeax/engine-runtime / engine-ecs / engine-app 引入引擎能力,并导出一个 GameEntry —— 这就是引擎加载一款游戏的契约。引擎能力总览见 案例页「引擎能力一览」。

k29y32x.en: Multiple games = multiple projects, switched in the top-bar project switcher. For how scenes / levels are organized, see Scenes & editor.
k29y32x.zh: 多款游戏 = 多个项目,在顶栏的项目切换器里切换。场景 / 关卡如何组织见 场景与编辑器。

k1klen0s.en: Forge and its team of sub-agents
k1klen0s.zh: Forge 与它的子 agent 团队

k1glsjm0.en: Forge (the main agent) is the only one that writes game code directly — it writes games/<slug>/src/main.ts, the preview hot-reloads, and it sees the running result to decide the next step. That edit → see → edit loop has to stay with whoever can see the preview, i.e. Forge (see Build by chatting).
k1glsjm0.zh: Forge(主 agent)是唯一直接写游戏代码的角色 —— 它写 games/<slug>/src/main.ts,右侧预览热重载,它立刻看到运行结果,据此决定下一步。这个"改 → 看 → 再改"的闭环必须握在能看到预览的 Forge 手里(详见 用对话做游戏)。

k1d9gqep.en: Sub-agents (e.g. Iori gameplay, Suzu design, Kotone narrative, Iro art, Tsumugi build) only plan / design / make assets / write docs and never touch src/ — they have no live-preview feedback, so any code they wrote would have nothing to steer it. See the full cast in the marketplace and Chapter 10 · The agent team.
k1d9gqep.zh: 子 agent(如 Iori 玩法、Suzu 设计、Kotone 叙事、Iro 美术、Tsumugi 工程)只做规划 / 设计 / 资产 / 文档,不碰 src/ —— 因为子 agent 没有实时预览反馈,写了代码也看不见效果。完整阵容见 插件市场 与 第 10 章 · Agent 团队。

kta0bxf.en: How dispatch works: Forge dispatches a sub-agent with one tool call (shaped like subagent(type="iori", task="…")); the server's /api/subagent stream bridges its output back into the main conversation in real time — that's the embedded sub-agent card you see in the message stream. A sub-agent's design docs are filed under its own section in the workbench (see Scenes & editor).
kta0bxf.zh: 怎么派活:Forge 用一次工具调用派发子 agent(形如 subagent(type="iori", task="…")),经服务端的 /api/subagent 流式桥接,把子 agent 的产出实时回流进主对话 —— 你在消息流里看到的就是嵌入的子 agent 卡片。子 agent 产出的设计文档会自动归到工作台里它自己的栏目下(见 场景与编辑器)。

ktuvy97.en: A session is an agent's memory — an append-only stream of events (each one is a user message / assistant message / thinking / tool call / tool result). Forge (main) and each sub-agent each keep their own.
ktuvy97.zh: 一个 session 就是某个 agent 的对话记忆 —— 一条只追加的事件流(每条是一个事件:用户消息 / 助手消息 / 思考 / 工具调用 / 工具结果)。Forge(主)与每个子 agent 各有自己的 session。

k1axcj7q.en: The UI splits events by who emitted them into the main thread vs sub-agents, rendering each sub-agent's slice as an embedded card. So on one screen you see both Forge's main thread and what the sub-agents it dispatched actually did.
k1axcj7q.zh: 前端按"是谁发的"把事件切成主对话与子 agent 两路,主对话里的子 agent 那段渲染成嵌入的卡片。所以同一屏里,你既看到 Forge 的主线,也看到它派出去的子 agent 干了什么。

k1ge7efs.en: Use the top-bar session switcher to review and switch past sessions. Switching a session restarts nothing — the UI just reads a different agent's event stream.
k1ge7efs.zh: 在顶栏的会话切换器里可以回看、切换历史会话。切换会话不会重启任何服务 —— 只是前端换了读取的那个 agent 的事件流而已。

k172paaz.en: How to describe your idea clearly

k1m9on5k.en: The more specific you are, the better Forge nails it first try with fewer redos. A good prompt usually covers:
k1m9on5k.zh: 描述越具体,Forge 越能一次到位、少返工。一个好需求通常覆盖这几点:

kfysqba.zh: 类型与视角 —— 俯视 / 第一人称 / 2.5D 横版……

k3e31xl.en: Core loop — the one thing the player keeps doing
k3e31xl.zh: 核心循环 —— 玩家从头到尾一直在做的那件事

kj9lj7w.zh: 操作、胜负条件、敌人 / 障碍、手感与氛围

knhkykv.en: Start small, get it running, then layer mechanics on. For example:
knhkykv.zh: 先从小处起步、跑起来,再逐步加机制。例如:

k1k4ft6v.en: A top-down game: a character runs around an arena, space fires bullets, enemies keep spawning, hits remove them and add score.
k1k4ft6v.zh:
做一个俯视角小游戏:角色在场地里跑,
按空格发射子弹,四周不断刷新敌人,
打中消失并记分。

k3p1gvs.en: For a step-by-step first game, see Quick start; for what's achievable, browse the showcase. For heavier design, Forge pulls in design sub-agents (see Core concepts).
k3p1gvs.zh: 想要一步步带着做第一个游戏,见 快速开始;不确定能做出什么效果,先看 案例。设计较重时 Forge 会叫上设计类子 agent(见 核心概念)。

k1fz5fsq.en: Watch Forge plan, code, and run it
k1fz5fsq.zh: 看 Forge 规划、写代码、跑起来

kdc4jon.en: Once you send a request, the chain is:
kdc4jon.zh: 你发出需求后,链路是这样的:

kyvz07k.en: Understand + plan — Forge clarifies the requirement, dispatching design / gameplay sub-agents for heavier work (see Core concepts).
kyvz07k.zh: 理解 + 规划 —— Forge 先把需求理清,设计较重时派设计 / 玩法子 agent(见 核心概念)。

k1r55xxq.en: Write code — Forge writes itself into games/<slug>/src/main.ts (and its split-out modules).
k1r55xxq.zh: 写代码 —— Forge 自己写到 games/<slug>/src/main.ts(及拆分出的模块)。

k7mpcfa.en: Hot-reload — on save, the engine's vite detects the change and the preview hot-replaces the module in place — no full reload, the picture updates almost instantly.
k7mpcfa.zh: 热重载 —— 文件一改,引擎的 vite 侦测到改动,右侧预览就地热替换模块,不整页刷新,画面几乎即时变。

k1ggqe4k.en: See the result — Forge sees the running result through the preview (which also forwards the game's console back), and decides the next step.
k1ggqe4k.zh: 看结果 —— Forge 通过预览看到运行效果(预览还把游戏里的 console 转发回来),据此决定下一步。

k3hnpnx.en: The whole process is transparent: the message stream shows Forge's thinking, each tool call, and the cards of the sub-agents it dispatched. For switching/controlling preview vs workbench, see Scenes & editor; for how hot-reload works, see Run & preview.
k3hnpnx.zh: 整个过程是透明的:消息流里能看到 Forge 的思考、每次工具调用,以及它派出去的子 agent 卡片。预览 / 工作台的切换与控制见 场景与编辑器;热重载机制见 运行与预览。

kf3jbow.en: Iterate: add mechanics, tune the feel
kf3jbow.zh: 一轮轮迭代:加机制、调手感

k1ru5tf0.en: Not happy? Keep talking — each bit of feedback becomes another change, visible instantly via hot-reload:
k1ru5tf0.zh: 不满意就继续说,每一句反馈都会变成一次新的改动,热重载即时见效:

k2t2ddu.en: Faster bullets, double enemy health, night background.
k2t2ddu.zh: 子弹再快一点,敌人血量加倍,背景换成夜晚。

k1qdgxn3.en: The preview has play / pause / reload controls for testing as you go; to pin the preview to a specific game, switch in the project switcher (see Open the studio, learn the interface).
k1qdgxn3.zh: 预览自带 播放 / 暂停 / 重载 控制,方便你边调边试;想固定预览某一款游戏,可在项目切换器里切换(见 认识界面)。

k7kwu15.en: The basic loop is describe → generate → play → describe again. Run it smoothly and you go from a sentence to a playable game — the full onboarding is in Quick start.
k7kwu15.zh: 基本循环就是:描述 → 生成 → 游玩 → 再描述。把它跑顺,就能从一句话迭代到一款能玩的游戏 —— 整套上手流程见 快速开始。

ky9phcr.en: The right-hand main area toggles between two views:
ky9phcr.zh: 右侧主区在两种视图间切换:

ka26rp3.en: Preview — your game runs live in an iframe, with an FPS readout and play / pause / reload controls. When Forge writes code, it hot-reloads here instantly (see Build by chatting).
ka26rp3.zh: 预览 —— 你的游戏在 iframe 里实时运行,带 FPS 显示与 播放 / 暂停 / 重载 控制。Forge 写完代码,这里热重载即时出结果(见 用对话做游戏)。

k1s9jvs3.en: Workbench — a file browser + editor: view / edit / save text & code, render markdown design docs, and preview images, audio, video and 3D models. It also surfaces file activity and "who's editing" locks, so you and the AI edit the same files without clobbering.
k1s9jvs3.zh: 工作台 —— 一个文件浏览 + 编辑器:看 / 改 / 存文本与代码、渲染 markdown 设计文档,还能预览图片、音频、视频、3D 模型。它也显示文件活动与"谁在编辑"的锁,人和 AI 改同一份不打架。

kvil19k.en: With no file open, the workbench shows entries for every creation workbench (character / animation / 3D / scene / UI / music…) — see Creation tools and the marketplace. For making assets, see Assets.
kvil19k.zh: 没打开文件时,工作台会展示所有创作工作台(角色 / 动画 / 3D / 场景 / UI / 音乐……)的入口 —— 详见 创作工具 与 插件市场。资产怎么做见 资产。

k11tdh66.en: Edit the scene, changes flow back live
k11tdh66.zh: 编辑场景,改动实时回到游戏

koal4of.en: The scene editor saves a level's contents to a scene data file in the game folder (scene.pack.json) — the single source of truth for that level: what's on disk is what runs in the game.
koal4of.zh: 场景编辑器把一关的内容存成游戏目录里的场景数据文件(scene.pack.json)—— 它是这关的单一可信源:磁盘上是什么,游戏里跑的就是什么。

kmazwle.en: When you place objects and leave edit mode, the changes are flushed to disk and the running game re-reads them, so the preview reflects your edits immediately — the edit→play round-trip. Conversely, when Forge changes code by chat it rides the same hot-reload path (see Build by chatting and Run & preview).
kmazwle.zh: 你在编辑器里摆好对象、离开编辑态时,改动会落盘并让运行中的游戏重新读取,于是预览即时反映你的编辑 —— 这就是 edit→play 实时回流。反过来,Forge 用对话改代码也走同一条热重载链路(见 用对话做游戏 与 运行与预览)。

kohb12b.en: A game can have multiple scenes / levels, each its own scene data, switched and reused as needed — the "Cow Survivor" demo switches between a day pasture and a night graveyard (see the showcase).
kohb12b.zh: 一款游戏可以有多个场景 / 关卡,各自一份场景数据,按需切换与复用 —— 案例里的「Cow Survivor」就在白天牧场与暗夜墓园两关之间切换(见 案例)。

k18wqwd9.en: How to organize: objects live in the scene data, while art / audio assets live in the game folder (project layout in Core concepts, asset generation in Assets). Splitting by scene keeps a growing game maintainable.
k18wqwd9.zh: 组织方式上:对象住在场景数据里,美术 / 音频资产放在游戏目录中(项目结构见 核心概念,资产怎么生成见 资产)。按场景拆分,游戏做大时更好维护。

klsiv9f.zh: 资产:美术 / 动画 / 音乐

kzz2t15.en: Use the character editor (wb-character) for character concept design: write a one-line brief, get a portrait + turnaround. No drawing skills needed to get a game-ready character.
kzz2t15.zh: 用角色编辑器(wb-character)做角色概念设计:写一句人设,生成正面立绘 + 转身三视图。不会画画也能拿到能进游戏的角色形象。

kvmvdfq.en: Its outputs (a character manifest + portrait / turnaround) are stored per character inside your game and feed straight into the animation workbench as downstream input — so "design the character → make it move" is one continuous pipeline (see the next item).
kvmvdfq.zh: 它的产出(角色清单 + 立绘 / 三视图)按角色存进你的游戏里,并作为下游输入直接接进动画工作台 —— 也就是说"画好的人 → 让它动起来"是一条顺下来的管线(见下一条)。

k1kpgglr.en: Each workbench is a panel plus a set of tools; you-by-hand and AI-by-dispatch edit the same artifact. Full list in the marketplace and the workbenches tutorial.
k1kpgglr.zh: 每个工作台都是一个面板 + 一组工具,人手点和 AI 派活改的是同一份产物。完整清单见 插件市场 与 工作台教程。

k1im3emn.zh: 让角色动起来(2D / 3D 动画)

k4mu3vx.en: 2D: the animation workbench (wb-anim) uses the character portrait as a template and turns it into walking, attacking, four-direction motion, even short clips — without face drift, so it stays the same character once it moves.
k4mu3vx.zh: 2D: 动画工作台(wb-anim)拿角色立绘当模板,把它变成会走、会打、四方向乃至短视频的动作 —— 而且不串脸,动起来还是同一个角色。

kpblyoq.en: 3D: the engine natively supports skeletal animation — import a rigged, skinned model plus animation clips from FBX, with smooth crossfades between idle / walk / run / cast / death. This pipeline is real and shipped — it's how the dark-fantasy witch in the showcase moves: see the skeletal-animation milestone and the showcase (Hellforge).
kpblyoq.zh: 3D: 引擎原生支持骨骼动画 —— 从 FBX 导入带骨架与蒙皮的模型及动画 clip,在 idle / walk / run / cast / death 之间平滑过渡(crossfade)。这条链路是真实跑通的,案例里的暗黑风女巫就是这么动起来的:见 骨骼动画里程碑 与 案例(Hellforge)。

k11mrbrc.en: Beyond characters, there are workbenches across the whole pipeline:
k11mrbrc.zh: 角色之外,还有覆盖全链路的工作台:

kv0f1jz.en: Blocky-character editor (wb-lowpoly-obj, exports engine-neutral .glb), node-graph low-poly (wb-3d-lowpoly), and text / image / multi-view-to-3D (wb-gen3d, provider-agnostic). Detailed in Chapter 9 · 3D modeling & generation.
kv0f1jz.zh: 方块人编辑器(wb-lowpoly-obj,导出引擎中立 .glb)、连线节点低多边形(wb-3d-lowpoly)、文字 / 图片 / 多视角转 3D(wb-gen3d,接入多家生成服务、择优而用)。逐一详解见 第 9 章 · 3D 建模与生成。

kctp3pl.zh: 特效 / 场景 / UI / 道具

k18xf13w.en: Skill VFX (wb-skill), scene generation and 2D scene assets (wb-scene-generator / wb-2d-scene-asset-generator), the UI workshop (wb-ui, clickable prototypes), and item icons (wb-items, art + data in one table). Detailed in Chapter 9 · Scenes / UI / items.
k18xf13w.zh: 技能特效(wb-skill)、场景生成与 2D 场景资产(wb-scene-generator / wb-2d-scene-asset-generator)、界面工坊(wb-ui,出可点原型)、道具图标(wb-items,图 + 数据一张表)。逐一详解见 第 9 章 · 场景 / UI / 道具。

kr94pej.zh: 音乐 / 调色 / 剧情

kap4qyj.en: Music and SFX (wb-bgm, a BGM timeline), color grading (wb-look, palette + LUT + postprocess), and narrative (wb-narrative, 117 genres × 9 templates). Detailed in Chapter 9 · Narrative / music / look / balance.
kap4qyj.zh: 音乐与音效(wb-bgm,BGM 时间轴)、整体调色(wb-look,调色板 + LUT + 后处理)、叙事(wb-narrative,117 题材 × 9 模板)。逐一详解见 第 9 章 · 叙事 / 音乐 / 调色 / 数值。

kcxhivf.en: Item-by-item coverage is in Chapter 9 · Creation tools, the workbenches tutorial, and the marketplace.
kcxhivf.zh: 每个工作台的逐一介绍见 第 9 章 · 创作工具、工作台教程 与 插件市场。

k1q3gxtk.zh: 在浏览器里直接跑(实时示例)

ka5zmkb.en: An actual ForgeaX engine example running live on this page (WebGPU — Chrome / Edge recommended). More runnable demos in Examples and Games.
ka5zmkb.zh: 下面是 ForgeaX 引擎的一个示例,直接在本页跑起来(WebGPU,建议 Chrome / Edge)。更多可玩示例见 引擎示例 与 游戏。

k1usl8vn.zh: 网页与桌面应用两种形态

k1uketdy.en: The same codebase runs in three forms:
k1uketdy.zh: 同一套代码有三种运行形态:

k4ckz80.en: Web dev — bun fx start boots three services (server / UI / engine); open http://localhost:18920 in a browser, edits hot-reload live. Works on macOS / Linux / Windows. Install in Before you start.
k4ckz80.zh: 网页开发 —— bun fx start 起三个服务(server / UI / engine),浏览器开 http://localhost:18920,改代码实时 HMR。三系统(macOS / Linux / Windows)通用。安装见 开始之前。

kwl3d53.en: Desktop dev — bun fx start app opens a native window loading the same dev server, with identical live source and HMR; first run auto-installs and starts the stack, closing the window stops it. Available on macOS / Linux / Windows.
kwl3d53.zh: 桌面开发 —— bun fx start app 开原生窗口,加载同一个 dev 服务,实时源码与 HMR 完全一致;首次自动装依赖 + 起栈,关窗口自动收栈;macOS / Linux / Windows 均可。

k1fmv53s.en: Desktop .app (packaged) — bun fx build app produces a self-contained .app / .dmg that runs on double-click with its own sidecar (ports 18810 / 15273, deliberately offset from dev's 18900 / 15173 so both can coexist); its key lives in ~/ForgeaxProjects/.env, with a first-run overlay. Packaging is in Publish & share.
k1fmv53s.zh: 桌面 .app(打包) —— bun fx build app 出自包含的 .app / .dmg,双击即用,自带 sidecar(端口 18810 / 15273,与 dev 的 18900 / 15173 刻意错开,可共存);它的 key 放在 ~/ForgeaxProjects/.env,首次打开有引导浮层。打包发布见 发布与分享。

krnifhn.en: All three ports are overridable in .env via FORGEAX_{SERVER,INTERFACE,ENGINE}_PORT. ⚠️ The desktop window uses the system WebView, so 3D runs on WebKit's WebGPU — a bit weaker than Chrome's. For the best visuals, use the browser.
krnifhn.zh: 三个端口都能在 .env 用 FORGEAX_{SERVER,INTERFACE,ENGINE}_PORT 覆盖。⚠️ 桌面窗口用系统 WebView,3D 走的是 WebKit 的 WebGPU,比 Chrome 略弱 —— 追求最强画质时用浏览器版。

kmk2ht6.en: Hot-reload: see it as you change it

k1mtcsif.en: Save and it takes effect — no manual refresh:
k1mtcsif.zh: 保存即生效,不用手动刷新:

k1gxc6qa.en: Edit game code (games/<slug>/src/…) → the engine hot-swaps the module in place and the preview updates instantly (Forge's edits ride this too — see Build by chatting).
k1gxc6qa.zh: 改游戏代码(games/<slug>/src/…)→ 引擎就地热替换模块,预览即时变(Forge 写代码也走这条,见 用对话做游戏)。

k1l90wjo.en: Changes in the scene editor flush to disk and flow back into the running game (see Scenes & editor).
k1l90wjo.zh: 在场景编辑器里的改动落盘后回流到运行中的游戏(见 场景与编辑器)。

k2j73pg.en: Blank preview / engine error — the engine isn't built; re-run bun fx setup.
k2j73pg.zh: 预览空白 / 引擎报错 —— 引擎没构建好,重跑 bun fx setup。

k177ebj1.en: SSL error on :18920 — access via http://localhost (WebGPU still works on localhost).
k177ebj1.zh: :18920 报 SSL 错 —— 用 http://localhost 访问即可(localhost 上 WebGPU 仍可用)。

kzbymyp.en: Port in use — a busy port errors out (it won't auto-pick another); run bun fx stop then bun fx start, or change ports in .env.
kzbymyp.zh: 端口被占用 —— 端口被占时会直接报错退出(不会自动换端口),先 bun fx stop 再 bun fx start;或在 .env 改端口。

k7i0j0m.en: Chat says no API key — set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env (the desktop app prompts on first run); key setup is in Advanced.
k7i0j0m.zh: 聊天提示没有 API key —— 在 .env 设 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY(桌面应用首次启动会弹窗让你填);key 的配置见 进阶。

knttxlo.en: 3D looks weaker on desktop — a limitation of the system WebView's WebGPU; use the Chrome browser build for best rendering.
knttxlo.zh: 桌面端 3D 偏弱 / 有差异 —— 系统 WebView 的 WebGPU 限制所致,改用 Chrome 浏览器版获得最佳渲染。

kbdfsiz.en: bun fx build app packages the whole studio together with your game into a self-contained desktop bundle (macOS .app / .dmg): a trimmed runtime, the server, the Studio UI, the marketplace and your game content are all inside, so it runs on double-click with zero setup for the user.
kbdfsiz.zh: bun fx build app 把整个工作室连同你的游戏装进一个自包含桌面包(macOS 的 .app / .dmg):里面带了一份精简运行时、服务端、Studio 界面、插件市场和你的游戏内容,双击即用、无需用户再装任何环境。

k1ei67d0.en: It runs on a built-in sidecar at its own ports (18810 / 15273), so it never collides with your dev stack (see Run & preview). Packaging must run on macOS; the packaged .app opens on double-click.
k1ei67d0.zh: 它在内置 sidecar 的独立端口(18810 / 15273)上运行,和你的开发栈互不打架(见 运行与预览)。出包需在 macOS 上进行;打好的 .app 双击即可打开。

kgss6fc.en: A game is one self-contained games/<slug>/ folder (forge.json + src/ + design docs + assets, see Core concepts). Share or commit that folder and someone else opens it in their studio to keep playing or building — the demo library stores several games side by side (fps, hellforge, cow-survivor, shoot-opt), see the showcase.
kgss6fc.zh: 一款游戏就是 games/<slug>/ 这一个自包含目录(forge.json + src/ + 设计文档 + 资产,见 核心概念)。把这个目录分享 / 提交给别人,对方在自己的工作室里打开就能继续玩或继续做 —— demo 库里的几款游戏(fps、hellforge、cow-survivor、shoot-opt)就是这样并排存放的,见 案例。

k1m0ij2z.en: For now the most reliable way to hand a game to players is the desktop package above; a smoother "one-click web publish / play online" is still in the works.
k1m0ij2z.zh: 目前最稳的对外分发是上面的桌面打包;更顺滑的"一键 Web 发布 / 在线试玩"仍在完善中。

k1pclpzn.zh: 切换 / 配置 AI 后端

knl7da0.en: Switch backends (swap the chip): pick the kernel from the backend switch at the composer's bottom-right, or under the CLI section of Settings — Claude Code (default) / Codex / Cursor / forgeax-native. The CLI section shows each backend's health and a Test button. Switching a backend also swaps its default persona (see The agent team); details per backend in the marketplace.
knl7da0.zh: 切后端(换芯):在输入框右下角的后端切换处,或设置里的「CLI」一栏选择智能内核 —— Claude Code(默认)/ Codex / Cursor / forgeax-native。设置里的 CLI 栏会显示每个后端的在线状态并带一个 Test 按钮。切后端会连带换掉默认人格(见 Agent 团队),各后端详情见 插件市场。

k1xc76x0.en: Keys / models: set your model API key (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) under Settings → Keys — it applies live, no restart (you can also edit .env directly); choose the model under Settings → Models. Missing-key troubleshooting is in Run & preview.
k1xc76x0.zh: 配 key / 选模型:在设置的「Keys」里填模型 API key(如 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY),保存即时生效、不用重启(也可直接编辑 .env);在「Models」里选用哪个模型。没填 key 的排查见 运行与预览。

kyji452.en: Almost every capability in ForgeaX is a runtime-loaded plugin (overview in the marketplace), so you can add your own.
kyji452.zh: ForgeaX 里几乎一切能力都是运行时加载的插件(总览见 插件市场),所以你也能加自己的。

kha1y2i.en: The quickest path today: copy an existing workbench plugin and adapt it, with the plugin author (wb-plugin-author) helping; a fuller in-app visual editor (file tree + code editor, save → auto-reload) is on the way. Once built, enable and reorder it in the admin panel — plugins are mounted by the CLI at runtime. See the kinds of workbench in Creation tools.
kha1y2i.zh: 当下最快的路子:复制一个现成的工作台插件改成你要的,配合插件作者(wb-plugin-author)辅助;更完整的 in-app 可视化编辑器(文件树 + 代码编辑 + 保存自动重载)正在路上。做好后在 admin 面板里启用、排序 —— 插件由 CLI 在运行时挂载。各类工作台见 创作工具。

kqoy13l.en: Use the persona editor (wb-agent-persona): pick an agent from the list, edit its persona in a text area, and save → hot-reload, no restart. You can give an agent a different character or voice without touching any code.
kqoy13l.zh: 用人格编辑器(wb-agent-persona):从列表里选一个 agent,在文本区改它的人设,保存即热重载、不用重启。这样你不动一行代码,就能给某个 agent 换个性格 / 说话风格。

k139h2o5.en: For who's the main vs sub-agents and where default personas come from, see Core concepts and The agent team; the full cast is in the marketplace.
k139h2o5.zh: 谁是主 agent、谁是子 agent、默认人格怎么来,见 核心概念 与 Agent 团队;完整阵容见 插件市场。

kdh9x0y.zh: 角色 / 动画 / 特效

khn1sd7.en: Character concept design: a one-line brief → portrait + turnaround. It has several pipelines — turnaround (three views), video character (turnaround → AI video motion → frame extraction → spritesheet export), and monster generation (8-direction × 5-animation monster sprites). No drawing skills needed; the output then feeds the animation workbench (see Assets).
khn1sd7.zh: 角色概念设计:写一句人设 → 正面立绘 + 转身三视图。内部有多条管线 —— 三视图(turnaround)、视频角色(三视图 → AI 视频动作 → 序列帧 → spritesheet 导出)、怪物生成(8 方向 × 5 动画的怪物精灵)。不会画画也能拿到能进游戏的角色形象,产出再喂给动画工作台(见 资产)。

k62m4lq.en: Uses a character portrait as a template and makes it move: four-direction pixel, vehicle animation, monster sprites, Spine binding, short-video generation — without face drift, so it stays the same character. Embedded panel with a center viewport. 3D characters use the engine's native skeletal pipeline — see the skeletal-animation milestone and Assets.
k62m4lq.zh: 把角色立绘当模板,变成会动的:像素四方向、载具动画、怪物 sprite、Spine 绑定、短视频生成 —— 而且不串脸,动起来还是同一个角色。面板内嵌、带中央预览视口。3D 角色的骨骼动画走引擎原生链路,见 骨骼动画里程碑 与 资产。

k1d2fghy.en: Skill-tree editing + VFX preview, listing your skill and effect outputs in one place. The key idea: the player's clicks and AI dispatch share one skill spec — effects auto-attach to "the moment of cast", no manual alignment.
k1d2fghy.zh: 技能树编辑 + VFX 预览,集中列出技能与特效产出。关键是玩家手点与 AI 派活共用同一份技能规格 —— 特效会自动挂到"出手那一刻",不用手动对齐。

k1k89nnk.en: Build rigged blocky 3D characters: either "vibe" it (say a line, AI generates) or edit by hand (Blender-style gizmo), with a built-in playground for live preview. Exports engine-neutral .glb usable in any engine.
k1k89nnk.zh: 做可动的方块 3D 角色:既能"vibe"——说一句让 AI 生成,也能手动编辑(Blender 风的 gizmo 拖拽),还自带游乐场实时预览。导出引擎中立的 .glb,任何引擎都能用。

k10zjnx.en: Build 3D props / mechanical assets with node-programming ("wire up blocks"): model the process as a node graph, change one parameter, regenerate the whole set. Great for batch, reusable, parametric hard-surface assets.
k10zjnx.zh: 用"连线搭积木"的节点式方式做 3D 道具 / 机械:把建模流程画成一张节点图,改一个参数,整套重新生成。适合需要批量、可复用、参数化的硬表面资产。

kjg2ab.en: A 3D asset generation entrypoint: pick a generation service and give an input (text / image / multi-view), and get a durable, game-ready 3D asset manifest. Plugged into several top generators so you pick whichever's best — no single-vendor lock-in.
kjg2ab.zh: 3D 资产生成入口:选一个生成服务 + 给输入(文字 / 图片 / 多视角图),产出持久化、可直接进游戏的 3D 资产清单。接入多家最强生成服务,择优而用、不被单家绑死。

k1wrolf9.en: Assemble a whole game scene with node-programming: lay out composition, placement and texturing as a graph; re-run anytime to regenerate the full scene. For how scenes / levels are organized, see Scenes & editor.
k1wrolf9.zh: 用节点式自动"搭"出一整张游戏场景:把组合、布局、贴图处理画成一张流程图;想改随时重跑,产出整套场景。场景与关卡如何组织见 场景与编辑器。

k42ykgs.en: Also node-programming, for batch-generating the small things in a scene — props, textures, decorations, UI bits — then auto-named and filed so assets don't turn into a mess.
k42ykgs.zh: 同样是节点式,批量生成场景里的小物件 —— 道具、贴图、装饰、UI 小图,生成完自动起名归档,资产不再乱成一团。

k1n2x1me.en: Generate a full interface set by genre, screen flow and visual style — UI blueprints, component assets, and clickable interactive prototypes (not just images). Menus, buttons and health bars in one go.
k1n2x1me.zh: 按游戏类型、界面流程、视觉风格生成一整套界面 —— UI 蓝图、组件素材,以及能点的交互原型(不只是图)。菜单、按钮、血条都能一键出。

ku5d5jm.en: Make the game's items and icons — pixel art for weapons, potions, coins — with their data attached. Art and data in one table (items.json) that you and the AI edit together, so they never drift apart.
