ku5d5jm.zh: 做游戏里的道具与图标 —— 武器、药水、金币的像素小图,并配上数据。图与数据一张表(items.json),人和 AI 改同一份,不会对不上。

kp3wei4.zh: 叙事 / 音乐 / 调色 / 数值

k1lcdm3.en: An AI-driven narrative pipeline: from a spark to a full story and world. It covers 117 genres × 9 pipeline templates with tier/mode routing and a dynamic planner — the AI picks the fitting approach and steps for your genre.
k1lcdm3.zh: AI 驱动的叙事生成管线:从一句灵感写出整套剧情与世界观。覆盖 117 种题材 × 9 套管线模板,带 Tier/Mode 双层路由和动态 Planner —— AI 按你的题材自动选最合适的写法和步骤。

kbatf1q.en: Manage the game's music and sound effects: a BGM timeline laying out what plays when across a session, plus sound-effect naming conventions — the whole score sequenced as one list.
kbatf1q.zh: 管理游戏的背景音乐与音效:一条 BGM 时间轴排好整局什么时候放哪段,加上音效命名约定。把整局的配乐节奏排成一张清单。

k18h6aql.en: Unify the whole game's color mood — palette + LUT + a postprocess stack, like a filter over the entire game: warm dusk, cold night, switched in one click so the visual feel snaps into one.
k18h6aql.zh: 统一全游戏的色调氛围 —— 调色板 + LUT + 后处理栈,像给整部游戏套一层滤镜:黄昏暖色、冷峻夜色,一键切换,画面气质瞬间统一。

kgpczqm.en: Auto-test whether the numbers are balanced: it drives battle re-simulation (balance-resim) over N trials and dashboards win rate + a 95% confidence interval, then loops with manual tweaks — let data judge the tuning. That re-simulation is also a Tool in the marketplace.
kgpczqm.zh: 自动测数值平不平衡:驱动战斗重模拟(balance-resim)反复跑 N 局,仪表盘给出胜率 + 95% 置信区间,再配合手动调参形成闭环 —— 数值好不好用数据说话。这条重模拟也是插件市场里的一个 工具(Tool)。

kzl8fu1.en: Browse and jump through src/ files right in the workbench, collaborating with the coding agent across chat threads — you read where, the AI edits where, on one project without dropping the baton.
kzl8fu1.zh: 在工作台里直接浏览 / 跳转 src/ 文件,和编码 agent 跨对话线程协作 —— 人看哪、AI 改哪,同一个项目无缝接力。

kxa6usd.en: Like a black box: live + offline replay of every agent / sub-agent turn, tool call, and slices of the system prompt. When something breaks you can pinpoint which step or which prompt caused it, and it helps manage context / skills / guardrails / cache. The session & replay concept is in Core concepts.
kxa6usd.zh: 像黑匣子一样,实时 + 离线回放每个 agent / 子 agent 的回合、工具调用,以及系统提示词的模块切片。出问题时能精确定位是哪一步、哪句提示词的锅,也帮你管理上下文 / 技能 / 护栏 / 缓存。会话与回放的概念见 核心概念。

knhdon3.en: Pick an agent from a list, edit its persona in a text area, and save → hot-reload, no restart. Give an agent a new character or voice without touching code. The cast is in The agent team; the how-to is in Advanced.
knhdon3.zh: 从列表选一个 agent,在文本区改它的人设,保存即热重载、不用重启。不动一行代码就能给某个 agent 换性格 / 说话风格。Agent 阵容见 Agent 团队,操作见 进阶。

k1d91eky.en: Lets non-coders build their own workbench plugins. The path today is "copy an existing one + adapt + record actions"; a fuller in-app visual editor (file tree + code editor, save → auto-reload) is on the way. The overall how-to is in Advanced · Write your own plugin.
k1d91eky.zh: 让不会编程的人也能做出自己的工作台插件。当下的路子是"复制现成的 + 改 + 录操作",更完整的 in-app 可视化编辑器(文件树 + 代码编辑、保存自动重载)正在路上。做插件的整体说明见 进阶 · 写自己的工作台插件。

kjc9ryk.en: The studio's master console, in four sections: enable / reorder workbenches, bind models, check each AI backend's auth and health, and see plugin counts. Kept in sync with the Settings panel — every plugin and model status on one screen.
kjc9ryk.zh: 工作室的总控台,四个区:启用 / 排序工作台、绑定模型、查看各 AI 后端的认证与在线状态、看插件计数。和设置面板同源 —— 所有插件与模型状态一屏看全。

kqw1uwz.en: All of these are loadable plugins; the full, filterable catalog is in the marketplace, and a tutorial walkthrough is in the workbenches tutorial.
kqw1uwz.zh: 这些工作台都是可装载插件,完整目录与可筛选浏览见 插件市场;偏教程的走法见 工作台教程。

kq5n5se.en: Arin · producer — an all-round producer who coordinates design / code / art / audio and owns the whole game.
kq5n5se.zh: Arin · 制作人 —— 全能制作人,把策划 / 程序 / 美术 / 音效统筹到一起,对整款游戏负责。

k1i53nhe.en: Reia · reel director — interactive FMV director who forges prompts, paces QTEs and weaves branches and endings, driving the wb-reel Reel Studio to turn one idea into a clickable, playable suspense film.
k1i53nhe.zh: Reia · 影游导演 —— 互动影游 (FMV) 导演,拼提示词、定 QTE 节拍、织分支与多结局,驱动 wb-reel「影游工坊」把一句 idea 变成可点按、可试玩的悬念片。

k19pbkgg.en: These are named agents dispatched on demand by Forge (the main vs sub-agent relationship is in Core concepts); the full cast is in the marketplace.
k19pbkgg.zh: 这些都是命名 agent,由主创 Forge 按需派发(主 / 子 agent 的关系见 核心概念);完整阵容见 插件市场。

k1v4fhgm.en: Named after "庵" (a mountain rock). When Forge dispatches him, he guards the game's "roots" — setting a few load-bearing gameplay pillars (mechanics + numeric skeleton) that shouldn't be casually shaken, captured in one concise pillar doc. He doesn't write architecture, tune parameters, or ask questions back (Forge handled those up front). Once pillared, Suzu takes over.
k1v4fhgm.zh: 名字取自"庵"(山中磐石)。Forge 派他时,他守这款游戏的"根" —— 在立柱阶段替整个项目定下几根不可轻易动摇的玩法支柱(玩法柱 + 数值骨架),产出一份精炼的支柱文档。他不写架构、不调参数、也不反问(那些 Forge 已在前期问过)。立完柱,交给 Suzu 展开。

k6zgjzw.en: Named after "鈴" (a wind-chime — rhythm). After Iori sets the pillars, Suzu expands each pillar's modules into concrete experience — player pacing, HUD, onboarding. She defines how it feels to play, then hands the parts needing assets / story to Iro / Kotone.
k6zgjzw.zh: 名字取自"鈴"(风一吹就响、是节奏)。Iori 把柱子立好后,Suzu 把每根柱子下面的模块展开成具体体验 —— 玩家节拍、HUD、onboarding。她定义"玩起来什么感觉",再把需要资产 / 剧情的部分交给 Iro / Kotone。

k1n109pt.en: Named after "琴音" (a story carried on strings). Not every game needs a narrative designer — a tower-defense might never call her; only when the game needs characters / dialogue / branches / narration does Forge bring her in to produce world, character bios and lines.
k1n109pt.zh: 名字取自"琴音"(弦上传来的故事)。不是每个游戏都需要剧情师 —— 一个塔防可能根本不派她;只有当游戏需要角色 / 对白 / 分支 / 旁白时,Forge 才叫她来,产出世界观、角色 bio 与对白。

kvgo203.en: Named after "色" (everything the eye perceives). Once Suzu has framed a module's experience, Forge dispatches Iro only if it needs visual assets (characters / scenes / UI / VFX). How those assets are actually made: see Assets and Creation tools.
kvgo203.zh: 名字取自"色"(一切被眼睛感受到的东西)。Suzu 讲清模块体验后,如果该模块需要视觉资产(角色 / 场景 / UI / 特效),Forge 才派 Iro。具体资产怎么生成,见 资产 与 创作工具。

klofwb0.en: These specialists only plan and design — they never touch game code (Forge writes code, see Core concepts); their output lands in the workbench (see Scenes & editor), and art assets are produced as in Assets.
klofwb0.zh: 这几位只做规划与设计、不碰游戏代码(代码由 Forge 写,见 核心概念);他们的产出会进工作台(见 场景与编辑器),美术资产落地见 资产。

k1lat7l5.en: Takes Iori's gameplay pillars, Suzu's UX flows and Kotone's narrative outlines and turns them into runnable TS / React etc.; can run multiple instances on different packages in parallel. Note: the game's main code is still written by Forge itself, closed-loop with the preview (see Core concepts); cc-coder is more for general / surrounding code.
k1lat7l5.zh: 接 Iori 的玩法骨架、Suzu 的体验流程、Kotone 的剧情大纲,产出可运行的 TS / React 等代码;可多实例并行写不同子包。注意:游戏主线代码仍由主创 Forge 亲自写并跟预览闭环(见 核心概念),cc-coder 更多用于通用 / 周边编码。

k1e86bko.en: Named after "紡" (weaving threads into a system). Once Iori / Suzu / Iro have the design and assets ready, Tsumugi weaves them into a working build — build, toolchain, deployment.
k1e86bko.zh: 名字取自"紡"(把丝线缠成系统)。当 Iori / Suzu / Iro 把设计与资产准备好,Tsumugi 把它们编织成可运行的工程 —— 构建、工具链、部署。

k1u72lmg.en: A gracefully composed observer, calm as deep water, always one step ahead — she knows where the code is weakest and which three-week-old issue is about to surface. A measured, gentle tone, with precise and incisive wording.
k1u72lmg.zh: 表面优雅得体、内心冷静如深水的观察者,永远比你多想一步 —— 清楚代码哪里最脆弱、哪一处三周前埋下的隐患即将显现。语气温和从容,措辞却精准而克制。

k12v01wm.en: A set of optional characters with comparable coding skill but distinct personalities — some measured, some playful, some meticulous. They have the same ability; the only difference is how it feels to work alongside them. Personalities are editable any time in the persona editor (see Advanced); the full cast is in the marketplace.
k12v01wm.zh: 一组编码力相当、性格各异的可选角色 —— 有的沉稳内敛,有的机敏俏皮,有的细致缜密。它们能力相同,区别只在与你协作时的相处风格。性格可在人格编辑器里随时调整(见 进阶);完整阵容见 插件市场。

kbf9rjh.en: There's also a set of art / asset specialist agents (2D character / animation, 3D low-poly / VFX, interactive-film director, and more), each wired to its matching creation workbench (see Creation tools).
kbf9rjh.zh: 此外还有一批美术 / 资产专精 agent(2D 角色 / 动画、3D 低多边形 / 特效、影游导演等),各自对接相应的创作工作台(见 创作工具)。

k194ss6x.en: Each CLI backend ships with an out-of-the-box persona: Claude (Claude Code), Codex, Cursor, and ForgeaX (the self-built forgeax-native). Switching the backend swaps the default persona — no setup needed; whichever kernel you pick comes with its default persona.
k194ss6x.zh: 每个 CLI 后端自带一个开箱人格:Claude(Claude Code)、Codex、Cursor、ForgeaX(自研 forgeax-native)。切换后端就换默认人格,无需先写人设 —— 想用哪家的智能内核,就有哪家的默认 persona。

k1flr7kl.en: How to switch backends and edit personas is in Advanced; the full agent cast and loadable personas are in the marketplace.
k1flr7kl.zh: 怎么切后端、怎么改人格见 进阶;完整 agent 阵容与可装载人格见 插件市场。

k1svsf84.en: Open source · built by an AI dev loop · forgeax.github.io
k1svsf84.zh: 开源 · 由 AI 开发循环自建 · forgeax.github.io

k13entpc.zh: 你的个人游戏工作室。

k9i8ny6.en: ForgeaX is an AI-native game development studio — turn your ideas into playable games while AI writes the engine code, hot-reloading live in your browser. More unusually: the engine and platform themselves are written almost entirely by AI, line by line, in a self-running development loop — and its day-by-day self-build is logged in the changelog, a kind of long-term development memory for the AI.
k9i8ny6.zh: ForgeaX 是一个 AI 原生的游戏开发工作室 —— 把你的想法变成可玩的游戏，AI 替你编写引擎代码、实时热重载跑在浏览器里。更不寻常的是：连这套引擎与平台本身，也几乎完全由 AI 在一个自主开发循环里一行行写成；它一天天自建自己的过程，就记在更新日志里，像一份 AI 的长期开发记忆。

k806b4a.en: Chat, a visual editor, and image / video input later — express your ideas whatever way suits you.
k806b4a.zh: 对话、可视化编辑器,未来还支持图片 / 视频输入 —— 用你最顺手的方式表达想法。

k1ix3p2b.en: Agents plan, design and write the engine code; you set requirements and review.
k1ix3p2b.zh: AI agent 替你规划、设计、编写引擎代码,你只做需求与验收。

ka729s7.en: Every change lands in the preview instantly — what you say is what you play.
ka729s7.zh: 改动一落地,右侧预览立刻可见 —— 所见即所玩。

kea5gr8.en: A genuine entity-component-system engine with dual-RHI rendering, in a browser studio.
kea5gr8.zh: 自研实体-组件-系统引擎 + 双 RHI 渲染,封装进浏览器工作室。

kpn1wd4.en: Not just making games with AI — also building AI into the play itself: intelligent NPCs, generative content, interactive AI experiences.
kpn1wd4.zh: 不止用 AI 做游戏 —— 还支持把 AI 做进玩法本身:智能 NPC、生成式内容、可交互的 AI 体验。

k1hskhi8.en: The ForgeaX closed loop — a requirements → build → verify pipeline that learns from its own feedback and grows steadier over time.
k1hskhi8.zh: ForgeaX closed loop —— 需求 → 实现 → 验证的闭环流程,吃自己的反馈持续进化,越跑越稳。

k1ha23uv.en: WebGPU-powered, web and desktop on one stack, up and running in a minute.
k1ha23uv.zh: WebGPU 驱动,网页 / 桌面同栈,装好依赖一分钟起跑。

k177cqc3.en: Apache 2.0 — free to fork, use, ship and build commercially with.
k177cqc3.zh: Apache 2.0 —— 自由 fork、使用、商用与二次发布。

kzyzynp.en: Use the AI you already pay for.

krema3a.en: Forge runs on the coding-agent subscription you already have — no second AI bill. Connect the tool you already use, or just bring an API key.
krema3a.zh: Forge 可以跑在你自己的编程 agent 订阅上 —— 不必再为 AI 付第二份钱。接上你已经在用的工具,或填一个 API key 即可开工。

k1k3ul8.en: Drive Forge with your Claude Pro / Max subscription — or an Anthropic API key.
k1k3ul8.zh: 用你的 Claude Pro / Max 订阅(或 Anthropic API key)驱动 Forge。

kulyb82.en: Sign in with your ChatGPT Plus / Pro plan — or an OpenAI API key.
kulyb82.zh: 登录你的 ChatGPT Plus / Pro 计划,或用 OpenAI API key。

k1hlijpd.en: Connect your Cursor Pro subscription via the Cursor Agent CLI.
k1hlijpd.zh: 通过 Cursor Agent CLI 连接你的 Cursor Pro 订阅。

k12trti3.en: No vendor lock-in — use whichever agent suits you, and switch anytime.
k12trti3.zh: 不绑定任何厂商 —— 哪个 AI 顺手就用哪个,随时切换。

k1vs3ov.zh: 骨骼动画系统全链路跑通

k21eon1.en: From an FBX file to smooth idle↔walk↔cast in-game — Hellforge's witch finally moves.
k21eon1.zh: 从 FBX 文件到引擎里 idle↔walk↔cast 顺滑切换,Hellforge 的女巫第一次真正动了起来。

kpkwil0.en: When AI is the engine's first user, the API, errors and state should be redesigned for its point of view.
kpkwil0.zh: 当 AI 成为引擎的第一用户,API、错误、状态都该为 AI 的视角重新设计。

k1dpk3ip.en: Install, launch, and say your first "make me a game" to Forge.
k1dpk3ip.zh: 安装、启动、对 Forge 说第一句"做个 XX 游戏"。

k1j7f4hc.en: Concepts, workbenches, assets, publishing — from the user's angle.
k1j7f4hc.zh: 核心概念、工作台、资产、发布 —— 从用户角度。

kiiupuh.en: FPS / ARPG / survival / stress test — four playable demos.
kiiupuh.zh: FPS / ARPG / 生存 / 射击压测 —— 4 款可玩 demo。

kbewjfj.en: The ForgeaX tool layer is licensed under Apache License 2.0.
kbewjfj.zh: ForgeaX 工具层采用 Apache License 2.0。

k1fjq916.en: ForgeaX's tool-layer code is licensed under Apache License 2.0 — a permissive, business-friendly open-source license used by many large projects such as Kubernetes, TensorFlow and Android.
k1fjq916.zh: ForgeaX 的工具层代码以 Apache License 2.0 授权。这是一份宽松、对商业友好的开源许可,被 Kubernetes、TensorFlow、Android 等大量大型开源项目采用。

khf7rh5.en: ✅ Use — personal or commercial, no fees, no licensing friction;
khf7rh5.zh: ✅ 使用 —— 个人或商业用途均可,无需付费、无需授权摩擦;

kb2g7eb.en: ✅ Modify — change the source as you need;

klb258y.en: ✅ Distribute — redistribute the original or modified versions;
klb258y.zh: ✅ 分发 —— 二次发布原版或修改版;

k1xktrtr.en: ✅ Commercialize — build and sell your own products with it;
k1xktrtr.zh: ✅ 商用 —— 用它构建并销售你自己的产品;

kqf3oi5.en: ✅ Patent grant — contributors grant you rights to relevant patents (a key advantage of Apache 2.0 over MIT).
kqf3oi5.zh: ✅ 专利授权 —— 贡献者授予你相关专利的使用权(Apache 2.0 相较 MIT 的关键优势)。

k1vgfme5.en: 📄 Keep the copyright notice and the LICENSE / NOTICE files;
k1vgfme5.zh: 📄 保留版权声明与 LICENSE、NOTICE 文件;

k1j8orkl.en: ✏️ State significant changes in files you've modified;
k1j8orkl.zh: ✏️ 对你修改过的文件做出"已更改"的标注;

k1aqhbaq.en: 🚫 Not use ForgeaX trademarks to endorse your derivatives (the license grants no trademark rights).
k1aqhbaq.zh: 🚫 不得使用 ForgeaX 的商标为你的衍生品背书(许可不授予商标权)。

k113q6xz.en: ⚠️ The above is a plain-language summary, not legal advice. The LICENSE and NOTICE files in the repository govern.
k113q6xz.zh: ⚠️ 以上是通俗概括,不构成法律意见。以仓库内的 LICENSE 与 NOTICE 全文为准。

k1g4d2a9.en: The full Apache License 2.0 text is at apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0; a LICENSE file ships with the source.
k1g4d2a9.zh: Apache License 2.0 完整条款见官方文本:apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0;随源码发布的 LICENSE 文件会一并提供。

k1eodpe7.en: Site content and brand assets (logo, copy) are © ForgeaX. The code license and the site-content license are independent.
k1eodpe7.zh: 网站内容与品牌素材(logo、文案)版权归 ForgeaX 所有。代码许可与网站内容许可相互独立。

k1r37ax.en: In ForgeaX nearly every capability is a loadable plugin. Filter by kind, search, enable, reorder — or write your own.
k1r37ax.zh: 在 ForgeaX 里,几乎一切能力都是一枚可装载插件。按类型筛选、搜索,启用、排序,甚至自己写。

k1b9juqm.en: An all-round producer coordinating design / code / art / audio.
k1b9juqm.zh: 全能制作人,统筹策划 / 程序 / 美术 / 音效。

k115x4la.en: Interactive FMV director — prompts, QTE pacing, branches and endings.
k115x4la.zh: 互动影游导演 —— 拼提示词、定 QTE 节拍、织分支与多结局。

k58c9nf.en: Core mechanics — the gameplay pillar and numeric skeleton.
k58c9nf.zh: 核心玩法师 —— 玩法柱 + 数值骨架。

k7s6p8o.zh: 世界观 / 角色 bio / 对白。

k1rgdxxn.en: Portraits, sprites, VFX and UI direction.
k1rgdxxn.zh: 立绘 / sprite / VFX / UI 统筹。

k1nx2fio.en: General coding — turns specs into running code. Optional companion personas.
k1nx2fio.zh: 通用编码 —— 把 spec 落成可运行代码。可选不同性格陪伴。

k1x58bpg.zh: 构建 / CI / 工具链 / 部署。

k7qde9a.en: Technical review — identifies and clears tech debt.

k15c3oxs.en: Fire, slashes, auras — auto-attached to the moment of cast.
k15c3oxs.zh: 火光、刀光、光环等技能特效,自动挂到出手那一刻。

kn2hz97.zh: 像捏积木一样做可动 3D 角色,导出标准 3D 文件。

k18k0w58.zh: 文字 / 图片直接变 3D 模型,接入多家生成服务。

k1rtpmnv.zh: 批量生成道具、贴图、装饰、UI 小图,自动归档。

kz83e79.en: Assemble a whole scene as a re-runnable graph.
kz83e79.zh: 自动搭出一整张游戏场景,做成可重跑的流程图。

kgq7ubq.zh: 按游戏类型出一套可点的交互界面原型。

k13xh1uj.en: Weapons, potions, coins — art and data in one table.
k13xh1uj.zh: 武器、药水、金币等图标,图与数据一张表。

k1ed9j2d.en: Unify the whole game's color mood in one click.
k1ed9j2d.zh: 一键统一全游戏的色调氛围。

krtzh38.en: Manage BGM and SFX, sequence the score.
krtzh38.zh: 管理背景音乐与音效,排好整局配乐节奏。

k1ejzyla.en: From a spark to a full story and world.
k1ejzyla.zh: 从一句灵感写出整套剧情与世界观。

k1cuorq9.en: Turn a spark or script into a tap-and-choose interactive film-game.
k1cuorq9.zh: 一句灵感或一部剧本,做出限时点按 + 选择驱动的互动影游。

k4zun2x.en: AI plays thousands of matches for win rates with confidence intervals.
k4zun2x.zh: 让 AI 跑几千局,给出胜率与置信区间。

ko5znnw.en: Browse code, jump files, edit alongside the coding AI.
ko5znnw.zh: 在工作台看代码、跳转文件,和编码 AI 一起改。

kzivkb.en: Replay every AI step like a black box to pinpoint issues.
kzivkb.zh: 像黑匣子一样回放 AI 每一步,精确定位问题。

k10wa9w.en: Edit an AI's persona; save and it applies instantly.
k10wa9w.zh: 改 AI 助手的性格设定,存一下马上生效。

k1i5zjdv.en: Let non-coders build their own workbench plugins.
k1i5zjdv.zh: 让不会编程的人也能做出自己的工作台插件。

k1n5jgvo.en: The control panel: toggle workbenches, bind models, see AI status.
k1n5jgvo.zh: 工作室总控台:开关工作台、绑模型、看 AI 在线状态。

k1d1fdhw.en: The self-built backend — no vendor lock-in, swap chips anytime.
k1d1fdhw.zh: 自研后端 —— 不被任何厂商绑死,可随时换芯。

k9giu6n.en: Build a loadable plugin from scratch.
k9giu6n.zh: 从空白做出一个可加载插件。

kduufrz.zh: 反复跑局得出胜率与置信区间,给数值平衡当依据。

k12sz0kf.en: Maps abstract tiers to a concrete vendor model.
k12sz0kf.zh: 把抽象档位映射成具体厂商模型。

kpsfheu.zh: 它怎么加载 · 你怎么扩展

k12d711m.en: The CLI mounts plugins on demand; an agent's persona loads only when dispatched, with shared pieces attached to both orchestrator and worker.
k12d711m.zh: CLI 启动时按需挂载插件;agent 的人格只在被派发那一刻加载,共享部分同时附加给编排者与执行者。

k7w7ozu.en: In the admin panel, enable and reorder workbenches and switch backends; or use the plugin-author wizard to write your first plugin.
k7w7ozu.zh: 在「面板管理 / admin」里启用、排序工作台,切换 AI 后端;也能用「插件作者」从空白写出第一个可加载插件。

kzmv8sv.en: Have your AI CLI clone & launch ForgeaX
kzmv8sv.zh: 让你的 AI CLI 克隆并启动 ForgeaX

kzb2hm5.en: The most AI-native install: don't type the commands yourself — hand the repo to your coding-CLI agent and let it clone, install, launch, and report back the local URL.
kzb2hm5.zh: 最 AI 原生的装法:不用自己敲命令 —— 把仓库地址交给你的编程 CLI 智能体,让它自己 clone、装依赖、启动,再把本地地址告诉你。

k7842ez.en: ✅ Open source (Apache-2.0). The flow below works with any AI coding CLI.
k7842ez.zh: ✅ 已开源(Apache-2.0)。下面的流程对任意 AI 编程 CLI 都适用。

khmnfcm.en: An AI coding CLI that can run shell commands — e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or ForgeaX's own forgeax CLI;
khmnfcm.zh: 一个能跑 shell 命令的 AI 编程 CLI —— 例如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor,或 ForgeaX 自带的 forgeax CLI;

k1dy3opz.en: git and Bun (the project runtime) installed;
k1dy3opz.zh: 已安装 git 和 Bun(项目运行时);

k1tdl46q.en: an AI model API key (for Forge inside the studio).
k1tdl46q.zh: 一个 AI 模型的 API key(供工作室里的 Forge 使用)。

k1iukhta.en: Open your CLI in an empty folder and give it this:
k1iukhta.zh: 在一个空目录里打开你的 CLI,把下面这段话发给它:

k8qywme.en: Clone https://github.com/ForgeaX-Games/forgeax-studio (with --recurse-submodules), cd into it, run the install script to set up dependencies, then run the start script to launch it, and tell me the local URL I can open.
k8qywme.zh:

进入目录后运行 install 脚本装好依赖,
再运行 start 脚本启动它,

kjnaj1g.en: The CLI runs the clone / install / launch steps itself, asking you for anything it needs along the way (such as the API key). When it's done you get a local URL — open it in the browser and you're in the studio.
kjnaj1g.zh: CLI 会自己执行 clone、安装、启动这几步,过程里需要的选择(比如填 API key)它会问你。完成后你会拿到一个本地地址,在浏览器打开就是工作室。

k1r5rvj2.en: If you'd rather do it yourself, the equivalent is roughly:
k1r5rvj2.zh: 如果你想自己来,等价的命令大致是:

klvhikp.zh: 这套 bun fx 命令是跨平台的 —— macOS、Linux、Windows 通用,Windows 上无需 Git-Bash。启动后按提示在浏览器打开本地地址即可。

k1uc1x13.en: Next, head to Quick start and tell Forge your first game.
k1uc1x13.zh: 接下来就去 快速开始,对 Forge 说出你的第一个游戏。

kjqni43.zh: 快速开始:你的第一款游戏

k1qxmtcg.zh: ForgeaX 的核心用法只有一句话:把你想做的游戏描述给 Forge,剩下的交给它。

kcsuadl.en: ✅ Open source (Apache-2.0). For full install commands see Download & install; this page covers what the workflow feels like once you’re in.
kcsuadl.zh: ✅ 已开源(Apache-2.0)。完整安装命令见 下载与安装;本篇讲"上手后的工作流"长什么样。

k17gau89.zh: 装好依赖后,一条启动命令会拉起工作室,浏览器打开后你会看到两块区域:

kbitu7g.en: Left: chat — where you talk to Forge (the main agent);
kbitu7g.zh: 左边:对话区 —— 你和 Forge(主 agent)聊天的地方;

k2msytu.zh: 右边:预览区 —— 你的游戏实时运行的画面。

k10cmmun.zh: 不用写任何代码,直接对 Forge 说,比如:

khtt8fe.en: Make a top-down game: a character runs around an arena, space fires bullets, enemies keep spawning, hits remove them, keep score.
khtt8fe.zh:
做一个俯视角的小游戏:
一个角色在场地里跑,按空格发射子弹,
四周不断刷新敌人,打中就消失,记个分。

k1oggx6w.en: Forge clarifies the requirement, brings in sub-agents to plan and design when needed, then writes the engine code itself.
k1oggx6w.zh: Forge 会先把需求理清楚,必要时派子 agent 做规划与设计,然后自己编写引擎代码。

k4lsj4h.en: As soon as code is written it hot-reloads into the preview — almost as it's typed. Not happy? Just keep talking:
k4lsj4h.zh: 代码一写好,就会热重载到右侧预览 —— 几乎是边写边出现。你不满意就继续说:

k15fvlou.zh:
子弹再快一点,敌人血量加倍,
背景换成夜晚。

k1fid2rr.en: Every bit of feedback becomes another iteration. That's the ForgeaX loop: describe → generate → play → describe again.
k1fid2rr.zh: 每一句反馈都会变成一次新的迭代。这就是 ForgeaX 的基本循环:描述 → 生成 → 游玩 → 再描述。

k1awxm61.en: add motion and skills to characters (animation, spells);
k1awxm61.zh: 给角色加上动作与技能(动画、法术);

kwksr8p.en: generate art with the workbenches (portraits, 3D, VFX, music);
kwksr8p.zh: 用工作台生成美术资产(立绘、3D、特效、音乐);

kzaobz6.en: build multiple levels and balance the numbers.

ktuaiai.zh: 让你的 AI CLI 克隆并启动它

k17ohog.zh: 把仓库交给 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / forgeax CLI，让它自己 clone、装依赖、启动。

k1e0fxn0.zh: 快速开始 · 你的第一款游戏

kzgs5wg.zh: 认识工作室，对 Forge 说出第一个需求，看它规划、写代码、实时跑出来。

k1kqdn2s.en: Add motion and skills to a character
k1kqdn2s.zh: 给角色加上动作与技能

k5kqyvu.en: Import a character, wire up animation clips, add a fireball spell.
k5kqyvu.zh: 导入角色、配动画 clip、加一个会放火球的法术。

kboiyvb.zh: 用工作台生成美术资产

k16n90y1.en: Meet the creation workbenches — characters, animation, 3D, VFX, UI, music — from a sentence to game-ready assets.
k16n90y1.zh: 认识一整套创作工作台 —— 角色、动画、3D、特效、UI、音乐，从一句话到可进游戏的素材。

k1f5vrm5.zh: 做一部可玩的互动影游

kb8dr6l.en: Spark or script → anchors → storyboards → video → play-test, then ship a webpage anyone can play.
kb8dr6l.zh: 一句灵感 / 一部剧本 → 锚点 → 分镜 → 视频 → 试玩，再一键打包成谁都能玩的网页。

kh90p34.zh: 做一个多关卡的小游戏

kz9pzlk.en: Level switching, scene reuse, and balancing the numbers.
kz9pzlk.zh: 关卡切换、场景复用、数值调平衡。

k1814xvi.en: From a single spark or a whole script, build an interactive film-game driven by timed taps and branching choices — AI breaks down the story, locks in characters and locations, generates storyboards and video; you edit, play-test, and ship it as a webpage anyone opens and plays in a browser.
k1814xvi.zh: 给一句灵感或一整部剧本,做出"限时点按 + 选择决定走向"的互动影游 —— AI 帮你拆剧情、定下角色与场景、生成分镜与视频,你来剪辑、试玩,最后一键打包成谁都能在浏览器里打开就玩的网页。

kmpgt0b.en: ✅ Open source (Apache-2.0). Below is a full overview of the flow; for clone & install see the docs.
kmpgt0b.zh: ✅ 已开源(Apache-2.0)。下面是创作流程的完整概览;克隆与安装见 文档。

kku18mq.en: An interactive film-game is a short film you can play. Scenes flow as video and images, like watching a short drama — but at key moments a timed tap pops up, asking you to react within seconds; and at the end of a scene a choice branches the story toward a different next beat, all the way to different endings.
kku18mq.zh: 互动影游是"能玩的短片"。画面以视频和图片连续呈现,像看一部短剧;但在关键时刻,屏幕上会跳出限时点按——你得在几秒内做出反应;在一个场景结束时,又会给出选择,不同的选择把故事带向不同的下一幕,直到不同的结局。

k38jjd1.en: You assemble the story, visuals, beats and branches in the editor; what players get is a deterministic, replayable experience — the same choices follow the same path, a different choice unlocks new story.
k38jjd1.zh: 你在编辑器里把剧情、画面、节奏点和分支拼装好,玩家最终拿到的是一段确定性的、可反复游玩的体验:同样的选择走同样的路,换个选择就解锁新的剧情。

kgnx3xh.en: 💡 In one line: you shape the story, the pacing and the choices; AI handles the "shooting", the "editing", and turning it into something that plays in a browser.
kgnx3xh.zh: 💡 一句话:你负责把故事讲清楚、把节奏和选择设计好;AI 负责把它"拍"出来、"剪"顺、变成能在浏览器里玩的成品。

k60ghbh.en: Interactive shorts / multi-ending stories — let the audience decide the protagonist's next move; one story, several paths.
k60ghbh.zh: 互动短剧 / 多结局故事 —— 让观众自己决定主角的下一步,一个故事玩出好几条线。

k18v5hx2.en: Story-driven mini games — turn dialogue, suspense and timed reactions into light gameplay, no engine code required.
k18v5hx2.zh: 剧情向小游戏 —— 把对话、悬念和限时反应做成轻量玩法,不需要写一行引擎代码。

k2xp9u5.en: Teaching / demos / training — drill processes and decisions with "what if I pick this" branches — more engaging than plain video.
k2xp9u5.zh: 教学 / 演示 / 培训 —— 用"选了会怎样"的分支演练流程与决策,比纯视频更有参与感。

k83r4sg.en: Prototyping — build a playable rough cut in hours to validate story and feel before committing.
k83r4sg.zh: 原型与试水 —— 几小时内做出可玩的雏形,先验证故事和玩法,再决定是否深做。

kdtfs9l.en: From script to film, in five steps

kxvbk5m.en: ① Script: from a spark to a structured story
kxvbk5m.zh: ① 剧本:从一句灵感到结构化故事

k1sv01qf.en: Drop in a one-line spark, a synopsis, or a whole script. AI expands and structures it into acts, characters, relationships and scene-by-scene beats. Long story? Continue it episode by episode while keeping earlier setups consistent.
k1sv01qf.zh: 丢进一句灵感、一段梗概,或一整部剧本都行。AI 会把它扩写并结构化成分幕、角色、人物关系和逐场的详细剧情。故事太长也不怕——可以一集一集往下续,保持前后设定连贯。

kasgegh.en: ② Anchors: lock the look first
kasgegh.zh: ② 锚点:先定"长什么样"

kcn1ux8.en: The system auto-extracts characters, locations and key props (and their states and variants) so you can lock their look up front. Every later shot aligns to these anchors, so characters don't swap faces and locations don't drift — the key step for keeping the whole film consistent.
kcn1ux8.zh: 系统自动从剧本里抽出角色、场景、关键道具(以及它们的不同状态与变体),让你先把"长什么样"定下来。之后所有画面都对齐这些锚点,所以人物不会换脸、场景不会跑偏——这是保持整部片一致性的关键一步。

kt3mzy.en: ③ Story tree · storyboards: split the story into a playable tree
kt3mzy.zh: ③ 剧情树 · 分镜:把故事拆成一棵可玩的树

kbn8nh1.en: AI splits the story into a storyboard tree: each node is a shot with an auto-generated image. You arrange it freely — reorder and reshape, add branching choices (fork two or more paths after a node), and set timed taps on tense moments. The tree is every route a player can take.
kbn8nh1.zh: AI 把剧情拆成一棵分镜树:每个节点是一个镜头,自动生成对应画面。你在树上自由编排——调整顺序与结构、加入选择分支(在某个节点之后岔出两条以上的路)、给紧张时刻设上限时点按。整棵树就是玩家会经历的所有可能路线。

k12pb59k.en: ④ Generate video: bring shots to life
k12pb59k.zh: ④ 生成视频:让画面动起来

k1h5daf.en: Once the boards look right, turn shots from stills into video in one click. Reference images keep characters and locations consistent across shots; lines can be carried by a chosen voice. Everything lands on the timeline, aligned to dialogue and beats.
k1h5daf.zh: 分镜满意后,一键把镜头从静态画面生成视频。生成时可以带上参考图,让人物和场景在镜头里保持一致;台词可以配上选定的音色。所有素材统一落到时间轴上,和台词、节奏点对齐。

kujwew4.en: ⑤ Edit · play-test: fine-tune on the timeline, tweak as you play
kujwew4.zh: ⑤ 剪辑 · 试玩:在时间轴上精修,边玩边改

kk1v6zz.en: Fine-tune on a three-track timeline: align dialogue, place when taps appear, wire where branches lead. Flip to a full-screen play-test anytime and experience it like a real player — wherever the pacing drags, a tap is too hard, or a branch feels off, jump back, fix it, and play again.
kk1v6zz.zh: 在三轨时间轴上精修:对齐台词、安排点按出现的时刻、连接分支去向。随时切到"试玩"全屏,像真正的玩家一样体验一遍——哪里节奏拖了、哪个点按太难、哪条分支不通顺,回来就改,改完再玩。

ktodijl.zh: 三条轨道:台词 / 点按 / 分支

kwwl19r.en: A film-game's playability comes from three timeline tracks, each owning one job:
kwwl19r.zh: 影游的"可玩性"主要由时间轴上的三条轨道决定,它们各管一件事:

kjliugt.en: When each line shows and for how long, with a voice
kjliugt.zh: 每句话出现的时刻与时长,配上音色

kju37s.en: Keep subtitles in sync with picture and voice
kju37s.zh: 让字幕和画面、语音对齐,别抢戏

k1hqot6k.en: Timed reactions: tap within a window to succeed
k1hqot6k.zh: 限时反应:在窗口内点中算成功

k12uhi6v.en: Place at tension peaks; don't make the window brutal
k12uhi6v.zh: 放在紧张/动作的高点,窗口别太苛刻

kp5fjbi.en: Choices at scene end that decide the next beat
kp5fjbi.zh: 场景结尾给出选择,决定下一幕去向

k1vev6ba.en: Two or three options; make every choice matter
k1vev6ba.zh: 两到三个选项最好,让每个选择都有后果

k1q5j5xr.en: A few tips for better play
k1q5j5xr.zh: 设计得更好玩的几个要点

kl8zykn.en: Put choices where they count — ask players to decide at moments that truly change the story, not trivial forks.
kl8zykn.zh: 把选择放在有分量的地方 —— 让玩家在"真的会改变故事"的节点上做决定,而不是无关紧要的二选一。

k1eibv96.en: Taps serve emotion — drop timed taps on action, confrontation and suspense to amplify "I'm in it".
k1eibv96.zh: 点按服务于情绪 —— 在动作、对峙、悬念这些高点放限时点按,强化"我在参与"的感觉。

kcqe4zz.en: Mix diverging and converging — branches needn't stay fully separate; let some rejoin the main line to add variety while keeping scope sane.
kcqe4zz.zh: 分支收敛与发散并用 —— 不必每条线都全程独立,适当让几条线再汇回主线,既有变化又控制工作量。

kpfy0en.en: Short first, then long — get one shortest complete path working end-to-end, then layer on branches and endings.
kpfy0en.zh: 先短后长 —— 先做一条最短的完整线跑通体验,再往上加分支和结局。

kh14wn.en: Play-test often — walking it as a player usually surfaces issues faster than staring at the timeline.
kh14wn.zh: 多试玩 —— 自己当玩家走一遍,往往比反复看时间轴更能发现问题。

k1g8nlir.en: A finished film-game packages into one self-contained webpage: story, images, video, taps and branch logic all bundled in. Send it to anyone and it plays in any modern browser — no install, no GPU needed.
k1g8nlir.zh: 做好的影游可以一键打包成一个自包含的网页:剧情、图片、视频、点按与分支逻辑全都打进去。把它发给别人,在任意现代浏览器里打开就能玩——不用安装任何东西,也不挑显卡。

k13sb6th.en: Inside a project it's also saved and addressed as a standard game asset, so it can be reused, referenced, redistributed, or wired into a larger project.
k13sb6th.zh: 在工程里,它还会作为一份标准游戏资产被保存与寻址,因此可以被复用、被引用,也方便再分发或接入更大的项目。

krqnjrr.en: Do players need to install anything? No. The package is a webpage — open it in a browser, locally or hosted.
krqnjrr.zh: 玩家需要装东西吗? 不需要。打包出来就是一个网页,双击或托管后用浏览器打开即可。

k183hqz5.en: I can't shoot or edit — can I still use it? Yes. Just shape the story and the choices; generation and alignment are handled by AI and the timeline.
k183hqz5.zh: 我不会拍片、不会剪辑,能用吗? 能。你只要把故事和选择讲清楚,生成与对齐都交给 AI 和时间轴。

k8ezmjs.en: What about long stories? Fine — continue episode by episode, each aligned to the characters and locations you've already locked.
k8ezmjs.zh: 故事很长可以吗? 可以,按集续写,每集都对齐已定下的角色与场景锚点。

kvt3npd.en: Can I edit later? Yes. It's an addressable asset in your project — return to the editor, adjust, and repackage anytime.
kvt3npd.zh: 之后还能改吗? 能。它在工程里是可寻址的资产,随时回到编辑器调整后重新打包。

k1cpz147.en: Can't shoot or edit film? That's fine — tell the story, and AI turns it into a short film you can play.
k1cpz147.zh: 不会拍片、不会剪辑也没关系 —— 把故事讲出来,AI 帮你把它变成一部能玩的短片。

k17a7xgo.en: Beyond chatting, ForgeaX has a set of "workbenches" — each a panel plus a group of tools that turn a sentence into game-ready assets. You by hand and AI by dispatch edit the same artifact.
k17a7xgo.zh: 除了对话,ForgeaX 还有一整套"工作台" —— 每个工作台是一个面板 + 一组工具,把一句话变成可进游戏的素材。你手点和 AI 派活,改的是同一份产物。

k189lrnw.en: ✅ Open source (Apache-2.0). Below is an overview of the workbench system; for clone & install see the docs.
k189lrnw.zh: ✅ 已开源(Apache-2.0)。下面是工作台体系的概览;克隆与安装见 文档。

kh2jscz.zh: 角色 · 动画 · 特效

k1ekhig4.en: Character editor — write a one-line brief, get a portrait plus a turnaround.
k1ekhig4.zh: 角色编辑器 —— 写一句人物设定,得到正面立绘 + 转身三视图。

k1s4rbyj.en: Animation — turn a still character into walking, attacking, four-direction, skeletal motion (even short clips) — without face drift.
k1s4rbyj.zh: 动画 —— 把静止角色变成会走、会打、四方向、带骨骼动作,甚至短视频;不串脸。

kxh4cwg.en: Skill / VFX — add effects like fire, slashes and auras, auto-attached to the moment of cast.
kxh4cwg.zh: 技能 / VFX —— 给技能配火光、刀光、光环等特效,自动挂到出手那一刻。

k1b25hh0.en: Blocky-character editor — build rigged 3D characters like snapping blocks, export standard 3D files.
k1b25hh0.zh: 方块人编辑器 —— 像捏积木小人一样做可动 3D 角色,一键导出标准 3D 文件。

k1uczl2i.en: Low-poly generator — build 3D props with a node-graph; change one parameter, regenerate the set.
k1uczl2i.zh: 低多边形生成器 —— 用"连线搭积木"的节点方式做 3D 道具 / 机械,改一个参数全套重出。

k1bmb5k7.en: 3D generation — text or image straight to a 3D model, plugged into several top generators, pick whichever's best.
k1bmb5k7.zh: 3D 生成 —— 文字 / 图片直接变 3D 模型,接入多家最强生成服务,择优而用。

kfyj6iv.en: Scene generator — assemble a whole game scene as a graph you can re-run anytime.
kfyj6iv.zh: 场景生成器 —— 自动"搭"出一整张游戏场景,做成流程图,想改随时重跑。

kablt88.en: 2D scene-asset generator — batch props, textures, decorations and UI bits, auto-named and filed.
kablt88.zh: 2D 场景资产生成器 —— 批量生成道具、贴图、装饰、UI 小图,自动起名归档。

k9u4vfi.en: UI workbench — a UI set for your game type — not just images, a clickable prototype.
k9u4vfi.zh: UI 工坊 —— 按你的游戏类型出一套界面,不只是图,是能点的交互原型。

kjeoy8b.en: Items / icons — weapons, potions, coins as icons with their data, art and numbers in one table.
kjeoy8b.zh: 道具 / 图标 —— 做武器、药水、金币等图标,还配上数据,图与数据一张表。

k1b5rv6e.zh: 叙事 · 音乐 · 调色 · 数值

kx2fs6q.en: Narrative workbench — from a spark to a full story and world, with the AI picking a fitting approach.
kx2fs6q.zh: 叙事工坊 —— 从一句灵感写出整套剧情和世界观,AI 自动选最合适的写法。

k1ffhhuc.en: Music / BGM — manage background music and sound effects, sequencing a whole session's score.
k1ffhhuc.zh: 音乐 / BGM —— 管理背景音乐与音效,排好整局的配乐节奏。

k800j3a.en: Color / Look — unify the whole game's color mood in one click, like a filter over everything.
k800j3a.zh: 色彩 / Look —— 一键统一全游戏的色调氛围,像给画面套滤镜。

k3rox8s.en: Balance — have AI play thousands of matches and report win rates with confidence intervals; let data judge the tuning.
k3rox8s.zh: 平衡 / 数值 —— 让 AI 反复打几千局,给出胜率与置信区间,数值好不好用数据说话。

k1k2010j.en: Code — browse code, jump between files, and edit alongside the coding AI.
k1k2010j.zh: 代码 —— 在工作台里看代码、跳转文件,和写代码的 AI 一起改。

kvp3nz7.en: Observatory — replay every step the AI took, like a black box, to pinpoint where things went wrong.
kvp3nz7.zh: 轨迹观察台 —— 像黑匣子一样回放 AI 每一步,精确定位是哪一步出的问题。

kiu3jqg.en: Plugin author — let non-coders build their own workbench plugins.
kiu3jqg.zh: 插件作者 —— 让不会编程的人也能做出自己的工作台插件。

k13bpjwb.en: Admin — the studio control panel: toggle workbenches, bind models, see which AIs are online.
k13bpjwb.zh: 面板管理 —— 工作室总控台:开关工作台、绑模型、看各家 AI 是否在线。

k1gf79wh.en: Can't draw, model or compose? That's fine — describe it, and the workbenches produce assets that drop straight into your game.
k1gf79wh.zh: 不会画画、不会建模、不会作曲也没关系 —— 描述出来,工作台帮你做出能直接进游戏的素材。

k14oici0.en: An AI-native personal game studio — turn ideas into playable games. Open source, Apache License 2.0.
k14oici0.zh: AI 原生的个人游戏工作室 —— 把想法变成可玩的游戏。开源,Apache License 2.0。

kqll73z.en: Arin is ForgeaX's all-round game-producer agent, acting as the orchestrator. She covers design, code, art and audio end to end, and is at her best when you only have a fuzzy idea — walking you from there to a shipped, playable game. Her style is a gentle companion: affirm what you got right first, then softly point out what to improve, with a built-in gentle-debug skill that treats bugs as lost little ones to bring home.
kqll73z.zh: Arin 是 ForgeaX 的全能游戏制作人 Agent,担任统筹编排(orchestrator)角色。她把策划、程序、美术、音效全栈一肩挑,擅长在你只有一句模糊想法时陪你一步步理清、再落地成可玩的游戏。风格温柔陪伴式——先肯定你做对的部分,再轻声指出可改之处,自带「陪伴式 debug」技能,把 bug 当迷路的小家伙一起找回家。

k7byus9.en: First release: producer persona + gentle-debug skill
k7byus9.zh: 首版:制作人人设 + 陪伴式 debug 技能

k11l8vvv.en: Persona fleshed out + long-term memory diary view
k11l8vvv.zh: 补全人设 + 长期记忆日记视图

k1i69m2o.en: Reia is ForgeaX's interactive FMV director agent (the reel-director role). She turns a one-line idea into a playable Scenario JSON — video/keyframes, dialogue, QTE pacing, choice branches and multiple endings — and drives the wb-reel Reel Studio end to end, pressing generate herself until it runs. Calm and professional, storyboard-first: structure before flesh, storyboard before video. She can borrow Kotone's narrative pipeline for early writing; long 94-category branching scripts are not her lane.
k1i69m2o.zh: Reia 是互动影游 (FMV) 导演 Agent,担任 reel-director 角色。她把作者一句 idea 落成可玩的 Scenario JSON——视频/关键帧、对话、QTE 节拍、选项分支、多结局,并亲手驱动 wb-reel「影游工坊」端到端跑完。风格克制专业、像过故事板;先排场景骨架再填血肉,分镜先行、你来按生成键。可借力 Kotone 的叙事管线做前期文字,长篇 94 品类剧本不归她。

kvr0krw.en: First release: reel-director persona + wb-reel tool wiring
kvr0krw.zh: 首版:影游导演人设 + wb-reel 工具对接

krlah6s.en: Video loop closed: reel:generate-video requires sceneId; workbench browser pipeline persists output
krlah6s.zh: 视频生成闭环:reel:generate-video 必须带 sceneId,工坊浏览器管线落盘

k1uupl98.en: Storyboard-first + produce-node pipeline + narrative import path
k1uupl98.zh: 分镜先行 + produce-node 逐节点生产线 + 叙事导入路径

k12o63wc.en: Iori is the core gameplay-pillar agent (the 'pillar' role) — the source of how a game actually plays. She turns a one-line vision into reverse-definable gameplay pillars plus a 3-tier core loop and numeric skeleton, deciding how the loop turns and how punishment/reward flow. She designs only — no code, no art — emitting pillars / spec / balance / loop markdown for cc-coder and tsumugi to build.
k12o63wc.zh: Iori 是核心玩法师 Agent,担任玩法柱(pillar)角色,是一款游戏「怎么玩」的源头。她把一句话愿景拆成可反向定义的三条玩法柱 + 三层核心循环与数值骨架,决定循环怎么转、惩罚与奖赏怎么发。她只做设计、不写代码也不画图,产出 pillars / spec / balance / loop 等白底文件,交给 cc-coder、tsumugi 去落地。

k127nf01.en: First release: gameplay pillars + design-pillars skill
k127nf01.zh: 首版:玩法柱 + 拆玩法柱技能

k13omep9.en: Suzu is the experience designer (the 'design' role). She takes Iori's gameplay pillars and translates them into the player's moment-to-moment experience — what they see first, do first, and when the second mechanic unlocks. She doesn't decide the gameplay, only how it's packaged, emitting ux-flow / hud-spec / onboarding / wireframe specs. Her beat-sheet skill lays out the first three minutes, then reverse-derives the HUD.
k13omep9.zh: Suzu 是体验设计师 Agent,担任设计(design)角色。她接住 Iori 的玩法柱,把它翻译成玩家可感知的体验节拍——玩家先看到什么、先做什么、到第几秒解锁第二个机制。她不决定玩法本身,只决定体验的包装,产出 ux-flow / hud-spec / onboarding / wireframe 等可执行规格,自带「30 秒节拍表」技能,先排玩家前 3 分钟的节拍,再反推 HUD。

k1pcwfjx.en: First release: UX persona + beat-sheet skill
k1pcwfjx.zh: 首版:体验设计人设 + 30 秒节拍表技能

k18m238r.en: Kotone is the narrative writer (the 'narrative' role). She pairs Iori's gameplay tempo with emotional motivation — why the protagonist does what they do — owning the world, character bios, key plot beats and line-level dialogue (with i18n keys). Every beat hangs on a concrete gameplay trigger (a monologue unlocks only after the third boss), and she refuses cheap bloodline/talent backstory, emitting narrative / world / characters / dialogue files.
k18m238r.zh: Kotone 是剧情师 Agent,担任叙事(narrative)角色。她把 Iori 的玩法节奏配上「主角为什么要做这件事」的情感线,负责世界观、角色 bio、关键剧情节点与 line-level 对白(含 i18n key)。每个剧情节点都挂在具体玩法触发上(打到第三只 boss 才解锁这段独白),拒绝靠血统/天赋开后门的廉价 backstory,产出 narrative / world / characters / dialogue 文件。

kw92jvq.en: First release: narrative persona + write-character-bio skill
kw92jvq.zh: 首版:剧情师人设 + 写角色 bio 技能

k1yr6w9d.en: Iro is the art director (the 'art' role), and can run multiple instances in parallel. Taking Iori's gameplay, Kotone's bios and Suzu's hud-spec, it first locks an art-style.md + tokenized palette, then produces actual png / svg / glb assets — portraits, pixel sprites, lowpoly OBJ, VFX, icons. Colors are tokens (hero-low-hp, boss-cooldown) rather than scattered hex, keeping global visual consistency so any screenshot is instantly recognizable as the same game.
k1yr6w9d.zh: Iro 是美术师 Agent,担任美术(art)角色,可多实例并行出图。她接住 Iori 的玩法、Kotone 的角色 bio、Suzu 的 hud-spec,先定 art-style.md + token 化 palette,再产出立绘、像素 sprite、lowpoly OBJ、VFX、icon 等实际 png / svg / glb 素材。配色给 token(hero-low-hp、boss-cooldown)而非散落 hex,保证全局视觉一致——玩家截图发出去同事一眼认出是同一款游戏。

k1vliua0.en: First release: art persona + establish-art-style skill
k1vliua0.zh: 首版:美术人设 + 立美术规范技能

k13zo6va.en: cc-coder is the generic coding agent (the 'coder' role), running multiple instances in parallel across packages. It takes Iori's gameplay skeleton, Suzu's UX flows and Kotone's narrative outlines and turns acceptance-bearing specs into runnable TypeScript / React / Go / Python — one small granule at a time (≤200-line diff) with ≥5 unit tests each, refusing --no-verify / --force / skipping hooks. Defaults to the claude-code CLI backend.
k13zo6va.zh: cc-coder 是通用编码 Agent,担任编码(coder)角色,可多实例并行写不同子包。它接住 Iori 的玩法骨架、Suzu 的体验流程、Kotone 的剧情大纲,把带验收条件的 spec 一颗粒一颗粒落成可运行的 TypeScript / React / Go / Python 代码,每次只动一颗(≤200 行 diff)并配 ≥5 个单测,拒绝 --no-verify / --force / 跳 hook。默认走 claude-code CLI 后端。

ke8s6yq.en: First release: coding persona + implement-feature skill
ke8s6yq.zh: 首版:通用编码人设 + 落地 spec 技能

kvlrnw7.en: Tsumugi is the engineer (the engineering role), owning whether the repo can build, run fast and ship — build chain, CI, toolchains, perf tuning and the ship gate. Unlike cc-coder it writes no feature code, only engineering. It records a baseline (bundle size / build time / FPS) before touching build config and can always answer 'what if we roll this back', emitting configs / workflows / perf-reports, with a ship-gate skill (typecheck/unit/lint/bundle/perf must all pass).
kvlrnw7.zh: Tsumugi 是工程师 Agent,担任工程角色,专管「仓库本身能不能跑、跑得快不快、能不能上线」——构建链、CI、工具链、性能调优、上线 gate。它和 cc-coder 不同:不写业务代码,只对工程负责。改 build config 前先记录基线(bundle size / build time / FPS),每个改动都答得出「回滚会怎样」,产出 *.config / workflows / perf-report,自带「上线 gate」技能(typecheck/单测/lint/bundle/perf 全绿才放行)。

k1qh6k2t.en: First release: engineer persona + ship-gate skill
k1qh6k2t.zh: 首版:工程师人设 + 上线 gate 技能

km01cd9.en: Yevi is the code- and design-review agent (the reviewer role). She runs a three-layer risk sweep — today's bugs, matured tech debt, and hazards that only bite at scale — soft in tone but surgical in content, using reverse questions to make you realize the issue rather than dictating it. With a long memory, she'll note 'that TODO you left three weeks ago is still here'. She reviews only — no coding, no CI — emitting review-notes and risk-report.
km01cd9.zh: 夜薇(Yevi)是代码 / 方案审查 Agent,担任审查(reviewer)角色。她做三层风险扫描——眼前的 bug、熟透的技术债、远期扩容才会爆的隐患;语气轻柔带笑意,内容却精准如手术刀,用反向提问让你自己想明白,而不是直接下定论。她记性极好,会顺手提醒「你三周前埋的那个 TODO 还在」。只做上线前把关,不写代码也不跑 CI,产出 review-notes 与 risk-report。

kixrhau.en: First release: reviewer persona + quiet-review skill
kixrhau.zh: 首版:审查人设 + 冷静审查技能

k1czicwp.en: The character editor workbench — a Three.js multi-pipeline character generator. It splits a character from concept to motion across pipelines: 4-direction pixel sprite sheets, Spine rig binding + animation, video turnaround → frames, skill VFX with game-feel (hit flashes, damage numbers), and 8-direction / 5-animation monster generation. With AI image and video generation, it outputs a manifest + portrait / turnaround / spritesheet that feed straight into the Animation workbench.
k1czicwp.zh: 角色编辑器工作台,基于 Three.js 的多管线角色生成器。它把角色从概念到能动起来分成多条管线:像素角色四方向序列帧、Spine 骨骼拆件绑骨与动画、视频角色三视图→序列帧、技能 VFX 与打击感(挂点 / 受击白闪 / 伤害飘字)、八方向五动画的怪物生成。集成 AI 图像与视频生成,产出 manifest + portrait / turnaround / spritesheet,下游直接接入动画工作台。

k1wojas6.zh: 首版:多管线角色生成器

ktcpddc.en: The animation workbench — a one-stop台 for making characters and objects move. It ships six generators: 4-direction pixel walk cycles, sprite-sheets, vehicle animation, monster sprites, Spine rig binding, and AI video via Kling. Embedded in Studio as an iframe with a live center-viewport preview, it outputs engine-ready animation assets and typically follows the character editor.
ktcpddc.zh: 动画工作台,把角色与物件「动起来」的一站式生成台。内置六条生成管线:像素角色四方向行走、序列帧 spritesheet、载具动画、怪物精灵、Spine 骨骼绑定,以及经 Kling 的 AI 视频生成。它以 iframe 嵌入 Studio,中间视口实时预览生成结果,产出可直接被引擎消费的动画资产,常接在角色编辑器之后做动作。

k1hoaej8.zh: 管线打磨与视频生成完善

kg06rst.en: The skill & VFX workbench, managing a game's skills and effects. It browses the game's skills/* and vfx/* files, previews effects live in a built-in VFX engine, and generates new ones via skill:generate-vfx. Players tweak by hand in the panel while AI dispatch edits the same shared skill spec, so the skill tree and game-feel effects are edited in one place, WYSIWYG.
kg06rst.zh: 技能 / VFX 工作台,管理一款游戏的技能与特效产出。它浏览游戏里的 skills/* 与 vfx/* 文件,内置一套 VFX 引擎实时预览特效效果,并用 skill:generate-vfx 生成新特效。玩家在面板里手点调整,与 AI dispatch 共改同一份 skill spec,做到技能树与打击感特效一处编辑、所见即所得。

k184p87c.zh: 首版:技能 / VFX 工作台

k16ajsnb.en: A lowpoly humanoid 3D character editor for animatable parametric block humanoids. The source is a LowPolySource JSON (joints + part geometry + animation clips) as the single source of truth; it supports vibe natural-language authoring/editing and Blender-style gizmo manual editing (part select + G/R/S axis lock + mirror + snapping), with a third-person playground to test rig animation via WASD. three.js live preview, baking to engine-neutral .glb (with skeleton+anim) / .obj, with Mixamo-compatible bone naming.
k16ajsnb.zh: 方块人 3D 角色编辑器,做可动的参数化低多边形人形。源数据是 LowPolySource JSON(关节绑骨 + 部件几何 + 动画 clip)且作为唯一 SSOT;支持 vibe 自然语言生成/修改角色,以及 Blender 风 gizmo 手编(选件 + G/R/S 轴锁 + 镜像 + 捕捉),内置第三人称 Playground 用 WASD 验证骨骼动画。three.js 实时预览,烘焙为引擎中立的 .glb(含骨骼动画)/ .obj,骨架命名兼容 Mixamo。

k1b3pt78.zh: 首版:参数化方块人编辑器

k1bdnmw6.en: The 3D Lowpoly Generator workbench — a node-graph programming app built on @forgeax/node-runtime. You build parametric low-poly geometry through a node pipeline, bake meshes with OCCT / replicad on the backend, preview live in three.js / URDF on the front end, and export .glb. It turns 'modeling' into a reusable, batchable node graph; AI can orchestrate via pipeline tools (applyBatch / execute / import / export), with project management, a built-in parts library (batteries) and screenshots.
k1bdnmw6.zh: 3D 低多边形生成器工作台,基于 @forgeax/node-runtime 的节点图编程应用。你用节点管线参数化地生成 low-poly 几何,经 OCCT / replicad 在后端烘焙网格,前端用 three.js / URDF 实时预览,最终导出 .glb。它把「建模」变成可复用、可批处理的节点图,AI 可经 pipeline 工具(applyBatch / execute / import / export)批量编排,也支持项目管理、内置零件库(batteries)与截图。

k1kh3g2u.zh: 首版:节点式 3D 低多边形生成器

kop2yid.en: The 3D character generation workbench — a one-stop entry to providers like Hunyuan3D and Meshy. It supports text-to-3D, image-to-3D and multi-view-to-3D, then mesh refine + lowpoly retopo, auto-rig + motion application, and quality scoring, finally producing durable, game-ready 3D asset manifests. Pick a provider, give input, and it carries through from generation to rigging.
kop2yid.zh: 3D 角色生成工作台,接 Hunyuan3D、Meshy 等 provider 的一站式 3D 资产生成入口。支持文本生成 3D、图片生成 3D、多视图生成 3D,再做网格精修与 retopo 低模、自动绑骨与套用动作、质量评分,最后产出可持久化、游戏可直接用的 3D 资产 manifest。选 provider、给输入,剩下的从生成到绑骨一条龙。

kbw3ypc.zh: 首版:3D 角色生成入口

k1l53no6.en: The 2D Scene Asset Generator workbench — a node-graph programming app on @forgeax/node-runtime + node-runtime-react. You batch-generate 2D scene assets through a node pipeline plus templates, produce images via AI generation nodes, preview live, manage a versioned asset library, instantiate groups from templates and publish to a game in one click. It turns ad-hoc 'generate an image' into a reusable, batchable, traceable 2D asset pipeline.
k1l53no6.zh: 2D 场景资产生成器工作台,基于 @forgeax/node-runtime + node-runtime-react 的节点图编程应用。你用节点管线加模板批量生成 2D 场景资产,经 AI 生图节点出图,实时预览生成结果,管理版本化的资产库,并能从模板实例化分组、一键发布到游戏。它把零散的「生成一张图」整合成可复用、可批处理、可追溯的 2D 资产流水线。

k17s6urn.en: First release: node-based 2D scene asset generator
k17s6urn.zh: 首版:节点式 2D 场景资产生成器

ko20a9l.en: The Scene Generator workbench — a node-graph programming app on @forgeax/node-runtime. You build whole game scenes through a node pipeline plus templates, reuse the game's existing texture library, preview in a layered renderer (layers, view modes, sub-layer expansion), and capture screenshots or publish externally. It turns scene-building into a reusable, batchable node graph; AI can orchestrate via pipeline tools, ideal for quickly producing style-consistent scenes.
ko20a9l.zh: 场景生成器工作台,基于 @forgeax/node-runtime 的节点图编程应用。你用节点管线加模板生成完整游戏场景,可复用游戏已有的纹理库,在多层渲染器里预览(支持分层、视图模式、子图层展开),并能截图与对外发布。它把搭场景变成可复用、可批处理的节点图,AI 可经 pipeline 工具批量编排,适合快速产出风格一致的场景。

k64kv7h.zh: 首版:节点式场景生成器

k2b4apy.en: The UI Workshop workbench — generate UI by game genre, screen flow and visual style. It validates UI module/layout combinations, generates component assets via Gemini image, previews HUD / menu / shop / dialog / result screens, and exports an interactive prototype preview. Visuals align to ForgeaX's main design-system tokens and motion; embedded in Studio the host tokens drive the final look so generated UI matches the product.
k2b4apy.zh: UI 工坊工作台,按游戏类型、界面流程与视觉风格生成 UI。它校验 UI 模块/布局组合,经 Gemini 生图产出 UI 组件素材,预览 HUD、菜单、商店、对话、结算等游戏界面,并导出可交互的原型预览。视觉对齐 ForgeaX 主设计系统的 token 与 motion,嵌入 Studio 时由宿主 token 驱动最终风格,保证生成的界面与产品一致。

k1z0kitt.en: Items & icons workbench (planned). The goal is to edit a game's items.json and pixel icons inside Studio and wire up 2D side-scroller / tileable / AI-pixel generation pipelines, managing item data and icon assets in one place, WYSIWYG. It is currently a marketplace placeholder: the manifest and entry are in place, with the real React panel scheduled for a later sprint to replace the shim.
k1z0kitt.zh: 道具 / 图标工作台(规划中)。目标是在 Studio 内编辑一款游戏的 items.json 与像素 icon,并接上 2D 侧滚 / 可平铺 / AI 像素的生图链路,做到道具数据与图标素材一处管理、所见即所得。当前为 marketplace 占位:插件清单与入口已就位,真正的 React 面板实现安排在后续 sprint,届时替换占位 shim。

k12awid4.en: Color & look-dev workbench (planned). The goal is to manage a game's global color centrally: colorgrade.toml grading, a theme.json, and a postprocess stack (palette + LUT + postprocess), making the look tunable and reusable, with 2D style-transfer and 3D LookMaster to follow. Currently a marketplace placeholder: manifest and entry are in place, with the real panel scheduled for a later sprint.
k12awid4.zh: 色彩 / Look-dev 工作台(规划中)。目标是统一管理一款游戏的全局色调:colorgrade.toml 调色、theme.json 主题、后处理栈(palette + LUT + 后处理),让画面风格可集中调、可复用,并接 2D 风格迁移与 3D LookMaster。当前为 marketplace 占位:清单与入口就位,真实面板安排在后续 sprint 落地。

krxhn4z.en: The BGM & SFX workbench — a local audio asset library plus an attach-to-game tool. You search and preview BGM and SFX from the library, then attach a pick to the current game in one click: the file downloads into .forgeax/games/<slug>/audio/ and is upserted into audio/manifest.json, which the engine plays from. It folds 'find the right music/SFX and wire it into the game' into one panel — search, listen, attach in one go.
krxhn4z.zh: BGM / 音效工作台,一个本地的音频素材库 + 配入游戏的工具。你搜索、试听音频素材库里的 BGM 与音效,选中后一键配入当前游戏:文件下载到 .forgeax/games/<slug>/audio/ 并写入(upsert)audio/manifest.json,引擎据 manifest 播放。它把「找一段合适的音乐/音效并接进游戏」这件事收进一个面板,搜、听、配一气呵成。

k1bvj6y3.en: The Narrative Studio workbench — an AI-driven game-narrative generation pipeline. Using two-layer Tier + Mode routing plus a dynamic planner, it adapts narrative depth per genre across 117 genres, 9 pipeline templates, 29 execution modes and 6 narrative archetypes, generating a full world→characters→plot→dialogue narrative. It offers a story-tree view, per-step regeneration, run-status tracking and result export, and connects its output to Kotone's narrative artifacts.
k1bvj6y3.zh: 叙事工坊工作台,AI 驱动的游戏叙事内容生成管线。它用 Tier + Mode 双层路由 + Planner 动态选步,自动适配不同品类的叙事深度,覆盖 117 个品类、9 种管线模板、29 种执行模式、6 种叙事原型,生成世界观→角色→剧情→对白的完整叙事。可视化故事树、单步重新生成、查看运行状态与导出结果,并能把产出对接到 Kotone 的剧情产物。

kna22d2.zh: 双层路由与可视化完善

k1iyvcsn.en: The Reel Studio workbench — an author-facing interactive FMV editor and player. Authors assemble prompts, video, shots, dialogue, QTE and branch trees into a playable interactive movie: Opus / Gemini forge画面 prompts, GPT-Image makes placeholder keyframes, Seedance generates video. Editor-time data is 100% serializable to a Scenario JSON; runtime is deterministic playback driven by timed taps (QTE) and choice branches, producing a distributable scenario + playable runtime.
k1iyvcsn.zh: 影游工坊工作台,作者向的互动影游(FMV)编辑器与运行时。作者把提示词、视频、镜头、台词、QTE 与剧情分支拼成可玩的互动影片:用 Opus / Gemini 锻造画面提示词、GPT-Image 出占位关键帧、Seedance 生成视频。编辑期数据 100% 可序列化为 Scenario JSON,运行期是确定性回放,由限时点按(QTE)与选项分支驱动,产出可分发的剧本 + 试玩运行时。

k1mz0bgh.en: First release: interactive FMV editor + runtime
k1mz0bgh.zh: 首版:互动影游编辑器 + 运行时

k1iohphj.en: Balance & sim workbench (planned). The goal is a visual loop for numeric tuning: call the balance:resim tool to run N resimulations of a scenario, show win-rate and a 95% CI on a dashboard, then let the player tweak stats and re-run until balanced. Currently a marketplace placeholder: the tool (tool-balance-resim) already works; the workbench panel is scheduled for a later sprint.
k1iohphj.zh: 平衡 / 数值工作台(规划中)。目标是给数值调优做一个可视化闭环:调用 balance:resim 工具对场景跑 N 次重模拟,在 dashboard 上显示胜率与 95% 置信区间,玩家据此手调数值、再跑一轮,直到平衡。当前为 marketplace 占位:工具(tool-balance-resim)已可用,工作台面板实现安排在后续 sprint。

k1nk2w71.en: Code workbench (planned). The goal is to upgrade the existing MainArea code view into a standalone plugin: browse and jump through a game's src/ files inside Studio and collaborate with cc-coder across chat threads, so 'reading code' and 'having AI change code' meet in one panel. Currently a marketplace placeholder: manifest and entry are in place, with the real panel scheduled for a later sprint.
k1nk2w71.zh: 代码工作台(规划中)。目标是把现有的 MainArea 代码视图升级成独立插件:在 Studio 内浏览、跳转一款游戏的 src/ 文件,并与 cc-coder 跨对话线程协作改代码,让「看代码」和「让 AI 改代码」在同一个面板里衔接。当前为 marketplace 占位:清单与入口就位,真实面板实现安排在后续 sprint。

kmqzmfp.en: The Observatory workbench makes a single agent run visible. Using reactflow it renders a session as a graph of session-root → each turn → tool / sub-agent nodes, with a live SSE tail and offline replay; it also slices the composed system prompt into inspectable modules with token estimates, aiding context / skill / guardrail / cache management. It is a read-only observer that passively consumes the host observatory endpoints.
kmqzmfp.zh: Observatory 轨迹观察台工作台,把一次 agent 运行变得可见。它用 reactflow 把会话画成 session-root → 每一回合 turn → tool / 子 agent 的节点图,支持实时(SSE)跟随与离线回放;同时把拼好的 system prompt 切成可检视的模块切片并给出 token 估算,辅助上下文、skill、护栏与 cache 管理。它是被动消费宿主 observatory 端点的只读观测工具。

k18m45w3.en: The Agent Persona Editor — tune each agent's persona right inside Studio. Pick an agent from the left list, edit its persona/zh.md in the right textarea, and save with hot-reload so changes apply instantly — adjust an agent's tone, duties and behavioral bounds without a restart. Great for fine-tuning the built-in agents (Arin/Iori/Suzu…) or polishing a custom one.
k18m45w3.zh: Agent Persona 编辑器,在 Studio 内直接调每个 agent 的人设。左侧列表选 agent,右侧文本区编辑它的 persona/zh.md,保存后热重载即时生效——不用重启就能改 agent 的语气、职责与行为边界。适合微调 Arin/Iori/Suzu 等内置 agent,或给自定义 agent 打磨人设。

k1f3rs5y.zh: 首版:persona 编辑 + 热重载

k1rvrhgs.en: The Plugin Author workbench — an in-app visual editor for local plugins. It reads and writes L2 plugins under .forgeax/plugins/<slug>/: a file tree on the left, a text editor on the right; saving writes back and hot-reloads the plugin registry in the background so changes apply at once. Paired with fork and record-as-skill to create new plugins, it lets non-engineers author, edit and ship plugins in-app.
k1rvrhgs.zh: 插件作者工作台,在 Studio 内编辑本地插件的可视化编辑器。它读写 .forgeax/plugins/<slug>/ 下的 L2 插件:左侧是文件树,右侧是文本编辑器,保存即写回并在后台热重载插件注册表,改完立刻生效。配合 fork 与 record-as-skill 创建新插件,让非工程师也能在应用内做、改、上自己的插件。

kqey6lk.zh: 落地真实文件树 + 编辑器面板

k18vord3.en: The Admin workbench — Studio's settings hub. It has four sections: workbench enable/order, multi-modal model bindings, cli-provider auth health, and marketplace plugin counts, all kept in sync with the SettingsPanel sections registry — toggle/reorder workbenches, bind models per channel, check CLI-backend auth status, and see how many plugins are installed.
k18vord3.zh: 面板管理工作台,是 Studio 的设置中枢。它有四个区:工作台启用与排序、多模态模型绑定、cli-provider 认证健康、marketplace 插件计数,四块都与设置面板(SettingsPanel)的 sections registry 保持同源——在这里开关/排序工作台、绑定各通道的模型、检查 CLI 后端认证状态、查看已装插件数量。

k123iw8l.en: Wires Anthropic's claude-code CLI in as a ForgeaX Studio reasoning backend. The plugin declares the capability list + Bus entry; the runner spawns `claude --mode stream` and bridges ChatEvent streams onto the internal bus, with streaming, thinking, tool calls, sub-agents and session resume. Once authenticated and selected in Admin, every agent's reasoning routes through it.
k123iw8l.zh: 把 Anthropic 的 claude-code CLI 接成 ForgeaX Studio 的推理后端。插件声明能力清单与 Bus 入口,实际 runner spawn `claude --mode stream` 子进程,把 ChatEvent 流桥接到内部消息总线;支持流式输出、思考过程、工具调用、子 agent 与会话续接。在面板管理里认证并选用后,所有 agent 的推理请求都走它。

k1tzzpwf.en: Wires OpenAI's codex CLI (@openai/codex) in as a ForgeaX Studio reasoning backend. The runner spawns `codex exec --json` and bridges ChatEvent streams onto the bus, with streaming, thinking, tool calls, sub-agents and sessions. Once authenticated and selected in Admin, agents reason through codex — handy for driving the dev loop with the GPT-5 family.
k1tzzpwf.zh: 把 OpenAI 的 codex CLI(@openai/codex)接成 ForgeaX Studio 的推理后端。runner spawn `codex exec --json` 子进程,把 ChatEvent 流桥接到消息总线;支持流式、思考、工具调用、子 agent 与会话。在面板管理认证并选用后,所有 agent 的推理走 codex 后端,适合想用 GPT-5 系列模型驱动开发循环的场景。

k1kdri2.en: Wires Cursor IDE's cursor-agent CLI in as a ForgeaX Studio reasoning backend. The runner spawns it in print mode (`cursor-agent -p --output-format stream-json --stream-partial-output -f`) and bridges partial output onto the bus, with streaming, thinking, tool calls, sub-agents and sessions. Once selected, agents reason through cursor-agent across auto / sonnet / gpt-5.
k1kdri2.zh: 把 Cursor IDE 的 cursor-agent CLI 接成 ForgeaX Studio 的推理后端。runner 以 print 模式 spawn `cursor-agent -p --output-format stream-json --stream-partial-output -f`,把部分输出流式桥接到消息总线;支持流式、思考、工具调用、子 agent 与会话。认证选用后所有 agent 推理走 cursor-agent,可在 auto / sonnet / gpt-5 间切换。

kpoln5m.en: Wires the in-repo forgeax command (packages/cli) in as ForgeaX Studio's native reasoning backend. The runner spawns `forgeax chat --stream` and bridges ChatEvent streams onto the bus, with streaming, thinking, tool calls, sub-agents and sessions. It is the built-in backend that needs no external CLI — works out of the box on a fresh machine and backs first-run onboarding.
kpoln5m.zh: 把仓库内置的 forgeax 命令(packages/cli)接成 ForgeaX Studio 的原生推理后端。runner spawn `forgeax chat --stream` 子进程,把 ChatEvent 流桥接到消息总线;支持流式、思考、工具调用、子 agent 与会话。它是「无需外部 CLI」的内置后端,新机器开箱即用,首次启动的默认引导也走它。

k1wcy7jw.en: First release: native forgeax backend adapter
k1wcy7jw.zh: 首版:内置 forgeax 后端适配

kmhyjjl.en: The plugin-author guide skill. Type /author-plugin in chat and it walks a non-TypeScript user, in about ten minutes, to their first server-loadable plugin: a schema-valid forgeax-plugin.json, a minimal runnable hello tool, and a reload-and-verify step that hot-loads it. Every step states which file to edit, what to write, and how to know it worked.
kmhyjjl.zh: 插件作者向导技能。在对话里输入 /author-plugin 触发,手把手带不会 TypeScript 的玩家在大约 10 分钟内做出第一个能被 forgeax-server 加载的插件:一个过 schema 的 forgeax-plugin.json、一个最小可运行的 hello tool,以及一份把插件热加载进去的 reload + 验证脚本。每一步都明确说明改哪个文件、改成什么、怎么知道改对了。

k11ikx55.en: First release: one of the four authoring paths
k11ikx55.zh: 首版:四条 authoring path 之一

kcqcw9k.en: The make-game-design skill. Type /make-game-design and it guides cc-coder-style agents, in about thirty minutes, to turn a one-line 'I want to make X' vision into a minimal, build-ready design doc covering gameplay, numbers, characters and chapters. The output lands in design/<slug>.md, which downstream workbenches read as ground truth.
kcqcw9k.zh: 做游戏设计技能。在对话里输入 /make-game-design 触发,引导 cc-coder 系列 agent 在大约 30 分钟内,把「我想做个 XX 游戏」的一句话愿景拆成一份可直接交给程序落代码的最小设计文档,涵盖玩法、数值、角色与章节。产出落到 design/<slug>.md,后续工作台直接读它作为 ground truth。

k1u5wgsz.en: The combat-resimulation tool. It exposes a single tool, balance:resim: run N PvP/PvE resimulations of a given scenario in an in-process worker and return the win-rate with a 95% confidence interval. It's the objective measure behind numeric balance, shared by the make-game-design skill and the Balance workbench, turning 'is this fair' from a guess into a statistic.
k1u5wgsz.zh: 战斗重模拟工具。暴露 balance:resim 一个工具:对指定 scenario 跑 N 次 PvP/PvE 重模拟,在 in-process worker 里算出胜率(winRate)与 95% 置信区间并返回。它是数值平衡的客观度量来源,被 /make-game-design 技能与平衡工作台共用,让「这套数值公不公平」从拍脑袋变成可统计的数字。

k16xv4qm.en: The Anthropic text model binding. On the text channel it declares the Anthropic vendor's capability list and a tier→model mapping: reasoning→opus, draft→sonnet, summarize→haiku, so each tier of task in Studio automatically uses the right Claude model. The plugin only declares the mapping; the actual HTTP is routed by the server's text channel.
k16xv4qm.zh: Anthropic 文本模型绑定。在 text 通道上声明 Anthropic 厂商的能力清单与「档位 → 模型」映射:reasoning 走 opus、draft 走 sonnet、summarize 走 haiku,让 Studio 里不同档位的任务自动用合适的 Claude 模型。本插件只声明映射,实际 HTTP 调用由 server 的 text 通道统一调度。
